sourceRange.text: 夏五月辛巳，以京師寺觀不甚清凈，詔曰：釋迦闡教，清凈為先，遠離塵垢，斷除貪欲。所以弘宣勝業，修植善根，開導愚迷，津梁品庶。是以敷演經教，檢約學徒，調懺身心，舍諸染著，衣服飲食，咸資四輩。自覺王遷謝，像法流行，末代陵遲，漸以虧濫。乃有猥賤之侶，規自尊高；浮惰之人，茍避徭役。妄為剃度，托號出家，嗜欲無厭，營求不息。出入閭里，周旋闤闠，驅策田產，聚積貨物。耕織為生，估販成業，事同編戶，跡等齊人。進違戒律之文，退無禮典之訓。至乃親行劫掠，躬自穿窬，造作妖訛，交通豪猾。每罹憲網，自陷重刑，黷亂真如，傾毀妙法。譬茲稂莠，有穢嘉苗；類彼淤泥，混夫清水。又伽藍之地，本曰凈居，棲心之所，理尚幽寂。近代以來，多立寺舍，不求閑曠之境，唯趨喧雜之方。繕採崎嶇，棟宇殊拓，錯舛隱匿，誘納奸邪。或有接延鄽邸，鄰近屠酤，埃塵滿室，膻腥盈道。徒長輕慢之心，有虧崇敬之義。且老氏垂化，實貴沖虛，養志無為，遺情物外。全真守一，是謂玄門，驅馳世務，尤乖宗旨。朕膺期馭宇，興隆教法，志思利益，情在護持。欲使玉石區分，薰蕕有辨，長存妙道，永固福田，正本澄源，宜從沙汰。諸僧、尼、道士、女寇等，有精勤練行、守戒律者，並令大寺觀居住，給衣食，勿令乏短。其不能精進、戒行有闕、不堪供養者，並令罷遣，各還桑梓。所司明為條式，務依法教，違制之事，悉宜停斷。京城留寺三所，觀二所。其餘天下諸州，各留一所。餘悉罷之。事竟不行。

manualTranslations.zh: 夏五月辛巳，以京師寺觀不甚清凈，詔曰：釋迦闡教，清凈為先，遠離塵垢，斷除貪欲。
manualTranslations.literal: In summer, fifth month, on xinsi, because the capital's Buddhist monasteries and Daoist temples were not very pure, an edict said: In the teaching expounded by Shakyamuni, purity comes first: one distances oneself from dust and defilement and cuts off greed and desire.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on xinsi, finding the capital's temples and monasteries impure, he issued an edict: Shakyamuni's teaching begins with purity, leaving defilement and desire behind.

manualTranslations.zh: 所以弘宣勝業，修植善根，開導愚迷，津梁品庶。
manualTranslations.literal: This is how the superior work is broadly proclaimed, good roots are cultivated and planted, the foolish and deluded are opened and guided, and the common people are ferried across.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Thus the teaching spreads merit, cultivates goodness, guides the ignorant, and ferries the people across.

manualTranslations.zh: 是以敷演經教，檢約學徒，調懺身心，舍諸染著，衣服飲食，咸資四輩。
manualTranslations.literal: Therefore scriptures and teachings are expounded, students are restrained and disciplined, body and mind are regulated and purified, all defilements and attachments are abandoned, and clothing and food are all supplied by the four groups of believers.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Scripture is taught, disciples are disciplined, body and mind are purified, attachments are abandoned, and clothing and food come from the four communities.

manualTranslations.zh: 自覺王遷謝，像法流行，末代陵遲，漸以虧濫。
manualTranslations.literal: Since the Enlightened King passed away and the age of semblance teachings has circulated, in later generations it has declined and gradually become deficient and excessive.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Since the Buddha's passing, the later age of the teaching has declined into abuses.

manualTranslations.zh: 乃有猥賤之侶，規自尊高；
manualTranslations.literal: There are low and base fellows who scheme to exalt themselves;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Base people seek status through it;

manualTranslations.zh: 浮惰之人，茍避徭役。
manualTranslations.literal: idle and lazy people casually avoid corvee service.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: the idle use it to evade labor service.

manualTranslations.zh: 妄為剃度，托號出家，嗜欲無厭，營求不息。
manualTranslations.literal: They recklessly undergo tonsure, falsely claim to have left the household, indulge desires without satiety, and seek profit without cease.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They take tonsure falsely, claim monastic status, and pursue appetite and gain without restraint.

manualTranslations.zh: 出入閭里，周旋闤闠，驅策田產，聚積貨物。
manualTranslations.literal: They go in and out of neighborhoods, move about marketplaces, manage fields and property, and accumulate goods.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They traffic through villages and markets, manage land and property, and pile up goods.

manualTranslations.zh: 耕織為生，估販成業，事同編戶，跡等齊人。
manualTranslations.literal: They live by farming and weaving, make trade their occupation, and in practice are the same as registered households, their conduct equal to commoners.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They farm, weave, and trade like ordinary registered households.

manualTranslations.zh: 進違戒律之文，退無禮典之訓。
manualTranslations.literal: Advancing, they violate the texts of discipline; withdrawing, they lack the instruction of ritual canons.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They violate monastic discipline and lack the teaching of ritual propriety.

manualTranslations.zh: 至乃親行劫掠，躬自穿窬，造作妖訛，交通豪猾。
manualTranslations.literal: Some even personally carry out robbery, themselves break through walls and climb over, fabricate strange deceptions, and associate with powerful scoundrels.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Some even commit robbery and burglary, spread occult frauds, and collude with powerful criminals.

manualTranslations.zh: 每罹憲網，自陷重刑，黷亂真如，傾毀妙法。
manualTranslations.literal: Whenever they fall into the net of law, they bring severe punishments on themselves, profaning true suchness and damaging the wondrous law.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the law catches them, their crimes profane the faith and damage the Dharma.

manualTranslations.zh: 譬茲稂莠，有穢嘉苗；
manualTranslations.literal: They are like weeds that foul good seedlings;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They are weeds among good sprouts;

manualTranslations.zh: 類彼淤泥，混夫清水。
manualTranslations.literal: they resemble silt and mud that muddle clear water.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: mud stirred into clear water.

manualTranslations.zh: 又伽藍之地，本曰凈居，棲心之所，理尚幽寂。
manualTranslations.literal: Moreover, the grounds of monasteries are originally called pure abodes; as places for lodging the mind, by principle they value quiet seclusion.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Monasteries are supposed to be pure dwellings, quiet places where the mind can rest.

manualTranslations.zh: 近代以來，多立寺舍，不求閑曠之境，唯趨喧雜之方。
manualTranslations.literal: In recent generations many temples have been established; they do not seek places that are quiet and open, but only hurry toward noisy and crowded locations.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Recently temples have multiplied, choosing busy places rather than quiet open ground.

manualTranslations.zh: 繕採崎嶇，棟宇殊拓，錯舛隱匿，誘納奸邪。
manualTranslations.literal: Their repairs and decorations are irregular, their buildings extravagantly expanded, confused and concealed, enticing and harboring the wicked.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Their buildings are sprawling and irregular, full of hidden corners that invite criminals.

manualTranslations.zh: 或有接延鄽邸，鄰近屠酤，埃塵滿室，膻腥盈道。
manualTranslations.literal: Some connect with shops and inns and neighbor butchers and wine sellers; dust fills the rooms and rank smells fill the roads.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Some adjoin shops, inns, slaughterers, and wine sellers, with dust inside and foul smells on the road.

manualTranslations.zh: 徒長輕慢之心，有虧崇敬之義。
manualTranslations.literal: They merely increase minds of contempt and negligence and diminish the meaning of reverence.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This only breeds contempt and damages reverence.

manualTranslations.zh: 且老氏垂化，實貴沖虛，養志無為，遺情物外。
manualTranslations.literal: Moreover, the teaching handed down by Laozi truly values emptiness and quietude, nourishing the will through non-action and leaving feelings beyond things.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Laozi's teaching values quiet emptiness, nurturing the will through non-action and leaving worldly things behind.

manualTranslations.zh: 全真守一，是謂玄門，驅馳世務，尤乖宗旨。
manualTranslations.literal: Preserving truth and guarding the One is what is called the Mysterious Gate; rushing about worldly affairs especially violates its central purpose.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: To preserve truth and guard the One is the Daoist way; bustling after worldly business is especially contrary to it.

manualTranslations.zh: 朕膺期馭宇，興隆教法，志思利益，情在護持。
manualTranslations.literal: I have answered the age and govern the realm, exalting and flourishing the teachings; my intent thinks on benefit, and my feelings lie in protecting and maintaining them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Having taken up rule, I wish to make the teachings flourish and protect what benefits the people.

manualTranslations.zh: 欲使玉石區分，薰蕕有辨，長存妙道，永固福田，正本澄源，宜從沙汰。
manualTranslations.literal: I wish jade and stone to be distinguished, fragrant thoroughwort and foul weeds to be differentiated, the wondrous Way to endure, and fields of merit to be forever secured; to correct the root and clarify the source, screening and elimination should be undertaken.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: To distinguish jade from stone and fragrance from stench, to preserve the Way and secure fields of merit, the root must be corrected through a purge.

manualTranslations.zh: 諸僧、尼、道士、女寇等，有精勤練行、守戒律者，並令大寺觀居住，給衣食，勿令乏短。
manualTranslations.literal: All monks, nuns, Daoist priests, Daoist nuns, and the like who diligently train in practice and keep the precepts and rules shall be made to reside in major monasteries and temples, and given clothing and food so that they are not deficient.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Monks, nuns, Daoists, and Daoist nuns who practice diligently and keep discipline are to live in major temples and monasteries, with clothing and food supplied.

manualTranslations.zh: 其不能精進、戒行有闕、不堪供養者，並令罷遣，各還桑梓。
manualTranslations.literal: Those who cannot be diligent, whose observance is deficient, and who are unworthy of support shall all be dismissed and sent back, each to his or her native place.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Those who are not diligent, lack discipline, or do not merit support are to be dismissed and sent home.

manualTranslations.zh: 所司明為條式，務依法教，違制之事，悉宜停斷。
manualTranslations.literal: The responsible offices shall clearly make regulations, striving to follow the teachings; all matters that violate the edict should be stopped.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The offices shall set clear rules according to the teachings and stop all violations.

manualTranslations.zh: 京城留寺三所，觀二所。
manualTranslations.literal: In the capital, leave three Buddhist monasteries and two Daoist temples.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The capital shall retain three monasteries and two Daoist temples.

manualTranslations.zh: 其餘天下諸州，各留一所。
manualTranslations.literal: In all other prefectures under Heaven, each shall retain one.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Every other prefecture shall retain one.

manualTranslations.zh: 餘悉罷之。
manualTranslations.literal: All the rest shall be abolished.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: All others are to be abolished.

manualTranslations.zh: 事竟不行。
manualTranslations.literal: In the end the matter was not carried out.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the end, the order was not implemented.

sourceRange.text: 戊午，隋帝詔曰：天禍隋國，大行太上皇遇盜江都，酷甚望夷，釁深驪北。憫予小子，奄造丕愆，哀號永感，心情糜潰。仰惟荼毒，仇復靡申，形影相吊，罔知啟處。相國唐王，膺期命世，扶危拯溺，自北徂南，東征西怨。致九合於諸侯，決百勝於千里。糾率夷夏，大庇氓黎，保乂朕躬，系王是賴。德侔造化，功格蒼旻，兆庶歸心，歷數斯在，屈為人臣，載違天命。在昔虞、夏，揖讓相推，茍非重華，誰堪命禹。當今九服崩離，三靈改卜，大運去矣，請避賢路。兆謀布德，顧己莫能，私僮命駕，須歸籓國。予本代王，及予而代，天之所廢，豈其如是！庶憑稽古之聖，以誅四兇；幸值惟新之恩，預充三恪。雪冤恥於皇祖，守禋祀為孝孫，朝聞夕殞，及泉無恨。今遵故事，遜於舊邸，庶官群闢，改事唐朝。宜依前典，趨上尊號，若釋重負，感泰兼懷。假手真人，俾除醜逆，濟濟多士，明知朕意。仍敕有司，凡有表奏，皆不得以聞。

manualTranslations.zh: 戊午，隋帝詔曰：天禍隋國，大行太上皇遇盜江都，酷甚望夷，釁深驪北。
manualTranslations.literal: On wuwu, the Sui emperor issued an edict: Heaven has brought disaster on Sui; the late Emperor Emeritus met bandits at Jiangdu, in cruelty worse than Wangyi and in guilt deeper than Li Bei.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On wuwu the Sui emperor proclaimed that Heaven had ruined Sui: the late Emperor Emeritus had been murdered at Jiangdu in an outrage surpassing the infamous regicides of antiquity.

manualTranslations.zh: 憫予小子，奄造丕愆，哀號永感，心情糜潰。
manualTranslations.literal: Pity me, the young one, suddenly brought to this great fault; my grief and wailing are everlasting, and my heart and mind are shattered.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I, young and pitiable, have suddenly inherited this great calamity; grief has broken my heart.

manualTranslations.zh: 仰惟荼毒，仇復靡申，形影相吊，罔知啟處。
manualTranslations.literal: Looking up and thinking on this cruelty, vengeance cannot be carried out; body and shadow mourn each other, and I do not know where to turn.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When I contemplate the cruelty, unable to avenge it, I am left alone with my shadow and have no refuge.

manualTranslations.zh: 相國唐王，膺期命世，扶危拯溺，自北徂南，東征西怨。
manualTranslations.literal: The Chancellor, the Prince of Tang, answered the age and was commanded for the world; he supported the endangered and rescued the drowning, going from north to south, while east and west longed for him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Prince of Tang arose in answer to the times, rescuing the realm from peril from north to south as all quarters looked to him.

manualTranslations.zh: 致九合於諸侯，決百勝於千里。
manualTranslations.literal: He brought about the ninefold assembly of the feudal lords and decided a hundred victories across a thousand li.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He united the lords and won victory after victory across the empire.

manualTranslations.zh: 糾率夷夏，大庇氓黎，保乂朕躬，系王是賴。
manualTranslations.literal: He marshaled Yi and Xia, broadly sheltered the people, and protected and ordered my person; I relied entirely on the prince.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He rallied Chinese and non-Chinese alike, protected the people, and safeguarded me; all depended on him.

manualTranslations.zh: 德侔造化，功格蒼旻，兆庶歸心，歷數斯在，屈為人臣，載違天命。
manualTranslations.literal: His virtue matches creation, his merit reaches azure Heaven; the multitudes turn their hearts to him, and the calendrical mandate rests with him; to bend him as a subject would violate Heaven's command.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His virtue and merit reach Heaven, the people have given him their hearts, and the mandate is his; keeping him as a subject would defy Heaven.

manualTranslations.zh: 在昔虞、夏，揖讓相推，茍非重華，誰堪命禹。
manualTranslations.literal: In ancient Yu and Xia, abdication was passed on by yielding; if it had not been Chonghua, who would have been fit to command Yu?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the age of Yao and Shun, abdication followed worth; only Shun was fit to charge Yu with the realm.

manualTranslations.zh: 當今九服崩離，三靈改卜，大運去矣，請避賢路。
manualTranslations.literal: Now the Nine Domains have collapsed and parted, the Three Spirits have changed their choice, and the great fortune has departed; I ask to withdraw from the path of the worthy.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Now the empire has fallen apart, Heaven, Earth, and Man have chosen anew, and the great mandate is gone; I ask to step aside for the worthy.

manualTranslations.zh: 兆謀布德，顧己莫能，私僮命駕，須歸籓國。
manualTranslations.literal: To plan for the multitudes and spread virtue is beyond me when I look to myself; as a private servant I order the carriage and must return to my feudal state.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I cannot govern and spread virtue for the people; I should depart and return to my own fief.

manualTranslations.zh: 予本代王，及予而代，天之所廢，豈其如是！
manualTranslations.literal: I was originally Prince of Dai, and when it came to me the dynasty was replaced; what Heaven has discarded, could it be otherwise?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I was only Prince of Dai, and in my hands the dynasty has ended; how can what Heaven has cast off be otherwise?

manualTranslations.zh: 庶憑稽古之聖，以誅四兇；
manualTranslations.literal: I hope to rely on a sage who examines antiquity to punish the Four Evils;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I hope the sage who follows antiquity will punish the wicked;

manualTranslations.zh: 幸值惟新之恩，預充三恪。
manualTranslations.literal: I am fortunate to encounter the grace of renewal and to be provisionally included among the Three Honored Guests.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: through the grace of the new dynasty, may I be allowed a place among the honored guests of former houses.

manualTranslations.zh: 雪冤恥於皇祖，守禋祀為孝孫，朝聞夕殞，及泉無恨。
manualTranslations.literal: If I can wash away the wrong and shame of my imperial ancestor and preserve the sacrifices as a filial descendant, then hearing it in the morning and dying by evening, I would have no regret even in the springs below.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: If I can cleanse my ancestors' shame and preserve their sacrifices as a filial descendant, I could die the same day without regret.

manualTranslations.zh: 今遵故事，遜於舊邸，庶官群闢，改事唐朝。
manualTranslations.literal: Now, following precedent, I withdraw to my former residence; the many officials and ministers shall transfer their service to the Tang court.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I now follow precedent and retire to my old residence; all officials are to serve the Tang court.

manualTranslations.zh: 宜依前典，趨上尊號，若釋重負，感泰兼懷。
manualTranslations.literal: You should follow former canons and hasten to present the exalted title; it is like releasing a heavy burden, and I feel peace and gratitude together.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In accordance with precedent, hasten to offer him the imperial title; I feel as though a heavy burden has been lifted.

manualTranslations.zh: 假手真人，俾除醜逆，濟濟多士，明知朕意。
manualTranslations.literal: Borrow the hand of the True Man and cause the ugly rebels to be removed; let the many assembled officers clearly know my intent.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Through the True Man, let the rebels be eliminated; let all assembled officers understand my will.

manualTranslations.zh: 仍敕有司，凡有表奏，皆不得以聞。
manualTranslations.literal: It is further ordered to the responsible offices that any memorials or submissions are not to be reported to me.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The offices are further ordered not to forward any memorials or submissions to me.

sourceRange.text: 」詔曰：天地定位，君臣之義以彰；卑高既陳，人倫之道斯著。是用篤厚風俗，化成天下。雖復時經治亂，主或昏明，疾風勁草，芬芳無絕，剖心焚體，赴蹈如歸。夫豈不愛七尺之軀，重百年之命？諒由君臣義重，名教所先，故能明大節於當時，立清風於身後。至如趙高之殞二世，董卓之鴆弘農，人神所疾，異代同憤。況凡庸小豎，有懷兇悖，遐觀典策，莫不誅夷。辰州刺史、長蛇縣男裴虔通，昔在隋代，委質晉籓，煬帝以舊邸之情，特相愛幸。遂乃志蔑君親，潛圖弒逆，密伺間隙，招結群醜，長戟流矢，一朝竊發。天下之惡，孰云可忍！宜其夷宗焚首，以彰大戮。但年代異時，累逢赦令，可特免極刑，除名削爵，遷配驩州。

localRange.text: 詔曰：

manualTranslations.zh: 」詔曰：天地定位，君臣之義以彰；
manualTranslations.literal: An edict said: When Heaven and Earth are fixed in their positions, the duty between ruler and minister is made manifest;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He issued an edict: With Heaven and Earth in their places, the duty of ruler and minister is clear;

manualTranslations.zh: 卑高既陳，人倫之道斯著。
manualTranslations.literal: when low and high have been set forth, the way of human relations is thereby made evident.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: with high and low properly ordered, the human order is manifest.

manualTranslations.zh: 是用篤厚風俗，化成天下。
manualTranslations.literal: By this customs are made sincere and substantial, and transformation is completed throughout the realm.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Thus customs are deepened and the realm is transformed.

manualTranslations.zh: 雖復時經治亂，主或昏明，疾風勁草，芬芳無絕，剖心焚體，赴蹈如歸。
manualTranslations.literal: Though times pass through order and disorder and rulers may be benighted or enlightened, strong grass shows in a harsh wind; fragrance never ceases, and men have cut out their hearts and burned their bodies, going to death as if returning home.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Even through ordered and chaotic ages, under dark or enlightened rulers, loyal men stand like strong grass in a gale; their fragrance endures, and they go to death as if going home.

manualTranslations.zh: 夫豈不愛七尺之軀，重百年之命？
manualTranslations.literal: How could they not love their seven-foot bodies and value lives of a hundred years?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Surely they loved their bodies and valued their lives.

manualTranslations.zh: 諒由君臣義重，名教所先，故能明大節於當時，立清風於身後。
manualTranslations.literal: It is truly because the duty of ruler and minister is weighty and is foremost in moral teaching that they could make the great principle clear in their time and establish a pure reputation after death.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: But because the bond of ruler and minister is paramount, they displayed great integrity in life and left a pure example after death.

manualTranslations.zh: 至如趙高之殞二世，董卓之鴆弘農，人神所疾，異代同憤。
manualTranslations.literal: As for Zhao Gao causing the death of the Second Emperor and Dong Zhuo poisoning the Prince of Hongnong, these are hated by humans and spirits alike, and different ages share the same indignation.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhao Gao murdering the Second Emperor and Dong Zhuo poisoning the Prince of Hongnong are crimes abhorred by men and spirits in every age.

manualTranslations.zh: 況凡庸小豎，有懷兇悖，遐觀典策，莫不誅夷。
manualTranslations.literal: How much more when ordinary, petty knaves harbor savage rebellion: looking broadly through the records, none were not executed and exterminated.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: How much more should petty villains who harbor murderous treason be punished; the histories show none escaped destruction.

manualTranslations.zh: 辰州刺史、長蛇縣男裴虔通，昔在隋代，委質晉籓，煬帝以舊邸之情，特相愛幸。
manualTranslations.literal: Pei Qiantong, prefect of Chenzhou and baron of Changshe county, formerly in the Sui entrusted himself to the Jin princely establishment, and Emperor Yang, because of affection from his old residence, especially favored and loved him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Pei Qiantong, prefect of Chenzhou and baron of Changshe, had served in the Sui under the Prince of Jin, and Emperor Yang especially favored him for that old connection.

manualTranslations.zh: 遂乃志蔑君親，潛圖弒逆，密伺間隙，招結群醜，長戟流矢，一朝竊發。
manualTranslations.literal: Yet he then set his mind on despising ruler and kin, secretly plotted regicide and rebellion, watched covertly for an opening, gathered a gang of villains, and in one morning let long halberds and flying arrows suddenly break out.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yet he scorned lord and kin, plotted regicide, waited for his chance, gathered villains, and one morning unleashed weapons in revolt.

manualTranslations.zh: 天下之惡，孰云可忍！
manualTranslations.literal: Of all evils under Heaven, who could say this can be endured!
manualTranslations.idiomatic: What evil in the world could be less tolerable?

manualTranslations.zh: 宜其夷宗焚首，以彰大戮。
manualTranslations.literal: It would be proper to exterminate his clan and burn his head, in order to display the great punishment.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His clan should be exterminated and his head burned to manifest the full punishment.

manualTranslations.zh: 但年代異時，累逢赦令，可特免極刑，除名削爵，遷配驩州。
manualTranslations.literal: But because the years and times are different and he has repeatedly encountered amnesty orders, he may be specially spared the extreme penalty, removed from the registers, stripped of his rank, and exiled to Huanzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: But since time has passed and repeated amnesties have intervened, he is specially spared execution: remove his name, strip his title, and exile him to Huanzhou.

sourceRange.text: 二月丁巳，詔曰：夫生者天地之大德，壽者修短之一期。生有七尺之形，壽以百齡為限，含靈稟氣，莫不同焉，皆得之於自然，不可以分外企也。是以《禮記》云：「君即位而為椑」。莊周云：「勞我以形，息我以死。」豈非聖人遠鑒，通賢深識？末代已來，明闢蓋寡，靡不矜黃屋之尊，慮白駒之過，並多拘忌，有慕遐年。謂雲車易乘，羲輪可駐，異軌同趣，其蔽甚矣。有隋之季，海內橫流，豺狼肆暴，吞噬黔首。朕投袂發憤，情深拯溺，扶翼義師，濟斯塗炭。賴蒼昊降鑒，股肱宣力，提劍指麾，天下大定。此朕之宿志，於斯已畢。猶恐身後之日，子子孫孫，習於流俗，猶循常禮，加四重之櫬，伐百祀之木，勞擾百姓，崇厚園陵。今預為此制，務從儉約，於九嵕之山，足容棺而已。積以歲月，漸而備之。木馬塗車，土桴葦龠，事合古典，不為時用。又佐命功臣，或義深舟楫，或謀定帷幄，或身摧行陣，同濟艱危，克成鴻業，追念在昔，何日忘之！使逝者無知，咸歸寂寞；若營魂有識，還如疇曩，居止相望，不亦善乎！漢氏使將相陪陵，又給以東園秘器，篤終之義，恩意深厚，古人豈異我哉！自今已後，功臣密戚及德業佐時者，如有薨亡，宜賜塋地一所，及以秘器，使窀穸之時，喪事無闕。所司依此營備，稱朕意焉。

manualTranslations.zh: 二月丁巳，詔曰：夫生者天地之大德，壽者修短之一期。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second month, on dingsi, an edict said: Life is the great virtue of Heaven and Earth; lifespan is a single term, whether long or short.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On dingsi of the second month he issued an edict: Life is Heaven and Earth's great virtue, and longevity is only a term that may be long or short.

manualTranslations.zh: 生有七尺之形，壽以百齡為限，含靈稟氣，莫不同焉，皆得之於自然，不可以分外企也。
manualTranslations.literal: In life one has a seven-foot form, and lifespan is bounded by a hundred years; all who contain spirit and receive qi are alike in this, all receiving it from nature, and one cannot seek beyond one's allotted share.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: A person is born with a body and a finite span; all living beings receive this from nature, and none can reach beyond their lot.

manualTranslations.zh: 是以《禮記》云：「君即位而為椑」。
manualTranslations.literal: Therefore the Record of Rites says, "When a ruler takes the throne, he makes his inner coffin."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Thus the Record of Rites says that when a ruler comes to the throne, he prepares his coffin.

manualTranslations.zh: 莊周云：「勞我以形，息我以死。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhuang Zhou said, "It burdens me with form and rests me with death.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhuang Zhou said, "It gives me labor in bodily form and rest in death.

manualTranslations.zh: 」豈非聖人遠鑒，通賢深識？
manualTranslations.literal: "Is this not the far-sighted discernment of sages and the deep understanding of penetrating worthies?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Was this not the far-sighted understanding of sages and wise men?

manualTranslations.zh: 末代已來，明闢蓋寡，靡不矜黃屋之尊，慮白駒之過，並多拘忌，有慕遐年。
manualTranslations.literal: Since later ages, enlightened rulers have been few; none has failed to prize the honor of the yellow-canopied carriage, worry over the passing of the white colt, become much constrained by taboos, and long for extended years.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In later ages enlightened rulers have been rare; they cling to imperial honor, fear life's swift passing, obsess over taboos, and yearn for unnatural longevity.

manualTranslations.zh: 謂雲車易乘，羲輪可駐，異軌同趣，其蔽甚矣。
manualTranslations.literal: They say cloud carriages can be mounted and Xihe's wheel can be halted; though their tracks differ, their destination is the same, and their delusion is extreme.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They imagine cloud chariots can be ridden and the sun's wheel stopped; whatever the method, the delusion is the same.

manualTranslations.zh: 有隋之季，海內橫流，豺狼肆暴，吞噬黔首。
manualTranslations.literal: At the end of the Sui, all within the seas overflowed with disorder; wolves and jackals unleashed violence and devoured the common people.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the end of Sui the realm was in flood, and violent predators devoured the people.

manualTranslations.zh: 朕投袂發憤，情深拯溺，扶翼義師，濟斯塗炭。
manualTranslations.literal: I shook out my sleeves and roused my indignation, deeply intent on rescuing the drowning, aiding the righteous army, and saving those in mud and fire.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I rose in anger to rescue the drowning people, support the righteous army, and save them from misery.

manualTranslations.zh: 賴蒼昊降鑒，股肱宣力，提劍指麾，天下大定。
manualTranslations.literal: Relying on azure Heaven lowering its gaze and on my arms and legs exerting their strength, I raised the sword and gave commands, and the realm was greatly settled.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Thanks to Heaven's favor and my ministers' efforts, I took command and brought the realm to peace.

manualTranslations.zh: 此朕之宿志，於斯已畢。
manualTranslations.literal: This long-held aspiration of mine has now been completed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: My long-standing purpose is now fulfilled.

manualTranslations.zh: 猶恐身後之日，子子孫孫，習於流俗，猶循常禮，加四重之櫬，伐百祀之木，勞擾百姓，崇厚園陵。
manualTranslations.literal: Still I fear that after my death, sons and grandsons, accustomed to common custom, will follow ordinary rites, add four layers of coffins, cut trees of a hundred years, trouble the people with labor, and make the tomb mound grand and thick.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: But I fear that after my death my descendants, following custom, will use multiple coffins, fell ancient trees, burden the people, and build an extravagant mausoleum.

manualTranslations.zh: 今預為此制，務從儉約，於九嵕之山，足容棺而已。
manualTranslations.literal: I now make this regulation in advance: make every effort to follow frugality; at Mount Jiuzong, it need only be enough to contain the coffin.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I therefore set this rule in advance: keep everything frugal; at Mount Jiuzong, make only enough space for the coffin.

manualTranslations.zh: 積以歲月，漸而備之。
manualTranslations.literal: Accumulate it over months and years, gradually preparing it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Prepare it gradually over time.

manualTranslations.zh: 木馬塗車，土桴葦龠，事合古典，不為時用。
manualTranslations.literal: Wooden horses and clay carriages, earthen drumsticks and reed pipes: these matters accord with ancient canons and are not for contemporary use.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wooden horses, clay carriages, earthen beaters, and reed pipes belong to ancient precedent, not present practice.

manualTranslations.zh: 又佐命功臣，或義深舟楫，或謀定帷幄，或身摧行陣，同濟艱危，克成鴻業，追念在昔，何日忘之！
manualTranslations.literal: Moreover, among meritorious ministers who aided the mandate, some had loyalty deep as boats and oars, some fixed plans within the command tent, and some broke their bodies in the battle ranks; together they crossed hardship and danger and completed the great enterprise. When I recall the past, on what day could I forget them!
manualTranslations.idiomatic: As for the founding ministers, some ferried the cause with loyal service, some planned in the command tent, and some risked their lives in battle. Together we survived danger and achieved the great enterprise; how could I ever forget them?

manualTranslations.zh: 使逝者無知，咸歸寂寞；
manualTranslations.literal: If the dead have no awareness, all returns to silence and stillness;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: If the dead know nothing, all returns to silence;

manualTranslations.zh: 若營魂有識，還如疇曩，居止相望，不亦善乎！
manualTranslations.literal: if the souls of the dead have awareness and are still as before, would it not be good for our dwellings and resting places to face one another?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: if their souls remain aware, would it not be good for us to rest within sight of one another as before?

manualTranslations.zh: 漢氏使將相陪陵，又給以東園秘器，篤終之義，恩意深厚，古人豈異我哉！
manualTranslations.literal: The Han house had generals and ministers accompany the imperial陵 and also supplied them with secret vessels from the Eastern Park; the meaning of honoring the end and the depth of grace were profound. How were the ancients different from me?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Han had generals and ministers buried near the imperial tombs and supplied them with Eastern Park burial goods; their care for the dead was deep. The ancients were no different from me.

manualTranslations.zh: 自今已後，功臣密戚及德業佐時者，如有薨亡，宜賜塋地一所，及以秘器，使窀穸之時，喪事無闕。
manualTranslations.literal: From now on, when meritorious ministers, close relatives, and those whose virtue and achievement aided the age die, they should be granted one burial plot and burial vessels, so that at the time of interment the funeral affairs lack nothing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From now on, when meritorious ministers, close kin, or men whose virtue and service aided the age die, grant them burial land and funerary vessels so their burials lack nothing.

manualTranslations.zh: 所司依此營備，稱朕意焉。

sourceRange.text: 夏四月辛丑，制曰：朕聞措刑由於用刑，去殺存乎必殺。明罰峻典，自古而然；立制齊人，於是乎在。自我朝建國，僅將百年，天下和平，其來已久。往承隋季，守法頗專；比襲時安，持綱日緩。況朕薄德，甚莫逮先；惟人難理，遠不如昔。粵從守位，三載於茲，庶務煩勞，不損晷景。嘗謂自我作則，感而成化；痛乎迷俗忘返，不威罔懲。將至純風，先歸重典。比者贓賄不息，渝濫公行，放心未寧，禁犯無懼。此焉暫革，期於承平，遂割小慈，以崇大體。自今已後，造偽頭首者斬，仍沒一房資財，同用廕者並停奪。非頭首者絞。其承前造偽人，限十日內首使盡。官典主司枉法受贓一匹已上，先決杖一百。其緣贓及惡狀被解及與替者，非選時不得輒入京城。縱家貫在京，不得輒至朝堂，妄有披訴。如有此色，並決杖仍加貶斥。其先在京城者，限三日內勒還。上下官僚輒緣私情相囑者，其受囑人宜封狀奏聞。成器已下，朕自決罰。其餘王公已下，並解見任官，三五年間不須齒錄。其進狀人別加褒賞。御史宜令分察諸司。

manualTranslations.zh: 夏四月辛丑，制曰：朕聞措刑由於用刑，去殺存乎必殺。
manualTranslations.literal: In summer, fourth month, on xinchou, a decree said: I have heard that setting punishments aside comes from using punishments, and removing killing depends on killing when it is necessary.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On xinchou of the fourth summer month he decreed: Punishment can be set aside only when punishment is properly used; killing can be ended only when necessary killing is enforced.

manualTranslations.zh: 明罰峻典，自古而然；
manualTranslations.literal: Clear punishments and stern statutes have been so since antiquity;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Clear penalties and strict laws have existed since antiquity;

manualTranslations.zh: 立制齊人，於是乎在。
manualTranslations.literal: establishing regulations and ordering the people lies in this.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: this is how institutions are set and the people made orderly.

manualTranslations.zh: 自我朝建國，僅將百年，天下和平，其來已久。
manualTranslations.literal: Since our dynasty founded the state, nearly a hundred years have passed, and peace under Heaven has lasted a long time.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Almost a century has passed since our dynasty was founded, and the realm has long been at peace.

manualTranslations.zh: 往承隋季，守法頗專；
manualTranslations.literal: Earlier, inheriting the end of Sui, enforcement of the law was rather strict;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At first, coming after Sui's collapse, the law was kept strictly;

manualTranslations.zh: 比襲時安，持綱日緩。
manualTranslations.literal: recently, continuing in an age of peace, holding the guiding cords has daily become lax.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: but as peace became habitual, discipline slackened day by day.

manualTranslations.zh: 況朕薄德，甚莫逮先；
manualTranslations.literal: Moreover, my virtue is meager and falls far short of my predecessors;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: My own virtue is slight and far below that of my forebears;

manualTranslations.zh: 惟人難理，遠不如昔。
manualTranslations.literal: and the people are hard to govern, far unlike those of former times.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: and the people are harder to govern than in the past.

manualTranslations.zh: 粵從守位，三載於茲，庶務煩勞，不損晷景。
manualTranslations.literal: Since I began holding the throne, three years have passed; the many affairs are burdensome, and not a moment of daylight has been spared.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Since I took the throne three years ago, public affairs have been so pressing that no daylight has been wasted.

manualTranslations.zh: 嘗謂自我作則，感而成化；
manualTranslations.literal: I once thought that if I set the rule myself, people would be moved and transformation would be completed;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I once believed that if I set the example, the people would be moved and transformed;

manualTranslations.zh: 痛乎迷俗忘返，不威罔懲。
manualTranslations.literal: but it is painful that deluded customs forget to return; without awe, there is no punishment.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: but corrupt custom has lost its way, and without severity it cannot be checked.

manualTranslations.zh: 將至純風，先歸重典。
manualTranslations.literal: To arrive at pure customs, one must first return to heavy statutes.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: To restore pure custom, we must first return to stern law.

manualTranslations.zh: 比者贓賄不息，渝濫公行，放心未寧，禁犯無懼。
manualTranslations.literal: Recently bribes and illicit gains have not ceased, abuse and excess are openly practiced, unrestrained minds are not settled, and those who violate prohibitions have no fear.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lately bribery has not stopped, abuses are public, reckless minds are unsettled, and offenders no longer fear the law.

manualTranslations.zh: 此焉暫革，期於承平，遂割小慈，以崇大體。
manualTranslations.literal: This must now be reformed temporarily, with the aim of lasting peace; therefore I cut off small compassion in order to honor the greater order.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This must be corrected for the sake of peace; I set aside lesser mercy to uphold the larger order.

manualTranslations.zh: 自今已後，造偽頭首者斬，仍沒一房資財，同用廕者並停奪。
manualTranslations.literal: From now on, ringleaders in forgery shall be beheaded, and the property of one household branch shall be confiscated; those who jointly used hereditary privilege shall all have it suspended and stripped away.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From now on, leaders of forgery cases are to be beheaded, one household branch's property confiscated, and anyone who shared in the use of inherited privilege is to have it suspended and revoked.

manualTranslations.zh: 非頭首者絞。
manualTranslations.literal: Those who are not ringleaders shall be strangled.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Non-ringleaders are to be strangled.

manualTranslations.zh: 其承前造偽人，限十日內首使盡。
manualTranslations.literal: As for those who committed forgery before this, they are limited to ten days in which to surrender and fully confess.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Those guilty of earlier forgery have ten days to surrender and make full confession.

manualTranslations.zh: 官典主司枉法受贓一匹已上，先決杖一百。
manualTranslations.literal: Officials, clerks, and responsible offices who bend the law and accept illicit goods of one bolt or more shall first receive one hundred strokes of the rod.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Officials or clerks in charge who take bribes of one bolt or more in violation of the law shall first be given one hundred strokes.

manualTranslations.zh: 其緣贓及惡狀被解及與替者，非選時不得輒入京城。
manualTranslations.literal: Those who have been dismissed or replaced on account of illicit goods or evil conduct may not casually enter the capital except during selection time.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Those dismissed or replaced for corruption or misconduct may not enter the capital except at official selection time.

manualTranslations.zh: 縱家貫在京，不得輒至朝堂，妄有披訴。
manualTranslations.literal: Even if their family registration is in the capital, they may not casually go to the court hall and recklessly present complaints.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Even those registered in the capital may not go to court and file reckless petitions.

manualTranslations.zh: 如有此色，並決杖仍加貶斥。
manualTranslations.literal: If there are people of this kind, they shall all be beaten with the rod and further demoted and expelled.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Anyone doing so shall be beaten and further demoted or expelled.

manualTranslations.zh: 其先在京城者，限三日內勒還。
manualTranslations.literal: Those who were already in the capital shall be compelled to return within three days.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Those already in the capital must be forced to leave within three days.

manualTranslations.zh: 上下官僚輒緣私情相囑者，其受囑人宜封狀奏聞。
manualTranslations.literal: When officials high or low rashly make requests of one another on private grounds, the person receiving the request should seal a statement and report it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: If officials use private ties to press requests, the recipient must seal a written report and submit it.

manualTranslations.zh: 成器已下，朕自決罰。
manualTranslations.literal: From Chengqi on down, I myself will decide the punishment.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: For Chengqi and those below him, I will decide the penalties myself.

manualTranslations.zh: 其餘王公已下，並解見任官，三五年間不須齒錄。
manualTranslations.literal: All other princes, dukes, and below shall be relieved of their current offices and need not be ranked or recorded for three to five years.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Other princes, dukes, and lower nobles are to be removed from current office and excluded from consideration for three to five years.

manualTranslations.zh: 其進狀人別加褒賞。
manualTranslations.literal: Those who submit statements shall be separately commended and rewarded.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Those who report such matters will receive special commendation and reward.

manualTranslations.zh: 御史宜令分察諸司。
manualTranslations.literal: The censors should be ordered to divide up and inspect the various offices.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The censors shall separately inspect the offices.

sourceRange.text: 丙午，制曰：舜去四兇而功格天地，武有七德而戡定黎人，故知有大勛者必受神明之福，仗高義者必為匕鬯之主。朕恭臨寶位，亭育寰區，以萬物之心為心，以兆人之命為命。雖承繼之道，咸以塚嫡居尊；而無私之懷，必推功業為首。然後可保安社稷，永奉宗祧。第三子平王基孝而克忠，義而能勇。比以朕居籓邸，虔守國彞，貴戚中人，都無引接。群邪害正，兇黨實繁，利口巧言，讒說罔極。韋溫、延秀，朋黨競起；晉卿、楚客，交構其間。潛結回邪，排擠端善，潛貯兵甲，將害朕躬。基密聞其期，先難奮發，推身鞠弭，眾應如歸，呼吸之間，兇渠殄滅。安七廟於幾墜，拯群臣於將殞。方舜之功過四，比武之德逾七。靈祇望在，昆弟樂推。一人元良，萬邦以定。為副君者，非此而誰？可立為皇太子。有司擇日，備禮冊命。

manualTranslations.zh: 丙午，制曰：舜去四兇而功格天地，武有七德而戡定黎人，故知有大勛者必受神明之福，仗高義者必為匕鬯之主。
manualTranslations.literal: On bingwu, a decree said: Shun removed the Four Evils and his merit reached Heaven and Earth; King Wu possessed the seven virtues and pacified the people. Thus we know that one with great merit must receive the blessing of spirits, and one who upholds high righteousness must become master of the ladle and libation vessel.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On bingwu he decreed: Shun cast out the Four Evils and his merit reached Heaven and Earth; King Wu had the seven virtues and settled the people. Great merit receives divine blessing, and high righteousness qualifies one to preside over the ancestral sacrifices.

manualTranslations.zh: 朕恭臨寶位，亭育寰區，以萬物之心為心，以兆人之命為命。
manualTranslations.literal: I reverently occupy the precious throne and nurture the realm, taking the mind of all things as my mind and the lives of the multitude as my charge.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I reverently hold the throne and nurture the realm, making the people's hearts my heart and their lives my responsibility.

manualTranslations.zh: 雖承繼之道，咸以塚嫡居尊；
manualTranslations.literal: Although in the way of succession the principal heir is generally placed in honor;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In succession, the principal heir is normally honored;

manualTranslations.zh: 而無私之懷，必推功業為首。
manualTranslations.literal: yet in a mind without private partiality, merit and achievement must be put first.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: but impartial judgment must put merit first.

manualTranslations.zh: 然後可保安社稷，永奉宗祧。
manualTranslations.literal: Only then can the altars of soil and grain be secured and the ancestral temples be served forever.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Only thus can the state be secured and the ancestral line served forever.

manualTranslations.zh: 第三子平王基孝而克忠，義而能勇。
manualTranslations.literal: My third son, Prince Ji of Ping, is filial and able to be loyal, righteous and able to be brave.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: My third son, Prince Ji of Ping, is filial, loyal, righteous, and brave.

manualTranslations.zh: 比以朕居籓邸，虔守國彞，貴戚中人，都無引接。
manualTranslations.literal: Recently, while I resided in my princely mansion and reverently kept the state norms, I had no dealings at all with noble relatives or palace attendants.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: While I lived in my princely residence and kept to state norms, I had no contact with powerful relatives or palace insiders.

manualTranslations.zh: 群邪害正，兇黨實繁，利口巧言，讒說罔極。
manualTranslations.literal: Many evildoers harmed the upright, the wicked faction was truly numerous, and smooth mouths and clever words produced slanders without limit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Evil men harmed the upright; the wicked faction was large, and slanderous clever talk had no limit.

manualTranslations.zh: 韋溫、延秀，朋黨競起；
manualTranslations.literal: Wei Wen and Yanxiu raised competing factions;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wei Wen and Yanxiu raised factions;

manualTranslations.zh: 晉卿、楚客，交構其間。
manualTranslations.literal: Jinqing and Chuke wove plots among them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jinqing and Chuke joined the plotting.

manualTranslations.zh: 潛結回邪，排擠端善，潛貯兵甲，將害朕躬。
manualTranslations.literal: They secretly linked with crooked evildoers, pushed out the upright and good, secretly stored arms and armor, and were about to harm my person.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They secretly joined the wicked, displaced the good, stockpiled weapons, and meant to harm me.

manualTranslations.zh: 基密聞其期，先難奮發，推身鞠弭，眾應如歸，呼吸之間，兇渠殄滅。
manualTranslations.literal: Ji secretly learned their appointed time, rose first against the disaster, put himself forward and bent to suppress it; the people responded as if returning home, and in a breath the chief villains were exterminated.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Ji learned the timing in secret, acted first to meet the crisis, threw himself into suppressing it, and the troops rallied to him; in moments the ringleaders were destroyed.

manualTranslations.zh: 安七廟於幾墜，拯群臣於將殞。
manualTranslations.literal: He secured the Seven Temples when they were about to fall and rescued the ministers when they were about to perish.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He saved the ancestral temples from collapse and the ministers from death.

manualTranslations.zh: 方舜之功過四，比武之德逾七。
manualTranslations.literal: Compared with Shun, his merit surpasses removing the four; compared with Wu, his virtue exceeds the seven.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Measured against Shun and King Wu, his merit and virtue go beyond the old examples.

manualTranslations.zh: 靈祇望在，昆弟樂推。
manualTranslations.literal: Spirits look to him, and his brothers gladly advance him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The spirits look to him, and his brothers gladly support him.

manualTranslations.zh: 一人元良，萬邦以定。
manualTranslations.literal: When the one man is primary and good, the myriad states are thereby settled.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: With such a worthy heir, all states will be secure.

manualTranslations.zh: 為副君者，非此而誰？
manualTranslations.literal: As for becoming the deputy ruler, if not this man, then who?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Who but he should be deputy ruler?

manualTranslations.zh: 可立為皇太子。
manualTranslations.literal: He may be established as Crown Prince.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He is to be established as Crown Prince.

manualTranslations.zh: 有司擇日，備禮冊命。
manualTranslations.literal: The responsible offices shall choose a day and prepare the rites for investiture by tablet.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The offices shall choose the date and prepare the full investiture rites.

sourceRange.text: 」七月壬午，制曰：朕以寡昧，虔奉鴻休，本殊王季之賢，早達延陵之節。昔在聖歷，已讓皇嗣之尊；爰暨神龍，終辭太弟之授。豈唯衣冠所睹，抑亦兆庶咸知。頃屬國步不夷，時艱主幼，大業有綴旒之懼，寶位深墜地之憂，議迫公卿，遂司契篆，日慎一日，以至於今。一紀之勞，勤亦至矣；萬方之俗，化漸行矣。將成宿願，脫屣寰區。昔堯之禪舜，唯能是與，禹以命啟，匪私其親，神器之重，允歸公授。皇太子基有大功於天地，定阽危於社稷，溫文既習，聖敬克躋。委之監國，已移歲年，時政益明，庶工惟序。朕之知子，庶不負時，歷數在躬，宜陟元後。可令即皇帝位，有司擇日授冊。朕方比跡洪古，希風太皇，神與化游，思與道合，無為無事，豈不美歟！王公百僚，宜識朕意。

manualTranslations.zh: 七月壬午，制曰：朕以寡昧，虔奉鴻休，本殊王季之賢，早達延陵之節。
manualTranslations.literal: On renwu of the seventh month, an edict said: We, in our meagerness and obscurity, reverently received vast blessing; fundamentally we are far from the worthiness of Wang Ji, yet early understood the integrity of Yanling.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On renwu of the seventh month, the throne issued an edict: In our slight and limited virtue, we have reverently received Heaven's great favor. We are no Wang Ji, yet from early on we understood the integrity of Yanling.

manualTranslations.zh: 昔在聖歷，已讓皇嗣之尊；
manualTranslations.literal: Formerly, in the Shengli reign, we already yielded the dignity of imperial heir;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the Shengli era we already declined the rank of imperial heir;

manualTranslations.zh: 爰暨神龍，終辭太弟之授。
manualTranslations.literal: and when it came to Shenlong, we finally declined the investiture as imperial younger brother.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: and in Shenlong we again refused appointment as imperial younger brother.

manualTranslations.zh: 豈唯衣冠所睹，抑亦兆庶咸知。
manualTranslations.literal: How could this only be what the officials saw? The multitudes also all knew it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This was witnessed not only by the court, but known to all the people.

manualTranslations.zh: 頃屬國步不夷，時艱主幼，大業有綴旒之懼，寶位深墜地之憂，議迫公卿，遂司契篆，日慎一日，以至於今。
manualTranslations.literal: Recently, because the state's course was uneven, the times were hard and the ruler young, the great enterprise had the fear of pendant streamers and the precious throne had deep anxiety of falling to the ground; discussion pressed upon the dukes and ministers, and so we managed tallies and seals, careful day after day, down to the present.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lately the state's path was perilous, the times difficult, and the ruler young. The great enterprise seemed as fragile as dangling tassels, and the throne itself seemed in danger of falling. Pressed by the counsel of the ministers, we took up the seals and tallies, and have proceeded with care every day until now.

manualTranslations.zh: 一紀之勞，勤亦至矣；
manualTranslations.literal: The labor of one cycle has been diligent indeed;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: A full cycle of labor has been strenuous enough;

manualTranslations.zh: 萬方之俗，化漸行矣。
manualTranslations.literal: the customs of the myriad regions have gradually been transformed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: and transformation has gradually spread through all regions.

manualTranslations.zh: 將成宿願，脫屣寰區。
manualTranslations.literal: We are about to fulfill our long-cherished wish and cast off the realm like shoes.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Now we would fulfill our old wish and cast off rule over the realm as one slips off worn shoes.

manualTranslations.zh: 昔堯之禪舜，唯能是與，禹以命啟，匪私其親，神器之重，允歸公授。
manualTranslations.literal: Formerly Yao abdicated to Shun, giving only to ability; Yu, in commanding Qi, did not privately favor his kin. The weight of the sacred vessel truly belongs to public bestowal.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Yao yielded to Shun, he gave the throne to ability; when Yu appointed Qi, he did not merely favor his own kin. So grave a sacred charge must rightly be conferred for public reasons.

manualTranslations.zh: 皇太子基有大功於天地，定阽危於社稷，溫文既習，聖敬克躋。
manualTranslations.literal: Crown Prince Ji has great merit before Heaven and Earth, stabilized danger and peril for the altars of soil and grain, is practiced in warm refinement, and can ascend in sage reverence.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Crown Prince Ji has rendered great service before Heaven and Earth, settling the altars of state when they stood on the brink. He is cultivated and humane, and has risen to sagely reverence.

manualTranslations.zh: 委之監國，已移歲年，時政益明，庶工惟序。
manualTranslations.literal: We entrusted him with supervising the state, and years have already passed; current government grows clearer, and the many offices are in order.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Since we entrusted him with supervising the state, the years have passed, government has grown clearer, and every office has found its order.

manualTranslations.zh: 朕之知子，庶不負時，歷數在躬，宜陟元後。
manualTranslations.literal: Our knowledge of our son will, we hope, not fail the times; the calendar-number rests in his person, and he should ascend as chief sovereign.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: We know our son, and trust that he will not fail the age. The mandate now rests in him; he should ascend as supreme ruler.

manualTranslations.zh: 可令即皇帝位，有司擇日授冊。
manualTranslations.literal: Let him take the imperial throne, and let the responsible offices choose a day to confer the writ.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He may take the imperial throne, and the proper offices shall choose a day to present the investiture.

manualTranslations.zh: 朕方比跡洪古，希風太皇，神與化游，思與道合，無為無事，豈不美歟！
manualTranslations.literal: We are now about to match our traces to high antiquity and aspire to the manner of the most august; spirit will roam with transformation, thought will unite with the Way, without action and without affairs: is this not beautiful?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: We shall follow the traces of remote antiquity and aspire to the style of the highest sovereigns; our spirit will move with transformation and our thoughts accord with the Way. To be without action and without affairs: is that not fine?

manualTranslations.zh: 王公百僚，宜識朕意。
manualTranslations.literal: Princes, dukes, and the hundred officials should understand our intent.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Princes, nobles, and all officials should understand our intent.

sourceRange.text: 」上御承天門樓，下制曰：朕承累聖之洪休，荷重光之積慶。昔因多難，內屬構屯，寶位深墜地之憂，神器有綴旒之懼。事殷家國，義感神祇，吟嘯風雲，龔行雷電，致君親於堯、舜，濟黔首於休和。遂以孟秋，允升儲貳；旋承內禪，繼體宸居。拜首之請空勤，讓立之誠莫展，恭臨億兆，二載於茲。上稟聖謨，下凝庶績，八荒同軌，瀛海無波。不謂奸慝潛謀，蕭墻竊發。逆賊竇懷貞等並以庸妄，權齒朝廷，毫發之效未申，丘山之釁乃積，共成梟獍，將肆奸回。太上皇聖斷宏通，英謀獨運，命朕率岐王範、薛王業等躬事誅鋤。齊斧一麾，兇渠盡殪。太陽朗耀，澄氛靄於天衢；高風順時，厲肅殺於秋序。神靈協贊，夷夏相歡，四族之慝既清，七百之祚方永。爰承後命，載闡休期，總軍國之大猷，施雲雨之鴻澤。承乾之道，既光被於無垠；作解之恩，思式覃於品物。當與億兆，同此惟新。可大赦天下，大闢罪已下咸赦除之。加邠王守禮實封三百戶，宋王成器、申王成義各加實封一千戶，岐王範、薛王業各加實封七百戶。文武官三品以下賜爵一級，四品已下各加一階。內外官人被諸道按察使及御史所摘伏，咸宜洗滌；選日依次敘用。

manualTranslations.zh: 上御承天門樓，下制曰：朕承累聖之洪休，荷重光之積慶。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor ascended the Tower of Accepting Heaven and issued an edict: We inherit the vast blessing of successive sages and bear the accumulated celebration of doubled radiance.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor mounted the Tower of Accepting Heaven and proclaimed: We have inherited the great blessings of sage forebears and received the accumulated fortune of renewed radiance.

manualTranslations.zh: 昔因多難，內屬構屯，寶位深墜地之憂，神器有綴旒之懼。
manualTranslations.literal: Formerly, because of many troubles, difficulties gathered within; the precious throne had deep anxiety of falling to the ground, and the sacred vessel had the fear of pendant streamers.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Earlier, amid many troubles and internal peril, the throne seemed in danger of falling and the sacred charge hung as precariously as tassels.

manualTranslations.zh: 事殷家國，義感神祇，吟嘯風雲，龔行雷電，致君親於堯、舜，濟黔首於休和。
manualTranslations.literal: Affairs were urgent for house and state; righteousness moved spirits and gods; singing and whistling stirred wind and cloud; respectfully acting with thunder and lightning, we brought ruler and parent to Yao and Shun and aided the black-haired people toward rest and harmony.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: With house and state in urgent danger, duty moved the spirits. We summoned wind and cloud and carried out thunderbolt action, bringing our sovereign and father near to Yao and Shun and rescuing the people into peace.

manualTranslations.zh: 遂以孟秋，允升儲貳；
manualTranslations.literal: Thus in early autumn we duly ascended as heir apparent;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Thus in early autumn we were raised to the succession;

manualTranslations.zh: 旋承內禪，繼體宸居。
manualTranslations.literal: soon we received the inner abdication and, succeeding to the body, occupied the imperial residence.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: and soon after received the abdication, succeeding to the throne and dwelling in the imperial seat.

manualTranslations.zh: 拜首之請空勤，讓立之誠莫展，恭臨億兆，二載於茲。
manualTranslations.literal: Our requests with bowed head were vainly earnest; our sincerity in yielding the establishment could not be extended; reverently ruling the multitudes has now been two years.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Our bowed petitions were in vain, and our sincere wish to decline could not be fulfilled. We have reverently ruled the multitudes for two years now.

manualTranslations.zh: 上稟聖謨，下凝庶績，八荒同軌，瀛海無波。
manualTranslations.literal: Above, we received the sage plan; below, we consolidated the many accomplishments. The eight wilds share one track, and the encircling seas have no waves.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Above we received sagely counsel; below the many works were brought together. The farthest lands share one road, and the seas are calm.

manualTranslations.zh: 不謂奸慝潛謀，蕭墻竊發。
manualTranslations.literal: Unexpectedly, traitorous wickedness plotted in secret, and within the screen-wall it stealthily erupted.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yet treacherous villains plotted in secret, and rebellion broke out within the palace walls.

manualTranslations.zh: 逆賊竇懷貞等並以庸妄，權齒朝廷，毫發之效未申，丘山之釁乃積，共成梟獍，將肆奸回。
manualTranslations.literal: The rebel traitors Dou Huaizhen and the others, all mediocre and reckless, improperly ranked in the court; they had not displayed the slightest service, yet piled up offenses like hills and mountains, together became owl-and-jing monsters, and were about to give free rein to treachery and perversity.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The rebel traitors Dou Huaizhen and his associates were mediocre and reckless men who had gained standing at court. They had not rendered the smallest service, yet their crimes rose like mountains; together they became monstrous rebels, ready to loose their treachery.

manualTranslations.zh: 太上皇聖斷宏通，英謀獨運，命朕率岐王範、薛王業等躬事誅鋤。
manualTranslations.literal: The Retired Emperor's sage decision was broad and penetrating, his heroic plan moved alone; he ordered us to lead Prince Fan of Qi, Prince Ye of Xue, and others personally in carrying out the eradication.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Retired Emperor, with broad sage judgment and singular heroic strategy, ordered us to lead Prince Fan of Qi, Prince Ye of Xue, and the others in personally suppressing them.

manualTranslations.zh: 齊斧一麾，兇渠盡殪。
manualTranslations.literal: At one wave of the punitive axe, the evil ringleaders were all killed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: With one swing of the punitive axe, the ringleaders were all destroyed.

manualTranslations.zh: 太陽朗耀，澄氛靄於天衢；
manualTranslations.literal: The great sun shines brightly, clearing haze and mist from the avenue of Heaven;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The sun shone bright, clearing haze from the avenue of Heaven;

manualTranslations.zh: 高風順時，厲肅殺於秋序。
manualTranslations.literal: the high wind follows the season, sharpening stern killing in the autumn order.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: the high wind followed the season, lending autumn its stern work of punishment.

manualTranslations.zh: 神靈協贊，夷夏相歡，四族之慝既清，七百之祚方永。
manualTranslations.literal: Spirits cooperated in assistance, Yi and Xia rejoiced together; the evil of the four clans having been cleared, the seven-hundred-year blessing is now lasting.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Spirits lent their aid, and foreign and Chinese peoples rejoiced together. Now that the evil of the four clans has been cleared away, the seven-hundred-year fortune will endure.

manualTranslations.zh: 爰承後命，載闡休期，總軍國之大猷，施雲雨之鴻澤。
manualTranslations.literal: Thereupon, receiving the later command, we again unfold the blessed occasion, take charge of the great plans of army and state, and dispense the vast grace of clouds and rain.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Now, receiving the later command, we open this auspicious moment, take charge of the great designs of army and state, and spread vast grace like clouds and rain.

manualTranslations.zh: 承乾之道，既光被於無垠；
manualTranslations.literal: The way of inheriting Heaven has already shone and covered the boundless;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The way of inheriting Heaven has already shone across all bounds;

manualTranslations.zh: 作解之恩，思式覃於品物。
manualTranslations.literal: the grace of making release we wish thereby to extend to all things.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: and we wish the grace of release to reach all creatures.

manualTranslations.zh: 當與億兆，同此惟新。
manualTranslations.literal: We should, together with the countless people, share in this renewal.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Together with the countless people, we shall share this renewal.

manualTranslations.zh: 可大赦天下，大闢罪已下咸赦除之。
manualTranslations.literal: A great amnesty may be granted throughout the realm; crimes from capital offenses downward shall all be pardoned and removed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Let a great amnesty be granted throughout the realm: all crimes from capital offenses downward are pardoned.

manualTranslations.zh: 加邠王守禮實封三百戶，宋王成器、申王成義各加實封一千戶，岐王範、薛王業各加實封七百戶。
manualTranslations.literal: Add three hundred households to the actual fief of Prince Shouli of Bin; to Prince Chengqi of Song and Prince Chengyi of Shen each add one thousand households of actual fief; to Prince Fan of Qi and Prince Ye of Xue each add seven hundred households of actual fief.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Prince Shouli of Bin is to receive three hundred additional taxable households. Prince Chengqi of Song and Prince Chengyi of Shen shall each receive one thousand, and Prince Fan of Qi and Prince Ye of Xue each seven hundred.

manualTranslations.zh: 文武官三品以下賜爵一級，四品已下各加一階。
manualTranslations.literal: Civil and military officials of the third rank and below are granted one grade of noble title; those of the fourth rank and below each receive one additional step.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials of the third rank and below are granted one grade of title; those of the fourth rank and below each receive one step of advancement.

manualTranslations.zh: 內外官人被諸道按察使及御史所摘伏，咸宜洗滌；
manualTranslations.literal: Officials within and without who have been exposed and charged by the circuit inspectors or by censors should all be cleansed;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Officials in the capital and provinces who have been reported or charged by circuit inspectors or censors shall all have their records cleared;

manualTranslations.zh: 選日依次敘用。
manualTranslations.literal: on selected days, they shall be ranked and employed in order.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: on chosen days they shall be restored to service in proper order.

sourceRange.text: 是日，御靈武南門，下制曰：朕聞聖人畏天命，帝者奉天時。知皇靈睠命，不敢違而去之；知歷數所歸，不獲已而當之。在昔帝王，靡不由斯而有天下者也。乃者羯胡亂常，京闕失守，天未悔禍，群兇尚扇。聖皇久厭大位，思傳眇身，軍興之初，已有成命，予恐不德，罔敢祗承。今群工卿士僉曰：「孝莫大於繼德，功莫盛於中興。」朕所以治兵朔方，將殄寇逆，務以大者，本其孝乎。須安兆庶之心，敬順群臣之請，乃以七月甲子，即皇帝位於靈武。敬崇徽號，上尊聖皇曰上皇天帝，所司擇日昭告上帝。朕以薄德，謬當重位，既展承天之禮，宜覃率士之澤，可大赦天下，改元曰至德。內外文武官九品已上加兩階、賜兩轉，三品已上賜爵一級。

manualTranslations.zh: 是日，御靈武南門，下制曰：朕聞聖人畏天命，帝者奉天時。
manualTranslations.literal: That day, at Lingwu's southern gate, he issued an edict: We have heard that sages fear Heaven's command, and emperors reverently follow Heaven's season.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That day, at Lingwu's southern gate, he issued an edict: Sages fear Heaven's command, and emperors act in obedience to Heaven's timing.

manualTranslations.zh: 知皇靈睠命，不敢違而去之；
manualTranslations.literal: Knowing that the imperial spirit has looked upon and commanded us, we dare not violate it and depart from it;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Heaven's favor has turned toward us, we dare not turn away from it;

manualTranslations.zh: 知歷數所歸，不獲已而當之。
manualTranslations.literal: knowing where the calendar-number returns, we cannot but take it on.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: when the mandate has come to rest here, we have no choice but to bear it.

manualTranslations.zh: 在昔帝王，靡不由斯而有天下者也。
manualTranslations.literal: Among emperors and kings of old, there were none who did not by this come to possess All-under-Heaven.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperors and kings of old all gained the realm through this same principle.

manualTranslations.zh: 乃者羯胡亂常，京闕失守，天未悔禍，群兇尚扇。
manualTranslations.literal: Recently the Jie barbarians disrupted the constant order, the capital towers were lost, Heaven had not yet repented of calamity, and the band of villains still fanned disorder.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Recently the rebel barbarians overturned the order, the capital fell, Heaven had not yet withdrawn its disaster, and the rebels still stirred unrest.

manualTranslations.zh: 聖皇久厭大位，思傳眇身，軍興之初，已有成命，予恐不德，罔敢祗承。
manualTranslations.literal: The Sage Emperor had long wearied of the great throne and wished to transmit it to my small person; when the army first rose, there was already a completed command, but I feared my virtue was insufficient and did not dare reverently accept it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Sage Emperor had long wished to lay down the throne and pass it to my humble person. At the start of the campaign the order had already been given, but I feared my virtue was unequal to it and did not dare accept.

manualTranslations.zh: 今群工卿士僉曰：「孝莫大於繼德，功莫盛於中興。」
manualTranslations.literal: Now the many officers, ministers, and gentlemen all say: "No filial piety is greater than continuing virtue, and no achievement is grander than restoring the dynasty."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Now all officers and ministers say, "No act of filial duty is greater than continuing his virtue, and no achievement is greater than restoring the dynasty."

manualTranslations.zh: 朕所以治兵朔方，將殄寇逆，務以大者，本其孝乎。
manualTranslations.literal: Our reason for ordering the troops in Shuofang and intending to destroy the rebel bandits is that, in attending to what is great, it is rooted in filial piety.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: We mustered the army in Shuofang to destroy the rebels; in attending to the greater duty, we act from filial piety.

manualTranslations.zh: 須安兆庶之心，敬順群臣之請，乃以七月甲子，即皇帝位於靈武。
manualTranslations.literal: It is necessary to settle the hearts of the countless common people and reverently follow the ministers' request; therefore, on jiazi of the seventh month, we took the imperial throne at Lingwu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: To settle the people's hearts and respectfully follow the ministers' request, on jiazi of the seventh month we ascended the imperial throne at Lingwu.

manualTranslations.zh: 敬崇徽號，上尊聖皇曰上皇天帝，所司擇日昭告上帝。
manualTranslations.literal: We reverently exalt the glorious title, honoring the Sage Emperor above as Retired Emperor Heavenly Emperor; the responsible offices shall choose a day to announce it clearly to the Supreme Emperor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: We reverently exalt his august title, honoring the Sage Emperor as Retired Emperor Heavenly Emperor. The offices shall choose a day to proclaim this to the Supreme Emperor above.

manualTranslations.zh: 朕以薄德，謬當重位，既展承天之禮，宜覃率士之澤，可大赦天下，改元曰至德。
manualTranslations.literal: We, with slight virtue, mistakenly occupy the weighty throne; having performed the rite of receiving Heaven, we should extend grace to all lands: a great amnesty may be granted throughout the realm, and the era name changed to Zhide.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: With slight virtue we have wrongly come to this weighty throne. Since we have performed the rite of receiving Heaven, grace should extend through all lands: grant a great amnesty throughout the realm and change the era name to Zhide.

manualTranslations.zh: 內外文武官九品已上加兩階、賜兩轉，三品已上賜爵一級。
manualTranslations.literal: Civil and military officials inside and outside the capital, of the ninth rank and above, shall receive two added grades and two turns of reward; those of the third rank and above shall be granted one rank of noble title.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials in the capital and provinces, ninth rank and above, are to receive two added grades and two turns of reward; those third rank and above receive one grade of noble title.

sourceRange.text: 壬寅，制：朕獲守丕業，敢忘謙沖，欲垂範而自我，亦去華而就實。其「乾元大聖光天文武孝感」等尊崇之稱，何德以當之？欽若昊天，定時成歲，《春秋》五始，義在體元，惟以紀年，更無潤色。至於漢武，飾以浮華，非前王之茂典，豈永代而作則。自今已後，朕號唯稱皇帝，其年號但稱元年，去上元之號。其以今北庭潞儀隰等州行營、本管節度觀察等事，移鎮絳州。

manualTranslations.zh: 壬寅，制：朕獲守丕業，敢忘謙沖，欲垂範而自我，亦去華而就實。
manualTranslations.literal: On renyin, an edict said: We have been able to guard the great enterprise; how could we dare forget modest emptiness? Wishing to leave a model, we begin with ourselves, and also remove ornament to approach substance.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On renyin, an edict declared: We have inherited and guarded this great enterprise; how could we forget humility? To set an example, we begin with ourselves, discarding ornament and returning to substance.

manualTranslations.zh: 其「乾元大聖光天文武孝感」等尊崇之稱，何德以當之？
manualTranslations.literal: As for exalted designations such as "Qianyuan Great Sage, Radiant Heaven, Civil and Martial, Filially Responsive," by what virtue could we be worthy of them?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: As for exalted titles like "Qianyuan Great Sage, Radiant Heaven, Civil and Martial, Filially Responsive," what virtue of ours could deserve them?

manualTranslations.zh: 欽若昊天，定時成歲，《春秋》五始，義在體元，惟以紀年，更無潤色。
manualTranslations.literal: Reverently following vast Heaven, fixing the seasons and completing the year, the five beginnings of the Spring and Autumn have their meaning in embodying the origin; it is only for recording years and has no further embellishment.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In reverently following high Heaven, setting the seasons and completing the year, the five beginnings of the Spring and Autumn Annals mean to embody the origin; an era name should only mark the year, without further embellishment.

manualTranslations.zh: 至於漢武，飾以浮華，非前王之茂典，豈永代而作則。
manualTranslations.literal: As for Emperor Wu of Han, he adorned it with empty splendor; this was not the flourishing canon of former kings, so how could it serve as a rule for all ages?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Emperor Wu of Han dressed such names in empty splendor. That was no excellent precedent of the former kings, and cannot be a model for later ages.

manualTranslations.zh: 自今已後，朕號唯稱皇帝，其年號但稱元年，去上元之號。
manualTranslations.literal: From now on, Our style shall only be called emperor, and the era shall simply be called the first year, removing the title Shangyuan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From now on, our style shall simply be Emperor, and the era shall be called only the first year, removing the name Shangyuan.

manualTranslations.zh: 其以今北庭潞儀隰等州行營、本管節度觀察等事，移鎮絳州。
manualTranslations.literal: Let the present campaign headquarters for Beiting, Lu, Yi, Xi, and the other prefectures, together with the originally administered military commissioner and observation affairs, move its garrison to Jiangzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Move the current field headquarters for Beiting, Lu, Yi, Xi, and the other prefectures, along with its military and inspection responsibilities, to Jiangzhou.

sourceRange.text: 乙丑，詔：四海之內，方協大寧，西戎無厭，獨阻王命，不可忘戰，尚勞邊事。朕頃以兵革之後，軍國空耗，躬率節儉，務勤農桑。上玄儲休，仍歲大稔，益用多愧，不知其然。雖屬此人和，近於家給，而邊穀未實，戎備猶虛。因其天時，思致豐積，將設平糴，以之餽軍。然以中都所供，內府不足，粗充常入之數，豈齊倍餘之收。其在方面藎臣，成茲大計。共佐公家之急，以資塞下之儲。每道歲有防秋兵馬，其淮南四千人，浙西三千人，魏博四千人，昭義二千人，成德三千人，山南東道三千人，荊南二千人，湖南三千人，山南西道二千人，劍南西川三千人，東川二千人，鄂岳一千五百人。宣歙三千人，福建一千五百人。其嶺南、浙東、浙西，亦合準例。恐路遠往來增費，各委本道每年取當使諸色雜錢及回易利潤、贓贖錢等，每人計二十貫。每道據合配防秋人數多少，都計錢數，市輕貨送納上都，以備和糴，仍以秋收送畢。

context.afterSource: 涇原節度使馬璘來朝。

manualTranslations.zh: 乙丑，詔：四海之內，方協大寧，西戎無厭，獨阻王命，不可忘戰，尚勞邊事。
manualTranslations.literal: On yichou, an edict said: Within the four seas, all is just joining in great peace, but the western Rong are insatiable and alone obstruct the royal command; war cannot be forgotten, and frontier affairs still require labor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On yichou, an edict declared: Within the four seas we are just entering great peace, yet the western Rong remain insatiable and alone resist the royal command. We cannot forget war, and frontier affairs still demand attention.

manualTranslations.zh: 朕頃以兵革之後，軍國空耗，躬率節儉，務勤農桑。
manualTranslations.literal: Recently, after war and arms, army and state were exhausted; we personally led in frugality and worked diligently at farming and sericulture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Since the recent wars left army and state depleted, we have personally practiced frugality and urged agriculture and sericulture.

manualTranslations.zh: 上玄儲休，仍歲大稔，益用多愧，不知其然。
manualTranslations.literal: High Heaven stored up blessing, and year after year there were great harvests; this makes us all the more ashamed, not knowing why it is so.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: High Heaven stored up blessing, and successive years brought great harvests; the more this happens, the more ashamed we feel, not knowing how we deserve it.

manualTranslations.zh: 雖屬此人和，近於家給，而邊穀未實，戎備猶虛。
manualTranslations.literal: Although this belongs to human harmony and approaches household sufficiency, frontier grain is not yet full and military preparations remain empty.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Although the people are harmonious and households nearly supplied, frontier granaries are not yet full and military stores remain thin.

manualTranslations.zh: 因其天時，思致豐積，將設平糴，以之餽軍。
manualTranslations.literal: Taking advantage of Heaven's season, we wish to bring about abundant stores, and will establish balanced purchases in order to feed the army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Taking advantage of this favorable season, we intend to build abundant reserves by arranging government grain purchases to provision the army.

manualTranslations.zh: 然以中都所供，內府不足，粗充常入之數，豈齊倍餘之收。
manualTranslations.literal: Yet with what the central capital supplies, the inner treasury is insufficient, barely enough to fill the amount of regular receipts; how could it equal doubled surplus revenue?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: But the central capital's supply and the inner treasury are insufficient, barely covering ordinary receipts; they cannot match the surplus now available elsewhere.

manualTranslations.zh: 其在方面藎臣，成茲大計。
manualTranslations.literal: It rests with devoted ministers in the regions to complete this great plan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This great plan must be completed by loyal ministers in the regional commands.

manualTranslations.zh: 共佐公家之急，以資塞下之儲。
manualTranslations.literal: Together assist the state's urgency, and thereby supply the stores below the frontier passes.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Together they should meet the state's urgent need and build up stores along the frontier.

manualTranslations.zh: 每道歲有防秋兵馬，其淮南四千人，浙西三千人，魏博四千人，昭義二千人，成德三千人，山南東道三千人，荊南二千人，湖南三千人，山南西道二千人，劍南西川三千人，東川二千人，鄂岳一千五百人。
manualTranslations.literal: Each circuit annually has troops and horses for autumn defense: Huainan, four thousand men; Zhexi, three thousand; Weibo, four thousand; Zhaoyi, two thousand; Chengde, three thousand; Shannan East Circuit, three thousand; Jingnan, two thousand; Hunan, three thousand; Shannan West Circuit, two thousand; Jiannan Xichuan, three thousand; Dongchuan, two thousand; E-Yue, one thousand five hundred.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Each circuit has annual autumn-defense troops: Huainan 4,000, Zhexi 3,000, Weibo 4,000, Zhaoyi 2,000, Chengde 3,000, Shannan East 3,000, Jingnan 2,000, Hunan 3,000, Shannan West 2,000, Jiannan Xichuan 3,000, Dongchuan 2,000, and E-Yue 1,500.

manualTranslations.zh: 宣歙三千人，福建一千五百人。
manualTranslations.literal: Xuan-Xi, three thousand men; Fujian, one thousand five hundred.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xuan-Xi is assigned 3,000 men, and Fujian 1,500.

manualTranslations.zh: 其嶺南、浙東、浙西，亦合準例。
manualTranslations.literal: As for Lingnan, Zhedong, and Zhexi, they too should accord with the precedent.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lingnan, Zhedong, and Zhexi shall also follow this precedent.

manualTranslations.zh: 恐路遠往來增費，各委本道每年取當使諸色雜錢及回易利潤、贓贖錢等，每人計二十貫。
manualTranslations.literal: Fearing that distant roads and round trips will increase costs, each is entrusted to its own circuit to take each year the commissioner's various miscellaneous funds, trading profits, and money from fines and redemptions, calculating twenty strings per man.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because distant transport would add expense, each circuit shall annually use its own commissioner's miscellaneous funds, trade profits, and fine or redemption money, reckoning twenty strings per man.

manualTranslations.zh: 每道據合配防秋人數多少，都計錢數，市輕貨送納上都，以備和糴，仍以秋收送畢。
manualTranslations.literal: Each circuit, according to the number of autumn-defense men it is assigned, shall total the amount of money, buy light goods, and send them to the capital for delivery, to provide for government grain purchases; it shall finish sending them after the autumn harvest.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Each circuit shall calculate the total funds according to its autumn-defense quota, buy easily transported goods, and deliver them to the capital for government grain purchases, completing delivery after the autumn harvest.

sourceRange.text: 己丑，敕：唐虞之際，內有百揆，庶政惟和。至於宗周，六卿分職，以倡九牧。《書》曰：「龍作納言，帝命惟允。《詩》云：仲山甫，王之喉舌。皆尚書之任也。雖西漢以二府分理，東京以三公總務；至於領錄天下之綱，綜核萬事之要，邦國善否，出納之由，莫不處正於會府也。令、僕以綜詳朝政，丞、郎以彌綸國典，法天地而分四序，配星辰而統五行，元本於是乎在。九卿之職，亦中臺之輔助，小大之政，多所關決。自王室多難，一紀於茲，東征西伐，略無寧歲。內外薦費，徵求調發，皆迫於國計，切於軍期，率於權便裁之，新書從事，且求當時之急，殊非致理之道。今外虞既平，罔不率俾，天時人事，表裹相符。將明畫一之法，大布惟新之命，陶甄化源，去末歸本。魏、晉有度支尚書，校計軍國之用，國朝但以郎官署領，辦集有餘。時艱之後，方立使額，參佐既眾，簿書轉煩，終無弘益，又失事體。其度支使及關內、河東、山南西道、劍南西川轉運常平鹽鐵等使宜停。禮儀之本，職在奉常，往年置使，因循未改，有乖舊制，實曠司存。委太常卿自舉本職，其使宜停。漢朝丞相與公卿已下五日一決事，帝親斷可否。且國之安危，不獨注于將相；考之理亂，固亦在於庶官。尚書、侍郎、左右丞及九卿，參領要重，朕所親倚，固當朝夕進見，以之匡益也。並宜詳校所掌，具陳損益，如非時宜，須有奏議，亦聽詣閣請對。當親覽其意，擇善而從。朕受昊天之成命，承累聖之鴻業，齊心滌慮，夙夜憂勞。顧以不敏不明，薄於德化，致使舊章多廢，至理未弘，其心愧恥，終食三嘆。雖詔書屢下，以申振恤，且朝典未舉，猶深鬱悼。思與百闢卿士，勵精於理，俾國經王道，可舉而行，各宜承式，以恭爾位。諸州置屯亦宜停。

localRange.text: 己丑，敕：

context.beforeSource: 荒田開墾者二升。
context.afterSource: 於是悉以度支之務委於宰相。
