sourceRange.text: 二十一年，征授金紫光祿大夫，復封宋國公。從幸玉華宮，遘疾薨於宮所，年七十四。太宗聞而輟膳，高宗為之舉哀，遣使弔祭。太常謚曰「肅」。太宗曰：「易名之典，必考其行。瑀性多猜貳，此謚失於不直，更宜摭實。」改謚曰貞褊公。冊贈司空、荊州都督，賜東園秘器，陪葬昭陵。臨終遺書曰：「生而必死，理之常分。氣絕後可著單服一通，以充小斂。棺內施單席而已，冀其速朽，不得別加一物。無假卜日，惟在速辦。自古賢哲，非無等例，爾宜勉之。」諸子遵其遺志，斂葬儉薄。

sourceRange.text: 道王元慶，高祖第十六子也。武德六年，封漢王。八年，改封陳王。貞觀九年，拜趙州刺史，賜實封八百戶。十年，改封道王，授豫州刺史。二十三年，加實封滿千戶。永徽四年，歷滑州刺史，以政績聞，賜物二百段。後歷徐、沁、衛三州刺史。元慶事母甚謹，及母薨，又請躬修墳墓，優詔不許。麟德元年薨，贈司徒、益州都督，陪葬獻陵，謚曰孝。子臨淮王誘嗣，官至澧州刺史。永淳中，坐贓削爵。次子詢，壽州刺史。詢子微，神龍初，封為嗣道王。景龍四年，加銀青光祿大夫。景雲元年，宗正卿，卒。子鏈，開元二十五年，襲封嗣道王。廣德中，官至宗正卿。鄧王元裕，高祖第十七子也。貞觀五年，封鄶王。十一年，改封鄧王，賜實封八百戶，歷鄧、梁、黃三州刺史。元裕好學，善談名理，與典簽盧照鄰為布衣之交。二十三年，加實封通前一千五百戶。高宗時，又歷壽、襄二州刺史、兗州都督。麟德二年薨，贈司徒、益州大都督，陪葬獻陵，謚曰康。無子，以弟江王元祥子廣平公炅嗣。神龍初，封炅子孝先為嗣鄧王。開元十三年，右監門衛大將軍、冠軍大將軍，卒。

sourceRange.text: 楚王智雲，高祖第五子也。母曰萬貴妃，性恭順，特蒙高祖親禮。宮中之事，皆諮稟之，諸王妃主，莫不推敬。後授楚國太妃，薨，陪葬獻陵。智雲本名稚詮，大業末，從高祖於河東。及義師將起，隱太子建成潛歸太原，以智雲年小，委之而去。因為吏所捕，送於長安，為陰世師所害，年十四。義寧元年，贈尚書左僕射、楚國公。武德元年，追封楚王，謚曰哀。無子，三年，以太宗子寬為嗣。寬薨，貞觀二年，復以濟南公世都子靈龜嗣焉。靈龜，永徽中歷魏州刺史，政尚清嚴，姦盜屏跡。又開永濟渠入於新市，以控引商旅，百姓利之。卒官。子福嗣，嗣降爵為公。儀鳳中，卒於右威衛將軍。子承況，神龍中為右羽林將軍，與節愍太子同舉兵，入玄武門，為亂兵所殺。

sourceRange.text: 子淮南王茂嗣。茂險薄無行，元禮姬趙氏有美色，及元禮遇疾，茂遂逼之，元禮知而切加責讓。茂乃屏斥元禮侍衛，斷其藥膳，仍云：「既得五十年為王，更何煩服藥？」竟以餒終。上元中，事洩，配流振州而死。神龍初，又封茂子璀為嗣徐王。景龍四年，加銀青光祿大夫。開元中，除宗正員外卿，卒。子延年嗣。開元二十六年，封嗣徐王，除員外洗馬。天寶初，拔汗那王入朝，延年將嫁女與之，為右相李林甫所奏，貶文安郡別駕、彭城長史，坐贓貶永嘉司士。至德初，餘杭郡司馬，卒。永泰元年，女婿黔中觀察使趙國珍入朝，請以延年子前施州刺史諷為嗣，因封嗣徐王。

sourceRange.text: 子履行，貞觀初歷祠部郎中。丁母憂，哀悴逾禮。太宗遣使諭之曰：「孝子之道，毀不滅性。汝宜強食，不得過禮。」服闋，累遷滑州刺史。尚太宗女東陽公主，拜駙馬都尉。十九年，除戶部侍郎，加銀青光祿大夫。無幾，遭父艱，居喪復以孝聞，太宗手詔敦喻曰：「古人立孝，毀不滅身。聞卿絕粒，殊乖大體，幸抑摧裂之情，割傷生之累。」俄起為衛尉卿，進加金紫光祿大夫，襲爵申國公。永徽元年，拜戶部尚書、檢校太子詹事、太常卿。顯慶元年，出為益州大都督府長史。先是，士廉居此職，頗著能名。至是，履行繼之，亦有善政，大為人吏所稱。三年，坐與長孫無忌親累，左授洪州都督，轉永州刺史，卒於官。

sourceRange.text: 客師孫令問，玄宗在籓時與令問款狎，及即位，以協贊功累遷至殿中少監。先天中，預誅竇懷貞等功，封宋國公，實封五百戶。令問固辭實封，詔不許。開元中，轉殿中監、左散騎常侍，知尚食事。令問雖特承恩寵，未嘗干預時政，深為物論所稱。然厚於自奉，食饌豐侈，廣畜芻豢，躬臨宰殺。時方奉佛，其篤信之士或譏之。令問曰：「此物畜生，與果菜何異？胡為強生分別，不亦遠於道乎？」略不以恩眄自恃，閒適郊野，從禽自娛。十五年，涼州都督王君跂奉回紇部落叛，令問坐與連姻，左授撫州別駕，尋卒。

sourceRange.text: 李君羨者，洺州武安人也。初為王世充驃騎，惡世充之為人，乃與其黨叛而來歸，太宗引為左右。從討劉武周及王世充等，每戰必單騎先鋒陷陣，前後賜以宮女、馬牛、黃金、雜彩，不可勝數。太宗即位，累遷華州刺史，封武連郡公。貞觀初，太白頻晝見，太史佔曰：「女三昌。」又有謠言：「當有女武王者。」太宗惡之。時君羨為左武衛將軍，在玄武門。太宗因武官內宴，作酒令，各言小名。君羨自稱小名「五娘子」，太宗愕然，因大笑曰：「何物女子，如此勇猛！」又以君羨封邑及屬縣皆有「武」字，深惡之。會御史奏君羨與妖人員道信潛相謀結，將為不軌，遂下詔誅之。天授二年，其家屬詣闕稱冤，則天乃追復其官爵，以禮改葬。

sourceRange.text: 戴胄，字玄胤，相州安陽人也。性貞正，有干局。明習律令，尤曉文簿。隋大業末，爲門下錄事，納言蘇威、黃門侍郎裴矩甚禮之。越王侗以爲給事郎。王世充將篡侗位，胄言於世充曰：「君臣之分，情均父子，理須同其休戚，勖以終始。明公以文武之才，當社稷之寄，與存與亡，在於今日。所願推誠王室，擬跡伊、周，使國有泰山之安，家傳代祿之盛，則率土之濱，莫不幸甚。」世充詭辭稱善，勞而遣之。世充後逼越王加其九錫，胄又抗言切諫。世充不納，由是出爲鄭州長史，令與兄子行本鎮武牢。太宗克武牢而得之，引爲秦府士曹參軍。及即位，除兵部郎中，封武昌縣男。

sourceRange.text: 伏伽上表諫曰：臣聞王言無戲，自古格言；去食存信，聞諸舊典。故《書》云：「爾無不信，朕不食言。」又《論語》雲，一言出口，駟不及舌。以此而論，言之出口，不可不慎。伏惟陛下光臨區宇，覆育群生，率土之濱，誰非臣妾。絲綸一發，取信萬方，使聞之者不疑，見之者不惑。陛下今月二日發雲雨之制，光被黔黎，無所間然，公私蒙賴。既雲常赦不免，皆赦除之，此非直赦其有罪，亦是與天下斷當，許其更新。以此言之，但是赦後，即便無事。因何王世充及建德部下，赦後乃欲遷之？此是陛下自違本心，欲遣下人若為取則？若欲子細推尋，逆城之內，人誰無罪？故《書》云：「殲厥渠魁，脅從罔治。」若論渠魁，世充等為首，渠魁尚免，脅從何辜？且古人云：「蹠狗吠堯，蓋非其主。」在東都城內及建德部下，乃有與陛下積小故舊，編髮友朋，猶尚有人敗後始至者。此等豈忘陛下，皆云被壅故也。以此言之，自外疏者，竊謂無罪。又《書》云：「非知之艱，行之惟艱。」上古以來，何代無君，所以只稱堯、舜之善者，何也？直由為天子者實難，善名難得故也。往者天下未平，威權須應機而作；今四方既定，設法須與人共之。但法者，陛下自作之，還須守之，使天下百姓信而畏之。今自為無信，欲遣兆人若為信畏？故《書》云：「無偏無黨，王道蕩蕩；無黨無偏，王道平平。」賞罰之行，達乎貴賤，聖人製法，無限親疏。如臣愚見，世充、建德下偽官，經赦合免責情，欲遷配者，請並放之，則天下幸甚。

sourceRange.text: 」書奏，太宗謂遂良曰：「朕亦悔此問，今得卿疏，深會我心。」承乾既敗德日增，玄素又上書諫曰：臣聞孔子云：「能近取譬，可謂仁之方也已。」然《書》、《傳》所載，言之或遠，尋覽近事，得失斯存。至如周武帝平定山東，卑宮菲食，以安海內。太子贇舉措無端，穢德日著。烏九軌知其不可，具言於武帝；武帝慈仁，望其漸改。及至踐祚，狂暴肆情，區宇崩離，宗祀覆滅，即隋文帝所代是也。文帝因周衰弱，憑藉女資，雖無大功於天下，然布德行仁，足為萬姓所賴。勇為太子，不能近遵君父之節儉，而務驕侈，今之山池遺蹟，即殿下所親睹是也。此時亦恃君親之恩，自謂太山之固，詎知邪臣敢進其說？向使動靜有常，進退合度，親君子，疏小人，舍浮華，尚恭儉，雖有邪臣間之，何能致慈父之隙？豈不由積德未弘，令聞不著，讒言一至，遂成其禍？竊惟皇儲之寄，荷戴殊重，如其積德不弘，何以嗣守成業？聖上以殿下親則父子，事兼家國，所應用物，不為節限。恩旨未逾六旬，用物已過七萬，驕奢之極，孰雲過此。龍樓之下，惟聚工匠；望苑之內，不睹賢良。今言孝敬則闕視膳問安之禮，語恭順則違君父慈訓之方，求風聲則無愛學好道之實，觀舉措則有因緣誅戮之罪。宮臣正士，未嘗在側；群邪淫巧，暱近深宮。愛好者皆游手雜色，施與者併圖畫雕鏤。在外瞻仰，已有此失；居中隱密，寧可勝計哉！宣猷禁門，不異阛阓，朝入暮出，穢聲已遠。臣以德音日損，頻上諫書，自爾已來，縱逸尤甚。右庶子趙弘智經明行修，當今善士，臣每奏請，望數召進，與之談論，庶廣徽猷。令旨反有猜嫌，謂臣妄相推引。從善如流，尚恐不逮；飾非拒諫，必招敗損。方崇閉塞之源，不慕欽明之術，雖抱睿哲之資，終罹罔念之咎。古人云：「苦藥利病，苦言利行。」伏惟居安思危，日慎一日。

sourceRange.text: 玄素上書諫曰：微臣竊思秦始皇之為君也，藉周室之餘、六國之盛，將貽之萬葉，及其子而亡，良由逞嗜奔欲，逆天害人者也。是知天下不可以力勝，神祇不可以親恃，惟當弘儉約，薄賦斂，慎終如始，可以永固。方今承百王之末，屬凋弊之餘，必欲節之以禮制，陛下宜以身為先。東都未有幸期，即何須補葺？諸王今並出籓，又須營構，興發漸多，豈疲人之所望？其不可一也。陛下初平東都之始，層樓廣殿，皆令撤毀，天下翕然，同心欣仰。豈有初則惡其侈靡，今乃襲其雕麗？其不可二也。每承音旨，未即巡幸，此則事不急之務，成虛費之勞。國無兼年之積，何用兩都之好，勞役過度，怨讟將起。其不可三也。百姓承亂離之後，財力凋盡，天恩含育，粗見存立，飢寒猶切，生計未安，三五年間，恐未平復。奈何營未幸之都，奪疲人之力？其不可四也。昔漢高祖將都洛陽，婁敬一言，即日西駕，豈不知地惟土中，貢賦所均，但以形勝不如關內也。伏惟陛下化凋弊之人，革澆漓之俗，為日尚淺，未甚淳和。斟酌事宜，詎可東幸？其不可五也。臣又嘗見隋室造殿，楹棟宏壯，大木非隨近所有，多從豫章采來。二千人曳一柱，其下施轂，皆以生鐵為之，若用木輪，便即火出。鐵轂既生，行一二里即有破壞，仍數百人別齎鐵轂以隨之，終日不過進三二十里。略計一柱，已用數十萬功，則余費又過於此。臣聞阿房成，秦人散；章華就，楚眾離；及乾陽畢功，隋人解體。且以陛下今時功力，何如隋日？役瘡痍之人，襲亡隋之弊，以此言之，恐甚於煬帝。深願陛下思之，無為由余所笑，則天下幸甚。

sourceRange.text: 其一曰：臣聞天子有諍臣，雖無道不失其天下；父有諍子，雖無道不陷於不義。故云子不可不諍於父，臣不可不諍於君。以此言之，臣之事君，猶子之事父故也。隋後主所以失天下者，何也？止為不聞其過。當時非無直言之士，由君不受諫，自謂德盛唐堯，功過夏禹，窮侈極欲，以恣其心。天下之士，肝腦塗地，戶口減耗，盜賊日滋，而不覺知者，皆由朝臣不敢告之也。向使修嚴父之法，開直言之路，選賢任能，賞罰得中，人人樂業，誰能搖動者乎？所以前朝好為變更，不師古訓者，止為天誘其咎，將以開今聖唐也。陛下龍舉晉陽，天下響應，計不旋踵，大位遂隆。陛下勿以唐得天下之易，不知隋失之不難也。陛下貴為天子，富有天下，動則左史書之，言則右史書之。既為竹帛所拘，何可恣情不慎？凡有搜狩，須順四時，既代天理，安得非時妄動？陛下二十日龍飛，二十一日有獻鷂雛者，此乃前朝之弊風，少年之事務，何忽今日行之！又聞相國參軍事盧牟子獻琵琶，長安縣丞張安道獻弓箭，頻蒙賞勞。但「普天之下，莫非王土；率土之濱，莫非王臣」，陛下必有所欲，何求而不得？陛下所少者，豈此物哉！願陛下察臣愚忠，則天下幸甚。其二曰：百戲散樂，本非正聲，有隋之末，大見崇用，此謂淫風，不可不改。近者，太常官司於人間借婦女裙襦五百餘具，以充散妓之服，雲擬五月五日於玄武門遊戲。臣竊思審，實損皇猷，亦非貽厥子孫謀，為後代法也。故《書》云：「無以小怨為無傷而弗去。」恐從小至於大故也。《論語》云：「放鄭聲，遠佞人。」又云：「樂則《韶》舞。」以此言之，散妓定非功成之樂也。如臣愚見，請並廢之。則天下不勝幸甚。其三曰：臣聞性相近而習相遠，以其所好相染也。故《書》云：「與治同道罔弗興，與亂同事罔弗亡。」以此言之，興亂其在斯與！皇太子及諸王等左右群僚，不可不擇而任之也。如臣愚見，但是無義之人，及先來無賴，家門不能邕睦；及好奢華馳獵馭射，專作慢游狗馬、聲色歌舞之人，不得使親而近之也。此等止可悅耳目，備驅馳，至於拾遺補闕，決不能為也。臣歷窺往古，下觀近代，至於子孫不孝，兄弟離間，莫不為左右亂之也。願陛下妙選賢才，以為皇太子僚友，如此即克隆盤石，永固維城矣。

manualTranslations.literal: He was transferred to Right Assistant of the Heir Apparent; he firmly declined and would not accept, and was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Right Assistant of the Heir Apparent, but firmly declined and would not accept the post; he was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat instead.

manualTranslations.zh: 上《聖德論》，辭多不載。
manualTranslations.literal: He submitted the "Treatise on Sagely Virtue," but most of the text is not recorded here.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He submitted the "Treatise on Sagely Virtue," but most of the text is not recorded here.

manualTranslations.zh: 七年，轉秘書監，賜爵永興縣子。
manualTranslations.literal: In the seventh year he was transferred to Director of the Secretariat and granted the title Viscount of Yongxing County.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was transferred to Director of the Secretariat and granted the title Viscount of Yongxing County.

manualTranslations.zh: 太宗重其博識，每機務之隙，引之談論，共觀經史。
manualTranslations.literal: Taizong valued his broad learning; whenever there was a pause in urgent state affairs, he would summon him to discuss affairs and together peruse the classics and histories.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Taizong valued his broad learning. Whenever there was a pause in urgent state affairs, he would summon him to discuss affairs and together peruse the classics and histories.

manualTranslations.zh: 世南雖容貌懦曌，若不勝衣，而志性抗烈，每論及古先帝王為政得失，必存規諷，多所補益。
manualTranslations.literal: Although Shinian's appearance was timid and frail, as if his clothes were too heavy for him, his will and nature were firm and resolute; whenever he discussed the gains and losses of the governance of ancient and former kings, he always preserved admonition and remonstrance and was of much benefit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Although Shinian's appearance was timid and frail, as if his clothes were too heavy for him, his will and nature were firm and resolute. Whenever he discussed the gains and losses in the governance of ancient and former kings, he always offered admonition and remonstrance and was of much benefit.

manualTranslations.zh: 太宗嘗謂侍臣曰：「朕因暇日，與虞世南商略古今，有一言之失，未嘗不悵恨，其懇誠若此，朕用嘉焉。
manualTranslations.literal: Taizong once said to attending officials: "On my leisure days I discuss past and present with Yu Shinian; for even one misplaced word I have never failed to regret it. Such is his earnest sincerity, and I commend him for it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Taizong once said to attending officials, "On my leisure days I discuss past and present with Yu Shinian. For even one misplaced word I have never failed to regret it. Such is his earnest sincerity, and I commend him for it.

manualTranslations.zh: 群臣皆若世南，天下何憂不理！」
manualTranslations.literal: If all the ministers were like Shinian, what worry would there be that the realm would not be well governed!"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: If all the ministers were like Shinian, what worry would there be that the realm would not be well governed!"

sourceRange.text: 太宗既滅高昌，每歲調發千餘人防遏其地，遂良上疏曰：臣聞古者哲後，必先事華夏而後夷狄，務廣德化，不事遐荒。是以周宣薄伐，至境而止；始皇遠塞，中國分離。漢武負文、景之聚財，玩士馬之餘力，始通西域，初置校尉。軍旅連出，將三十年。復得天馬於宛城，采蒲萄於安息。而海內虛竭，生人失所，租及六畜，算至舟車，因之凶年，盜賊並起，搜粟都尉桑弘羊復希主意，遣士卒遠田輪台，築城以威西域。帝翻然追悔，情發於中，棄輪台之野，下哀痛之詔，人神感悅，海內乃康。向使武帝復用弘羊之言，天下生靈皆盡之矣。是以光武中興，不逾蔥嶺，孝章即位，都護來歸。陛下誅滅高昌，威加西域，收其鯨鯢，以為州縣。然則王師初發之歲，河西供役之年，飛芻挽粟，十室九空，數郡蕭然，五年不復。陛下歲遣千餘人遠事屯戍，終年離別，萬里思歸。去者資裝，自須營辦，既賣菽粟，傾其機杼。經途死亡，復在其外，兼遣罪人，增其防遏。彼罪人者，生於販肆，終朝惰業，犯禁違公。止能擾於邊城，實無益於行陣。所遣之內，復有逃亡，官司捕捉，為國生事。高昌途路，沙磧千里，冬風冰冽，夏風如焚。行人去來，遇之多死。《易》云：「安不忘危，理不忘亂。」設令張掖塵飛，酒泉烽舉，陛下豈能得高昌一人菽粟而及事乎？終鬚髮隴右諸州，星馳電擊。由斯而言，此河西者方於心腹，彼高昌者他人手足，豈得糜費中華，以事無用？《書》曰：「不作無益害有益。」其此之謂乎！陛下道映先天，威行無外，平頡利於沙塞，滅吐渾於西海。突厥余落，為立可汗；吐渾遺氓，更樹君長。復立高昌，非無前例，此所謂有罪而誅之，既伏而立之。四海百蠻，誰不聞見，蠕動懷生，畏威慕德。宜擇高昌可立者立之，征給首領，遣還本國，負戴洪恩，長為籓翰。中國不擾，既富且寧，傳之子孫，以貽永世。

manualTranslations.zh: 太宗既滅高昌，每歲調發千餘人防遏其地，遂良上疏曰：臣聞古者哲後，必先事華夏而後夷狄，務廣德化，不事遐荒。
manualTranslations.literal: After the Taizong Emperor had destroyed Gaochang, each year more than a thousand men were levied and sent to guard and block that territory; Suiliang submitted a memorial, saying: "This subject has heard that in antiquity wise rulers first attended to the Hua-Xia and afterward to the Yi-Di, striving to extend virtue and transformation, not serving distant wilds.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Taizong had destroyed Gaochang, more than a thousand men were levied each year to garrison the region. Suiliang submitted a memorial: "I have heard that in antiquity wise rulers first attended to the Hua-Xia and afterward to the Yi-Di, striving to extend virtue and transformation rather than serving distant wilds.

manualTranslations.zh: 是以周宣薄伐，至境而止；
manualTranslations.literal: Therefore King Xuan of Zhou made a light campaign, reaching the border and stopping;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Therefore King Xuan of Zhou made a light campaign, reaching the border and stopping;

manualTranslations.zh: 始皇遠塞，中國分離。
manualTranslations.literal: the First Emperor made distant barriers, and China was divided.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: the First Emperor made distant barriers, and China was divided.

manualTranslations.zh: 漢武負文、景之聚財，玩士馬之餘力，始通西域，初置校尉。
manualTranslations.literal: Emperor Wu of Han relied on Wen and Jing's accumulated wealth, played with remaining strength of soldiers and horses, first opened the Western Regions, first established commandants.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Emperor Wu of Han relied on the accumulated wealth of Emperors Wen and Jing and played with the remaining strength of soldiers and horses. He first opened the Western Regions and first established commandants.

manualTranslations.zh: 軍旅連出，將三十年。
manualTranslations.literal: Armies and brigades went forth in succession for nearly thirty years.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Armies went forth in succession for nearly thirty years.

manualTranslations.zh: 復得天馬於宛城，采蒲萄於安息。
manualTranslations.literal: He again obtained heavenly horses at Wancheng and gathered grapes at Parthia.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He obtained heavenly horses at Wancheng and gathered grapes at Parthia.

manualTranslations.zh: 而海內虛竭，生人失所，租及六畜，算至舟車，因之凶年，盜賊並起，搜粟都尉桑弘羊復希主意，遣士卒遠田輪台，築城以威西域。
manualTranslations.literal: Yet within the seas was emptied and exhausted, living people lost their places, levies reaching the six livestock, assessments reaching boats and chariots—because of this there were famine years, bandits and robbers rose together; Search-for-Grain Commandant Sang Hongyang again hoped for the ruler's intent, sent soldiers to farm Luntai from afar, built walls to awe the Western Regions.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yet the realm was emptied and exhausted, the living lost their homes, levies reached even the six livestock, and assessments reached boats and chariots. Because of this there were famine years and bandits rose together. Search-for-Grain Commandant Sang Hongyang again hoped for the ruler's intent and sent soldiers to farm Luntai from afar and build walls to awe the Western Regions.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝翻然追悔，情發於中，棄輪台之野，下哀痛之詔，人神感悅，海內乃康。
manualTranslations.literal: The Emperor suddenly turned and regretted, feeling arising from within, abandoned the fields of Luntai, issued the edict of mournful pain—men and spirits were moved and pleased, within the seas then was peace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor suddenly turned and regretted, feeling arising from within. He abandoned the fields of Luntai and issued the edict of mournful pain. Men and spirits were moved and pleased, and the realm then knew peace.

manualTranslations.zh: 向使武帝復用弘羊之言，天下生靈皆盡之矣。
manualTranslations.literal: If formerly Emperor Wu had again used Hongyang's words, all living spirits under Heaven would have been exhausted.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: If Emperor Wu had again used Hongyang's words, all living beings under Heaven would have been exhausted.

manualTranslations.zh: 是以光武中興，不逾蔥嶺，孝章即位，都護來歸。
manualTranslations.literal: Therefore Guangwu's restoration did not cross the Onion Range; when Emperor Zhang assumed the throne, the Protector came to submit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Therefore Guangwu's restoration did not cross the Onion Range, and when Emperor Zhang assumed the throne, the Protector came to submit.

manualTranslations.zh: 陛下誅滅高昌，威加西域，收其鯨鯢，以為州縣。
manualTranslations.literal: Your Majesty executed and destroyed Gaochang, awe extended to the Western Regions, gathered its whales and minnows and made them prefectures and counties.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Your Majesty executed and destroyed Gaochang, extended your awe to the Western Regions, gathered its people, and made them prefectures and counties.

manualTranslations.zh: 然則王師初發之歲，河西供役之年，飛芻挽粟，十室九空，數郡蕭然，五年不復。
manualTranslations.literal: Yet when the royal army first set forth, in the year Hexi supplied labor service, flying fodder and hauling grain—nine of ten houses empty, several commanderies desolate and bleak, five years without recovery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yet in the year when the royal army first set forth, Hexi supplied labor service. Fodder flew and grain was hauled—nine of ten houses stood empty, several commanderies lay desolate, and five years passed without recovery.

manualTranslations.zh: 陛下歲遣千餘人遠事屯戍，終年離別，萬里思歸。
manualTranslations.literal: Your Majesty each year sends more than a thousand men to serve garrison duty from afar—whole years of separation, ten thousand li thinking of return.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Your Majesty each year sends more than a thousand men to serve in distant garrisons. They spend whole years in separation and think of home across ten thousand li.

manualTranslations.zh: 去者資裝，自須營辦，既賣菽粟，傾其機杼。
manualTranslations.literal: Those who go must themselves prepare travel expenses and equipment—having sold beans and millet, they exhaust their looms.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Those who go must themselves prepare travel expenses and equipment. Having sold beans and millet, they exhaust their looms.

manualTranslations.zh: 經途死亡，復在其外，兼遣罪人，增其防遏。
manualTranslations.literal: Death along the route is again outside this; moreover sending criminals increases their guarding and blocking.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Death along the route is in addition to this, and moreover sending criminals increases the burden of guarding and blocking.

manualTranslations.zh: 彼罪人者，生於販肆，終朝惰業，犯禁違公。
manualTranslations.literal: Those criminals are born in markets and shops, all day lazy in occupation, violating prohibitions and going against the public.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Those criminals are born in markets and shops, lazy in occupation all day, violating prohibitions and going against the public good.

manualTranslations.zh: 止能擾於邊城，實無益於行陣。
manualTranslations.literal: They can only disturb border cities and truly have no benefit for battle formations.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They can only disturb border cities and truly have no benefit for battle formations.

manualTranslations.zh: 所遣之內，復有逃亡，官司捕捉，為國生事。
manualTranslations.literal: Among those sent, again there are fugitives; government offices capture them, creating affairs for the state.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Among those sent, there are again fugitives whom government offices must capture, creating troubles for the state.

manualTranslations.zh: 高昌途路，沙磧千里，冬風冰冽，夏風如焚。
manualTranslations.literal: The Gaochang route—sand and desert for a thousand li, winter winds icy and sharp, summer winds like burning.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The route to Gaochang crosses sand and desert for a thousand li. Winter winds are icy and sharp, and summer winds burn like fire.

manualTranslations.zh: 行人去來，遇之多死。
manualTranslations.literal: Travelers coming and going—meeting it many die.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Travelers coming and going—many die upon it.

manualTranslations.zh: 《易》云：「安不忘危，理不忘亂。
manualTranslations.literal: The Changes says: "In security do not forget peril; in order do not forget disorder.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Book of Changes says, "In security do not forget peril; in order do not forget disorder.

manualTranslations.zh: 」設令張掖塵飛，酒泉烽舉，陛下豈能得高昌一人菽粟而及事乎？
manualTranslations.literal: "Suppose Zhangye's dust flies and Jiuquan's beacon fires are raised—can Your Majesty obtain one man of Gaochang's beans and millet and reach the affair?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: "Suppose dust flies at Zhangye and beacon fires rise at Jiuquan—can Your Majesty obtain even one man or one measure of grain from Gaochang and put it to use?"

manualTranslations.zh: 終鬚髮隴右諸州，星馳電擊。
manualTranslations.literal: In the end one must dispatch the Longyou commanderies, stars racing and lightning striking.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the end you must dispatch the Longyou commanderies, racing like stars and striking like lightning.

manualTranslations.zh: 由斯而言，此河西者方於心腹，彼高昌者他人手足，豈得糜費中華，以事無用？
manualTranslations.literal: Speaking from this, this Hexi is like the heart and belly, that Gaochang is another's hands and feet—how can one waste and exhaust the Central States to serve what is useless?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From this perspective, Hexi is like the heart and belly, while Gaochang is another's hands and feet. How can one waste and exhaust the Central States to serve what is useless?"

manualTranslations.zh: 《書》曰：「不作無益害有益。
manualTranslations.literal: The Documents says: "Do not do what is not beneficial and harm what is beneficial.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Book of Documents says, "Do not do what is not beneficial and harm what is beneficial.

manualTranslations.zh: 」其此之謂乎！
manualTranslations.literal: "This is what it means!"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This is what it means!"

manualTranslations.zh: 陛下道映先天，威行無外，平頡利於沙塞，滅吐渾於西海。
manualTranslations.literal: Your Majesty's Way shines before Heaven, awe extends without outer limit, pacified Jieli at the sand passes, destroyed Tuhun at the Western Sea.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Your Majesty's Way shines before Heaven and your awe extends without limit. You pacified Jieli at the sand passes and destroyed Tuhun at the Western Sea.

manualTranslations.zh: 突厥余落，為立可汗；
manualTranslations.literal: Turkish remnant bands—for them a qaghan was established;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: For the Turkish remnant bands you established a qaghan;

manualTranslations.zh: 吐渾遺氓，更樹君長。
manualTranslations.literal: Tuhun's surviving people—again a lord and chief was planted.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: for Tuhun's surviving people you again planted a lord and chief.

manualTranslations.zh: 復立高昌，非無前例，此所謂有罪而誅之，既伏而立之。
manualTranslations.literal: To restore and establish Gaochang is not without former precedent—this is what is called having guilt and executing them, having submitted and then establishing them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: To restore and establish Gaochang is not without former precedent. This is what is called punishing the guilty and, once they have submitted, establishing them anew.

manualTranslations.zh: 四海百蠻，誰不聞見，蠕動懷生，畏威慕德。
manualTranslations.literal: Within the four seas the hundred barbarians—who does not hear and see? Wriggling things cherishing life, fearing awe and admiring virtue.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Within the four seas the hundred barbarians—who does not hear and see? All living things cherish life, fear your awe, and admire your virtue.

manualTranslations.zh: 宜擇高昌可立者立之，征給首領，遣還本國，負戴洪恩，長為籓翰。
manualTranslations.literal: One should select one among Gaochang who can be established and establish him, levy and supply a chief, send back to his native state, bearing and carrying vast favor, long serving as screen and balustrade.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: You should select one among Gaochang who can be established and establish him, levy and supply a chief, and send him back to his native state. Bearing your vast favor, he will long serve as your screen and balustrade.

manualTranslations.zh: 中國不擾，既富且寧，傳之子孫，以貽永世。
manualTranslations.literal: The Central States undisturbed, already rich and at peace, transmitted to sons and grandsons, to bequeath for eternal generations.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Central States will remain undisturbed, already rich and at peace, and this may be transmitted to your sons and grandsons to bequeath for eternal generations.

sourceRange.text: 遂良上疏曰：臣聞信為國本，百姓所歸，是以文王許枯骨而不違，仲尼寧去食而存信。延陀曩歲乃一俟斤耳，值神兵北指，蕩平沙塞，狼山、瀚海，萬里蕭條，陛下兵加諸外而恩起於內，以為余寇奔波，須立酋長，璽書鼓纛，立為可汗。其懷恩光，仰天無極，而余方戎狄，莫不聞知，以共沐和風，同餐恩信。頃者頻年遣使，請婚大國，陛下復降鴻私，許其姻媾。於是報吐蕃，告思摩，示中國，五尺童子人皆知之。於是御幸北門，受其獻食，於時百僚端笏，戎夷左衽，虔奉歡宴，皆承德音，口歌手舞，樂以終日。百官會畢，亦各有言，咸以為陛下欲得百姓安寧，不欲邊境交戰，遂不惜一女而妻可汗，預在含生，所以感德。今一朝生進退之意，有改悔之心，臣為國家惜茲聲聽。君子不失色於物，不失口於人。晉文公圍原，命三日糧，原不降，命去之。諜出曰：「原將降矣。」軍吏請待之，公曰：「信，國之寶也，民之庇也。得原失信，何以庇之？」陛下慮生意表，信在言前，今者臨事，忽然乖殊，所惜尤少，所失滋多。情既不通，方生嫌隙，一方所以相畏忌，邊境不得無風塵。西州、朔方，能無勞擾？彼胡以主被欺而心怨，此士以此無信而懷慚，不可以訓戎兵，不可以勵軍事。伏惟陛下以聖德神功，廓清四表。自君臨天下，十有七載，以仁恩而結庶類，以信義而撫戎夷，莫不欣然，負之無力。其見在之人，皆思報厚德；其所生胤嗣，亦望報陛下子孫。今者得一公主配之，以成陛下之信，有始有卒，其唯聖人乎！且又龍沙以北，部落無算，中國擊之，終不能盡。亦由可北敗，芮芮興，突厥亡，延陀盛。時以古人虛外實內，懷之以德，為惡在夷不在華，失信在彼不在此。伏惟陛下聖德無涯，威靈遠震，遂平高昌，破吐渾，立延陀，滅頡利。輕刑薄賦，庶事無壅，菽粟豐賤，祥符累臻。此則堯、舜、禹、湯不及陛下遠矣。伏願旁垂愷悌，廣茲含育，而常嗔絕域，有意遠籓，非偃伯興文之道，非止戈為武之義。臣以庸暗，忝居左右，敢獻瞽言，不勝戰懼。

manualTranslations.zh: 遂良上疏曰：臣聞信為國本，百姓所歸，是以文王許枯骨而不違，仲尼寧去食而存信。
manualTranslations.literal: Suiliang submitted a memorial, saying: "This subject has heard that trustworthiness is the root of the state and what the hundred names return to—therefore King Wen promised dried bones and did not violate it; Zhongni would rather leave food and preserve trust.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Suiliang submitted a memorial: "I have heard that trustworthiness is the foundation of a state and what the people rely upon. King Wen once promised even dried bones and did not break his word. Confucius said he would rather go without food than abandon trust.

manualTranslations.zh: 延陀曩歲乃一俟斤耳，值神兵北指，蕩平沙塞，狼山、瀚海，萬里蕭條，陛下兵加諸外而恩起於內，以為余寇奔波，須立酋長，璽書鼓纛，立為可汗。
manualTranslations.literal: Xueyantuo in former years was but one tribal leader; when divine troops pointed north, leveling the sand passes, Wolf Mountain and the Sea of Sand for ten thousand li were desolate and bleak—Your Majesty's armies were applied to the outer lands while favor arose within, thinking the remnant bandits scattered in flight needed a chief established; imperial writ and drums and banners established him as qaghan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In former years Xueyantuo was but a single tribal leader. When Your Majesty's armies marched north and swept the desert passes clean, Wolf Mountain and the Sea of Sand lay desolate for a thousand li. Your Majesty extended military force abroad while showing grace at home, judging that the scattered remnant tribes needed a chief. With imperial writ and banners raised, he was established as qaghan.

manualTranslations.zh: 其懷恩光，仰天無極，而余方戎狄，莫不聞知，以共沐和風，同餐恩信。
manualTranslations.literal: He cherished the favor's radiance, looking up to Heaven without limit; the remaining frontier barbarians all heard and knew, thereby together bathing in gentle wind and sharing favor and trust.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He cherished Your Majesty's grace beyond measure, and the remaining frontier peoples all heard of it and shared alike in gentle favor and trusting goodwill.

manualTranslations.zh: 頃者頻年遣使，請婚大國，陛下復降鴻私，許其姻媾。
manualTranslations.literal: Recently for successive years he sent envoys requesting marriage with the great state; Your Majesty again descended vast favor and promised the marriage alliance.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In recent years he has repeatedly sent envoys to request marriage with the great state. Your Majesty again showed vast favor and promised the alliance.

manualTranslations.zh: 於是報吐蕃，告思摩，示中國，五尺童子人皆知之。
manualTranslations.literal: Thereupon reporting to Tibet, informing Shimi, displaying to China—every five-foot child knew it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: You reported this to Tibet, informed Shimi, and displayed it to all within China, so that even children knew of it.

manualTranslations.zh: 於是御幸北門，受其獻食，於時百僚端笏，戎夷左衽，虔奉歡宴，皆承德音，口歌手舞，樂以終日。
manualTranslations.literal: Thereupon Your Majesty in person visited the North Gate and received their presented food; at the time the hundred officials held tablets upright, Rong and Yi wore left lapel, reverently offering joyous feast—all received the virtuous pronouncement, mouths singing and hands dancing, joy until the day's end.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Your Majesty then visited the North Gate in person and received their offerings of food. The hundred officials held their tablets upright while the barbarian guests wore their left lapels. All reverently joined the joyous feast, received your gracious words, sang and danced with joy until the day ended.

manualTranslations.zh: 百官會畢，亦各有言，咸以為陛下欲得百姓安寧，不欲邊境交戰，遂不惜一女而妻可汗，預在含生，所以感德。
manualTranslations.literal: When the hundred officials' assembly concluded, each also had words—all thought Your Majesty wished to obtain the hundred names' peace and quiet, did not wish borderlands to exchange battle, and therefore did not spare one daughter to marry the qaghan; beforehand among all who bear life, therefore they were moved by virtue.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the assembly of officials ended, each had his own comment. All believed Your Majesty wished the people to live in peace and did not wish war on the borders, and therefore did not spare a daughter to marry the qaghan. Even the unborn, it was thought, would be moved by such virtue.

manualTranslations.zh: 今一朝生進退之意，有改悔之心，臣為國家惜茲聲聽。
manualTranslations.literal: Now in one morning there arises intent to advance and retreat, a heart to change and regret—this subject for the state grieves this reputation and hearing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Now, in a single morning, there arises an intent to advance and retreat and a heart to change and regret. I grieve for the state's reputation and credibility.

manualTranslations.zh: 君子不失色於物，不失口於人。
manualTranslations.literal: The noble man does not lose composure over things, does not lose words toward people.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: A noble man does not change his expression because of things, and he does not go back on his word to others.

manualTranslations.zh: 晉文公圍原，命三日糧，原不降，命去之。
manualTranslations.literal: Duke Wen of Jin besieged Yuan, ordered three days' provisions; Yuan did not surrender, he ordered to leave it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Duke Wen of Jin besieged Yuan and ordered three days' provisions brought up. When Yuan did not surrender, he ordered the army to withdraw.

manualTranslations.zh: 諜出曰：「原將降矣。
manualTranslations.literal: A spy came out and said: "Yuan is about to surrender.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: A spy came out and reported, "Yuan is about to surrender.

manualTranslations.zh: 」軍吏請待之，公曰：「信，國之寶也，民之庇也。
manualTranslations.literal: "The army officers asked to wait; the duke said: "Trustworthiness is the state's treasure and the people's shelter.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: "The army officers asked to wait, but the duke said, "Trustworthiness is the state's treasure and the people's shelter.

manualTranslations.zh: 得原失信，何以庇之？
manualTranslations.literal: Obtain Yuan yet lose trust—how can one shelter them?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: If we take Yuan but lose our trust, how can we shelter the people?"

manualTranslations.zh: 」陛下慮生意表，信在言前，今者臨事，忽然乖殊，所惜尤少，所失滋多。
manualTranslations.literal: "Your Majesty's concern for living things shows on your face; trust comes before words—now facing affairs, suddenly there is divergence; what is regretted is especially little, what is lost grows much.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: "Your Majesty's concern for living beings is written on your face, and your trustworthiness has always preceded your words. Yet now, when the matter is at hand, you have suddenly changed course. What you would save is very little, but what you would lose is very great.

manualTranslations.zh: 情既不通，方生嫌隙，一方所以相畏忌，邊境不得無風塵。
manualTranslations.literal: Feelings already not in accord, suspicion and rifts just arise—on one side therefore mutual fear and jealousy; the borderlands cannot be without wind and dust.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When feelings no longer accord, suspicion and rifts arise. On their side there will be mutual fear and jealousy, and the borders cannot remain free of turmoil."

manualTranslations.zh: 西州、朔方，能無勞擾？
manualTranslations.literal: Xizhou and Shuofang—can they be without labor and disturbance?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Can Xizhou and Shuofang escape labor and disturbance?"

manualTranslations.zh: 彼胡以主被欺而心怨，此士以此無信而懷慚，不可以訓戎兵，不可以勵軍事。
manualTranslations.literal: Those barbarians because the ruler was deceived will harbor resentment in heart; these soldiers because of this lack of trust will bear shame in heart—one cannot use this to instruct Rong troops, cannot use this to encourage military affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The barbarians will resent that their ruler was deceived, and our soldiers will be ashamed that we proved untrustworthy. This cannot be used to instruct frontier troops or to encourage military affairs."

manualTranslations.zh: 伏惟陛下以聖德神功，廓清四表。
manualTranslations.literal: I prostrate myself wishing Your Majesty, by sagely virtue and divine achievement, to clear and pacify the four quarters.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I respectfully note that Your Majesty, through sagely virtue and divine achievement, has cleared and pacified the four quarters.

manualTranslations.zh: 自君臨天下，十有七載，以仁恩而結庶類，以信義而撫戎夷，莫不欣然，負之無力。
manualTranslations.literal: Since assuming lordship over all under Heaven, for seventeen years, with benevolence and grace binding the myriad kinds, with trust and righteousness soothing Rong and Yi—all without exception rejoiced, bearing it without strength to refuse.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Since you assumed the throne, for seventeen years you have bound the myriad peoples with benevolence and grace and soothed the frontier tribes with trust and righteousness. All have rejoiced and accepted your rule willingly.

manualTranslations.zh: 其見在之人，皆思報厚德；
manualTranslations.literal: Those now living all think to repay deep virtue;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Those now living all wish to repay your deep virtue;

manualTranslations.zh: 其所生胤嗣，亦望報陛下子孫。
manualTranslations.literal: their born descendants also hope to repay Your Majesty's descendants.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: and their descendants also hope to repay Your Majesty's descendants."

manualTranslations.zh: 今者得一公主配之，以成陛下之信，有始有卒，其唯聖人乎！
manualTranslations.literal: Now obtain one princess to match with him, thereby completing Your Majesty's trust—having beginning and having end, is this not only for the sage?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Now, if you give one princess in marriage to him, you will fulfill Your Majesty's trust. To have a beginning and an end—surely that is the way of a sage!"

manualTranslations.zh: 且又龍沙以北，部落無算，中國擊之，終不能盡。
manualTranslations.literal: Moreover north of Dragon Sand, tribes are beyond counting; China strikes them yet ultimately cannot exhaust them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Moreover, north of the desert the tribes are beyond counting. China may strike them, yet can never destroy them all.

manualTranslations.zh: 亦由可北敗，芮芮興，突厥亡，延陀盛。
manualTranslations.literal: Also because the Kehan was defeated in the north, Rouran rose, the Turks perished, and Xueyantuo flourished.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This is also why, when the qaghan was defeated in the north, Rouran rose, the Turks perished, and Xueyantuo flourished.

manualTranslations.zh: 時以古人虛外實內，懷之以德，為惡在夷不在華，失信在彼不在此。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time the ancients made the outer empty and the inner solid, cherishing them with virtue—evil lies with the Yi, not with the Hua; loss of trust lies with them, not with us.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The ancients made the outer realm empty and the inner realm solid, cherishing the frontier peoples with virtue. Evil should lie with the barbarians, not with China; breach of trust should lie with them, not with us.

manualTranslations.zh: 伏惟陛下聖德無涯，威靈遠震，遂平高昌，破吐渾，立延陀，滅頡利。
manualTranslations.literal: I prostrate myself wishing Your Majesty's sagely virtue without limit, awe-inspiring spirit shaking far—thereupon pacifying Gaochang, breaking Tuhun, establishing Xueyantuo, destroying Jieli.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Your Majesty's sagely virtue is boundless and your awe-inspiring spirit shakes the distant realms. You pacified Gaochang, broke Tuhun, established Xueyantuo, and destroyed Jieli.

manualTranslations.zh: 輕刑薄賦，庶事無壅，菽粟豐賤，祥符累臻。
manualTranslations.literal: Light punishments and thin levies, the hundred affairs without obstruction, grain and millet abundant and cheap, auspicious signs repeatedly arriving.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: You lightened punishments and reduced levies, so that the hundred affairs flowed without obstruction, grain grew abundant and cheap, and auspicious signs arrived one after another.

manualTranslations.zh: 此則堯、舜、禹、湯不及陛下遠矣。
manualTranslations.literal: In this Yao, Shun, Yu, and Tang do not reach Your Majesty by far.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In this respect Yao, Shun, Yu, and Tang fall far short of Your Majesty.

manualTranslations.zh: 伏願旁垂愷悌，廣茲含育，而常嗔絕域，有意遠籓，非偃伯興文之道，非止戈為武之義。
manualTranslations.literal: I prostrate myself wishing Your Majesty to extend kindness and forbearance on every side, broadly nurture and rear—yet constantly to rage at distant regions and intend toward far vassals is not the Way of resting the hegemon and raising culture, not the meaning of stopping weapons to make martial virtue.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I beg Your Majesty to extend kindness and forbearance on every side and broadly nurture all peoples. Yet constantly to rage at distant regions and turn your intent toward far vassals is not the way of resting the hegemon and raising culture, nor the meaning of stopping weapons to make true martial virtue.

manualTranslations.zh: 臣以庸暗，忝居左右，敢獻瞽言，不勝戰懼。
manualTranslations.literal: This subject, by mediocrity and dimness, disgracefully occupies Your left and right, dares offer blind words, cannot overcome trembling fear.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I am mediocre and dull, yet I disgracefully serve at Your side. I dare offer these blind words, overcome with trembling fear.

sourceRange.text: 遂良以太宗銳意三韓，懼其遺悔，翌日上疏諫曰：臣聞有國家者譬諸身，兩京等於心腹，四境方乎手足，他方絕域，若在身外。臣近於坐下，伏奉口敕，布語臣下，雲自欲伐遼。臣數夜思量，不達其理。高麗王為陛下之所立，莫離支輒殺其主，陛下討逆收地，斯實乘機。關東賴陛下德澤，久無征戰，但命二、三勇將，發兵四、五萬，飛石輕梯，取如回掌。夫聖人有作，必履常規，貴能克平凶亂，駕馭才傑。惟陛下弘兩儀之道，扇三五之風，提厲人物，皆思效命。昔侯君集、李靖，所謂庸夫，猶能掃萬里之高昌，平千載之突厥，皆是陛下發蹤指示，聲歸聖明。臣旁求史籍，訖乎近代，為人之主，無自伐遼，人臣往征，則有之矣。漢朝則荀彘、楊僕，魏代則毋丘儉、王頎；司馬懿猶為人臣，慕容真僭號之子，皆為其主長驅高麗，虜其人民，削平城壘。陛下立功同於天地，美化包於古昔，自當超邁於百王，豈止俯同於六子？陛下昔翦平寇逆，大有爪牙，年齒未衰，猶堪任用，匪唯陛下之所使，亦何行而不克。方今太子新立，年實幼少，自余籓屏，陛下所知。今一旦棄金湯之全，渡遼海之外，臣忽三思，煩愁並集。大魚依於巨海，神龍據於川泉，此謂人君不可輕而遠也。且以長遼之左，或遇霖淫，水潦騰波，平地數尺。夫帶方、玄菟，海途深渺，非萬乘所宜行踐。東京太原，謂之中地，東捴可以為聲勢，西指足以摧延陀，其於西京，逕路非遠，為其節度，以設軍謀，系莫離支頸，獻皇家之廟。此實處安全之上計，社稷之根本，特乞天慈，一垂省察。

manualTranslations.zh: 遂良以太宗銳意三韓，懼其遺悔，翌日上疏諫曰：臣聞有國家者譬諸身，兩京等於心腹，四境方乎手足，他方絕域，若在身外。
manualTranslations.literal: Suiliang because the Taizong Emperor was keen on the Three Han, feared he would leave regret, and the next day submitted a memorial remonstrating, saying: "This subject has heard that one who has a state is compared to the body—the two capitals equal the heart and belly, the four borders are like the hands and feet, other regions and distant realms are as if outside the body.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because Taizong was keen on the Three Han states, Suiliang feared he would later regret it. The next day he submitted a memorial of remonstrance: "I have heard that one who possesses a state may be compared to the body. The two capitals are like the heart and belly, the four borders like the hands and feet, and other regions and distant realms are as if outside the body.

manualTranslations.zh: 臣近於坐下，伏奉口敕，布語臣下，雲自欲伐遼。
manualTranslations.literal: This subject recently below Your seat, prostrate received oral edict, promulgated words to ministers below, saying you yourself wish to attack Liao.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Recently below Your seat I received an oral edict, promulgated to your ministers below, saying that you yourself wish to attack Liao.

manualTranslations.zh: 臣數夜思量，不達其理。
manualTranslations.literal: This subject for several nights pondered and could not reach its principle.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: For several nights I have pondered this and cannot understand its rationale.

manualTranslations.zh: 高麗王為陛下之所立，莫離支輒殺其主，陛下討逆收地，斯實乘機。
manualTranslations.literal: The King of Goryeo was established by Your Majesty; Yeon Gaesomun abruptly killed his lord—Your Majesty punishing rebellion and recovering territory is truly seizing the opportunity.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The King of Goryeo was established by Your Majesty. Yeon Gaesomun abruptly killed his lord. For Your Majesty to punish the rebel and recover the territory is truly to seize the opportune moment.

manualTranslations.zh: 關東賴陛下德澤，久無征戰，但命二、三勇將，發兵四、五萬，飛石輕梯，取如回掌。
manualTranslations.literal: Guandong relies on Your Majesty's virtue and favor, long without campaigns and battles—only command two or three brave generals, send forth forty or fifty thousand troops, flying stones and light ladders, taking it like turning the palm.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Guandong relies on Your Majesty's virtue and grace and has long been free of warfare. You need only command two or three brave generals and send forth forty or fifty thousand troops. With flying stones and light ladders, taking it would be like turning the palm.

manualTranslations.zh: 夫聖人有作，必履常規，貴能克平凶亂，駕馭才傑。
manualTranslations.literal: The sage when he acts must tread constant norms, valuing the ability to overcome and pacify fierce disorder and to drive and control talented heroes.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When a sage acts, he must follow constant norms, valuing the ability to overcome fierce disorder and to drive and control talented heroes.

manualTranslations.zh: 惟陛下弘兩儀之道，扇三五之風，提厲人物，皆思效命。
manualTranslations.literal: Only Your Majesty expands the Way of the Two Principles, fans the wind of the Three and Five, lifts and sharpens men and things—all think to offer their lives.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Your Majesty alone expands the Way of the Two Principles and fans the wind of the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors, lifting and sharpening men of talent, all of whom wish to offer their lives.

manualTranslations.zh: 昔侯君集、李靖，所謂庸夫，猶能掃萬里之高昌，平千載之突厥，皆是陛下發蹤指示，聲歸聖明。
manualTranslations.literal: Formerly Hou Junji and Li Jing, so-called mediocre men, still could sweep ten-thousand-li Gaochang and pacify thousand-year Turks—all were Your Majesty issuing tracks and giving directions, reputation returning to sagely brilliance.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Formerly Hou Junji and Li Jing, so-called mediocre men, still swept Gaochang ten thousand li away and pacified the Turks of a thousand years—all because Your Majesty set them on the track and gave directions, and the credit returned to your sagely brilliance.

manualTranslations.zh: 臣旁求史籍，訖乎近代，為人之主，無自伐遼，人臣往征，則有之矣。
manualTranslations.literal: This subject searched history on every side down to recent times—as ruler of men, none personally campaigned against Liao; as ministers going on campaign, there have been such cases.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I have searched the histories on every side down to recent times. As ruler of men, none has personally campaigned against Liao, though as ministers going on campaign there have been such cases.

manualTranslations.zh: 漢朝則荀彘、楊僕，魏代則毋丘儉、王頎；
manualTranslations.literal: Han dynasty then Xun Yi and Yang Pu; Wei era then Wuqiu Jian and Wang Qi;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the Han dynasty there were Xun Yi and Yang Pu; in the Wei era there were Wuqiu Jian and Wang Qi;

manualTranslations.zh: 司馬懿猶為人臣，慕容真僭號之子，皆為其主長驅高麗，虜其人民，削平城壘。
manualTranslations.literal: Sima Yi was still a minister of men; Murong Zhen was a son who usurped a title—all for their lords drove far into Goryeo, captured its people, and leveled walls and ramparts.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sima Yi was still a minister of men, and Murong Zhen was the son of a usurper—all of them for their lords drove deep into Goryeo, captured its people, and leveled walls and ramparts.

manualTranslations.zh: 陛下立功同於天地，美化包於古昔，自當超邁於百王，豈止俯同於六子？
manualTranslations.literal: Your Majesty's establishment of achievement equals Heaven and Earth, civilizing transformation embraces antiquity—you should naturally surpass the hundred kings, how only bow to match the six sons?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Your Majesty's achievements equal Heaven and Earth, and your civilizing transformation embraces antiquity. You should naturally surpass the hundred kings—how could you merely bow to match the six sons?

manualTranslations.zh: 陛下昔翦平寇逆，大有爪牙，年齒未衰，猶堪任用，匪唯陛下之所使，亦何行而不克。
manualTranslations.literal: Your Majesty formerly cut down and pacified bandit rebels, greatly possessing claws and fangs; years not yet declined, still fit for employment—not only those Your Majesty can employ, what undertaking would not succeed?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Your Majesty formerly cut down bandit rebels and greatly possessed capable men. Your years are not yet declined and they are still fit for employment. Not only can Your Majesty employ them—what undertaking would they not succeed in?

manualTranslations.zh: 方今太子新立，年實幼少，自余籓屏，陛下所知。
manualTranslations.literal: Just now the Crown Prince is newly established, years truly young and small; the rest of the screen of vassals Your Majesty knows.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Just now the crown prince has been newly established and is truly young. As for the rest of the princely screen, Your Majesty knows them well.

manualTranslations.zh: 今一旦棄金湯之全，渡遼海之外，臣忽三思，煩愁並集。
manualTranslations.literal: Now in one morning abandoning the completeness of metal and boiling water, crossing beyond the Liao Sea—this subject suddenly thrice thinks, worry and sorrow together gather.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Now, in a single morning, to abandon the completeness of metal and boiling water and cross beyond the Liao Sea—when I think of it three times over, worry and sorrow gather together.

manualTranslations.zh: 大魚依於巨海，神龍據於川泉，此謂人君不可輕而遠也。
manualTranslations.literal: Great fish rely on the vast sea; divine dragon occupies streams and springs—this means the ruler of men cannot be lightly made distant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Great fish rely on the vast sea, and the divine dragon occupies streams and springs. This means that the ruler of men cannot lightly go far from home.

manualTranslations.zh: 且以長遼之左，或遇霖淫，水潦騰波，平地數尺。
manualTranslations.literal: Moreover along the left of long Liao, one may meet prolonged rain; floods surge in waves, level ground several feet.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Moreover, along the left bank of the long Liao, one may meet prolonged rain, when floods surge in waves and the level ground stands several feet deep.

manualTranslations.zh: 夫帶方、玄菟，海途深渺，非萬乘所宜行踐。
manualTranslations.literal: Daifang and Xuantu—the sea route deep and vast, not what ten-thousand chariots should tread.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Daifang and Xuantu lie along a sea route deep and vast—not a path that the Son of Heaven should tread.

manualTranslations.zh: 東京太原，謂之中地，東捴可以為聲勢，西指足以摧延陀，其於西京，逕路非遠，為其節度，以設軍謀，系莫離支頸，獻皇家之廟。
manualTranslations.literal: Eastern Capital Taiyuan is called the central land—eastward gathering can serve as sound and momentum, westward pointing suffices to crush Xueyantuo; as for Western Capital, the direct route is not far, make dispositions for it, set military plans, tie Yeon Gaesomun's neck, present to the imperial clan temple.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Eastern Capital at Taiyuan is called the central land. A gathering to the east can serve as momentum, and a thrust to the west suffices to crush Xueyantuo. As for the Western Capital, the direct route is not far. Make dispositions from there, set military plans, tie Yeon Gaesomun by the neck, and present his head in the imperial clan temple.

manualTranslations.zh: 此實處安全之上計，社稷之根本，特乞天慈，一垂省察。
manualTranslations.literal: This is truly the upper plan for dwelling in security, the root of altars of soil and grain—I specially beg heavenly kindness, once to extend examination.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This is truly the best plan for dwelling in security and the root of the altars of state. I specially beg your heavenly kindness to examine it once.

sourceRange.text: 遂良復上疏諫曰：臣聞周世問安，三至必退，漢儲視膳，五日乃來。前賢作法，規模弘遠。禮曰：「男子十年出就外傅，出宿於外，學書計也。然則古之達者，豈無慈心？減茲私愛，欲使成立。凡人尚猶如此，況君之世子乎？自當春誦夏弦，親近師傅，體人間之庶事，適君臣之大道，使翹足延首，皆聆善聲。若獻歲之有陽春，玄天之有日月，弘此懿德，乃作元良。伏惟陛下道育三才，功包九有，親樹太子，莫不欣欣。既雲廢昏立明，須稱天下瞻望，而教成之道，實深乖闕。不離膝下，常居宮內，保傅之說無暢，經籍之談蔑如。且朋友不可以深交，深交必有怨；父子不可以滯愛，滯愛或生愆。伏願遠覽殷、周，近遵漢、魏，不可頓革，事須階漸。嘗計旬日，半遣還宮，專學藝以潤身，布芳聲於天下，則微臣雖死，猶曰生年。

localRange.text: 遂良復上疏諫曰：

context.beforeSource: 二十年，太宗於寢殿側別置一院，令太子居，絕不令往東宮。
context.afterSource: 太宗從之。
context.beforeLocal: 二十年，太宗於寢殿側別置一院，令太子居，絕不令往東宮。
context.afterLocal: 太宗從之。

manualTranslations.zh: 遂良復上疏諫曰：臣聞周世問安，三至必退，漢儲視膳，五日乃來。
manualTranslations.literal: Suiliang again submitted a memorial remonstrating, saying: "This subject has heard that in Zhou times one inquired after well-being, three visits then must withdraw; Han heir viewed meals, five days then would come.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Suiliang again submitted a memorial of remonstrance: "I have heard that in Zhou times one inquired after the ruler's well-being but withdrew after three visits, and that the Han heir viewed his father's meals but came only every five days.

manualTranslations.zh: 前賢作法，規模弘遠。
manualTranslations.literal: Former worthies made their methods, their scope vast and far-reaching.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Former worthies established their methods on a vast and far-reaching scale.

manualTranslations.zh: 禮曰：「男子十年出就外傅，出宿於外，學書計也。
manualTranslations.literal: The Rites say: "At ten years a boy goes out to his outer tutor, lodges outside, to learn writing and reckoning.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Rites say, "At ten years a boy goes out to his outer tutor and lodges outside, to learn writing and reckoning.

manualTranslations.zh: 然則古之達者，豈無慈心？
manualTranslations.literal: Thus the accomplished men of antiquity—how could they lack a loving heart?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Thus the accomplished men of antiquity—did they lack a loving heart?

manualTranslations.zh: 減茲私愛，欲使成立。
manualTranslations.literal: They reduced this private love, wishing to make him established.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They reduced this private love in order to help him become established.

manualTranslations.zh: 凡人尚猶如此，況君之世子乎？
manualTranslations.literal: Ordinary men still are thus—how much more the ruler's heir?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: If ordinary men still did so, how much more the ruler's heir?

manualTranslations.zh: 自當春誦夏弦，親近師傅，體人間之庶事，適君臣之大道，使翹足延首，皆聆善聲。
manualTranslations.literal: He should naturally in spring recite and in summer play the lute, draw near teachers and masters, embody the myriad affairs of human society, accord with the great Way of ruler and minister, making all crane their feet and stretch their necks to hear good sounds.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He should naturally study the classics in spring and music in summer, draw near his teachers, learn the myriad affairs of human society, and accord with the great Way of ruler and minister, so that all crane their feet and stretch their necks to hear good counsel.

manualTranslations.zh: 若獻歲之有陽春，玄天之有日月，弘此懿德，乃作元良。
manualTranslations.literal: Like the offering year's having spring, the dark Heaven's having sun and moon—expand this excellent virtue and then become the primary good.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Like the offering year having its spring, or the dark Heaven having its sun and moon—expand this excellent virtue and he will become a true heir.

manualTranslations.zh: 伏惟陛下道育三才，功包九有，親樹太子，莫不欣欣。
manualTranslations.literal: I prostrate myself wishing Your Majesty's Way nurtures the three talents, achievements embrace the nine possessions, personally planting the Crown Prince—all without exception rejoice.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Your Majesty's Way nurtures the three talents and your achievements embrace the nine realms. When you personally established the crown prince, all rejoiced.

manualTranslations.zh: 既雲廢昏立明，須稱天下瞻望，而教成之道，實深乖闕。
manualTranslations.literal: Having said to depose the dim and establish the bright, it must be called what all under Heaven look up to—yet the Way of teaching and completion is truly deeply at odds and lacking.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Having said you would depose the unworthy and establish the worthy, it must be what all under Heaven look up to—yet the Way of teaching and completion is truly deeply deficient.

manualTranslations.zh: 不離膝下，常居宮內，保傅之說無暢，經籍之談蔑如。
manualTranslations.literal: Not leaving below the knees, constantly dwelling within the palace—the guardian and tutor's explanations not flowing freely, the classics' discussions treated as nothing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He does not leave your knees and constantly dwells within the palace. The guardian and tutor's explanations do not flow freely, and discussions of the classics are treated as nothing.

manualTranslations.zh: 且朋友不可以深交，深交必有怨；
manualTranslations.literal: Moreover friends cannot be deeply befriended—deep friendship surely has resentment;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Moreover, friends cannot be deeply befriended—deep friendship surely breeds resentment;

manualTranslations.zh: 父子不可以滯愛，滯愛或生愆。
manualTranslations.literal: father and son cannot have stagnant love—stagnant love perhaps produces fault.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: and father and son cannot have stagnant love—stagnant love may produce fault.

manualTranslations.zh: 伏願遠覽殷、周，近遵漢、魏，不可頓革，事須階漸。
manualTranslations.literal: I prostrate myself wishing to view far Yin and Zhou, near follow Han and Wei—cannot suddenly change, affairs must proceed by steps and gradations.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I beg Your Majesty to view far the examples of Yin and Zhou and near follow those of Han and Wei. One cannot change suddenly; the matter must proceed step by step.

manualTranslations.zh: 嘗計旬日，半遣還宮，專學藝以潤身，布芳聲於天下，則微臣雖死，猶曰生年。
manualTranslations.literal: Try calculating ten-day periods, half sent back to the palace, exclusively studying arts to enrich the person, spreading fragrant reputation through all under Heaven—then this humble subject though dead would still be called living years.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Try calculating in ten-day periods: half the time send him back to the palace, and let him exclusively study the arts to enrich himself and spread a fragrant reputation through all under Heaven. Then this humble subject, though dead, would still count as living.

sourceRange.text: 承乾大怒，陰遣刺客張師政、紇干承基就殺之。二人潛入其第，見志寧寢處苫廬，竟不忍而止。及承乾敗後，推鞫具知其事。太宗謂志寧曰：「知公數有規諫，事無所隱。」深加勉勞。右庶子令狐德棻等以無諫書，皆從貶責。及高宗為皇太子，復授志寧太子左庶子，未幾遷侍中。永徽元年，加光祿大夫，進封燕國公。二年，監修國史。時洛陽人李弘泰坐誣告太尉長孫無忌，詔令不待時而斬決。

manualTranslations.zh: 承乾大怒，陰遣刺客張師政、紇干承基就殺之。
manualTranslations.literal: Chengan was greatly enraged and secretly sent assassins Zhang Shizheng and Qigan Chengji to go kill him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chengan flew into a rage and secretly sent the assassins Zhang Shizheng and Qigan Chengji to kill him.

manualTranslations.zh: 二人潛入其第，見志寧寢處苫廬，竟不忍而止。
manualTranslations.literal: The two men stole into his residence and saw Zhining sleeping in a mourning hut of straw; in the end they could not bear it and stopped.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The two men stole into his residence and found Zhining in the mourning hut beside his mother's bier; they could not bring themselves to kill him and withdrew.

manualTranslations.zh: 及承乾敗後，推鞫具知其事。
manualTranslations.literal: When Chengan was defeated afterward, investigation fully revealed the affair.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Chengan's downfall, investigation fully revealed what had happened.

manualTranslations.zh: 太宗謂志寧曰：「知公數有規諫，事無所隱。」
manualTranslations.literal: Taizong said to Zhining, "I know you have remonstrated repeatedly, and nothing is hidden in the matter."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Taizong said to Zhining, "I know you have remonstrated repeatedly, and nothing in this affair has been concealed."

manualTranslations.zh: 深加勉勞。
manualTranslations.literal: He greatly encouraged and comforted him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He greatly commended and comforted him.

manualTranslations.zh: 右庶子令狐德棻等以無諫書，皆從貶責。
manualTranslations.literal: Right Junior Tutor Linghu Defen and others, because they had no written remonstrances, were all demoted and punished.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Right Junior Tutor Linghu Defen and others, because they had left no written remonstrances, were all demoted and punished.

manualTranslations.zh: 及高宗為皇太子，復授志寧太子左庶子，未幾遷侍中。
manualTranslations.literal: When Gaozong became crown prince, Zhining was again appointed left junior tutor of the crown prince, and before long was transferred to palace attendant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Gaozong became crown prince, Zhining was again appointed left junior tutor of the crown prince, and before long was promoted to palace attendant.

manualTranslations.zh: 永徽元年，加光祿大夫，進封燕國公。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Yonghui he was given the additional title grand master of splendid happiness and advanced to Duke of Yan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yonghui (650) he was given the additional title grand master of splendid happiness and advanced to Duke of Yan.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年，監修國史。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year he supervised compilation of the national history.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year he was put in charge of compiling the national history.

manualTranslations.zh: 時洛陽人李弘泰坐誣告太尉長孫無忌，詔令不待時而斬決。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time Li Hongtai of Luoyang was convicted of falsely accusing Grand Preceptor Zhangsun Wuji, and an edict ordered his execution without waiting for the season.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At that time Li Hongtai of Luoyang was convicted of falsely accusing Grand Preceptor Zhangsun Wuji, and an edict ordered his immediate execution.

sourceRange.text: 神龍元年正月，則天病甚。是月二十日，宰臣崔玄暐、張柬之等起羽林兵迎太子，至玄武門，斬關而入，誅易之、昌宗於迎仙院，並梟首於天津橋南。則天遜居上陽宮。易之兄昌期，歷岐、汝二州刺史，所在苛猛暴橫，是日亦同梟首。朝官房融、崔神慶、崔融、李嶠、宋之問、杜審言、沈佺期、閻朝隱等皆坐二張竄逐，凡數十人。

sourceRange.text: 臨奏曰：臣聞國家大典，在於賞刑，古先聖王，惟刑是釁。《尚書虞書》曰：“罪疑惟輕，功疑惟重，與其殺弗辜，寧失弗經。”《周禮》：“刑平國用中典，刑亂國用重典。”天下太平，應用堯、舜之典。比來有司多行重法，敘勳必須刻削，論罪務從重科，非是憎惡前人，止欲自為身計。今議蕭齡之事，有輕有重，重者流死，輕者請除名。以齡之受委大藩，贓罪狼籍，原情取事，死有餘辜。然既遣詳議，終須近法。竊惟議事群官，未盡識議刑本意。律有八議，並依《周禮》舊文，矜其異於眾臣，所以特製議法。禮：王族刑於隱者，所以議親；刑不上大夫，所以議貴。知重其親貴，議欲緩刑，非為嫉其賢能，謀致深法。今既許議，而加重刑，是與堯、舜相反，不可為萬代法。

sourceRange.text: 上元元年，大赦，義府妻子得還洛陽。如意元年，則天以義府與許敬宗、御史大夫崔義玄、中書舍人王德儉、大理正侯善業、大理丞袁公瑜等六人，在永徽中有翊贊之功，追贈義府揚州大都督，義玄益州大都督，德儉魏州刺史，公瑜江州刺史。長安元年，又賜義府子左千牛衛將軍湛及敬宗諸子實封各三百戶，義玄子司賓卿基、德儉子殿中監璇實封各二百五十戶，善業子太子右庶子知一、公瑜子殿中丞忠臣實封各二百戶。睿宗即位，景雲元年，並停義府等六家實封。

manualTranslations.zh: 如意元年，則天以義府與許敬宗、御史大夫崔義玄、中書舍人王德儉、大理正侯善業、大理丞袁公瑜等六人，在永徽中有翊贊之功，追贈義府揚州大都督，義玄益州大都督，德儉魏州刺史，公瑜江州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Ruyi, Zetian, because Yifu together with Xu Jingzong, Censor-in-Chief Cui Yixuan, Palace Secretariat Drafter Wang Dejian, Senior Corrector of the Court of Judicial Review Hou Shanye, and Corrector of the Court of Judicial Review Yuan Gongyu—six men who during Yonghui had rendered meritorious support—posthumously enfeoffed Yifu as Area Commander-in-Chief of Yangzhou, Yixuan as Area Commander-in-Chief of Yizhou, Dejian as Prefect of Weizhou, and Gongyu as Prefect of Jiangzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In 692 Empress Zetian, because Yifu together with Xu Jingzong, Censor-in-Chief Cui Yixuan, Palace Secretariat Drafter Wang Dejian, Senior Corrector of the Court of Judicial Review Hou Shanye, and Corrector of the Court of Judicial Review Yuan Gongyu—the six men who during the Yonghui era had rendered meritorious support—posthumously enfeoffed Yifu as Area Commander-in-Chief of Yangzhou, Yixuan as Area Commander-in-Chief of Yizhou, Dejian as Prefect of Weizhou, and Gongyu as Prefect of Jiangzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 長安元年，又賜義府子左千牛衛將軍湛及敬宗諸子實封各三百戶，義玄子司賓卿基、德儉子殿中監璇實封各二百五十戶，善業子太子右庶子知一、公瑜子殿中丞忠臣實封各二百戶。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Chang'an, she furthermore granted Zhan, General of the Left Qianniu Guard and son of Yifu, and the various sons of Jingzong each three hundred households of enfeoffment in actuality; Ji, Director of Palace Receptions and son of Yixuan, and Xuan, Director of the Palace Domestic Service and son of Dejian, each two hundred fifty households; Zhiyi, Right Subdirector of the Crown Prince's household and son of Shanye, and Zhongchen, Attendant-in-Ordinary of the Palace and son of Gongyu, each two hundred households.

sourceRange.text: 仁傑上疏曰：臣聞朝廷議者，以爲契丹作梗，始明人之逆順，或因迫脅，或有願從，或受偽官，或爲招慰，或兼外賊，或是土人，跡雖不同，心則無別。誠以山東雄猛，由來重氣，一顧之勢，至死不回。近緣軍機，調發傷重，家道悉破，或至逃亡，剔屋賣田，人不爲售，內顧生計，四壁皆空。重以官典侵漁，因事而起，取其髓腦，曾無心愧。修築池城，繕造兵甲，州縣役使，十倍軍機。官司不矜，期之必取，枷杖之下，痛切肌膚。事迫情危，不循禮義，愁苦之地，不樂其生。有利則歸，且圖賒死，此乃君子之愧辱，小人之常行。人猶水也，壅之則爲泉，疏之則爲川，通塞隨流，豈有常性。昔董卓之亂，神器播遷，及卓被誅，部曲無赦，事窮變起，毒害生人，京室丘墟，化爲禾黍。此由恩不普洽，失在機先。臣一讀此書，未嘗不廢卷歎息。今以負罪之伍，必不在家，露宿草行，潛竄山澤。赦之則出，不赦則狂，山東群盜，緣茲聚結。臣以邊塵暫起，不足爲憂，中土不安，以此爲事。臣聞持大國者不可以小道，理事廣者不可以細分。人主恢弘，不拘常法，罪之則眾情恐懼，恕之則反側自安。伏願曲赦河北諸州，一無所問。自然人神道暢，率土歡心，諸軍凱旋，得無侵擾。

sourceRange.text: 仁傑上疏諫曰：臣聞爲政之本，必先人事。陛下矜群生迷謬，溺喪無歸，欲令像教兼行，睹相生善。非爲塔廟必欲崇奢，豈令僧尼皆須檀施？得栰尚舍，而況其餘。今之伽藍，製過宮闕，窮奢極壯，畫繢盡工，寶珠殫於綴飾，環材竭於輪奐。工不使鬼，止在役人，物不天來，終須地出，不損百姓，將何以求？生之有時，用之無度，編戸所奉，常若不充，痛切肌膚，不辭箠楚。遊僧一説，矯陳禍福，翦發解衣，仍慚其少。亦有離間骨肉，事均路人，身自納妻，謂無彼我。皆托佛法，詿誤生人。裏陌動有經坊，闤闠亦立精舍。化誘倍急，切於官征；法事所須，嚴於製敕。膏腴美業，倍取其多；水碾莊園，數亦非少。逃丁避罪，並集法門，無名之僧，凡有幾萬，都下檢括，已得數千。且一夫不耕，猶受其弊，浮食者眾，又劫人財。臣每思惟，實所悲痛。往在江表，像法盛興，梁武、簡文，舍施無限。及其三淮沸浪，五嶺騰煙。列刹盈衢，無救危亡之禍；緇衣蔽路，豈有勤王之師！比年已來，風塵屢擾，水旱不節，征役稍繁。家業先空，瘡痍未復，此時興役，力所未堪，伏惟聖朝，功德無量，何必要營大像，而以勞費爲名。雖斂僧錢，百未支一。尊容既廣，不可露居，覆以百層，尚憂未遍，自餘廓廡，不得全無。又雲不損國財，不傷百姓，以此事主，可謂盡忠？臣今思惟，兼采眾議，鹹以爲如來設教，以慈悲爲主，下濟群品，應是本心，豈欲勞人，以存虛飾？當今有事，邊境未寧，宜寬征鎮之徭，省不急之費。設令雇作，皆以利趨，既失田時，自然棄本。今不樹稼，來歳必饑，役在其中，難以取給。況無官助，義無得成，若費官財，又盡人力，一隅有難，將何救之！

sourceRange.text: 章懷太子賢，字明允，高宗第六子也。永徽六年，封潞王。顯慶元年，遷授岐州刺史。其年，加雍州牧、幽州都督。時始出閣，容止端雅，深為高宗所嗟賞。高宗嚐謂司空李勳曰：“此兒已讀得《尚書》、《禮記》、《論語》，誦古詩賦復十餘篇，暫經領覽，遂即不忘。我曾遣讀《論語》，至‘賢賢易色’，遂再三覆誦。我問何為如此，乃言性愛此言。方知夙成聰敏，出自天性。”龍朔元年，徙封沛王，加揚州都督、兼左武衛大將軍，雍州牧如故。二年，加揚州大都督。麟德二年，加右衛大將軍。咸亨三年，改名德，徙封雍王，授涼州大都督，雍州牧、右衛大將軍如故，食實封一千戶。上元元年，又依舊名賢。

sourceRange.text: ”表奏不報。及韋庶人臨朝，遽令左屯衛大將軍趙承恩以兵五百人就均州守衛重福。俄而韋氏伏誅，睿宗即位，又轉集州刺史。未及行，洛陽人張靈均進計於重福曰：“大王地居嫡長，自合繼為天子。相王雖有討平韋氏功，安可越次而居大位！昔漢誅諸呂，猶迎代王，今東都百官士庶，皆願王來。王若潛行直詣洛陽，亦是從天上落，遣人襲殺留守，即擁兵西據陝州，東下河北，此天下可圖也。”初，景龍三年，鄭愔自吏部侍郎出為江州司馬，便道詣重福陰相結托。至是又與靈均通傳動靜，亦密遣使勸重福構逆，預推尊重福為天子，溫王重茂為皇太弟，自署為左丞相。重福乃遣家臣王道先赴東都，潛募勇敢之士，重福遽自均州詐乘驛與靈均繼進。

context.beforeSource: 重投荒徼，亦所甘心。
context.afterSource: 王道始至東都，俄有泄其謀者，洛州司馬崔日知捕獲其黨數十人。

sourceRange.text: ”節湣太子重俊，中宗第三子也。聖曆元年，封義興郡王。長安中，累授衛尉員外少卿。神龍初，封衛王，拜洛州牧，賜實封千戶，尋遷左衛大將軍，兼遙授揚州大都督。二年秋，立為皇太子。重俊性雖明果，未有賢師傅，舉事多不法。俄以秘書監楊敫、太常卿武崇訓並為太子賓客。敫等皆主婿年少，唯以蹴鞠猥戲取狎於重俊，竟無調護之意。左庶子姚珽數上疏諫諍，右庶子平貞慎又獻《孝經議》、《養德傳》以諷，重俊皆優納焉。

sourceRange.text: 殤皇帝重茂，中宗第四子也。聖曆三年，封北海王。神龍初，進封溫王，授右衛大將軍，兼遙領并州大都督，未出閤。景龍四年，中宗崩，韋庶人立重茂為帝，而自臨朝稱製。及韋氏敗，重茂遂遜位，讓叔父相王，退居別所。景雲二年，改封襄王，遷於集州，令中郎將率兵五百人守衛。開元二年，轉房州刺史。尋薨，時年十七，諡曰殤皇帝，葬於武功西原。

sourceRange.text: 劉禕之，常州晉陵人也。祖興宗，陳鄱陽王諮議參軍。父子翼，善吟諷，有學行。隋大業初，歷秘書監，河東柳顧言甚重之。性不容非，朋僚有短，面折之。友人李伯藥常稱曰：“劉四雖復罵人，人都不恨。”貞觀元年，詔追入京，以母老固辭，太宗許其終養。江南大使李襲譽嘉其至孝，恒以米帛賚之，因上表旌其門閭，改所居為孝慈里。母卒，服竟，征拜吳王府功曹，再遷著作郎、弘文館直學士，預修《晉書》，加朝散大夫。永徽初卒，高宗遣使弔贈，給靈輿還鄉。有集二十卷。

sourceRange.text: 永淳元年，高宗幸東都，留太子哲守京師，命炎與劉仁軌、薛元超為輔。明年，高宗不豫，炎從太子赴東都侍疾。十一月，高宗疾篤，命太子監國，炎奉詔與黃門侍郎劉齊賢、中書侍郎郭正一並於東宮平章事。十二月丁巳，高宗崩，太子即位。未聽政，宰臣奏議，天後降令於門下施行。中宗既立，欲以後父韋玄貞為侍中，又欲與乳母子五品，炎固爭以為不可。中宗不悅，謂左右曰：“我讓國與玄貞豈不得，何為惜侍中耶？”炎懼，乃與則天定策廢立。炎與中書侍郎劉禕之、羽林將軍程務挺、張虔勖等勒兵入內，宣太后令，扶帝下殿。帝曰：“我有何罪？”太后報曰：“汝若將天下與韋玄貞，何得無罪！”乃廢中宗為盧陵王，立豫王旦為帝。炎以定策功，封河東縣侯。

manualTranslations.zh: 永淳元年，高宗幸東都，留太子哲守京師，命炎與劉仁軌、薛元超為輔。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Yongchun, Gaozong visited the Eastern Capital, left Crown Prince Zhe to guard the capital, and ordered Yan to assist him together with Liu Rengui and Xue Yuanchao.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yongchun, Gaozong went to the Eastern Capital, left Crown Prince Zhe in Chang'an, and ordered Yan, Liu Rengui, and Xue Yuanchao to assist him.

manualTranslations.zh: 明年，高宗不豫，炎從太子赴東都侍疾。
manualTranslations.literal: The next year Gaozong fell ill; Yan followed the crown prince to the Eastern Capital to attend him in his illness.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The next year, when Gaozong fell ill, Yan followed the crown prince east to attend him.

manualTranslations.zh: 十一月，高宗疾篤，命太子監國，炎奉詔與黃門侍郎劉齊賢、中書侍郎郭正一並於東宮平章事。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eleventh month, Gaozong's illness became critical; the crown prince was ordered to supervise the state; Yan received an edict to serve with Vice Director of the Yellow Gate Liu Qixian and Vice Director of the Secretariat Guo Zhengyi jointly as grand councilors at the Eastern Palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, as Gaozong's illness turned critical, the crown prince was ordered to supervise the realm. Yan received an edict to deliberate on state affairs at the Eastern Palace with Liu Qixian and Guo Zhengyi.

manualTranslations.zh: 十二月丁巳，高宗崩，太子即位。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twelfth month, on dingsi, Gaozong died and the crown prince ascended the throne.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on dingsi, Gaozong died and the crown prince took the throne.

manualTranslations.zh: 未聽政，宰臣奏議，天後降令於門下施行。
manualTranslations.literal: Before attending to government, when the chief ministers deliberated and submitted proposals, the Empress Dowager issued orders from the Chancellery for implementation.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Before he took up rule, when the chief ministers submitted proposals, the Empress Dowager issued orders through the Chancellery for their implementation.

manualTranslations.zh: 中宗既立，欲以後父韋玄貞為侍中，又欲與乳母子五品，炎固爭以為不可。
manualTranslations.literal: After Zhongzong had taken the throne, he wished to make his father-in-law Wei Xuanzhen palace attendant and also to grant fifth rank to the sons of his wet nurse; Yan stubbornly argued that this could not be done.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Once Zhongzong had ascended, he wished to make his father-in-law Wei Xuanzhen palace attendant and grant fifth rank to his wet nurse's sons; Yan firmly argued that this could not be allowed.

manualTranslations.zh: 中宗不悅，謂左右曰：“我讓國與玄貞豈不得，何為惜侍中耶？
manualTranslations.literal: Zhongzong was displeased and said to those around him: "If I yield the realm to Xuanzhen, would that not be permitted—why begrudge the post of palace attendant?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhongzong was displeased and told his attendants: "If I yield the empire to Xuanzhen, would that not be allowed—why quibble over the post of palace attendant?

manualTranslations.zh: ”炎懼，乃與則天定策廢立。
manualTranslations.literal: " Yan feared this and therefore joined Zetian in plotting deposition and enthronement.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: " Alarmed, Yan joined Zetian in plotting to depose and enthrone.

manualTranslations.zh: 炎與中書侍郎劉禕之、羽林將軍程務挺、張虔勖等勒兵入內，宣太后令，扶帝下殿。
manualTranslations.literal: Yan, together with Vice Director of the Secretariat Liu Yizhi, Yulin General Cheng Wuting, Zhang Qianxu, and others, led troops into the inner palace, proclaimed the Empress Dowager's order, and helped the emperor down from the hall.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yan, Liu Yizhi, Cheng Wuting, Zhang Qianxu, and others led troops into the palace, proclaimed the Empress Dowager's order, and brought the emperor down from the throne.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝曰：“我有何罪？
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor said: "What crime have I committed?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "What crime have I committed?

manualTranslations.zh: ”太后報曰：“汝若將天下與韋玄貞，何得無罪！
manualTranslations.literal: " The Empress Dowager replied: "If you were to give the realm to Wei Xuanzhen, how could you be without guilt!
manualTranslations.idiomatic: " The Empress Dowager replied: "If you were to give the empire to Wei Xuanzhen, how could you be guiltless!

manualTranslations.zh: ”乃廢中宗為盧陵王，立豫王旦為帝。
manualTranslations.literal: " They then deposed Zhongzong as Prince of Luling and enthroned Prince of Yu Dan as emperor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: " They deposed Zhongzong as Prince of Luling and enthroned Prince of Yu Dan as emperor.

manualTranslations.zh: 炎以定策功，封河東縣侯。
manualTranslations.literal: For his merit in settling the succession, Yan was enfeoffed as Marquis of Hedong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: For his role in fixing the succession, Yan was enfeoffed Marquis of Hedong.

sourceRange.text: 初，禕之既下獄，睿宗為之抗疏申理，禕之親友咸以為必見原宥，竊賀之。禕之曰：“吾必死矣。太后臨朝獨斷，威福任己，皇帝上表，徒使速吾禍也。”禕之在獄時，嚐上疏自陳。及臨終，既洗沐，而神色自若，命其子執筆草謝表，其子將絕，殆不能書。監刑者促之。禕之乃自操數紙，援筆立成，詞理懇至，見者無不傷痛。時麟台郎郭翰、太子文學周思鈞共稱歎其文，則天聞而惡之，左遷翰為巫州司法，思鈞為播州司倉。睿宗即位，以禕之宮府舊僚，追贈中書令。有集七十卷，傳於時。

sourceRange.text: 」時新都丞朱待辟坐贓至死，逮捕繫獄。待辟素善沙門理中，陰結諸不逞，因待辟以殺璹爲名，擬據巴蜀爲亂。人密表告之者，製令璹按其獄。璹深持之，事涉疑似引而誅死者，僅以千數。則天又令洛州長史宋元爽、御史中丞霍獻可等重加詳覆，亦無所發明。逮繫獄數百人，不勝酷毒，遞相附會，以就反狀。因此籍沒者復五十餘家，其餘稱知反配流者亦十八九，道路冤之。監察御史袁恕己劾奏其事。則天初令璹與恕己對定，又尋令罷推。俄拜地官尚書。歳餘，轉冬官尚書，仍西京留守。長安中，累表乞骸骨，製聽致仕，進爵爲伯。遇官名復舊，爲工部尚書。神龍元年卒，遺令薄葬，贈越州都督，諡曰成。弟珽，少好學，以勤苦自立。舉明經，累除定、汴、滄、虢、豳等五州刺史，加銀青光祿大夫，轉秦州刺史。以善政有聞，璽書褒美，賜絹百匹。神龍元年，累封宣城郡公，三遷太子詹事，仍兼左庶子。時節湣太子舉事不法，班前後上書進諫。今載四事：其一曰：臣聞賈誼曰：「選天下之端士，孝悌博聞有道術者，使與太子居處出入。

sourceRange.text: 時初置右御史台，巡按天下，嶠上疏陳其得失曰：陛下創置右台，分巡天下，察吏人善惡，觀風俗得失，斯政途之綱紀，禮法之準繩，無以加也。然猶有未折衷者，臣請試論之。夫禁綱尚疏，法令宜簡，簡則法易行而不煩雜，疏則所羅廣而無苛碎。竊見垂拱二年諸道巡察使所奏科目，凡有四十四件，至於別準格敕令察訪者，又有三十餘條。而巡察使率是三月已後出都，十一月終奏事，時限迫促，簿書填委，晝夜奔逐，以赴限期。而每道所察文武官，多至二千餘人，少者一千已下，皆須品量才行，褒貶得失，欲令曲盡行能，則皆不暇。此非敢墮於職而慢於官也，實才有限而力不及耳。臣望量其功程，與其節製，使器周於用，力濟於時，然後進退可以責成，得失可以精覈矣。又曰：今之所察，但準漢之六條，推而廣之，則無不包矣。無為多張科目，空費簿書。且朝廷萬機，非無事也，機事之動，恒在四方，是故冠蓋相望，郵驛繼踵。今巡使既出，其他外州之事，悉當委之，則傳驛大減矣。然則御史之職，故不可得閑，自非分州統理，無由濟其繁務。請大小相兼，率十州置御史一人，以周年為限，使其親至屬縣，或入閭裏，督察奸訛，觀采風俗，然後可以求其實效，課其成功。若此法果行，必大裨政化。且御史出持霜簡，入奏天闕，其於勵已自修，奉職存憲，比於他吏，可相百也。若其按劾奸邪，糾擿欺隱，比於他吏，可相十也。陛下試用臣言，妙擇賢能，委之心膂，假溫言以製之，陳賞罰以勸之，則莫不盡力而效死矣。何政事之不理，何禁令之不行，何妖孽之敢興？

manualTranslations.zh: 時初置右御史台，巡按天下，嶠上疏陳其得失曰：陛下創置右台，分巡天下，察吏人善惡，觀風俗得失，斯政途之綱紀，禮法之準繩，無以加也。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time the Right Censorate had just been established to inspect throughout the realm; Jiao submitted a memorial stating its strengths and weaknesses, saying: "Your Majesty has newly established the Right Censorate, dispatching it to inspect throughout the realm, examining officials and people for good and evil, observing the gains and losses of local custom—this is the backbone of the path of governance and the measuring rod of ritual and law; nothing could surpass it."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At that time the Right Censorate had just been established to inspect the empire; Jiao submitted a memorial on its strengths and weaknesses, saying: "Your Majesty's new Right Censorate, sent out to inspect the realm, examine the conduct of officials and people, and observe local custom, is the backbone of governance and the standard of ritual and law, and nothing could improve upon it."

manualTranslations.zh: 然猶有未折衷者，臣請試論之。
manualTranslations.literal: Yet there are still matters not yet reconciled; your servant requests permission to discuss them briefly.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yet some points remain unsettled; I beg leave to discuss them briefly.

manualTranslations.zh: 夫禁綱尚疏，法令宜簡，簡則法易行而不煩雜，疏則所羅廣而無苛碎。
manualTranslations.literal: As for prohibitions and regulatory nets, it is best they be loosely woven; laws and ordinances should be kept simple—simplicity makes the law easy to enforce without complexity, looseness makes what is covered broad without petty minutiae.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Prohibitory regulations should be kept broad, and laws kept simple—simplicity makes enforcement easy and avoids needless complexity, while breadth of scope covers much without petty intrusion.

manualTranslations.zh: 竊見垂拱二年諸道巡察使所奏科目，凡有四十四件，至於別準格敕令察訪者，又有三十餘條。
manualTranslations.literal: I have privately observed that in the second year of the Chuigong era the inspection categories reported by the inspection commissioners of the various circuits totaled forty-four items; as for separate items based on statutes, edicts, and orders for inspection, there were also more than thirty additional articles.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I note that in the second year of the Chuigong era the inspection commissioners of the various circuits reported upon forty-four inspection categories, and that separate items drawn from statutes, edicts, and orders added more than thirty articles.

manualTranslations.zh: 而巡察使率是三月已後出都，十一月終奏事，時限迫促，簿書填委，晝夜奔逐，以赴限期。
manualTranslations.literal: Yet inspection commissioners as a rule depart the capital after the third month and submit their reports by the end of the eleventh month—the time limit is pressing, documents pile up thick, they rush day and night to meet the deadline.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yet inspection commissioners typically leave the capital after the third month and must file their reports by the end of the eleventh month—a tight deadline that fills their desks with paperwork and keeps them racing day and night.

manualTranslations.zh: 而每道所察文武官，多至二千餘人，少者一千已下，皆須品量才行，褒貶得失，欲令曲盡行能，則皆不暇。
manualTranslations.literal: In each circuit the civil and military officials inspected number as many as more than two thousand, or no fewer than below one thousand—all must be graded for talent and conduct, praised or blamed for gains and losses; if one wishes exhaustively to cover everyone's performance and capacity, there is no time for any of it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In each circuit they must inspect civil and military officials—often more than two thousand, never fewer than a thousand—all of whom must be graded for talent and conduct and commended or censured for their merits and faults; if they are to cover every officer's full record, they simply have no time.

manualTranslations.zh: 此非敢墮於職而慢於官也，實才有限而力不及耳。
manualTranslations.literal: This is not because they dare fall short in duty and treat their office lightly; it is truly that talent is limited and strength does not suffice.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This is not dereliction of duty or contempt for office—it is simply that their talent is limited and their strength falls short.

manualTranslations.zh: 臣望量其功程，與其節製，使器周於用，力濟於時，然後進退可以責成，得失可以精覈矣。
manualTranslations.literal: Your servant hopes to measure the scope of their work and regulate their limits, so that capacity matches the task and strength meets the demands of the time—only then can promotion and dismissal be held accountable for results, and gains and losses be carefully verified.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I ask that their workload be measured and bounded so that capacity matches the task and effort fits the time—only then can appointments and removals be held to account and outcomes judged with precision.

manualTranslations.zh: 又曰：今之所察，但準漢之六條，推而廣之，則無不包矣。
manualTranslations.literal: He further said: What is inspected today need only follow the Six Articles of Han—extend and broaden them, and nothing would fall outside their scope.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He further said: Today's inspections need only follow the Han Six Articles; extend them, and nothing would lie outside their scope.

manualTranslations.zh: 無為多張科目，空費簿書。
manualTranslations.literal: There is no need to multiply inspection categories wastefully and empty effort into documents and registers.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: There is no need to multiply inspection categories and waste effort on paperwork.

manualTranslations.zh: 且朝廷萬機，非無事也，機事之動，恒在四方，是故冠蓋相望，郵驛繼踵。
manualTranslations.literal: Moreover the court has ten thousand affairs—it is not that there is nothing to do; when urgent matters arise, they are always in the four directions, which is why official carriages and canopies follow one after another and courier posts come in succession.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The court's myriad affairs are never idle; when urgent business arises it is usually in the provinces, which is why official carriages follow one after another and courier traffic is unceasing.

manualTranslations.zh: 今巡使既出，其他外州之事，悉當委之，則傳驛大減矣。
manualTranslations.literal: Now that inspection commissioners have already gone out, all other affairs of outer provinces should likewise be entrusted to them—then relay traffic would be greatly reduced.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: With inspection commissioners already in the field, other provincial affairs could all be entrusted to them as well, and courier traffic would drop sharply.

manualTranslations.zh: 然則御史之職，故不可得閑，自非分州統理，無由濟其繁務。
manualTranslations.literal: Thus the duties of censor officials naturally cannot be idle; unless they are assigned to govern circuits in division, there is no way to manage the heavy workload.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Censorial duties cannot be left idle; without assigning censors to govern grouped prefectures, there is no way to manage such overwhelming work.

manualTranslations.zh: 請大小相兼，率十州置御史一人，以周年為限，使其親至屬縣，或入閭裏，督察奸訛，觀采風俗，然後可以求其實效，課其成功。
manualTranslations.literal: I ask that large and small [circuits] be combined, setting one censor for every ten prefectures on average, with a term of one full year, allowing them to reach subordinate counties in person or enter lanes and hamlets, investigate fraud and error, observe and gather local custom—only then can real results be sought and success assessed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I propose combining larger and smaller jurisdictions, assigning one censor for every ten prefectures on average for a one-year term, with time to reach subordinate counties in person or walk the lanes to investigate fraud and observe local custom—only then can real results be demanded and success measured.

manualTranslations.zh: 若此法果行，必大裨政化。
manualTranslations.literal: If this method is truly carried out, it will greatly aid governance and transformation.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: If this plan is adopted, it will greatly strengthen government.

manualTranslations.zh: 且御史出持霜簡，入奏天闕，其於勵已自修，奉職存憲，比於他吏，可相百也。
manualTranslations.literal: Moreover censors going out hold the frost tablets; entering they report at the heavenly gate—in encouraging self-discipline and self-cultivation, in fulfilling office and preserving the statutes, compared with other officials they may be counted a hundredfold.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Censors go out bearing the frost tablets and return to report at the imperial gate; in self-discipline, faithful service, and upholding the law they exceed other officials a hundredfold.

manualTranslations.zh: 若其按劾奸邪，糾擿欺隱，比於他吏，可相十也。
manualTranslations.literal: If in investigating and impeaching the wicked and deceitful, exposing and plucking out concealment and fraud, compared with other officials they may be counted tenfold.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In investigating wickedness and exposing fraud and concealment, they surpass other officials tenfold.

manualTranslations.zh: 陛下試用臣言，妙擇賢能，委之心膂，假溫言以製之，陳賞罰以勸之，則莫不盡力而效死矣。
manualTranslations.literal: Your Majesty, if you trial my words, finely select the worthy and capable, entrust them as backbone, lend warm words to restrain them and set forth rewards and punishments to encourage them—then none will fail to exert their utmost strength and render service unto death.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: If Your Majesty puts my proposal to the test, selects the best men, entrusts them as your inner counsellors, governs them with gracious words, and encourages them with rewards and punishments, none will fail to give their all—even unto death.

manualTranslations.zh: 何政事之不理，何禁令之不行，何妖孽之敢興？
manualTranslations.literal: How could governance fail to be ordered? How could prohibitions fail to be enforced? How could evil omens dare to arise?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: What affair of state would go ungoverned? What prohibition would fail to be enforced? What evil omen would dare to arise?

sourceRange.text: 時有司表稅關市，融深以為不可，上疏諫曰：伏見有司稅關市事條，不限工商，但是行人盡稅者，臣謹按《周禮》九賦，其七日“關市之賦”。竊惟市縱繁巧，關通末遊，欲令此徒止抑，所以鹹增賦稅。臣謹商度今古，料量家國，竊將為不可稅。謹件事跡如左，伏惟聖旨擇焉。往古之時，淳樸未散，公田籍而不稅，關防譏而不征。中代已來，澆風驟進，桑麻疲弊，稼穡辛勤，於是各徇通財，爭趨作巧，求徑捷之欲速，忘歲計之無餘。遂使田萊日荒，倉廩不積，蠶織休廢。弊縕闕如，饑寒猥臻，亂離斯起。先王懲其若此，所以變古隨時，依本者恒科，占末者增稅。夫關市之稅者，謂市及國門，關門者也，唯斂出入之商賈，不稅來往之行人。今若不論商人，通取諸色，事不師古，法乃任情。悠悠末代，於何瞻仰；濟濟盛朝，自取嗤笑。雖欲憲章姬典，乃是違背《周官》。臣知其不可者一也。臣謹案《易》《係辭》稱：“庖羲氏沒，神農氏作，日中為市，致天下之人，聚天下之貨，交易而退，各得其所。”《班志》亦云：“財者，帝王聚人守位，養成群生，奉順天德，理國安人之本也。仕農工商，四人有業。學以居位曰仕，辟士殖穀曰農，作巧成器曰工，通財鬻貨曰商。聖王量能授事，四人陳力受職。”然則四人各業久矣。今復安得動而搖之！蕭何云：“人情一定，不可復動。”班固又云：曹參相齊，齊國安集，大稱賢相。參去，屬其後相曰：“以齊獄市為寄，慎勿擾也。”後相曰：“理無大於此者乎？”參曰：“不然。夫獄市者，所以並容也，今若擾之，奸人安所容乎？吾是以先之。”夫獄市，兼受善惡。若窮極，奸人無所容竄；奸人無所容竄，久且為亂。秦人極刑而天下叛，孝武峻法而刑獄繁，此其效也。老子曰：“我無為而人自化，我好靜而人自正。”參欲以道化其本，不欲擾其末。臣知其不可者二也。四海之廣，九州之雜。關必據險路，市必憑要津。若乃富商大賈，豪宗惡少，輕死重義，結黨連群，喑鳴則彎弓，睚眥則挺劍。小有失意，且猶如此，一旦變法，定是相驚。乘茲困窮，或致騷動，便恐南走越，北走胡，非唯流逆齊人，亦自攪亂殊俗。又如邊徼之地，寇賊為鄰，興胡之旅，歲月相繼，倘同科賦，致有猜疑，一從散亡，何以製禁？求利雖切，為害方深。而有司上言，不識大體，徒欲益帑藏，助軍國，殊不知軍國益擾，帑藏逾空。臣知其不可者三也。孟軻又云：“古之為關也，將以禦暴；今之為關也，將以為暴。”今行者皆稅，本末同流。且如天下諸津，舟航所聚，旁通巴、漢，前指閩、越，七澤十藪，三江五湖，控引河洛，兼包淮海。弘舸巨艦，千軸萬艘，交貿往還，昧旦永日。今若江津河口，置鋪納稅，納稅則檢覆，檢覆則遲留。此津才過，彼鋪復止，非唯國家稅錢，更遭主司僦賂。船有大小，載有少多，量物而稅，觸途淹久。統論一日之中，未過十分之一，因此壅滯，必致籲嗟。一朝失利，則萬商廢業，萬商廢業，則人不聊生。其間或有輕訬任俠之徒，斬龍刺蛟之黨，鄱陽暴謔之客，富平悍壯之夫，居則藏鏹，出便竦劍。加之以重稅，因之以威脅，一旦獸窮則搏，鳥窮則攫，執事者復何以安之哉？臣知其不可者四也。五帝之初，不可詳已；三王之後，厥有著雲；秦、漢相承，典章大備至如關市之稅，史籍有文。秦政以雄圖武力，舍之而不用也；漢武以霸略英才，去之而勿取也。何則？關為禦暴之所，市為聚人之地，稅市則人散，稅關則暴興，暴興則起異圖，人散則懷不軌。夫人心莫不背善而樂禍，易動而難安。一市不安，則天下之市心搖矣；一關不安，則天下之關心動矣。況澆風久扇，變法為難，徒欲禁末流、規小利，豈知失玄默、亂大倫。魏、晉眇小，齊、隋齷齪，亦所不行斯道者也。臣知其不可者五也。今之所以稅關市者，何也？豈不以國用不足，邊寇為虞，一行斯術，冀有殷贍然也！微臣敢借前箸以籌之。伏惟陛下當聖期，禦玄籙，沉璧於洛，刻石於嵩，鑄寶鼎以窮奸，坐明堂而布政，神化廣洽，至德潛通。東夷暫驚，應時平殄；南蠻才動，計日歸降。西域五十餘國，廣輸一萬餘里，城堡清夷，亭堠靜謐。比為患者，唯苦二蕃。今吐蕃請命，邊事不起，即目雖尚屯兵，久後疑成馳柝。獨有默啜，假息孤恩，惡貫禍盈，覆亡不暇。征役日已省矣，繁費日已稀矣，然猶下明製，遵太樸，愛人力，惜人財，王侯舊封，妃主新禮，所有支料，咸令減削。此陛下以躬率先，堯、舜之用心也。且關中、河北，水旱數年，諸處逃亡，今始安輯，倘加重稅，或慮相驚。況承平歲積，薄賦日久，俗荷深恩，人知自樂。卒有變法，必多生怨，生怨則驚擾，驚擾則不安，中既不安，外何能禦？文王曰：“帝王富其人，霸王富其地，理國若不足，亂國若有餘。”古人有言：“帝王藏於天下，諸侯藏於百姓，農夫藏於庾，商賈藏於篋。”惟陛下詳之。必若師興有費，國儲多窘，即請倍算商客，加斂平人。如此則國保富強，人免憂懼，天下幸甚。臣知其不可者六也。陛下留神係表，屬想政源，冒茲炎熾，早朝晏坐。一日二日，機務不遺，先天後天，虛心密應。時政得失，小子何知，率陳瞽辭，伏紙惶懼。疏奏，則天納之，乃寢其事。
