manualTranslations.zh: 彥伯聖曆中累除給事中，時王公卿士多以言語不慎，密為酷吏周興、來俊臣等所陷，彥伯乃著《樞機論》以誡於代，其辭曰：《書》曰：“唯口起羞，惟甲胃起戎。
manualTranslations.literal: During Shenli Xu Yanbo was repeatedly appointed gentleman-attendant; at that time many princes, dukes, and officials were secretly framed by cruel officials such as Zhou Xing and Lai Junchen for careless speech; Xu Yanbo therefore composed the "Discourse on the Pivot of Power" to warn his generation. The text says: The Book says, "It is the mouth that gives rise to disgrace; it is armor and helmet that give rise to warfare."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During the Shenli era Xu Yanbo was repeatedly promoted to gentleman-attendant. At that time many princes, dukes, and officials were secretly framed by cruel officials such as Zhou Xing and Lai Junchen for careless speech, so Xu Yanbo composed the "Discourse on the Pivot of Power" to warn his generation. The text reads: The Book of Documents says, "It is the mouth that gives rise to disgrace; it is armor and helmet that give rise to warfare."

manualTranslations.zh: ”又云：“齊乃位，度乃口。
manualTranslations.literal: " It also says, "Make yourself correct, and measure your words."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: " It also says, "Make yourself upright, and measure your words."

manualTranslations.zh: ”《易》曰：“慎言語，節飲食。
manualTranslations.literal: " The Book of Changes says, "Be careful in speech; moderate food and drink."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: " The Book of Changes says, "Be careful in speech and moderate in food and drink."

manualTranslations.zh: ”又云：“出其言善，千里應之；
manualTranslations.literal: " It also says, "When what one puts forth is good, it is answered from a thousand li away;"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: " It also says, "When what one puts forth is good, it is answered from a thousand li away;"

manualTranslations.zh: 出其言不善，千里違之。
manualTranslations.literal: when what one puts forth is not good, it is opposed from a thousand li away."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: when what one puts forth is not good, it is opposed from a thousand li away."

manualTranslations.zh: ”《禮》亦云：“可言也，不可行也，君子不言也；
manualTranslations.literal: " The Book of Rites also says, "What may be said but cannot be done—the gentleman does not say it;"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: " The Book of Rites also says, "What may be said but cannot be done, the gentleman does not say it;"

manualTranslations.zh: 可行也，不可言也，君子不行也。
manualTranslations.literal: what may be done but cannot be said—the gentleman does not do it."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: what may be done but cannot be said, the gentleman does not do it."

manualTranslations.zh: ”嗚呼！
manualTranslations.literal: " Alas!
manualTranslations.idiomatic: " Alas!

manualTranslations.zh: 先聖知言之為大也，知言之為急也，精微以勸之，典謨以告之，禮經以防之。
manualTranslations.literal: The ancient sages knew how great a matter speech is, knew how urgent a matter speech is—they exhorted with subtle principles, instructed with canonical models, and guarded against it with the Classic of Rites.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The ancient sages knew how great a matter speech is and how urgent a matter it is. They exhorted with subtle principles, instructed with canonical models, and guarded against its dangers with the Classic of Rites.

manualTranslations.zh: 守名教者，何可不修其詁訓而服其糟粕乎？
manualTranslations.literal: Those who uphold orthodox teaching—how can they fail to study its glosses and commentaries and submit to its essential leavings?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Those who uphold orthodox teaching—how can they fail to study its glosses and commentaries and live by its distilled precepts?

manualTranslations.zh: 故曰：“言語者，君子之樞機，動則物應，物應則得失之兆見也。
manualTranslations.literal: Therefore it is said, "Speech is the pivot and trigger of the gentleman—when it moves, things respond; when things respond, the auguries of gain and loss appear."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Therefore it is said, "Speech is the pivot and trigger of the gentleman. When it moves, things respond; when things respond, the signs of gain and loss appear."

manualTranslations.zh: 得之者江海比鄰，失之者肝膽楚、越，然後知否泰榮辱，係於言乎！
manualTranslations.literal: Those who succeed in it find neighbors across rivers and seas; those who fail find heart and liver separated like Chu and Yue—and only then does one know whether prosperity and decline, glory and disgrace, depend upon speech!
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Those who succeed in it find neighbors as close as those across rivers and seas; those who fail find heart and liver torn apart like Chu and Yue. Only then does one know that prosperity and decline, glory and disgrace, depend upon speech!

manualTranslations.zh: 夫言者，德之柄也，行之主也，誌之端也，身之文也，既可以濟身，亦可以覆身。
manualTranslations.literal: Speech is the handle of virtue, the master of conduct, the beginning of intent, the ornament of the person—it can both save the person and can also destroy the person.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Speech is the handle of virtue, the master of conduct, the beginning of intent, and the ornament of the person. It can both save a person and destroy a person.

manualTranslations.zh: 故中庸鏤其心，右階銘其背，南容復於白圭，箕子疇於《洪範》，良有以也。
manualTranslations.literal: Therefore the Doctrine of the Mean was engraved upon the heart, the right-hand steps bore inscriptions on the back, Nan Rong repeated the white-jade maxim, and Jizi set forth the Great Plan—there was good reason for this.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Therefore the Doctrine of the Mean was engraved upon the heart, moral maxims were inscribed on the right-hand steps and upon the back, Nan Rong repeated the white-jade maxim, and Jizi set forth the Great Plan—all for good reason.

manualTranslations.zh: 是以掎摭瑕玷，參詳躁競，審無常以階亂，將不密以致危。
manualTranslations.literal: Therefore one must gather and inspect every flaw, weigh anxious contention carefully, recognize that inconstancy paves the way to disorder, and recognize that lack of secrecy leads to danger.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Therefore one must gather and inspect every flaw, weigh anxious contention carefully, recognize that inconstancy paves the way to disorder, and recognize that lack of discretion leads to danger.

manualTranslations.zh: 利生於口，森然覆邦之說；
manualTranslations.literal: Profit arising from the mouth—there is talk dense enough to overturn the state;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Profit arising from the mouth—there is talk dense enough to overturn a state;

manualTranslations.zh: 道不由衷，變彼如簧之刺。
manualTranslations.literal: the Way not proceeding from the heart—how it transforms into those reed-pipe barbs!
manualTranslations.idiomatic: when the Way does not proceed from the heart, it turns into those slanderous barbs like reed pipes!

manualTranslations.zh: 可不懼之哉！
manualTranslations.literal: Should one not fear this!
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Should one not fear this!

manualTranslations.zh: 其有識暗邪正，慮微形朕，破金湯之龠，封禍亂之根，用詀讘為全計，以號詉為令德。
manualTranslations.literal: There are those who fail to discern right from wrong, who detect the faintest marks, break through gates of bronze and moats of iron, seal up the roots of calamity and disorder, employ revilement as a complete stratagem, and take shouting abuse as excellent virtue.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: There are those who fail to discern right from wrong, who detect the faintest signs of offense, break through gates of bronze and moats of iron, seal up the roots of calamity and disorder, employ revilement as a complete stratagem, and treat shouting abuse as excellent virtue.

manualTranslations.zh: 至若梧宮問答，荊、齊所以奔命；
manualTranslations.literal: For instance, the question-and-answer at the Wu Palace—therefore Jing and Qi raced to answer the call;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Consider, for instance, the question-and-answer at the Wu Palace, which set Jing and Qi racing to answer the call;

manualTranslations.zh: 韓、魏加肘，智伯所以危殘。
manualTranslations.literal: when Han and Wei applied the elbow hold—therefore Zhi Bo was endangered and destroyed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: when Han and Wei applied the elbow hold, Zhi Bo was endangered and destroyed.

manualTranslations.zh: 蔡侯繩息媯也，亟招甲兵之罰；
manualTranslations.literal: Duke Ai of Cai tied up Xi Gui—and quickly brought upon himself the punishment of armored troops;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Duke Ai of Cai tied up Xi Gui and quickly brought upon himself the punishment of armored troops;

manualTranslations.zh: 鄭曼圖宗卿也，而受鼎鑊之誅。
manualTranslations.literal: Zheng Man plotted against the minister of the ancestral temple—and received execution by cauldron and boiling.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zheng Man plotted against the minister of the ancestral temple and received execution by cauldron and boiling.

manualTranslations.zh: 史遷輕議，終下蠶室；
manualTranslations.literal: Sima Qian lightly criticized—and in the end descended to the Silkworm Chamber;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sima Qian spoke lightly in criticism and in the end was sent down to the Silkworm Chamber;

manualTranslations.zh: 張紘說，更齒龍淵。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhang Hong's persuasion—again teeth at Dragon Abyss.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhang Hong's persuasion again cost teeth at Dragon Abyss.

manualTranslations.zh: 凡此過言，其流匪一。
manualTranslations.literal: All such excessive speech—its currents are not one.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: All such excessive speech—its currents are not one.

manualTranslations.zh: 或穢猶糞土，或動成刀劍，或苟且其心，或脂膏其吻。
manualTranslations.literal: Some vile as dung and soil, some the moment they move become swords and blades; some debased in mind, some with lips grease-slicked.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Some are vile as dung and soil; some the moment they move become swords and blades; some are debased in mind; some grease their lips with flattery.

manualTranslations.zh: 挾邪作蠱，守之而不懈；
manualTranslations.literal: Wielding depravity and working witchcraft, they hold to it without slackening;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wielding depravity and working witchcraft, they hold to it without slackening;

manualTranslations.zh: 往輒破的，去之而彌遠。
manualTranslations.literal: going forth they always pierce the target; departing from it they go ever farther.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: going forth they always hit the mark; turning from it they go ever farther astray.

manualTranslations.zh: 亦可異韓廬聚音，釐也群吠，得死為幸，何循名之立乎？
manualTranslations.literal: How strange—like Han Lu gathering voices and Li howling in a pack: to die by chance would be fortune—how can upright reputation be established?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: How strange—like Han Lu gathering voices and Li howling in a pack: to die by chance would be good fortune. How then can an upright reputation be established?

manualTranslations.zh: 雖復伯玉沮顏，追謝於元凱，蔣濟貽恨，失譽於王陵，犀首沒齒於季章，曹瞞齚舌於劉主，當何及哉！
manualTranslations.literal: Even if Qu Boyu looked ashamed and later apologized to Yuan Kai; even if Jiang Ji left behind regret and lost reputation before Wang Ling; even if Xi Shou lost his teeth before Ji Zhang; even if Cao Man clenched his tongue before Lord Liu—what good would it come to!
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Even if Qu Boyu looked ashamed and later apologized to Yuan Kai; even if Jiang Ji left behind regret and lost his reputation before Wang Ling; even if Xi Shou lost his teeth before Ji Zhang; even if Cao Man clenched his tongue before Lord Liu—what good would it do!

manualTranslations.zh: 孔子曰：“予欲無言。
manualTranslations.literal: Confucius said, "I wish to speak no more."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Confucius said, "I wish to speak no more."

manualTranslations.zh: ”又云：“終身為善一言敗之，惜也。
manualTranslations.literal: " He also said, "To do good all one's life and have one word ruin it—how regrettable."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: " He also said, "To do good all one's life and have one word ruin it—how regrettable."

manualTranslations.zh: ”老子亦云：“多言數窮。
manualTranslations.literal: " Laozi also said, "Much speaking ends in exhaustion."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: " Laozi also said, "Much speaking ends in exhaustion."

manualTranslations.zh: ”又雲“聰明深察而近於死者，議人者也。
manualTranslations.literal: " He also said, "Those who are clever and deeply observant and yet approach death—such are those who discuss others."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: " He also said, "Those who are clever and deeply observant and yet approach death are those who discuss others."

manualTranslations.zh: ”何聖人之深思偉慮，杜漸防萌之至乎！
manualTranslations.literal: " How deeply the sages thought, how grandly they considered—to the utmost of stopping what is beginning and guarding against what is sprouting!
manualTranslations.idiomatic: " How deeply the sages thought and how grandly they considered—to the utmost of stopping what is beginning and guarding against what is sprouting!

manualTranslations.zh: 夫不可言而言者曰狂，可言而不言者曰隱。
manualTranslations.literal: What must not be spoken yet is spoken is called reckless; what may be spoken yet is not spoken is called secretive.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: What must not be spoken yet is spoken is called reckless; what may be spoken yet is not spoken is called secretive.

manualTranslations.zh: 鉗舌拱默，曷通彼此之懷；
manualTranslations.literal: Clamping the tongue and bowing in silence—how can the feelings of both parties be communicated;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Clamping the tongue and bowing in silence—how can the feelings of both parties be communicated;

manualTranslations.zh: 括囊而處，孰啟謨明之訓？
manualTranslations.literal: pocketing the mouth and dwelling thus—who will open the instruction of counsel and clarity?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: pocketing the mouth and dwelling thus—who will open the instruction of counsel and clarity?

manualTranslations.zh: 則上言者，下聽也；
manualTranslations.literal: Then what the superior speaks—the subordinate listens to;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Then what the superior speaks, the subordinate listens to;

manualTranslations.zh: 下言者，上用也。
manualTranslations.literal: what the subordinate speaks—the superior employs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: what the subordinate speaks, the superior employs.

manualTranslations.zh: 睿哲之言，猶天地也，人覆燾而生焉；
manualTranslations.literal: Words of sage wisdom are like Heaven and Earth—people live covered beneath their nurturing canopy;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Words of sage wisdom are like Heaven and Earth—people live beneath their nurturing canopy;

manualTranslations.zh: 大雅之言，猶鍾鼓也，人考擊而樂焉。
manualTranslations.literal: Words of great elegance are like bells and drums—people find joy in striking and sounding them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Words of great elegance are like bells and drums—people find joy in striking and sounding them.

manualTranslations.zh: 作以龜鏡，姬公之言也；
manualTranslations.literal: Made as a mirror of tortoise shell—such were the words of the Duke of Zhou;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Made as a mirror of tortoise shell—such were the words of the Duke of Zhou;

manualTranslations.zh: 出為金石，曾子之言也；
manualTranslations.literal: Coming forth as metal and stone—such were the words of Zengzi;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Coming forth as metal and stone—such were the words of Zengzi;

manualTranslations.zh: 存其家邦，國僑之言也；
manualTranslations.literal: Preserving his house and state—such were the words of Zichan;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Preserving his house and state—such were the words of Zichan;

manualTranslations.zh: 立而不朽，臧孫之言也。
manualTranslations.literal: Standing without decay—such were the words of Zang Sun.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Standing without decay—such were the words of Zang Sun.

manualTranslations.zh: 是謂德音，詣我宗極，滿於天下，貽厥後昆。
manualTranslations.literal: These are called virtuous words—reaching our ancestral apex, filling all under Heaven, bequeathing to posterity.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: These are called virtuous words—reaching our ancestral apex, filling all under Heaven, and bequeathing to posterity.

manualTranslations.zh: 殷宗甘之於酒醴，孫卿諭之以琴瑟，闕里重於四時，郢都輕其千乘。
manualTranslations.literal: The Yin dynast lord sweetly took to wine and spirits; Sun Qing admonished him with lute and zither; Queli was heavier than the four seasons; Ying capital lightly held its thousand chariots.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Yin dynast lord sweetly indulged in wine and spirits; Sun Qing admonished him with lute and zither; Queli was valued more than the four seasons; Ying capital lightly held its thousand chariots.

manualTranslations.zh: 豈不韙哉，豈不休哉！
manualTranslations.literal: Is this not correct! Is this not glorious!
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Is this not correct! Is this not glorious!

manualTranslations.zh: 但楙探世猷，克念丕訓，審思而應，精慮而動。
manualTranslations.literal: But one should deeply probe the ways of the world, earnestly recall the great instruction, respond only after careful thought, and act only after refined deliberation.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: But one should deeply probe the ways of the world, earnestly hold in mind the great instruction, respond only after careful thought, and act only after refined deliberation.

manualTranslations.zh: 謀其心以後發，擇其交以後談，不蹙趨於非黨，不屏營於詭遇。
manualTranslations.literal: Plan in the heart before speaking, choose one's company before talking; do not press hurriedly toward hostile factions, do not hide and scheme for deceptive encounters.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Plan in the heart before speaking and choose one's company before talking. Do not press hurriedly toward hostile factions, and do not hide and scheme for deceptive encounters.

manualTranslations.zh: 非先王之至德不敢行，非先王之法言不敢道，翦其諜諜之緒，撲其炎炎之勢。
manualTranslations.literal: Without the utmost virtue of the former kings one dares not act; without the model words of the former kings one dares not speak—cut off the trailing threads of whispered scheming, beat down the blazing momentum.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Without the utmost virtue of the former kings one dares not act; without the model words of the former kings one dares not speak. Cut off the trailing threads of whispered scheming and beat down the blazing momentum.

manualTranslations.zh: 自然介爾景福，錫茲純嘏，則悔吝何由而生，怨惡何由而至哉？
manualTranslations.literal: Naturally the great blessing will come to you, and this pure felicity will be granted—then from what would regret and distress arise, from what would resentment and hatred come?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Naturally the great blessing will come to you and this pure felicity will be granted—then from what would regret and distress arise, and from what would resentment and hatred come?

manualTranslations.zh: 孔子曰：“終日行，不遺已患；
manualTranslations.literal: Confucius said, "Going all day without forgetting oneself brings no calamity;"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Confucius said, "Going all day without forgetting oneself brings no calamity;"

manualTranslations.zh: 終日言，不遺已憂。
manualTranslations.literal: speaking all day without forgetting oneself brings no worry."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: speaking all day without forgetting oneself brings no worry."

manualTranslations.zh: ”如此乃可以言也。
manualTranslations.literal: " Only thus may one speak.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: " Only thus may one speak.

manualTranslations.zh: 戒之哉，戒之哉！
manualTranslations.literal: Be on guard! Be on guard!
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Be on guard! Be on guard!

sourceRange.text: 其年秋，柬之表請歸襄州養疾。許之，仍特授襄州刺史，又拜其子漪爲著作郎，令隨父之任。上親賦詩祖道，又令群公餞送於定鼎門外。柬之至襄州，有鄉親舊交抵罪者，必深文致法，無所縱舍。其子漪恃以立功，每見諸少長，不以禮接，時議以爲不能易荊楚之剽性焉。尋爲武三思所構，貶授新州司馬。柬之至新州，憤恚而卒，年八十餘，景雲元年，製曰：「褒德紀功，事華典冊；飾終追遠，理光名教。故吏部尚書張柬之翼戴興運，謨明帝道，經綸謇諤，風範猶存。往屬回邪，構成釁咎，無辜放逐，淪沒荒遐。言念勳賢，良深軫悼，宜加寵贈，式賁幽泉。可贈中書令，封漢陽郡公。」建中初，又贈司徒。

sourceRange.text: 長安元年，超拜天官侍郎。每介然自守，都絶請謁，頗爲執政者所忌。轉文昌左丞。經月餘，則天謂曰：「自卿改職以來，選司大有罪過。或聞令史乃設齋自慶，此欲盛爲貪惡耳。今要卿復舊任。」又除天官侍郎，賜雜彩七十段。三年，拜鸞台侍郎、同鳳閣鸞台平章事，兼太子左庶子。四年，遷鳳閣侍郎，加銀青光祿大夫，仍依舊知政事。先是，來俊臣、周興等誣陷良善，冀圖爵賞，因緣籍沒者數百家。玄暐固陳其枉狀，則天乃感悟，鹹從雪免。

sourceRange.text: 上慘惻久之，遽於光順門舉哀，因罷十九年元正朝會，詔曰：弘濟艱難，參其功者時傑；經緯禮樂，贊其道者人師。式瞻而百度允厘，既往而千載貽範。臺衡軒鼎，垂黼藻於當今；徽策寵章，播芳蕤於後葉。故開府儀同三司、尚書左丞相、集賢院學士知院事、上柱國、燕國公張説，辰象降靈，雲龍合契。元和體其沖粹，妙有釋其至賾。挹而莫測，仰之彌高。精義探系表之微，英辭鼓天下之動。昔侍春誦，綢繆歳華。含舂容之聲，叩而盡應；蘊泉源之智，啟而斯沃。授命興國，則天衢以通；濟用和民，則朝政惟允。司鈞總六官之紀，端揆爲萬邦之式。方弘風緯俗，返本於上古之初；而邁德振仁，不臻於中壽之福。於嗟不慭，既喪斯文。宣室餘談，泠然在耳；王殿遺草，宛留其跡。言念忠賢，良深震悼。是使當寧撫幾，臨樂徹懸，罷稱觴之儀，遵往襚之禮。可贈太師，賜物五百段。

manualTranslations.literal: Just as he was broadening custom and ordering society, returning to the roots of high antiquity;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Just as he was broadening custom and ordering society, returning to the roots of high antiquity;

manualTranslations.zh: 而邁德振仁，不臻於中壽之福。
manualTranslations.literal: in advancing virtue and raising benevolence, he did not attain the blessing of middle age.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: in advancing virtue and raising benevolence, he did not attain the blessing of middle age.

manualTranslations.zh: 於嗟不慭，既喪斯文。
manualTranslations.literal: Alas, Heaven was not kind; this culture is already lost.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Alas, Heaven was not kind; this culture is already lost.

manualTranslations.zh: 宣室餘談，泠然在耳；
manualTranslations.literal: The remaining discourse of the Xuan Chamber still sounds clearly in the ear;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The remaining discourse of the Xuan Chamber still sounds clearly in the ear;

manualTranslations.zh: 王殿遺草，宛留其跡。
manualTranslations.literal: the drafts left in the royal hall still preserve his traces.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: the drafts left in the royal hall still preserve his traces.

manualTranslations.zh: 言念忠賢，良深震悼。
manualTranslations.literal: Speaking in remembrance of this loyal worthy, our grief and mourning are profound.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Speaking in remembrance of this loyal worthy, our grief and mourning are profound.

manualTranslations.zh: 是使當寧撫幾，臨樂徹懸，罷稱觴之儀，遵往襚之禮。
manualTranslations.literal: For this reason, seated at the throne he mourns over the state, halts music and removes the bells, cancels the rite of raising the cup, and follows the funeral rites for the departed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: For this reason, seated at the throne he mourns over the state, halts music and removes the bells, cancels the rite of raising the cup, and follows the funeral rites for the departed.

manualTranslations.zh: 可贈太師，賜物五百段。
manualTranslations.literal: He may be posthumously granted Grand Preceptor and given five hundred bolts of goods.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He is posthumously granted Grand Preceptor and given five hundred bolts of goods.

sourceRange.text: 元振聞其謀，遽上疏曰：往者吐蕃所爭，唯論十姓、四鎮，國家不能舍與，所以不得通和。今吐蕃不相侵擾者，不是顧國家和信不來，直是其國中諸豪及泥婆羅門等屬國自有攜貳。故贊普躬往南征，身殞寇庭，國中大亂，嫡庶競立，將相爭權，自相屠滅。兼以人畜疲癘，財力困窮，人事天時，俱未稱愜。所以屈誌，且共漢和，非是本心能忘情於十姓、四鎮也。如國力殷足之後，則必爭小事，方便絕和，縱其醜徒，來相吞擾，此必然之計也。今忠節乃不論國家大計，直欲爲吐蕃作鄉導主人，四鎮危機，恐從此啟。頃緣默啜憑陵，所應處兼四鎮兵士，歳久貧羸，其勢未能得爲忠節經略，非是憐突騎施也。忠節不體國家中外之意，而別求吐蕃，吐蕃得誌，忠節則在其掌握，若爲復得事漢？往年吐蕃於國非有恩有力，猶欲爭十姓、四鎮；今若效力樹恩之後，或請分於闐、疏勒，不知欲以何理抑之？又其國中諸蠻及婆羅門等國見今攜背，忽請漢兵助其除討，亦不知欲以何詞拒之？是以古之賢人，皆不願夷狄妄惠，非是不欲其力，懼後求請無厭，益生中國之事。故臣愚以爲用吐蕃之力，實爲非便。又請阿史那獻者，豈不以獻等並可汗子孫，來即可以招脅十姓？但獻父元慶、叔仆羅、兄俀子並斛瑟羅及懷道，豈不俱是可汗子孫？往四鎮以他匐十姓不安，請冊元慶爲可汗，竟不能招脅得十姓，卻令元慶沒賊，四鎮盡淪。頃年，忠節請斛瑟羅及懷道俱爲可汗，亦不能招脅得十姓，卻遣碎葉數年被圍，兵士饑餒。又，吐蕃頃年亦冊俀子及仆羅並拔布相次爲可汗，亦不能招得十姓，皆自磨滅。何則？此等子孫非有惠下之才，恩義素絕，故人心不歸，來者既不能招攜，唯與四鎮卻生瘡磐，則知冊可汗子孫，亦未獲招脅十姓之算也。今料獻之恩義，又隔遠於其父兄，向來既未樹立威恩，亦何由即遣人心懸附。若自舉兵，力勢能取，則可招脅十姓，不必要須得可汗子孫也。又，欲令郭虔瓘入拔汗那稅甲稅馬以充軍用者，但往年虔瓘已曾與忠節擅入拔汗那稅甲稅馬，臣在疏勒其訪，不聞得一甲入軍，拔汗那胡不勝侵擾，南勾吐蕃，即將俀子重擾四鎮。又虔瓘往入之際，拔汗那四面無賊可勾，恣意侵吞，如獨行無人之境，猶引俀子爲蔽。今此有娑葛強寇，知虔瓘等西行，必請相救。胡人則內堅城壘，突厥則外伺邀遮。必知虔瓘等不能更如往年得恣其吞噬，內外受敵，自陷危道，徒與賊結隙，令四鎮不安。臣愚揣之，亦爲非計。

manualTranslations.zh: 元振聞其謀，遽上疏曰：往者吐蕃所爭，唯論十姓、四鎮，國家不能舍與，所以不得通和。
manualTranslations.literal: Yuanzhen heard of the plot and hurriedly submitted a memorial saying: In former times what the Tibetans disputed was only the Ten Surnames and the Four Garrisons. The state could not yield them, and therefore peace could not be achieved.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Yuanzhen learned of the plot, he immediately submitted a memorial that read: "In former times what Tibet disputed was only the Ten Surnames and the Four Garrisons. The state could not yield them, and therefore peace could not be achieved.

manualTranslations.zh: 今吐蕃不相侵擾者，不是顧國家和信不來，直是其國中諸豪及泥婆羅門等屬國自有攜貳。
manualTranslations.literal: That the Tibetans now do not invade and harass is not because they care for the state's peace and good faith and therefore do not come; it is simply that the various chieftains within their state and subordinate states such as Nepal have their own divisions and defections.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That Tibet now does not invade and harass is not because it cares for the court's peace and good faith and therefore holds back; it is simply that the various chieftains within Tibet and subordinate states such as Nepal have their own divisions and defections.

manualTranslations.zh: 故贊普躬往南征，身殞寇庭，國中大亂，嫡庶競立，將相爭權，自相屠滅。
manualTranslations.literal: Hence the zanpu personally went south on campaign, perished in the enemy's territory, and the state fell into great disorder: legitimate and illegitimate sons competed for the throne, generals and ministers fought for power, and slaughtered one another.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Hence the zanpu personally went south on campaign, perished in enemy territory, and the state fell into great disorder. Legitimate and illegitimate sons competed for the throne, generals and ministers fought for power, and slaughtered one another.

manualTranslations.zh: 兼以人畜疲癘，財力困窮，人事天時，俱未稱愜。
manualTranslations.literal: Together with this, men and livestock were worn out and sick, wealth and strength were exhausted, and both human affairs and the season of Heaven were alike unsatisfactory.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Moreover, men and livestock were worn out and sick, wealth and strength were exhausted, and both human affairs and Heaven's season were alike unsatisfactory.

manualTranslations.zh: 所以屈誌，且共漢和，非是本心能忘情於十姓、四鎮也。
manualTranslations.literal: Therefore they bend their will and for the moment make peace with the Han; it is not that in their true hearts they can forget the Ten Surnames and the Four Garrisons.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Therefore they bend their will and for the moment make peace with the Han. It is not that in their true hearts they can forget the Ten Surnames and the Four Garrisons.

manualTranslations.zh: 如國力殷足之後，則必爭小事，方便絕和，縱其醜徒，來相吞擾，此必然之計也。
manualTranslations.literal: Once their national strength is ample again, they will surely contend over small matters, find occasion to break peace, unleash their wicked followers, and come to swallow and harass us. This is an inevitable plan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Once their national strength is ample again, they will surely contend over small matters, find occasion to break peace, unleash their wicked followers, and come to swallow and harass us. This is inevitable.

manualTranslations.zh: 今忠節乃不論國家大計，直欲爲吐蕃作鄉導主人，四鎮危機，恐從此啟。
manualTranslations.literal: Now Zhongjie does not consider the state's great plan but directly wishes to serve Tibet as guide and host. The crisis of the Four Garrisons, I fear, will begin from this.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Now Zhongjie does not consider the state's great plan but directly wishes to serve Tibet as guide and host. I fear the crisis of the Four Garrisons will begin from this.

manualTranslations.zh: 頃緣默啜憑陵，所應處兼四鎮兵士，歳久貧羸，其勢未能得爲忠節經略，非是憐突騎施也。
manualTranslations.literal: Recently, because Mochuo relied on force to oppress us, the troops of the Four Garrisons stationed in the relevant areas have for years been poor and weak. Their strength cannot now carry out a campaign for Zhongjie. This is not pity for the Turgesh.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Recently, because Mochuo relied on force to oppress us, the troops of the Four Garrisons in the relevant areas have for years been poor and weak. Their strength cannot now carry out a campaign for Zhongjie. This is not pity for the Turgesh.

manualTranslations.zh: 忠節不體國家中外之意，而別求吐蕃，吐蕃得誌，忠節則在其掌握，若爲復得事漢？
manualTranslations.literal: Zhongjie does not understand the state's intent at home and abroad but separately seeks Tibet. Once Tibet gets its wish, Zhongjie will be in its grasp. How then could he again serve the Han?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhongjie does not understand the state's intent at home and abroad but separately seeks Tibet. Once Tibet gets its wish, Zhongjie will be in its grasp. How then could he again serve the Han?

manualTranslations.zh: 往年吐蕃於國非有恩有力，猶欲爭十姓、四鎮；
manualTranslations.literal: In former years Tibet owed the state no favor and had no strength, yet still wished to contend for the Ten Surnames and the Four Garrisons;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In former years Tibet owed the state no favor and had no strength, yet still wished to contend for the Ten Surnames and the Four Garrisons;

manualTranslations.zh: 今若效力樹恩之後，或請分於闐、疏勒，不知欲以何理抑之？
manualTranslations.literal: if now, after rendering service and building favor, it should request a division of Khotan and Shule, by what reasoning would we restrain it?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: if now, after rendering service and building favor, it should request a division of Khotan and Shule, by what reasoning would we restrain it?

manualTranslations.zh: 又其國中諸蠻及婆羅門等國見今攜背，忽請漢兵助其除討，亦不知欲以何詞拒之？
manualTranslations.literal: Moreover, the various barbarian peoples within its state and countries such as Nepal are now divided and rebellious. If it suddenly requests Han troops to help suppress and punish them, by what words would we refuse?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Moreover, the various barbarian peoples within its state and countries such as Nepal are now divided and rebellious. If it suddenly requests Han troops to help suppress them, by what words would we refuse?

manualTranslations.zh: 是以古之賢人，皆不願夷狄妄惠，非是不欲其力，懼後求請無厭，益生中國之事。
manualTranslations.literal: Therefore the worthy men of antiquity all did not wish for reckless favors from the barbarians. It was not that they did not desire their strength; they feared that later requests would know no limit and would only increase troubles for China.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Therefore the worthy men of antiquity all did not wish for reckless favors from the barbarians. It was not that they did not desire their strength; they feared that later requests would know no limit and would only increase troubles for China.

manualTranslations.zh: 故臣愚以爲用吐蕃之力，實爲非便。
manualTranslations.literal: Therefore your subject in his foolishness believes that using Tibet's strength is truly inexpedient.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Therefore I believe that using Tibet's strength is truly inexpedient.

manualTranslations.zh: 又請阿史那獻者，豈不以獻等並可汗子孫，來即可以招脅十姓？
manualTranslations.literal: As for the request for Ashina Xian, is it not because Xian and the others are all descendants of khans and that once they come they can win over the Ten Surnames by coercion?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: As for the request for Ashina Xian, is it not because Xian and the others are all descendants of khans and that once they come they can win over the Ten Surnames by coercion?

manualTranslations.zh: 但獻父元慶、叔仆羅、兄俀子並斛瑟羅及懷道，豈不俱是可汗子孫？
manualTranslations.literal: Yet Xian's father Yuanqing, his uncle Pulu, his elder brother Youzi, as well as Husheluo and Huaidao—were they not all descendants of khans?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yet Xian's father Yuanqing, his uncle Pulu, his elder brother Youzi, as well as Husheluo and Huaidao—were they not all descendants of khans?

manualTranslations.zh: 往四鎮以他匐十姓不安，請冊元慶爲可汗，竟不能招脅得十姓，卻令元慶沒賊，四鎮盡淪。
manualTranslations.literal: Formerly the Four Garrisons, because the Ten Surnames under Tafu were unsettled, requested that Yuanqing be enfeoffed as khan. In the end they could not win over the Ten Surnames by coercion; instead Yuanqing perished among the bandits and the Four Garrisons were wholly lost.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Formerly the Four Garrisons, because the Ten Surnames under Tafu were unsettled, requested that Yuanqing be enfeoffed as khan. In the end they could not win over the Ten Surnames; instead Yuanqing perished among the bandits and the Four Garrisons were wholly lost.

manualTranslations.zh: 頃年，忠節請斛瑟羅及懷道俱爲可汗，亦不能招脅得十姓，卻遣碎葉數年被圍，兵士饑餒。
manualTranslations.literal: In recent years Zhongjie requested that Husheluo and Huaidao both be made khans. They too could not win over the Ten Surnames by coercion, and instead Suyab was besieged for several years and the soldiers suffered hunger.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In recent years Zhongjie requested that Husheluo and Huaidao both be made khans. They too could not win over the Ten Surnames, and instead Suyab was besieged for several years while the soldiers suffered hunger.

manualTranslations.zh: 又，吐蕃頃年亦冊俀子及仆羅並拔布相次爲可汗，亦不能招得十姓，皆自磨滅。
manualTranslations.literal: Moreover, in recent years Tibet also enfeoffed Youzi and Pulu and Babu in succession as khans. They too could not win over the Ten Surnames and all perished on their own.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Moreover, in recent years Tibet also enfeoffed Youzi, Pulu, and Babu in succession as khans. They too could not win over the Ten Surnames and all perished on their own.

manualTranslations.zh: 何則？
manualTranslations.literal: Why is this?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Why is this?

manualTranslations.zh: 此等子孫非有惠下之才，恩義素絕，故人心不歸，來者既不能招攜，唯與四鎮卻生瘡磐，則知冊可汗子孫，亦未獲招脅十姓之算也。
manualTranslations.literal: These descendants lack the talent to show favor to those below; grace and righteousness have long been severed, and therefore people's hearts do not turn to them. Once they come they cannot win loyalty, and only create sores upon the Four Garrisons. Thus one knows that enfeoffing descendants of khans is also not a plan for winning the Ten Surnames by coercion.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: These descendants lack the talent to show favor to those below; grace and righteousness have long been severed, and therefore people's hearts do not turn to them. Once they come they cannot win loyalty and only create sores upon the Four Garrisons. Thus enfeoffing descendants of khans is also not a plan for winning the Ten Surnames.

manualTranslations.zh: 今料獻之恩義，又隔遠於其父兄，向來既未樹立威恩，亦何由即遣人心懸附。
manualTranslations.literal: Now I reckon that Xian's grace and righteousness are even more distant than those of his father and elder brothers. Hitherto he has not established authority and favor; how then could he at once cause people's hearts to attach to him in suspense?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Now I reckon that Xian's grace and righteousness are even more distant than those of his father and elder brothers. Hitherto he has not established authority and favor; how then could he at once win people's hearts?

manualTranslations.zh: 若自舉兵，力勢能取，則可招脅十姓，不必要須得可汗子孫也。
manualTranslations.literal: If one raises troops on one's own and strength and power can take them, then one can win over the Ten Surnames by coercion. It is not necessary to have descendants of khans.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: If one raises troops on one's own and strength and power can take them, then one can win over the Ten Surnames. It is not necessary to have descendants of khans.

manualTranslations.zh: 又，欲令郭虔瓘入拔汗那稅甲稅馬以充軍用者，但往年虔瓘已曾與忠節擅入拔汗那稅甲稅馬，臣在疏勒其訪，不聞得一甲入軍，拔汗那胡不勝侵擾，南勾吐蕃，即將俀子重擾四鎮。
manualTranslations.literal: Moreover, as for wishing to have Guo Qian'gu enter Ferghana to levy armor and horses to supply the army: in former years Qian'gu already once entered Ferghana with Zhongjie on their own authority to levy armor and horses. When your subject was in Shule and made inquiries, he did not hear of a single suit of armor entering the army. The Hu of Ferghana could not bear the harassment, turned south to ally with Tibet, and then brought Youzi to trouble the Four Garrisons again.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Moreover, as for wishing to have Guo Qian'gu enter Ferghana to levy armor and horses for the army: in former years Qian'gu already once entered Ferghana with Zhongjie on their own authority to levy armor and horses. When I was in Shule and made inquiries, I did not hear of a single suit of armor entering the army. The people of Ferghana could not bear the harassment, turned south to ally with Tibet, and then brought Youzi to trouble the Four Garrisons again.

manualTranslations.zh: 又虔瓘往入之際，拔汗那四面無賊可勾，恣意侵吞，如獨行無人之境，猶引俀子爲蔽。
manualTranslations.literal: Moreover, when Qian'gu entered before, on all four sides of Ferghana there were no bandits to be enlisted. He seized as he pleased, as if walking alone through an uninhabited land, yet still brought in Youzi as cover.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Moreover, when Qian'gu entered before, on all four sides of Ferghana there were no bandits to be enlisted. He seized as he pleased, as if walking alone through an uninhabited land, yet still brought in Youzi as cover.

manualTranslations.zh: 今此有娑葛強寇，知虔瓘等西行，必請相救。
manualTranslations.literal: Now there is the powerful enemy Suoge here. Knowing that Qian'gu and the others are going west, he will surely request mutual rescue.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Now there is the powerful enemy Suoge here. Knowing that Qian'gu and the others are going west, he will surely request mutual rescue.

manualTranslations.zh: 胡人則內堅城壘，突厥則外伺邀遮。
manualTranslations.literal: The Hu will then hold firm within walls and ramparts, while the Turks watch from without to intercept and block.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Hu will then hold firm within walls and ramparts, while the Turks watch from without to intercept and block.

manualTranslations.zh: 必知虔瓘等不能更如往年得恣其吞噬，內外受敵，自陷危道，徒與賊結隙，令四鎮不安。
manualTranslations.literal: They will surely know that Qian'gu and the others cannot again, as in former years, devour at will. Attacked from within and without, they will fall into a perilous path, vainly creating enmity with the bandits and making the Four Garrisons insecure.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They will surely know that Qian'gu and the others cannot again, as in former years, devour at will. Attacked from within and without, they will fall into peril, vainly creating enmity with the bandits and making the Four Garrisons insecure.

manualTranslations.zh: 臣愚揣之，亦爲非計。
manualTranslations.literal: Your subject in his foolishness reckons that this too is no plan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In my foolish reckoning, this too is no plan."

sourceRange.text: 元振還，上疏曰：臣聞利或生害，害亦生利。國家難消息者，唯吐蕃與默啜耳。今吐蕃請和，默啜受命，是將大利於中國也。若圖之不審，則害必隨之。今欽陵欲分裂十姓，去四鎮兵，此誠動靜之機，不可輕舉措也。今若直塞其善意，恐邊患之起，必甚於前，若以鎮不可拔，兵不可抽，則宜爲計以緩之，藉事以誘之，使彼和望未絕，則其惡意亦不得頓生。且四鎮之患遠，甘、涼之患近，取舍之計，實宜深圖。今國之外患者，十姓、四鎮是也；內患者，甘、涼、瓜、肅是也。關、隴之人，久事屯戍，向三十年，力用竭矣。脫甘、涼有不虞，豈堪廣調發耶？夫善爲國者，當先料內以敵外，不貪外以害內，然後夷夏晏安，昇平可保。如欽陵雲「四鎮諸部接界，懼漢侵竊，故有是請」，此則吐蕃所要者。然青海、吐渾密邇蘭、鄯，比爲漢患，實在茲輩，斯亦國家之要者。今宜報欽陵云：「國家非吝四鎮，本置此以扼蕃國之要，分蕃國之力，使不得並兵東侵。今委之於蕃，力強易爲東擾。必實無東侵意，則還漢吐渾諸部及青海故地，即俟斤部落亦還吐蕃。」如此，則足塞欽陵之口，而事未全絕也。如欽陵小有乖，則曲在彼矣。又西邊諸國，款附歳久，論其情義，豈可與吐蕃同日而言。今未知其利害，未審其情實，遙有分裂，亦恐傷彼諸國之意，非制馭之長算也。

manualTranslations.zh: 元振還，上疏曰：臣聞利或生害，害亦生利。
manualTranslations.literal: Yuanzhen returned and submitted a memorial saying: Your subject has heard that benefit may give rise to harm, and harm may also give rise to benefit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yuanzhen returned and submitted a memorial that read: "I have heard that benefit may produce harm, and harm may also produce benefit.

manualTranslations.zh: 國家難消息者，唯吐蕃與默啜耳。
manualTranslations.literal: For the state, those hard to settle are only the Tibetans and Mochuo.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: For the state, the two powers hardest to settle are Tibet and Mochuo alone.

manualTranslations.zh: 今吐蕃請和，默啜受命，是將大利於中國也。
manualTranslations.literal: Now the Tibetans request peace and Mochuo accepts orders; this will be a great benefit to China.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Now Tibet seeks peace and Mochuo accepts our orders—this will greatly benefit China.

manualTranslations.zh: 若圖之不審，則害必隨之。
manualTranslations.literal: If the plan is not carefully considered, harm will surely follow.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: If the plan is not carefully weighed, harm will surely follow.

manualTranslations.zh: 今欽陵欲分裂十姓，去四鎮兵，此誠動靜之機，不可輕舉措也。
manualTranslations.literal: Now Qinling wishes to divide the Ten Surnames and remove troops from the Four Garrisons; this is truly a moment when movement and stillness are at stake and must not be lightly decided.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Now Qinling wishes to divide the Ten Surnames and withdraw troops from the Four Garrisons. This is truly a critical moment and must not be decided lightly.

manualTranslations.zh: 今若直塞其善意，恐邊患之起，必甚於前，若以鎮不可拔，兵不可抽，則宜爲計以緩之，藉事以誘之，使彼和望未絕，則其惡意亦不得頓生。
manualTranslations.literal: If we now directly block their good intent, I fear border troubles will arise even worse than before. If the garrisons cannot be abandoned and the troops cannot be withdrawn, then we should devise a plan to slow matters, use events to entice them, and keep their hope of peace from being cut off, so that their evil intent cannot suddenly arise.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: If we now bluntly reject their goodwill, I fear border troubles will arise worse than before. If the garrisons cannot be abandoned and the troops cannot be withdrawn, we should devise a plan to slow matters and use events to draw them on, so that their hope of peace is not cut off and their hostile intent cannot suddenly flare up.

manualTranslations.zh: 且四鎮之患遠，甘、涼之患近，取舍之計，實宜深圖。
manualTranslations.literal: Moreover, the trouble of the Four Garrisons is distant, while the trouble of Gan and Liang is near; the plan of what to take and what to leave truly should be deeply considered.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Moreover, the threat from the Four Garrisons is distant, while the threat to Gan and Liang is near. The choice of what to keep and what to yield truly demands deep deliberation.

manualTranslations.zh: 今國之外患者，十姓、四鎮是也；
manualTranslations.literal: Now the state's external troubles are the Ten Surnames and the Four Garrisons;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: China's external troubles are the Ten Surnames and the Four Garrisons;

manualTranslations.zh: 內患者，甘、涼、瓜、肅是也。
manualTranslations.literal: the internal troubles are Gan, Liang, Guazhou, and Suzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: its internal troubles are Gan, Liang, Guazhou, and Suzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 關、隴之人，久事屯戍，向三十年，力用竭矣。
manualTranslations.literal: The people of Guan and Long have long served in garrison duty; for nearly thirty years their strength and resources have been exhausted.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The people of Guan and Long have long served on the frontier; for nearly thirty years their strength and resources have been exhausted.

manualTranslations.zh: 脫甘、涼有不虞，豈堪廣調發耶？
manualTranslations.literal: If Gan and Liang should meet with unexpected trouble, how could they bear broad levies and deployments?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: If Gan and Liang should meet with unexpected trouble, how could they bear broad levies and deployments?

manualTranslations.zh: 夫善爲國者，當先料內以敵外，不貪外以害內，然後夷夏晏安，昇平可保。
manualTranslations.literal: One who governs a state well should first reckon the interior to meet the exterior and not covet the exterior to harm the interior; only then will barbarians and Chinese be tranquil and peace be secured.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: A good statesman reckons first from within to meet threats from without and does not covet external gains at the expense of internal strength. Only then can barbarians and Chinese live in peace and order be preserved.

manualTranslations.zh: 如欽陵雲「四鎮諸部接界，懼漢侵竊，故有是請」，此則吐蕃所要者。
manualTranslations.literal: As Qinling says, "The various tribes of the Four Garrisons border us and fear Han encroachment, hence this request"—this is what the Tibetans want.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: As Qinling says, "The various tribes of the Four Garrisons border us and fear Han encroachment, hence this request"—that is what Tibet wants.

manualTranslations.zh: 然青海、吐渾密邇蘭、鄯，比爲漢患，實在茲輩，斯亦國家之要者。
manualTranslations.literal: Yet Qinghai and the Tuyuhun lie close to Lan and Shan; they have long been troubles to the Han, and the reality lies with these peoples. This too is vital to the state.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yet Qinghai and the Tuyuhun lie close to Lan and Shan and have long troubled the Han. The reality lies with these peoples, and this too is vital to the state.

manualTranslations.zh: 今宜報欽陵云：「國家非吝四鎮，本置此以扼蕃國之要，分蕃國之力，使不得並兵東侵。
manualTranslations.literal: Now we should reply to Qinling, saying, "The state is not stingy with the Four Garrisons. They were originally established to choke Tibet's vital points and divide Tibet's strength so that it could not combine its forces and invade eastward.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: We should now reply to Qinling: "The state is not reluctant to yield the Four Garrisons. They were originally established to choke Tibet's vital points and divide its strength so that it could not combine forces and invade eastward.

manualTranslations.zh: 今委之於蕃，力強易爲東擾。
manualTranslations.literal: If we now hand them over to Tibet, once its strength grows it will easily harass the east.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: If we now hand them over to Tibet, once its strength grows it will easily harass the east.

manualTranslations.zh: 必實無東侵意，則還漢吐渾諸部及青海故地，即俟斤部落亦還吐蕃。」
manualTranslations.literal: If there is truly no intent to invade eastward, then return the Han Tuyuhun tribes and the former lands of Qinghai, and the Yuezhi tribes as well shall be returned to Tibet."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: If there is truly no intent to invade eastward, then return the Han Tuyuhun tribes and the former lands of Qinghai, and the Yuezhi tribes shall also be returned to Tibet."

manualTranslations.zh: 如此，則足塞欽陵之口，而事未全絕也。
manualTranslations.literal: In this way we would suffice to silence Qinling's mouth, while the matter would not be wholly cut off.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In this way we would silence Qinling while the matter would not be wholly cut off.

manualTranslations.zh: 如欽陵小有乖，則曲在彼矣。
manualTranslations.literal: If Qinling should be slightly at fault, then the wrong will lie with him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: If Qinling should be slightly at fault, the wrong will lie with him.

manualTranslations.zh: 又西邊諸國，款附歳久，論其情義，豈可與吐蕃同日而言。
manualTranslations.literal: Moreover, the western states have long submitted in good faith; speaking of their affection and righteousness, how can they be mentioned in the same day as Tibet?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Moreover, the western states have long submitted in good faith. In affection and loyalty they cannot be mentioned in the same breath as Tibet.

manualTranslations.zh: 今未知其利害，未審其情實，遙有分裂，亦恐傷彼諸國之意，非制馭之長算也。
manualTranslations.literal: Now, without knowing the advantages and harms, without examining the true circumstances, to divide them from afar will also likely wound the feelings of those states. This is not a long-term plan for control.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Without knowing the advantages and harms or examining the true circumstances, to divide them from afar will likely wound the feelings of those states. This is not a sound long-term plan for control."

sourceRange.text: 久視年，則天幸三陽宮，自夏涉秋，不時還都，説上疏諫曰：陛下屯萬乘，幸離宮，暑退涼歸，未降還旨。愚臣固陋，恐非良策，請爲陛下陳其不可。三陽宮去洛城一百六十里，有伊水之隔，崿阪之峻，過夏涉秋，水潦方積，道壞山險，不通轉運，河廣無梁，咫尺千里。扈從兵馬，日費資給，連雨彌旬，即難周濟。陛下太倉、武庫，並在都邑，紅粟利器，蘊若山丘。奈何去宗廟之上都，安山谷之僻處？是猶倒持劍戟，示人鐏柄，臣竊爲陛下不取。夫禍變之生，在人所忽，故曰：「安樂必誡，無行所悔。」此不可止之理一也。宮成褊小，萬方輻湊，填城溢郭，並鍤無所。排斥居人，蓬宿草次，風雨暴至，不知庇托，孤煢老病，流轉衢巷。陛下作人父母，將若之何？此不可止之理二也。池亭奇巧，誘掖上心，削巒起觀，竭流漲海，俯貫地脈，仰出雲路，易山川之氣，奪農桑之土，延木石，運斧斤，山谷連聲，春夏不輟。勸陛下作此者，豈正人耶？《詩》云：「人亦勞止，汔可小康。」此不可止之理三也。御苑東西二十里，所出入來往，雜人甚多，外無墻垣局禁，內有榛藂谿谷，猛獸所伏，暴慝是憑。陛下往往輕行，警蹕不肅，歷蒙密，乘嶮巇，卒然有逸獸狂夫，驚犯左右，豈不殆哉！雖萬全無疑，然人主之動，不宜易也。《易》曰：「思患預防。」願陛下爲萬姓持重。此不可止之理四也。今國家北有胡寇覷邊，南有夷獠騷僥。關西小旱，耕稼是憂；安東近平，輸漕方始。臣願陛下及時旋軫，深居上京，息人以展農，修德以來遠，罷不急之役，省無用之費。澄心淡懷，惟億萬年，蒼蒼群生，莫不幸甚。臣自度芻議，十不一從。何者？沮盤遊之娛，間林沚之玩，規遠圖而替近適，要後利而棄前歡，未沃明主之心，已戾貴臣之意。然臣血誠密奏而不愛死者，不願負陛下言責之職耳。輕觸天威，伏地待罪。

manualTranslations.zh: 久視年，則天幸三陽宮，自夏涉秋，不時還都，説上疏諫曰：陛下屯萬乘，幸離宮，暑退涼歸，未降還旨。
manualTranslations.literal: In the Jiushi year Empress Wu visited the Sanyang Palace; from summer through autumn she did not return to the capital in timely fashion. Yue submitted a remonstrance memorial saying: Your Majesty stations the imperial chariot and visits the detached palace. Summer has passed and cool weather has returned, yet no order to return has been issued.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In 700 Empress Wu visited the Sanyang Palace. From summer through autumn she did not return to the capital on time. Yue submitted a remonstrance memorial that read: "Your Majesty stations the imperial chariot and visits the detached palace. Summer has passed and cool weather has returned, yet no order to return has been issued.

manualTranslations.zh: 愚臣固陋，恐非良策，請爲陛下陳其不可。
manualTranslations.literal: Your foolish subject is indeed crude and fears this is not a good plan. I beg to set forth for Your Majesty why it should not be done.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I am crude and foolish and fear this is not a good plan. I beg to set forth for Your Majesty why it should not be done.

manualTranslations.zh: 三陽宮去洛城一百六十里，有伊水之隔，崿阪之峻，過夏涉秋，水潦方積，道壞山險，不通轉運，河廣無梁，咫尺千里。
manualTranslations.literal: The Sanyang Palace is one hundred sixty li from Luoyang. The Yi River lies between, and the E Slope is steep. Passing summer and entering autumn, floodwaters have just accumulated, roads are ruined and mountains perilous, transport cannot pass, the river is broad and has no bridge, and a short distance becomes a thousand li.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Sanyang Palace is one hundred sixty li from Luoyang. The Yi River lies between, and the E Slope is steep. Passing summer and entering autumn, floodwaters have accumulated, roads are ruined and mountains perilous, transport cannot pass, the river is broad and has no bridge, and a short distance becomes a thousand li.

manualTranslations.zh: 扈從兵馬，日費資給，連雨彌旬，即難周濟。
manualTranslations.literal: The escorting troops and horses consume supplies daily. If rain continues for more than ten days, it will be hard to provide fully.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The escorting troops and horses consume supplies daily. If rain continues for more than ten days, it will be hard to provide fully.

manualTranslations.zh: 陛下太倉、武庫，並在都邑，紅粟利器，蘊若山丘。
manualTranslations.literal: Your Majesty's Great Granary and Armory are both in the capital. Red grain and sharp weapons are stored like hills.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Your Majesty's Great Granary and Armory are both in the capital. Red grain and sharp weapons are stored like hills.

manualTranslations.zh: 奈何去宗廟之上都，安山谷之僻處？
manualTranslations.literal: Why leave the supreme capital where the ancestral temple stands and settle in a secluded valley?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Why leave the supreme capital where the ancestral temple stands and settle in a secluded valley?

manualTranslations.zh: 是猶倒持劍戟，示人鐏柄，臣竊爲陛下不取。
manualTranslations.literal: This is like holding sword and halberd upside down and showing people the haft. Your subject privately believes Your Majesty should not do this.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This is like holding sword and halberd upside down and showing people the haft. I privately believe Your Majesty should not do this.

manualTranslations.zh: 夫禍變之生，在人所忽，故曰：「安樂必誡，無行所悔。」
manualTranslations.literal: Calamity and change arise from what people neglect. Therefore it is said: "In ease and pleasure one must be warned; do not act and then regret."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Calamity and change arise from what people neglect. Therefore it is said: "In ease and pleasure one must be warned; do not act and then regret."

manualTranslations.zh: 此不可止之理一也。
manualTranslations.literal: This is the first reason why it should not be stopped.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This is the first reason why it should not continue.

manualTranslations.zh: 宮成褊小，萬方輻湊，填城溢郭，並鍤無所。
manualTranslations.literal: The palace, once completed, is narrow and small. The myriad regions converge like wheel spokes, filling the city and overflowing the outer wards, with no place even to drive a spade together.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The palace, once completed, is narrow and small. The myriad regions converge like wheel spokes, filling the city and overflowing the outer wards, with no place even to drive a spade together.

manualTranslations.zh: 排斥居人，蓬宿草次，風雨暴至，不知庇托，孤煢老病，流轉衢巷。
manualTranslations.literal: Residents are driven out to lodge in grass huts. When wind and rain suddenly arrive, they know not where to take shelter. The orphaned, solitary, old, and sick wander through streets and lanes.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Residents are driven out to lodge in grass huts. When wind and rain suddenly arrive, they know not where to take shelter. The orphaned, solitary, old, and sick wander through streets and lanes.

manualTranslations.zh: 陛下作人父母，將若之何？
manualTranslations.literal: Your Majesty is father and mother to the people—what will you do about this?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Your Majesty is father and mother to the people—what will you do about this?

manualTranslations.zh: 此不可止之理二也。
manualTranslations.literal: This is the second reason why it should not be stopped.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This is the second reason why it should not continue.

manualTranslations.zh: 池亭奇巧，誘掖上心，削巒起觀，竭流漲海，俯貫地脈，仰出雲路，易山川之氣，奪農桑之土，延木石，運斧斤，山谷連聲，春夏不輟。
manualTranslations.literal: Pools and pavilions of strange ingenuity entice and draw the ruler's heart. Peaks are cut down to raise belvederes, streams are drained and seas are filled, piercing the earth's veins below and reaching cloud paths above, altering the qi of mountains and rivers, seizing land for farming and mulberry, hauling timber and stone and wielding axe and adze, with sounds echoing through valleys unceasing from spring through summer.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Pools and pavilions of strange ingenuity entice and draw the ruler's heart. Peaks are cut down to raise belvederes, streams are drained and seas are filled, piercing the earth's veins below and reaching cloud paths above, altering the qi of mountains and rivers, seizing land for farming and mulberry, hauling timber and stone and wielding axe and adze, with sounds echoing through valleys unceasing from spring through summer.

manualTranslations.zh: 勸陛下作此者，豈正人耶？
manualTranslations.literal: Those who urge Your Majesty to do this—are they upright men?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Those who urge Your Majesty to do this—are they upright men?

manualTranslations.zh: 《詩》云：「人亦勞止，汔可小康。」
manualTranslations.literal: The Odes says: "The people also have labored long; they may now have a little rest."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Odes says: "The people also have labored long; they may now have a little rest."

manualTranslations.zh: 此不可止之理三也。
manualTranslations.literal: This is the third reason why it should not be stopped.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This is the third reason why it should not continue.

manualTranslations.zh: 御苑東西二十里，所出入來往，雜人甚多，外無墻垣局禁，內有榛藂谿谷，猛獸所伏，暴慝是憑。
manualTranslations.literal: The imperial park extends twenty li east and west. Those who come and go are many and mixed. Outside there are no walls or guarded boundaries; within are thickets, brush, and ravines where fierce beasts lie hidden and the violent and wicked take refuge.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The imperial park extends twenty li east and west. Those who come and go are many and mixed. Outside there are no walls or guarded boundaries; within are thickets, brush, and ravines where fierce beasts lie hidden and the violent and wicked take refuge.

manualTranslations.zh: 陛下往往輕行，警蹕不肅，歷蒙密，乘嶮巇，卒然有逸獸狂夫，驚犯左右，豈不殆哉！
manualTranslations.literal: Your Majesty often travels lightly, with the imperial guard not strict, passing through dense cover and riding perilous heights. Suddenly a fleeing beast or madman may startle and offend those at your side—is this not dangerous!
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Your Majesty often travels lightly, with the imperial guard not strict, passing through dense cover and riding perilous heights. Suddenly a fleeing beast or madman may startle and offend those at your side—is this not dangerous!

manualTranslations.zh: 雖萬全無疑，然人主之動，不宜易也。
manualTranslations.literal: Although there may be no doubt of complete safety, the movements of the ruler should not be taken lightly.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Although there may be no doubt of complete safety, the movements of the ruler should not be taken lightly.

manualTranslations.zh: 《易》曰：「思患預防。」
manualTranslations.literal: The Changes says: "Think of trouble and guard against it beforehand."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Changes says: "Think of trouble and guard against it beforehand."

manualTranslations.zh: 願陛下爲萬姓持重。
manualTranslations.literal: I wish Your Majesty to be weighty on behalf of the myriad people.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I wish Your Majesty to be weighty on behalf of the myriad people.

manualTranslations.zh: 此不可止之理四也。
manualTranslations.literal: This is the fourth reason why it should not be stopped.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This is the fourth reason why it should not continue.

manualTranslations.zh: 今國家北有胡寇覷邊，南有夷獠騷僥。
manualTranslations.literal: Now the state has Hu bandits in the north watching the borders and Yi and Liao raiders in the south stirring trouble.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Now the state has Hu bandits in the north watching the borders and Yi and Liao raiders in the south stirring trouble.

manualTranslations.zh: 關西小旱，耕稼是憂；
manualTranslations.literal: In Guanxi there is a small drought, and farming is a worry;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Guanxi there is a small drought, and farming is a worry;

manualTranslations.zh: 安東近平，輸漕方始。
manualTranslations.literal: Andong is newly pacified and transport by canal has only just begun.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Andong is newly pacified and transport by canal has only just begun.

manualTranslations.zh: 臣願陛下及時旋軫，深居上京，息人以展農，修德以來遠，罷不急之役，省無用之費。
manualTranslations.literal: Your subject wishes Your Majesty to turn the chariot in timely fashion, dwell deeply in the upper capital, let the people rest so that farming may expand, cultivate virtue to draw the distant, cease unurgent labor, and reduce useless expense.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I wish Your Majesty to turn the chariot in timely fashion, dwell deeply in the upper capital, let the people rest so that farming may expand, cultivate virtue to draw the distant, cease unurgent labor, and reduce useless expense.

manualTranslations.zh: 澄心淡懷，惟億萬年，蒼蒼群生，莫不幸甚。
manualTranslations.literal: Clear the heart and lighten the breast, for ten thousand myriad years; the vast multitude of living beings would all be greatly blessed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Clear the heart and lighten the breast, for ten thousand myriad years; the vast multitude of living beings would all be greatly blessed.

manualTranslations.zh: 臣自度芻議，十不一從。
manualTranslations.literal: Your subject reckons that of his humble opinions, not one in ten will be followed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I reckon that of my humble opinions, not one in ten will be followed.

manualTranslations.zh: 何者？
manualTranslations.literal: Why?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Why?

manualTranslations.zh: 沮盤遊之娛，間林沚之玩，規遠圖而替近適，要後利而棄前歡，未沃明主之心，已戾貴臣之意。
manualTranslations.literal: Because it obstructs the pleasure of roaming excursions, interrupts play in woods and islets, plans for distant aims in place of present comfort, seeks later profit while abandoning present delight, has not yet nourished the enlightened ruler's heart, and already offends the intent of honored ministers.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because it obstructs the pleasure of roaming excursions, interrupts play in woods and islets, plans for distant aims in place of present comfort, seeks later profit while abandoning present delight, has not yet nourished the enlightened ruler's heart, and already offends the intent of honored ministers.

manualTranslations.zh: 然臣血誠密奏而不愛死者，不願負陛下言責之職耳。
manualTranslations.literal: Yet your subject submits this secret memorial in blood sincerity and without sparing death because he does not wish to fail in the duty of remonstrance entrusted by Your Majesty.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yet I submit this secret memorial in blood sincerity and without sparing death because I do not wish to fail in the duty of remonstrance entrusted by Your Majesty.

manualTranslations.zh: 輕觸天威，伏地待罪。
manualTranslations.literal: Having lightly touched heavenly majesty, I prostrate myself and await punishment.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Having lightly touched heavenly majesty, I prostrate myself and await punishment."

sourceRange.text: 挺之上疏諫曰：微臣竊惟陛下應天順人，發號施令，躬親大禮，昭布鴻澤，孜孜庶政，業業萬幾。蓋以天下心為心，深戒安危之理，此誠堯、舜、禹、湯之德教也。奈何親禦城門，以觀大酺，累日兼夜，臣愚竊所未諭。夫酺者，因人所利，合醵為歡，無相奪倫，不至糜弊。且臣卜其晝，史冊攸存，君舉必書，帝王重慎。今乃暴衣冠於上路，羅妓樂於中宵。雜鄭、衛之音，縱倡優之樂。陛下還淳復古，宵衣旰食，不矜細行，恐非聖德所宜。臣以為一不可也。誰何警夜，伐鼓通晨，以備非常，存之善教。今陛下不深惟戒慎，輕違動息，重門弛禁，巨猾多徒。倘有躍馬奔車，流言駭叫，一塵聽覽，有累宸衷。臣以為二不可也。且一人向隅，滿堂不樂；一物失所，納隍增慮。陛下北宮多暇，西墉暫臨。青春日長，已積埃塵之弊；紫微漏永，重窮歌舞之樂。倘令有司跛倚，下人饑倦，以陛下近猶不恤，而況於遠乎！聖情攸聞，豈不懍然只畏。臣以為三不可也。且元正首祚，大禮頻光，百姓颙颙，咸謂業盛配天，功垂曠代。今陛下恩似薄於眾望，酺即過於往年。王公貴人，各承微旨；州縣坊曲，競為課稅。籲嗟道路，貿易家產，損萬人之力，營百戲之資。適欲同其歡，而乃遺其患，復令兼夜，人何以堪？臣以為四不可也。《書》曰：「罔咈百姓，以從己之欲。」況自去夏霪霖，經今亢旱，農乏收成，市有騰貴。損其實，崇其虛，馳不急之務，擾方春之業。前代聖主明王，忽於細微而成過患多矣，陛下可效之哉？伏望晝則歡娛，暮令休息，要令兼夜，恐無益於聖朝。

sourceRange.text: 時帝未行親郊之禮，九齡上疏曰：伏以天才者，百神之君，而王者之所由受命也。自古繼統之主，必有郊配之義，蓋以敬天命以報所受。故於郊之義，則不以德澤未洽，年谷不登，凡事之故，而闕其禮。《孝經》云：「昔者周公郊祀後稷以配天。」斯謂成王幼沖，周公居攝，猶用其禮，明不暫廢。漢丞相匡衡亦云：「帝王之事，莫重乎郊祀。」董仲舒又云：「不郊而祭山川，失祭之序，逆於禮正，故《春秋》非之。」臣愚以為匡衡、仲舒，古之知禮者，皆謂郊之為祭所宜先也。伏惟陛下紹休聖緒，其命惟新，御極已來，於今五載，既光太平之業，未行大報之禮，竊考經傳，義或未通。今百穀嘉生，鳥獸咸若，夷狄內附，兵革用寧。將欲鑄劍為農，泥金封禪，用彰功德之美，允答神只之心。能事畢行，光耀帝載。況郊祀常典，猶闕其儀，有若怠於事天，臣恐不可以訓。伏望以迎日之至，展焚柴之禮，升紫壇，陳采席，定天位，明天道，則聖朝典則，可謂無遺矣。

sourceRange.text: 湊上書曰：臣聞王者發號施令，必法乎天道，使三綱攸敘，十等鹹若者，善善明，惡惡著也。善善者，懸爵賞以勸之也；惡惡者，設刑罰以懲之也。其賞罰所不加者，則考行立謚以褒貶之，所以勸誡將來也。斯並至公之大猷，非私情之可徇。故箕、微獲用，管、蔡為戮。謚者，臣議其君，子議其父，而曰「靈」曰「厲」者，不敢以私而亂大猷也，則其餘安可失衷哉！臣竊見節湣太子與李多祚等擁北軍禁旅，上犯宸居，破扉斬關，突禁而入，兵指黃屋，騎騰紫微。孝和皇帝移禦玄武門，親降德音，諭以逆順，而太子據鞍自若，督眾不停。俄而其黨悔非，轉逆為順，或回兵討賊，或投狀自拘。多祚等伏誅，太子方事逃竄。向使同惡相濟，天道無征，賊徒闕倒戈之人，侍臣虧陛戟之衛，其為禍也，胡可忍言！於時臣任將作少匠，賜通事舍人內供奉。其明日，孝和皇帝引見供奉官等，雨淚謂曰：「幾不與卿等相見！」其為危懼，不亦甚乎！而今聖朝雪罪禮葬，謚為節湣，以臣愚識，竊所惑焉。夫臣子之禮，嚴敬斯極，故過位必趨，蹙路馬芻有誅。昔漢成之為太子也，行不敢絕馳道。當周室之衰微也，秦師過周北門，左右免胄而下，王孫滿猶以其不卷甲束兵，譏其無禮，知其必敗。由是言之，則太子稱兵宮內，跨馬御前，悖禮已甚矣，況將更甚乎。而可褒謚，此臣所未諭也。以其斬武三思父子而嘉之乎？然弄兵討逆以安君父，則可嘉也，而乃因欲自取之，是競為逆，可褒謚乎？此又臣所未諭也。將廢韋氏而嘉之乎？然韋氏逆彰義絕，雖誅之亦可也。當此時也，韋氏未有逆彰，未有義絕，於太子為母，豈有廢母之理乎！且既非中宗之命而廢之，是劫父廢母，亦悖逆也，可褒謚乎？此又臣所未諭也。夫君或不君，臣安可不臣？父或不父，子安可不子？借如君父有桀、紂之行，臣子無廢殺之理。況先帝功格宇宙，德被生靈，廟號中宗，謚曰孝和皇帝，而逆命之子，可褒謚乎？此又臣所未諭也。昔獻公惑驪姬之譖，將殺其太子申生，公子重耳謂之曰：「子盍言子之誌於公乎？」太子曰：「不可，君安驪姬，是我傷君之心也。」曰：「然則盍行乎？」曰：「不可，君謂我欲弒君也，天下豈有無父之國哉！吾何行之！」使人辭於狐突曰：「申生不敢愛其死。雖然，吾君老矣，子少，國家多難。伯氏茍出而圖吾君，申生受賜而死。」再拜稽首，乃自縊。其行如是，其謚僅可為恭。今太子之行反是，可謚為節湣乎？此又臣所未諭也。昔漢武帝末年，江充與太子有隙，恐帝晏駕後為太子所誅。會巫蠱事起，充典理其事。因此為奸，遂至太子宮掘蠱，得桐木以誣太子。時武帝避暑甘泉宮，獨皇后、太子在，太子不能自明，納其少傅石德謀，遂矯節斬充，因敗逃匿。非稱兵詣闕，無逆謀於父，然身死於湖，不葬無謚。至昭帝時，有男子詣北闕自稱衛太子，制使公卿識視，至者莫敢發言。京兆尹雋不疑後至，叱從吏收縛之。或曰：「是非未可知，且安之。」不疑曰：「諸君何患於衛太子。昔蒯聵出奔，輒拒而不納，《春秋》是之。衛太子得罪先帝，亡不即死，今來自詣，此罪人也。」遂送制獄。天子聞而嘉之曰：「公卿大臣，當用經術明於大義者。」及後太子孫立為天子，是曰孝宣皇帝，太子方獲禮葬，而謚曰戾。今節湣太子之行比之，豈可同年而語。其於陛下，又猶子也，而謚為節湣乎？此又臣所未諭也。昔項羽之臣丁公，常將危漢高祖，高祖謂之曰：「二賢豈相厄哉！」丁公乃止。及高祖滅項氏，遂戮丁公以徇，曰：「使項王失天下者，丁公也。」夫戮之，大義至公也，不私德之，所以誡其後之事君者。今節湣太子之為逆，復非欲保護陛下，其可褒謚乎？此又臣之所未諭也。陛下天縱聖哲，所任賢明，以臣至愚，寧可幹議？然臣又惟堯、舜，聖君也，八凱、五臣，良佐也，猶廣聽芻蕘之言者，蓋為智者千慮，或有一失，愚者千慮，或有一得也。故曰：「狂夫之言，聖人擇焉。」臣輒緣斯義，敢以陳聞，願得與議謚者對議於御前。若臣言非也，甘受謗聖政之罪，赴鼎鑊之誅。仍請申明義以示天下，使臣輩愚惑者鹹蒙冰釋，則無復異議矣。若所謚未當，奈何施之聖朝，垂之史冊，使後代逆臣賊子因而引譬，資以為辭，是開悖亂之門，豈示將來之法！伏望改定其謚，務合禮經。其李多祚等罪，請從宥免，不謂為雪，以順天下之心，則盡善盡美矣。

sourceRange.text: 廷珪上疏曰：臣聞古有多難興王、殷憂啟聖者，皆以事危則誌銳，情迫則思深，故能自下登高，轉禍為福者也。伏見景龍之末，中宗遇禍，先天之際，兇黨構謀，社稷有危於綴旒，國朝將均於絕綖。陛下神武超代，精誠動天，再掃氛沴，六合清朗。而後上順皇旨，俯念黔黎，高運璿衡，光膺寶箓。日月所燭之地，書軌未通之鄉，無不霑濡渥恩，被服淳化。十堯、九舜，未足稱也。明明上帝，照臨下土，宜錫介祉，以答鴻休。然屬頃歲已來，陰陽愆候，九谷失稔，萬姓阻饑，關輔之間，更為尤劇。至有樵蘇莫爨，糧籺靡資，不復聊生，方憂轉死。偶會昌運，遘茲難否者，臣竊思之，皇天之意，將恐陛下春秋鼎盛，神聖在躬，不崇朝而建大功，自籓邸而陟元後，或簡下濟之道，獨滿雄圖之誌，輕虞舜而不法，思漢武以自高。是故昭見咎征，載加善誘，將欲大君日慎一日，雖休勿休，永保太和，以固邦本也。斯皇天於陛下睠顧深矣，陛下焉可不奉若休旨而寅畏哉！臣愚誠願陛下約心削誌，澄思勵精，考羲、農之書，敦素樸之道。登庸端士，放黜佞人，屏退後宮，減徹外廄，場無蹴⻊匊之玩，野絕從禽之賞。休石田之遠境，罷金甲之懸軍，矜恤煢嫠，蠲薄徭賦。去奇伎淫巧，捐和璧隋珠，不見可欲，使心不亂。自然波清四海，塵銷九域，農夫樂其業，餘糧棲於畝。則和氣上通於天，雖五星連珠，兩曜合璧，未足多也；珍祥下降於地，雖鳳皇巢閣，麒麟在郊，未足奇也。或謂天之炯戒不足畏者，則將上帝憑怒，風雨迷錯，荒饉日甚，無以濟下矣。或謂人之窮乏不足恤者，則將齊甿沮誌，億兆攜離，愁苦勢極，無以奉上矣。斯蓋安危所系，禍福之源，奈何朝廷曾不是察！況今陛下受命伊始，敷政惟新，卿士百僚，華夷萬族，莫不清耳以聽，刮目而視，延頸企踵，冀有所聞見，颙颙如也。何可怠棄典則，坐辜其望哉！

sourceRange.text: 替否上疏諫曰：臣聞古之建官，員不必備，九卿以下，皆有其位而闕其選。賞一人謀乎三事，職一人訪乎群司，負寵者畏權勢之在躬，知榮者避權門而不入。故稱賞不僭，官不濫，士皆完行，家有廉節，朝廷有餘俸，百姓有餘食。下忠於上，上禮於下，委裘而無倉卒之危，垂拱而無顛沛之患。夫事有惕耳目，動心慮，作不師古，以行於今者，蓋有之矣。伏惟陛下百倍行賞，十倍增官，金銀不供其印，束帛無充於錫，何愧於無用之臣，何慚於無力之士！至於公府補授，罕有推擇，遂使富商豪賈，盡居纓冕之流，鬻伎行巫，鹹涉膏腴之地。臣聞古人曰：「福生有基，禍生有胎。」伏惟公主陛下之愛女，選賢良以嫁之，設官職以輔之，傾府庫以賜之，壯第觀以居之，廣池膋以嬉之，可謂之至重也，可謂之至憐也。然而用不合於古義，行不根於人心，將恐變愛成憎，轉福為禍。何者？竭人之力，人怨也；費人之財，人怨也；奪人之家，人怨也。愛數子而取三怨於天下，使邊疆之士不盡力，朝廷之士不盡忠，人之散矣，獨持所愛，何所恃乎？向者魯王賞同諸婿，禮等朝臣，則亦有今日之福，無曩時之禍。人徒見其禍，不知禍之所來。所以禍者，寵愛過於臣子也。去年七月五日，已見其征矣。而今事無改，更尚因循，棄一宅而造一宅，忘前禍而忽後禍。臣竊謂陛下憎之矣，非愛之也。臣聞君以人為本，本固則邦寧。邦寧則陛下夫婦、母子長相保也。伏惟外謀宰臣，為久安之計以存之，不使奸臣賊子以伺之。臣聞微不可不防，遠不可不慮。當今疆場危駭，倉廩空虛，揭竿守禦之士賞不及，肝腦塗地之卒輸不充。而方大起寺舍，廣造第宅，伐木空山，不足充梁棟，運土塞路，不足充墻壁。誇古耀今，逾章越制，百僚鉗口四海傷心。夫釋教者，以清凈為基，慈悲為主，故當體道以濟物，不欲利己以損人，故常去己以全真，不為榮身以害教。三時之月，掘山穿池，損命也；殫府虛帑，損人也；廣殿長廊，榮身也。損命則不慈悲，損人則不濟物，榮身則不清凈，豈大聖大神之心乎！臣以為非真教，非佛意，違時行，違人欲。自像王西下，佛教東傳，青螺不入於周前，白馬方行於漢後。風流雨散，千帝百王，飾彌盛而國彌空，役彌重而禍彌大。覆車繼軌，曾不改途，晉臣以佞佛取譏，梁主以舍身構隙。若以造寺必為其理體，養人不足以經邦，則殷、周已往皆暗亂，漢、魏已降皆聖明；殷、周已往為不長，漢、魏已降為不短。臣聞夏為天子二十餘代而殷受之，殷為天子二十餘代而周受之，周為天子三十餘代而秦受之，自漢已後歷代可知也。何者？有道之長，無道之短，豈因其窮金玉、修塔廟，方得久長之祚乎！臣聞於經曰：「菩薩心住於法而行布施，如人入暗，即無所見。」又曰：「一切有為法，如夢幻泡影，如露亦如電。」臣以減雕琢之費以賑貧下，是有如來之德；息穿掘之苦以全昆蟲，是有如來之仁；罷營構之直以給邊陲，是有湯、武之功；回不急之祿以購廉清，是有唐、虞之理。陛下緩其所急，急其所緩，親未來而疏見在，失真實而冀虛無，重俗人之所為而輕天子之功業，臣竊痛之矣。當今出財依勢者盡度為沙門，避役奸訛者盡度為沙門；其所未度，唯貧窮與善人。將何以作範乎？將何以役力乎？臣以為出家者，舍塵俗，離朋黨，無私愛。今殖貨營生，非舍塵俗；拔親樹知，非離朋黨；畜妻養孥，非無私愛。是致人以毀道，非廣道以求人。伏見今之宮觀臺榭，京師之與洛陽，不增修飾，猶恐奢麗。陛下尚欲填池塹，捐苑囿，以賑貧人無產業者。今天下之寺蓋無其數，一寺當陛下一宮，壯麗之甚矣！用度過之矣！是十分天下之財而佛有七八，陛下何有之矣！百姓何食之矣！雖以陰陽為炭，萬物為銅，役不食之人，使不衣之士，猶尚不給。況資於天生地養，風動雨潤，而後得之乎！臣聞國無九年之儲，國非其國。伏計倉廩，度府庫，百僚供給，百事用度，臣恐卒歲不充，況九年之積乎！一旦風塵再擾，霜雹薦臻，沙門不可擐干戈，寺塔不足攘饑饉，臣竊痛之矣！

sourceRange.text: 時有敕復孝敬廟為義宗，湊上書曰：臣聞王者制禮，是曰規模，規模之興，實由師古。師古之道，必也正名，名之與實，故當相副。其在宗廟，禮之大者，豈可失哉！禮，祖有功而宗有德，祖宗之廟，百代不毀。故殷太甲為太宗，太戊曰中宗，武丁曰高宗；周宗文王、武王；漢則文帝為太宗，武帝為世宗。其後代有稱宗者，皆以方制海內，德澤可宗，列於昭穆，期於不毀。稱宗之義，不亦大乎！伏惟孝敬皇帝位止東宮，未嘗南面，聖道誠冠於儲副，德教不被於寰瀛，立廟稱宗，恐非合禮。況別起寢廟，不入昭穆，稽諸祀典，何義稱宗？而廟號義宗，稱之萬代，以臣庸識，竊謂不可。陛下率循典禮，以辟大猷，有司所議，以致此失，或虧盡善，豈不惜哉！望更詳議，務合於禮。

sourceRange.text: 廷珪上疏諫曰：夫佛者，以覺知為義，因心而成，不可以諸相見也。經云：「若以色見我，以音聲求我，是人行邪道，不能見如來。」此真如之果不外求也。陛下信心歸依，發弘誓願，壯其塔廟，廣其尊容，已遍於天下久矣。蓋有住於相而行布施，非最上第一希有之法。何以言之？經云：「若人滿三千大千世界七寶以用布施，及恆河沙等身命布施，其福甚多。若人於此經中受持及四句偈等為人演說，其福勝彼。」如佛所言，則陛下傾四海之財，殫萬人之力，窮山之木以為塔，極冶之金以為像，雖勞則甚矣，費則多矣，而所獲福不愈於一禪房之匹夫。菩薩作福德，不應貪著，蓋有為之法不足高也。況此營建，事殷木土，或開發盤礴，峻築基階，或塞穴洞，通轉采斫，輾壓蟲蟻，動盈巨億。豈佛標坐夏之義，湣蠢動而不忍害其生哉！又役鬼不可，唯人是營，通計工匠，率多貧窶，朝驅暮役，勞筋苦骨，簞食瓢飲，晨炊星飯，饑渴所致，疾疹交集。豈佛標徒行之義，湣畜獸而不忍殘其力哉！又營築之資，僧尼是稅，雖乞丐所致，而貧闕猶多。州縣征輸，星火逼迫，或謀計靡所，或鬻賣以充，怨聲載路，和氣未洽。豈佛標隨喜之義，湣愚蒙而不忍奪其產哉！且邊朔未寧，軍裝日給，天下虛竭，海內勞弊。伏惟陛下慎之重之，思菩薩之行為利益一切眾生，應如是布施，則其福德若南西北方四維上下虛空不可思量。夫何必勤於住相，雕蒼生之業，崇不急之務乎！臣以時政論之，則宜先邊境，蓄府庫，養人力；臣以釋教論之，則宜救苦厄，滅諸相，崇無為。伏願陛下察臣之愚，行佛之意，務以理為上，不以人廢言，幸甚幸甚。

sourceRange.text: 替否時為左補闕，又上疏陳時政曰：臣嘗以為古之用度不時，爵賞不當，破家亡國者，口說不如身逢，耳聞不如眼見，臣請以有唐已來理國之得失，陛下之所眼見者以言之。惟陛下審之聽之，擇善而從之，則萬歲之業，自可致矣，何憂乎黎庶之不康，福祚之不永！伏以太宗文武聖皇帝，陛下之祖，撥亂反正，開階立極，得至理之體，設簡要之方。省其官，清其吏，舉天下職司無一虛授，用天下財帛無一枉費。賞必俟功，官必得俊，所為無不成，所征無不伏。不多造寺觀而福德自至，不多度僧尼而殃咎自滅。道合乎天地，德通乎神明。故天地憐之，神明祐之，使陰陽不愆，風雨合度。四人樂其業，五谷遂其成，腐粟爛帛，填街委巷。千里萬里，貢賦於郊；九夷百蠻，歸款於闕。自有帝皇已來，未有若斯之神聖者也，故得享國久長，多歷年所，陛下何不取而則之？中宗孝和皇帝，陛下之兄，居先人之業，忽先人之化，不取賢良之言，而恣子女之意。官爵非擇，虛食祿者數千人；封建無功，妄食土者百餘戶。造寺不止，枉費財者數百億；度人不休，免租庸者數十萬。是使國家所出加數倍，所入減數倍。倉不停卒歲之儲，庫不貯一時之帛。所惡者逐，逐多忠良；所愛者賞，賞多讒慝。朋佞喋喋，交相傾動。容身不為於朝廷，保位皆由於黨附。奪百姓之食，以養殘兇；剝萬人之衣，以塗土木。於是人怨神怒，親忿眾離，水旱不調，疾疫屢起。遠近殊論，公私罄然。五六年間，再三禍變，享國不永，受終於兇婦人。寺舍不能保其身，僧尼不能護妻子，取譏萬代，見笑四夷。此陛下之所眼見也，何不除而改之。依太宗之理國，則百官以理，百姓無憂，故太山之安立可致矣；依中宗之理國，則萬人以怨，百事不寧，故累卵之危立可致矣。頃自夏已來，霪雨不解，谷荒於壟，麥爛於場。入秋已來，亢旱成災，苗而不實，霜損蟲暴，草葉枯黃。下人咨嗟，未知赒賑；而營寺造觀，日繼於時，檢校試官，充臺溢署。伏惟陛下愛兩女，為造兩觀，燒瓦運木，載土填坑，道路流言，皆云計用錢百餘萬貫。惟陛下，聖人也，無所不知；陛下，明君也，無所不見。既知且見，知倉有幾年之儲，庫有幾年之帛？知百姓之間可存活乎？三邊之上可轉輸乎？當今發一卒以禦邊陲，遣一兵以衛社稷，多無衣食，皆帶饑寒。賞賜之間，迥無所出，軍旅驟敗，莫不由斯。而乃以百萬貫錢造無用之觀，以受六合之怨乎！以違萬人之心乎！伏惟陛下續阿韋之醜跡，而不改阿韋之亂政。忍棄太宗之理本，不忍棄中宗之亂階；忍棄太宗久長之謀，不忍棄中宗短促之計。陛下又何以繼祖宗、觀萬國。昔陛下為皇太子，在阿韋之時，危亡是懼，常切齒於群兇。今貴為天子，富有海內，而不改群兇之事，臣恐復有切齒於陛下者也，陛下又何以非群兇而誅之？臣往見明敕，自今已後，一依貞觀故事。且貞觀之時，豈有今日之造寺營觀，加僧尼道士，益無用之官，行不急之務，而亂政者也！臣以為棄其言而不行其信，慕其善而不遷其惡，陛下又何以刑於四海？往者，和帝之憐悖逆也，為奸人之所誤，宗晉卿勸為第宅，趙履溫勸為園亭，損數百家之居，侵數百家之地。工徒斫而未息，義兵紛以交馳，卒使亭不得遊，宅不得坐。信邪佞之說，成骨肉之刑，此陛下之所眼見也。今茲造觀，臣必知非陛下、公主之本意，得無趙履溫之徒將勸為之，冀誤其骨肉，不可不明察也。臣聞出家修道者，不預人事，專清其身心，以虛泊為高，以無為為妙，依兩卷《老子》，視一軀天尊，無欲無營，不損不害。何必璇臺玉榭，寶像珍龕，使人困窮，然後為道哉！且舊觀足可歸依，無造無營，以取窮竭。若此行之三年，國不富，人不安，朝廷不清，陛下不樂，則臣請殺身於朝，以令天下言事者。伏惟陛下行非常之惠，權停兩觀，以俟豐年。以兩觀之財，為公主施貧窮，填府庫，則公主福德無窮矣。不然，臣恐下人怨望，不減於前朝之時。前朝之時，賢愚知敗，人雖有口而不敢言，言未發聲，禍將及矣。韋月將受誅於丹僥，燕欽融見殺於紫庭，此人皆不惜其身而納忠於主，身既死矣，朝亦危矣。故先朝誅之，陛下賞之，是陛下知直言之士有裨於國。臣今直言，亦先代之直，惟陛下察之。

sourceRange.text: 天授中，為左補闕，時選舉頗濫，謙光上疏曰：臣聞國以得賢為寶，臣以舉士為忠。是以子皮之讓國僑，鮑叔之推管仲，燕昭委兵於樂毅，苻堅托政於王猛。子產受國人之謗，夷吾貪共賈之財，昭王錫輅馬以止讒，永固戮樊世以除譖。處猜嫌而益信，行間毀而無疑，此由默而識之，委而察之深也。至若宰我見愚於宣尼，逢萌被知於文叔，韓信無聞於項氏，毛遂不齒於平原，此失士之故也。是以人主受不肖之士則政乖，得賢良之佐則時泰，故堯資八元而庶績其理，周任十亂而天下和平。由是言之，則士不可不察，而官不可妄授也。何者？比來舉薦，多不以才，假譽馳聲，互相推獎，希潤身之小計，忘臣子之大猷，非所以報國求賢，副陛下翹翹之望者也。臣竊窺古之取士，實異於今。先觀名行之源，考其鄉邑之譽，崇禮讓以勵己，明節義以標信，以敦樸為先最，以雕蟲為後科。故人崇勸讓之風，士去輕浮之行。希仕者必修貞確不拔之操，行難進易退之規。眾議以定其高下，郡將難誣於曲直。故計貢之賢愚，即州將之榮辱；穢行之彰露，亦鄉人之厚顏。是以李陵降而隴西慚，幹木隱而西河美。故名勝於利，則小人之道消；利勝於名，則貪暴之風扇。是以化俗之本，須擯輕浮。昔冀缺以禮讓升朝，則晉人知禮；文翁以儒林獎俗，則蜀士多儒。燕昭好馬，則駿馬來庭；葉公好龍，則真龍入室。由是言之，未有上之所好而下不從其化者也。自七國之季，雖雜縱橫，而漢代求才，猶征百行。是以禮節之士，敏德自修，閭裏推高，然後為府寺所辟。魏氏取人，尤愛放達；晉、宋之後，祗重門資。獎為人求官之風，乖授職惟賢之義。有梁薦士，雅愛屬詞；陳氏簡賢，特珍賦詠。故其俗以詩酒為重，不以修身為務。逮至隋室，餘風尚在，開皇中李諤論之於文帝曰：「魏之三祖，更好文詞，忽君人之大道，好雕蟲之小藝。連篇累牘，不出月露之形；積案盈箱，唯是風雲之狀。代俗以此相高，朝廷以茲擢士，故文筆日煩，其政日亂」。帝納李諤之策，由是下制禁斷文筆浮詞。其年，泗洲刺史司馬幼之以表不典實得罪。於是風俗改勵，政化大行。煬帝嗣興，又變前法，置進士等科。於是後生之徒，復相放效，因陋就寡，赴速邀時，緝綴小文，名之策學，不以指實為本，而以浮虛為貴。有唐纂歷，雖漸革於故非；陛下君臨，思察才於共理。樹本崇化，惟在旌賢。今之舉人，有乖事實。鄉議決小人之筆，行修無長者之論。策第喧競於州府，祈恩不勝於拜伏。或明制才出，試遣搜易攵，驅馳府寺之門，出入王公之第。上啟陳詩，唯希咳唾之澤；摩頂至足，冀荷提攜之恩。故俗號舉人，皆稱覓舉。覓為自求之稱，未是人知之辭。察其行而度其材，則人品於茲見矣。徇己之心切，則至公之理乖；貪仕之性彰，則廉潔之風薄。是知府命雖高，異叔度勤勤之讓；黃門已貴，無秦嘉耿耿之辭。縱不能抑己推賢，亦不肯待於三命。豈與夫白駒皎皎，不雜風塵，束帛戔戔，榮高物表，校量其廣狹也！是以耿介之士，羞自拔而致其辭；循常之人，舍其疏而取其附。故選司補署，喧然於禮闈；州貢賓王，爭訟於階闥。謗議紛合，浸以成風。夫競榮者必有競利之心，謙遜者亦無貪賄之累。自非上智，焉能不移；在於中人，理由習俗。若重謹厚之士，則懷祿者必崇德以修名；若開趨競之門，邀仕者皆戚施而附會。附會則百姓罹其弊，潔己則兆庶蒙其福。故風化之漸，靡不由茲。今訪鄉閭之談，唯祇歸於裏正。縱使名虧禮則，罪掛刑章，或冒籍以偷資，或邀勛而竊級，假其不義之賂，則是無犯鄉閭。豈得比郭有道之銓量，茅容望重，裴逸人之賞拔，夏少名高，語其優劣也！祇如才應經邦之流，唯令試策；武能制敵之例，只驗彎弧。若其文擅清奇，便充甲第，藻思微減，便即告歸。以此收人，恐乖事實。何者？樂廣假筆於潘嶽，靈運詞高於穆之，平津文劣於長卿，子建筆麗於荀彧。若以射策為最，則潘、謝、曹、馬必居孫、樂之右；若使協贊機猷，則安仁、靈運亦無裨附之益。由此言之，不可一概而取也。至如武藝，則趙雲雖勇，資諸葛之指捴；周勃雖雄，乏陳平之計略。若使樊噲居蕭何之任，必失指縱之機；使蕭何入戲下之軍，亦無免主之效。鬥將長於摧鋒，謀將審於料事。是以文泉聚米，知隗囂之可圖；陳湯屈指，識烏孫之自解。八難之謀設，高祖追慚於酈生；九拒之計窮，公輸息心於伐宋。謀將不長於弓馬，良相寧資於射策。豈與夫元長自表，妄飾詞鋒，曹植題章，虛飛麗藻，校量其可否也！伏願陛下降明制，頒峻科。千里一賢，尚不為少，僥幸冒進，須立堤防。斷浮虛之飾詞，收實用之良策，不取無稽之說，必求忠告之言。文則試以效官，武則令其守禦，始既察言觀行，終亦循名責實，自然僥幸濫吹之伍，無所藏其妄庸。故晏嬰云：「舉之以語，考之以事；寡其言而多其行，拙於文而工於事。」此取人得賢之道也。其有武藝超絕，文鋒挺秀，有效伎之偏用，無經國之大才，為軍鋒之爪牙，作詞賦之標準。自可試淩雲之策，練穿劄之工，承上命而賦《甘泉》，稟中軍而令赴敵，既有隨才之任，必無負乘之憂。臣謹案吳起臨戰，左右進劍，吳子曰：「夫提鼓揮桴，臨難決疑，此將事也。一劍之任，非將事也。」謹案諸葛亮臨戎，不親戎服，頓蜀兵於渭南，宣王持劍，卒不敢當。此豈弓矢之用也！謹案楊得意誦長卿之文，武帝曰：「恨不得與此人同時。」及相如至，終於文園令，不以公卿之位處之者，蓋非其所任故也。謹案漢法，所舉之主，終身保任。楊雄之坐田儀，責其冒薦；成子之居魏相，酬於得賢。賞罰之令行，則請謁之心絕；退讓之義著，則貪競之路消。自然朝廷無爭祿之人，選司有謙捴之士。仍請寬立年限，容其采訪簡汰，堪用者令其試守，以觀能否；參驗行事，以別是非。不實免王丹之官，得人加翟璜之賞，自然見賢不隱，食祿不專。荀彧進鐘繇、郭嘉，劉隱薦李膺、硃穆，勢不雲遠。有稱職者受薦賢之賞，濫舉者抵欺罔之罪，自然舉得賢行，則君子之道長矣。

sourceRange.text: 無量建議曰：夫郊祀者，明王之盛事，國家之大禮。行其禮者，不可以臆斷，不可以情求，皆上順天心，下符人事，欽若稽古，率由舊章，然後可以交神明，可以膺福祐。然禮文雖眾，莫如《周禮》。《周禮》者，周公致太平之書，先聖極由衷之典，法天地而行教化，辯方位而敘人倫。其義可以幽贊神明，其文可以經緯邦國，備物致用，其可忽乎！至如冬至圓丘，祭中最大，皇后內主，禮位甚尊。若合郊天助祭，則當具著禮典。今遍檢《周官》，無此儀制。蓋由祭天南郊，不以地配，唯將始祖為主，不以祖妣配天，故唯皇帝親行其禮，皇后不合預也。謹按《大宗伯》職云：「若王不祭祀，則攝位。」《註》云：「王有故，代行其祭事。」下文云：「凡大祭祀，王後不與，則攝而薦豆籩，徹。」若皇后合助祭，承此下文，即當云「若不祭祀，則攝而薦豆籩。」今於文上更起凡，則是別生餘事。夫事與上異，則別起凡。凡者，生上起下之名，不專系於本職。《周禮》一部之內，此例極多，備在文中，不可具錄。又王後助祭，親薦豆籩而不徹。案《九嬪》職云：「凡祭，贊後薦，徹豆籩。」《註》云：「後進之而不徹。」則知中徹者，為宗伯生文。若宗伯攝祭，則宗伯親徹，不別使人。又案「外宗掌宗廟之祀，王後不與，則贊宗伯」。此之一文，與上相證。何以明之？案外宗唯掌宗廟祭祀，不掌郊天，足明此文是宗廟祭也。案王後行事，總在《內宰》職中。檢其職文，唯云：「大祭祀，後稞獻則贊，瑤爵亦如之。」《鄭註》云：「謂祭宗廟也。」《註》所以知者，以文雲「稞獻」，祭天無稞，以此得知。又祭天之器，則用陶匏，亦無瑤爵，《註》以此得知是宗廟也。又內司服掌王後六服，無祭天之服；而巾車職掌王後之五輅，亦無後祭天之輅；祭天七獻，無後亞獻。以此諸文參之，故知後不合助祭天也。唯《漢書》《郊祀志》則有天地合祭，皇后預享之事，此則西漢末代，強臣擅朝，悖亂彜倫，黷神諂祭，不經之典，事涉誣神。故《易傳》曰：「誣神者，殃及三代。」《太誓》曰：「正稽古立功立事，可以永年，承天之大律。」斯史策之良誡，豈可不知。今南郊禮儀，事不稽古，忝守經術，不敢默然。請旁詢碩儒，俯摭舊典，采曲臺之故事，行圓丘之正儀，使聖朝葉昭曠之塗，天下知文物之盛，豈不幸甚。
