manualTranslations.zh: 乃獻《教本書》曰：臣伏見陛下降明詔，修廢學，增胄子，選司成。
manualTranslations.literal: He therefore presented a "Book on the Foundations of Instruction," which read: This subject humbly sees that Your Majesty has issued a bright edict to restore abandoned schools, increase the crown prince's students, and select a director of studies.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He accordingly submitted his "Book on the Foundations of Instruction," which began: This subject humbly observes that Your Majesty has issued a bright edict to restore abandoned schools, increase the crown prince's students, and select a director of studies.

manualTranslations.zh: 大哉，堯之為君，伯夷典禮，夔教胄子之深旨也！
manualTranslations.literal: How great! When Yao was ruler, Boyi supervised rites and Kui taught the crown prince's students—the deep meaning of this!
manualTranslations.idiomatic: How great! When Yao was ruler, Boyi supervised the rites and Kui taught the crown prince's students—that is the deep meaning of this!

manualTranslations.zh: 然而事有萬萬於此者，臣敢冒昧殊死而言之。
manualTranslations.literal: However, there are matters ten thousand times greater than this; this subject dares speak of them presumptuously, at the risk of death.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yet there are matters ten thousand times greater than this, and this subject dares speak of them presumptuously, at the risk of death.

manualTranslations.zh: 臣聞諸賈生曰：「三代之君，仁且久者，教之然也。」
manualTranslations.literal: This subject has heard Jia Yi say: "The rulers of the Three Dynasties who were benevolent and long-lasting were so because of instruction."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This subject has heard Jia Yi say: "The rulers of the Three Dynasties who were benevolent and long-lasting were so because of instruction."

manualTranslations.zh: 誠哉是言！
manualTranslations.literal: Truly this saying!
manualTranslations.idiomatic: How true that saying is!

manualTranslations.zh: 且夫周成王，人之中才也，近管、蔡則讒入，有周、召則義聞，豈可謂天聰明哉？
manualTranslations.literal: Moreover, King Cheng of Zhou was a man of middling talent; near Guan and Cai, slander entered; with the Duke of Zhou and Duke of Shao, righteousness was heard—how can one say he was heaven-endowed with brilliance?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: King Cheng of Zhou, moreover, was a man of middling talent: near Guan and Cai, slander entered; with the Duke of Zhou and Duke of Shao, righteousness was heard. How can one say he was heaven-endowed with brilliance?

manualTranslations.zh: 然而克終於道者，得不謂教之然耶？
manualTranslations.literal: Yet because he was able to complete the Way to the end, must one not say it was because of instruction?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yet because he was able to complete the Way to the end, must one not say it was because of instruction?

manualTranslations.zh: 俾伯禽、唐叔與之遊，《禮》、《樂》、《詩》、《書》為之習，目不得閱淫艷妖誘之色，耳不得聞優笑淩亂之音，口不得習操斷擊博之書，居不得近容順陰邪之黨，遊不得縱追禽逐獸之樂，玩不得有遐異僻絕之珍。
manualTranslations.literal: He was made to associate with Bo Qin and Uncle Tang; the Rites, Music, Poetry, and Documents were made his studies; his eyes were not allowed to view lewd, gaudy, and seductive colors; his ears were not allowed to hear the sounds of jesters' laughter and disorderly music; his mouth was not allowed to practice the arts of manipulation, gambling, and gaming; in residence he was not allowed to approach a party of flatterers and sinister men; in recreation he was not allowed to indulge in the pleasure of chasing birds and pursuing beasts; in playthings he was not allowed to possess rare and exotic treasures from distant lands.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was made to associate with Bo Qin and Uncle Tang; the Rites, Music, Poetry, and Documents were made his studies. His eyes were not allowed to view lewd and seductive sights; his ears were not allowed to hear jesters' laughter and disorderly music; his mouth was not allowed to practice manipulation, gambling, and gaming; in residence he was not allowed to approach flatterers and sinister men; in recreation he was not allowed to indulge in chasing birds and pursuing beasts; in playthings he was not allowed to possess rare exotic treasures from distant lands.

manualTranslations.zh: 凡此數者，非謂備之於前而不為也，亦將不得見之矣。
manualTranslations.literal: Of all these matters, it is not that they are prepared before him yet he does not do them; rather, he will not even be allowed to see them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Of all these matters, it is not that they are set before him yet he refrains from them; rather, he will not even be allowed to see them.

manualTranslations.zh: 及其長而為君也，血氣既定，遊習既成，雖有放心快己之事日陳於前，固不能奪已成之習、已定之心矣。
manualTranslations.literal: When he grew up and became ruler, his vital energies were already settled and his habits of association already formed; even if matters that indulge the heart and please the self were daily set before him, they could not wrest away habits already formed and a heart already settled.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When he grew up and became ruler, his vital energies were already settled and his habits of association already formed. Even if indulgences that pleased himself were daily set before him, they could not wrest away habits already formed and a heart already settled.

manualTranslations.zh: 則彼忠直道德之言，固吾之所習聞也，陳之者有以諭焉；
manualTranslations.literal: Then those words of loyalty, uprightness, and moral virtue were what he was accustomed to hearing; when they were set forth, there was means to instruct him;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Then words of loyalty, uprightness, and moral virtue were what he was accustomed to hearing; when they were set forth, there was means to instruct him;

manualTranslations.zh: 彼庸佞違道之說，固吾之所積懼也，諂之者有以辨焉。
manualTranslations.literal: those base and fawning words that violate the Way were what he had long accumulated fear of; when flattery was offered, there was means to distinguish it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: base and fawning words that violated the Way were what he had long accumulated fear of; when flattery was offered, there was means to distinguish it.

manualTranslations.zh: 人之情，莫不欲耀其所能而黨其所近；
manualTranslations.literal: In human disposition, there is none who does not wish to display what he is capable of and take as his party those he is close to;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In human nature, everyone wishes to display what he is capable of and take as his party those he is close to;

manualTranslations.zh: 茍將得志，則必快其所蘊矣。
manualTranslations.literal: if he is about to achieve his aim, he will surely give free rein to what he harbors within.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: if he is about to achieve his aim, he will surely give free rein to what he harbors within.

manualTranslations.zh: 物之性亦然。
manualTranslations.literal: The nature of things is likewise so.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The nature of things is likewise so.

manualTranslations.zh: 是以魚得水而遊，馬逸駕而走，鳥得風而翔，火得薪而熾。
manualTranslations.literal: Thus fish obtain water and swim; horses loose the reins and run; birds obtain wind and soar; fire obtains fuel and blazes.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Thus fish obtain water and swim; horses loose the reins and run; birds obtain wind and soar; fire obtains fuel and blazes.

manualTranslations.zh: 此皆物之快其所蘊也。
manualTranslations.literal: All these are things giving free rein to what they harbor within.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: All these are instances of things giving free rein to what they harbor within.

manualTranslations.zh: 今夫成王所蘊道德也，所近聖賢也。
manualTranslations.literal: Now what King Cheng harbored within was moral virtue; those he was close to were sages and worthies.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: What King Cheng harbored within was moral virtue; those he was close to were sages and worthies.

manualTranslations.zh: 是以舉其近，則周公左而召公右，伯禽魯而太公齊。
manualTranslations.literal: Thus when he raised up those close to him, the Duke of Zhou was at his left and the Duke of Shao at his right; Bo Qin was in Lu and Grand Duke Wang in Qi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Thus when he raised up those close to him, the Duke of Zhou was at his left and the Duke of Shao at his right; Bo Qin ruled Lu and Grand Duke Wang ruled Qi.

manualTranslations.zh: 快其蘊，則興禮樂而朝諸侯，措刑罰而美教化。
manualTranslations.literal: Giving free rein to what he harbored within, he raised rites and music and received the feudal lords in audience, set aside punishments, and glorified instruction and transformation.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Giving free rein to what he harbored within, he raised rites and music and received the feudal lords in audience, set aside punishments, and glorified instruction and transformation.

manualTranslations.zh: 教之至也，可不謂信然哉！
manualTranslations.literal: Instruction at its utmost—can one not call this truly so!
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Instruction at its utmost—can one not call this truly so!

manualTranslations.zh: 及夫秦則不然。
manualTranslations.literal: But when it came to Qin, it was not so.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: But when it came to Qin, it was not so.

manualTranslations.zh: 滅先王之學，曰將以愚天下；
manualTranslations.literal: It abolished the learning of former kings, saying it would thereby make all under Heaven stupid;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: It abolished the learning of former kings, saying it would thereby keep all under Heaven ignorant;

manualTranslations.zh: 黜師保之位，曰將以明君臣。
manualTranslations.literal: it dismissed the posts of teacher and protector, saying it would thereby clarify ruler and minister.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: it dismissed the posts of teacher and protector, saying it would thereby clarify the roles of ruler and minister.

manualTranslations.zh: 胡亥之生也，《詩》、《書》不得聞，聖賢不得近。
manualTranslations.literal: When Huhai was born, he was not allowed to hear the Poetry and Documents, and sages and worthies were not allowed near him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Huhai was born, he was not allowed to hear the Poetry and Documents, and sages and worthies were not allowed near him.

manualTranslations.zh: 彼趙高者，詐宦之戮人也；
manualTranslations.literal: That Zhao Gao was a castrated man of the fraudulent eunuch class;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That Zhao Gao was a castrated man of the fraudulent eunuch class;

manualTranslations.zh: 而傅之以殘忍戕賊之術，且曰恣睢天下以為貴，莫見其面以為尊。
manualTranslations.literal: yet he was made his tutor in cruel and murderous arts, and it was said that to act wantonly over all under Heaven was esteemed, and that not seeing his face was honor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: yet he was made his tutor in cruel and murderous arts, and it was said that to act wantonly over all under Heaven was esteemed, and that not seeing his face was honor.

manualTranslations.zh: 是以天下之人人未盡愚，而胡亥固已不能分獸畜矣。
manualTranslations.literal: Thus though the people of all under Heaven were not yet entirely stupid, Huhai was already unable to distinguish beasts from livestock.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Thus though the people of all under Heaven were not yet entirely ignorant, Huhai was already unable to distinguish beasts from livestock.

manualTranslations.zh: 趙高之威懾天下，而胡亥固已自幽於深宮矣。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhao Gao's authority awed all under Heaven, and Huhai was already shut away in the deep palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhao Gao's authority awed all under Heaven, and Huhai was already shut away in the deep palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 彼李斯，秦之寵丞相也。
manualTranslations.literal: That Li Si was Qin's favored chancellor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Li Si was Qin's favored chancellor.

manualTranslations.zh: 因讒冤死，無所自明，而況於疏遠之臣庶乎！
manualTranslations.literal: Because of slander he died unjustly with no means to clear himself—how much more so for distant and lowly ministers and commoners!
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because of slander he died unjustly with no means to clear himself—how much more so for distant and lowly ministers and commoners!

manualTranslations.zh: 若然，則秦之亡有以致之也。
manualTranslations.literal: If it was so, then Qin's perishing had causes that brought it about.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: If it was so, then Qin's fall had causes that brought it about.

manualTranslations.zh: 漢高承之以兵革，漢文守之以廉謹，卒不能蘇復大訓。
manualTranslations.literal: Emperor Gaozu of Han took it over by arms, and Emperor Wen guarded it with integrity and caution, yet in the end could not revive the great instruction.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Emperor Gaozu of Han took it over by arms, and Emperor Wen guarded it with integrity and caution, yet in the end could not revive the great instruction.

manualTranslations.zh: 是以景、武、昭、宣，天資甚美，才可以免禍亂；
manualTranslations.literal: Thus Jing, Wu, Zhao, and Xuan, with very fine natural endowments, were able by their talent to escape calamity and disorder;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Thus Emperors Jing, Wu, Zhao, and Xuan, with very fine natural endowments, were able by their talent to escape calamity and disorder;

manualTranslations.zh: 哀、平之間，則不能虞篡弒矣。
manualTranslations.literal: between Ai and Ping, they could not guard against usurpation and regicide.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: but between Emperors Ai and Ping, they could not guard against usurpation and regicide.

manualTranslations.zh: 然而惠帝廢易之際，猶賴羽翼以勝邪心。
manualTranslations.literal: Yet at the time when Emperor Hui was deposed and replaced, they still relied on supporting wings to overcome wicked hearts.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yet when Emperor Hui was deposed and replaced, they still relied on supporting ministers to overcome wicked hearts.

manualTranslations.zh: 是後有國之君，議教化者，莫不以興廉舉孝、設學崇儒為意，曾不知教化之不行，自貴始。
manualTranslations.literal: After this, rulers who possessed the state, when discussing instruction and transformation, all took promoting integrity and recommending filial piety, establishing schools and honoring Confucianism as their intent—yet they never knew that instruction and transformation did not prevail because it began with the honored.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After this, rulers who possessed the state, when discussing instruction and transformation, all took promoting integrity and recommending filial piety, establishing schools and honoring Confucianism as their intent—yet they never knew that instruction failed because it began with the honored rather than the humble.

manualTranslations.zh: 略其貴者，教其賤者，無乃鄰於倒置乎？
manualTranslations.literal: Neglecting the honored and instructing the lowly—is this not close to turning things upside down?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Neglecting the honored and instructing only the lowly—is this not close to turning things upside down?

manualTranslations.zh: 洎我太宗文皇帝之在籓邸，以至於為太子也，選知道德者十八人與之遊習。
manualTranslations.literal: Down to when our Emperor Taizong was in the princely residence, and up to when he became crown prince, he selected eighteen men who understood moral virtue to associate and study with him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When our Emperor Taizong was in the princely residence, and up to when he became crown prince, he selected eighteen men who understood moral virtue to associate and study with him.

manualTranslations.zh: 即位之後，雖遊宴飲食之間，若十八人者，實在其中。
manualTranslations.literal: After he ascended the throne, even amid feasting and dining, those eighteen men were truly among them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After he ascended the throne, even amid feasting and dining, those eighteen men were truly present.

manualTranslations.zh: 上失無不言，下情無不達。
manualTranslations.literal: Of the ruler's faults, none went unspoken; of sentiments below, none went unreached.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: None of the ruler's faults went unspoken; none of the sentiments below went unreached.

manualTranslations.zh: 不四三年而名高盛古，豈一日二日而致是乎？
manualTranslations.literal: In less than four or three years his fame rose above the ancients—could one or two days have brought this about?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In less than three or four years his fame rose above the ancients—could one or two days have brought this about?

manualTranslations.zh: 遊習之漸也！
manualTranslations.literal: It was the gradual effect of association and habit!
manualTranslations.idiomatic: It was the gradual effect of association and habit!

manualTranslations.zh: 貞觀已還，師傅皆宰相兼領，其餘宮僚，亦甚重焉。
manualTranslations.literal: From the Zhenguan era onward, teachers and tutors were all concurrently held by chancellors, and the other palace officials were also greatly honored.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From the Zhenguan era onward, teachers and tutors were all concurrently held by chancellors, and the other palace officials were also greatly honored.

manualTranslations.zh: 馬周以位高恨不得為司議郎，此其驗也。
manualTranslations.literal: Ma Zhou, because his rank was high, regretted that he could not be a director of deliberation—this is proof of it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Ma Zhou, because his rank was high, regretted that he could not serve as director of deliberation—this is proof of it.

manualTranslations.zh: 文皇之後，漸疏賤之。
manualTranslations.literal: After Emperor Taizong, they were gradually treated with distance and contempt.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Emperor Taizong, they were gradually treated with distance and contempt.

manualTranslations.zh: 用至母後臨朝，翦棄王室。
manualTranslations.literal: Their use reached the point where the empress dowager held court and the royal house was pruned and cast aside.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Matters reached the point where the empress dowager held court and the royal house was pruned and cast aside.

manualTranslations.zh: 當中、睿二聖勤勞之際，雖有骨鯁敢言之士，既不得在調護保安之職，終不能吐扶衛之一辭。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time when the two sage emperors Zhongzong and Ruizong labored diligently, though there were men of firm bone and gills who dared speak, since they could not hold posts of tending, protecting, and securing, in the end they could not utter a single word of support and defense.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the two sage emperors Zhongzong and Ruizong labored diligently, though there were outspoken men of firm principle, since they could not hold posts of tending, protecting, and securing the heir, in the end they could not utter a single word of support and defense.

manualTranslations.zh: 而令醫匠安金藏剖腹以明之，豈不大哀也耶？
manualTranslations.literal: Yet a physician-craftsman, An Jinzang, was made to cut open his belly to prove it—is this not great sorrow!
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yet the physician An Jinzang was made to cut open his belly to prove his loyalty—is this not great sorrow!

manualTranslations.zh: 兵興已來，茲弊尤甚。
manualTranslations.literal: Since military campaigns arose, this abuse has been especially severe.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Since military campaigns arose, this abuse has been especially severe.

manualTranslations.zh: 師資保傅之官，非疾廢眊聵不任事者為之，即休戎罷帥不知書者處之。
manualTranslations.literal: The offices of teacher, protector, and tutor were filled either by men who were sick, disabled, dim-sighted, and deaf and unfit for duties, or by retired soldiers and dismissed generals who did not know books.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The offices of teacher, protector, and tutor were filled either by men who were sick, disabled, dim-sighted, and deaf and unfit for duty, or by retired soldiers and dismissed generals who could not read.

manualTranslations.zh: 至於友諭贊議之徒，疏冗散賤之甚者，縉紳恥由之。
manualTranslations.literal: As for companions, advisers, and commentators, they were men so remote, superfluous, scattered, and base that the gentry were ashamed to come by such posts.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: As for companions, advisers, and commentators, they were men so remote, superfluous, scattered, and base that the gentry were ashamed to hold such posts.

manualTranslations.zh: 夫以匹士之愛其子者，猶求明哲慈惠之師以教之，直諒多聞之友以成之。
manualTranslations.literal: For a common scholar who loves his son, he still seeks a wise, clear, kind, and gracious teacher to instruct him and a straightforward, honest, and widely learned friend to complete him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: A common scholar who loves his son still seeks a wise, clear, kind, and gracious teacher to instruct him and a straightforward, honest, and widely learned friend to complete his formation.

manualTranslations.zh: 豈天下之元良，而可以疾廢眊聵不知書者為之師乎？
manualTranslations.literal: How can the heir apparent of all under Heaven have as his teacher one who is sick, disabled, dim-sighted, deaf, and does not know books?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: How can the heir apparent of all under Heaven have as his teacher one who is sick, disabled, dim-sighted, deaf, and illiterate?

manualTranslations.zh: 疏冗散賤不適用者為之友乎？
manualTranslations.literal: Have as his friends men who are remote, superfluous, scattered, base, and unfit for use?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Have as his friends men who are remote, superfluous, scattered, base, and unfit for use?

manualTranslations.zh: 此何不及上古之甚也！
manualTranslations.literal: How is this not far inferior to high antiquity!
manualTranslations.idiomatic: How is this not far inferior to high antiquity!

manualTranslations.zh: 近制，宮僚之外，往往以沈滯僻老之儒，充侍直、侍讀之選，而又疏棄斥逐之，越月逾時，不得召見，彼又安能傅成道德而保養其身躬哉？
manualTranslations.literal: Under recent regulations, apart from palace officials, sunken, stagnant, eccentric, and aged Confucians are often used to fill the selections for attendance duty and lecturing; yet they are also neglected, cast aside, and expelled—over months and beyond the proper time they are not summoned to audience. How can they tutor and complete moral virtue and nurture and preserve his person?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Under recent regulations, apart from palace officials, sunken, stagnant, eccentric, and aged Confucians are often used to fill the selections for attendance duty and lecturing; yet they are also neglected, cast aside, and expelled—for months on end they are not summoned to audience. How can they tutor moral virtue and nurture and preserve his person?

manualTranslations.zh: 臣以為積此弊者，豈不以皇天眷佑，祚我唐德，以舜繼堯，傳陛下十一聖矣，莫不生而神明，長而仁聖，以是為屑屑習儀者故不之省耳。
manualTranslations.literal: This subject believes that those who have accumulated this abuse surely do so because Heaven favors and protects, and the mandate rests on our Tang virtue; from Yao to Shun, down through Your Majesty's eleven sage emperors, none failed to be spiritually bright from birth and benevolent and sage in maturity—because of this they take it as mere petty ritual practice and do not examine it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This subject believes that those who have accumulated this abuse do so because Heaven favors and protects our Tang virtue; from Yao to Shun, down through Your Majesty's eleven sage emperors, none failed to be spiritually bright from birth and benevolent and sage in maturity—because of this they take it as mere petty ritual practice and do not examine it.

manualTranslations.zh: 臣獨以為於列聖之謀則可也，計傳後嗣則不可。
manualTranslations.literal: This subject alone believes that for the plans of the successive sage emperors it may suffice, but when calculating the transmission to later generations it will not do.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This subject alone believes that for the plans of the successive sage emperors it may suffice, but when calculating the transmission to later generations it will not do.

manualTranslations.zh: 脫或萬代之後，若有周成之中才，而又生於深宮優笑之間，無周、召保助之教，則將不能知喜怒哀樂之所自矣，況稼穡艱難乎？
manualTranslations.literal: If perchance ten thousand generations hence there should be one of King Cheng's middling talent, yet born amid the deep palace and jesters' laughter, without the instruction of the Duke of Zhou and Duke of Shao to protect and assist, then he will not be able to know whence joy, anger, sorrow, and delight come—how much less the hardships of planting and harvesting?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: If perchance ten thousand generations hence there should be one of King Cheng's middling talent, yet born amid the deep palace and jesters' laughter, without the instruction of the Duke of Zhou and Duke of Shao to protect and assist, then he will not know whence joy, anger, sorrow, and delight come—how much less the hardships of planting and harvesting?

manualTranslations.zh: 今陛下以上聖之資，肇臨海內，是天下之人傾耳註心之日。
manualTranslations.literal: Now Your Majesty, with the endowment of a supreme sage, has newly come to rule within the seas—this is the day when the people of all under Heaven incline their ears and fix their hearts.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Now Your Majesty, with the endowment of a supreme sage, has newly come to rule the realm—this is the day when the people of all under Heaven incline their ears and fix their hearts.

manualTranslations.zh: 特願陛下思成王訓導之功，念文皇遊習之漸，選重師保，慎擇宮僚，皆用博厚弘深之儒，而又明達機務者為之。
manualTranslations.literal: This subject especially wishes that Your Majesty reflect on King Cheng's achievement in instruction and guidance, recall Emperor Taizong's gradual effect of association and habit, select weighty teachers and protectors, carefully choose palace officials, and employ for them all broad, generous, vast, and profound Confucians who are also clear and penetrating in practical affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This subject especially wishes that Your Majesty reflect on King Cheng's achievement in instruction and guidance, recall Emperor Taizong's gradual effect of association and habit, select weighty teachers and protectors, carefully choose palace officials, and employ broad, generous, and profound Confucians who are also clear and penetrating in practical affairs.

manualTranslations.zh: 更相進見，日就月將。
manualTranslations.literal: Let them attend one another in audience, advancing day by day and month by month.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Let them attend in rotation, advancing day by day and month by month.

manualTranslations.zh: 因令皇太子聚諸生，定齒胄講業之儀，行嚴師問道之禮。
manualTranslations.literal: Thereby command the crown prince to gather the students, fix the ceremonies of ordering by age and cap for lecturing on studies, and perform the rites of a stern teacher inquiring into the Way.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Thereby command the crown prince to gather the students, fix the ceremonies of ordering by age and cap for lecturing on studies, and perform the rites of a stern teacher inquiring into the Way.

manualTranslations.zh: 至德要道以成之，徹膳記過以警之。
manualTranslations.literal: Use the utmost virtue and essential Way to complete him; withdraw meals and record faults to warn him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Use the utmost virtue and essential Way to complete him; withdraw meals and record faults to warn him.

manualTranslations.zh: 血氣未定，則去禽色之娛以就學；
manualTranslations.literal: While vital energies are not yet settled, remove the diversions of birds and sensual pleasures to attend to study;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: While vital energies are not yet settled, remove the diversions of birds and sensual pleasures to attend to study;

manualTranslations.zh: 聖質已備，則資遊習之善以弘德。
manualTranslations.literal: when sage substance is already complete, then draw on the goodness of association and habit to enlarge virtue.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: when sage substance is already complete, then draw on the goodness of association and habit to enlarge virtue.

manualTranslations.zh: 此所謂「一人元良，萬方以貞」之化也。
manualTranslations.literal: This is what is called the transformation of "one man as the chief good, the myriad regions thereby upright."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This is what is called the transformation of "one man as the chief good, the myriad regions thereby upright."

manualTranslations.zh: 豈直修廢學，選司成，而足倫匹其盛哉？
manualTranslations.literal: How can merely restoring abandoned schools and selecting a director of studies suffice to match its greatness?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: How can merely restoring abandoned schools and selecting a director of studies suffice to match its greatness?

manualTranslations.zh: 而又俾則百王，莫不幼同師，長同術，識君道之素定，知天倫之自然，然後選用賢良，樹為籓屏。
manualTranslations.literal: Moreover, make them models for the hundred kings, so that none fail to share teachers in youth and share methods in maturity, know that the ruler's Way is settled from the first, and know that heavenly relations are natural—then afterward select and employ the worthy and good and establish them as feudal screens.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Moreover, make them models for the hundred kings, so that none fail to share teachers in youth and share methods in maturity, know that the ruler's Way is settled from the first, and know that heavenly relations are natural—then afterward select and employ the worthy and good and establish them as feudal screens.

manualTranslations.zh: 出則有晉、鄭、魯、衛之盛，入則有東牟、硃虛之強，蓋所謂宗子維城、犬牙盤石之勢也，又豈與夫魏、晉以降，囚賤其兄弟而自翦其本枝者，同年而語哉？
manualTranslations.literal: Going forth there would be the splendor of Jin, Zheng, Lu, and Wei; coming in there would be the strength of Dongmou and Zhuxu—this is what is called the momentum of clansmen as walls and interlocking teeth like bedrock. How can it be spoken of in the same year as Wei and Jin onward, who imprisoned and debased their brothers and themselves pruned their own branches?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Going forth there would be the splendor of Jin, Zheng, Lu, and Wei; coming in there would be the strength of Dongmou and Zhuxu—this is what is called the momentum of clansmen as walls and interlocking teeth like bedrock. How can it be spoken of in the same breath as Wei and Jin onward, who imprisoned and debased their brothers and themselves pruned their own branches?

sourceRange.text: 長慶末，浙東觀察使元稹，為居易集序曰：樂天始未言，試指「之」、「無」字，能不誤。始既言，讀書勤敏，與他兒異。五六歲識聲韻，十五志辭賦，二十七舉進士。貞元末，進士尚馳競，不尚文，就中六籍尤擯落。禮部侍郎高郢始用經藝為進退，樂天一舉擢上第。明年，中拔萃甲科，由是《性習相近遠》、《玄珠》、《斬白蛇劍》等賦洎百節判，新進士競相傳於京師。會憲宗皇帝策召天下士，對詔稱旨，又登甲科。未幾，選入翰林，掌制誥。比比上書言得失，因為《賀雨詩》、《秦中吟》等數十章，指言天下事，時人比之《風》、《騷》焉。予始與樂天同秘書，前後多以詩章相贈答。予譴掾江陵，樂天猶在翰林，寄予百韻律體及雜體，前後數十詩。是後各佐江、通，復相酬寄。巴、蜀、江、楚間洎長安中少年，遞相仿效，競作新辭，自謂為元和詩。而樂天《秦中吟》、《賀雨》諷諭閑適等篇，時人罕能知者。然而二十年間，禁省觀寺、郵候墻壁之上無不書；王公妾婦、牛童馬走之口無不道。其繕寫模勒，炫賣於市井，或因之以交酒茗者，處處皆是。其甚有至盜竊名姓，茍求自售，雜亂間廁，無可奈何。予嘗於平水市中，見村校諸童，競習歌詠，召而問之，皆對曰：「先生教我樂天、微之詩。」固亦不知予為微之也。又雞林賈人求市頗切，自云：「本國宰相，每以一金換一篇，甚偽者，宰相輒能辨別之。」自篇章已來，未有如是流傳之廣者。長慶四年，樂天自杭州刺史以右庶子召還，予時刺會稽，因得盡征其文，手自排纘，成五十卷，凡二千二百五十一首。前輩多以前集、中集為名，予以為陛下明年當改元，長慶訖於是矣，因號《白氏長慶集》。大凡人之文各有所長，樂天長可以為多矣。夫諷諭之詩長於激，閑適之時長於遣，感傷之詩長於切，五字律詩百言而上長於贍，五字、七字百言而下長於情，賦贊箴誡之類長於當，碑記敘事制誥長於實，啟奏表狀長於直，書檄辭冊剖判長於盡。總而言之，不亦多乎哉！

localRange.text: 長慶末，浙東觀察使元稹，為居易集序曰：

context.beforeSource: 有文集七十五卷，《經史事類》三十卷，並行於世。
context.afterSource: 人以為稹序盡其能事。

manualTranslations.zh: 長慶末，浙東觀察使元稹，為居易集序曰：樂天始未言，試指「之」、「無」字，能不誤。
manualTranslations.literal: At the end of the Changqing era, Yuan Zhen, surveillance commissioner of Zhedong, wrote a preface to Juyi's collected works, which read: Juyi at first did not speak; when tested by pointing to the characters "zhi" and "wu," he could do so without error.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the end of the Changqing era, as surveillance commissioner of Zhedong, he wrote a preface to Juyi's collected works, which read: Juyi at first did not speak; when tested by pointing to the characters "zhi" and "wu," he could do so without error.

manualTranslations.zh: 始既言，讀書勤敏，與他兒異。
manualTranslations.literal: Once he began to speak, in reading he was diligent and quick, different from other children.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Once he began to speak, in reading he was diligent and quick, different from other children.

manualTranslations.zh: 五六歲識聲韻，十五志辭賦，二十七舉進士。
manualTranslations.literal: At five or six he knew tonal patterns; at fifteen he aspired to rhapsodies and fu; at twenty-seven he passed the presented scholar examination.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At five or six he knew tonal patterns; at fifteen he aspired to rhapsodies and fu; at twenty-seven he passed the presented scholar examination.

manualTranslations.zh: 貞元末，進士尚馳競，不尚文，就中六籍尤擯落。
manualTranslations.literal: At the end of Zhenyuan, presented scholars still valued rushing competition and did not value literature; among them the Six Classics were especially cast aside.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the end of Zhenyuan, presented scholars still valued rushing competition and did not value literature; among them the Six Classics were especially cast aside.

manualTranslations.zh: 禮部侍郎高郢始用經藝為進退，樂天一舉擢上第。
manualTranslations.literal: Vice Minister of Rites Gao Ying first used classical arts as the criterion for advancement and demotion; Juyi in one attempt was promoted to the top rank.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Vice Minister of Rites Gao Ying first used classical arts as the criterion for advancement and demotion; Juyi in one attempt was promoted to the top rank.

manualTranslations.zh: 明年，中拔萃甲科，由是《性習相近遠》、《玄珠》、《斬白蛇劍》等賦洎百節判，新進士競相傳於京師。
manualTranslations.literal: The next year he passed the selected outstanding first class; thereby his fu such as On Nature and Habit Near and Far, Mysterious Pearl, and Sword That Slew the White Serpent, together with a hundred-section judgment, were competitively transmitted among new presented scholars in the capital.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The next year he passed the selected outstanding first class; thereby his fu such as On Nature and Habit Near and Far, Mysterious Pearl, and Sword That Slew the White Serpent, together with a hundred-section judgment, were competitively transmitted among new presented scholars in the capital.

manualTranslations.zh: 會憲宗皇帝策召天下士，對詔稱旨，又登甲科。
manualTranslations.literal: It happened that Emperor Xianzong by examination summoned scholars of all under Heaven; his examination response matched the intent, and again he passed the top class.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: It happened that Emperor Xianzong by examination summoned scholars of all under Heaven; his examination response matched the intent, and again he passed the top class.

manualTranslations.zh: 未幾，選入翰林，掌制誥。
manualTranslations.literal: Before long he was selected into the Hanlin Academy to manage drafting of edicts.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Before long he was selected into the Hanlin Academy to manage drafting of edicts.

manualTranslations.zh: 比比上書言得失，因為《賀雨詩》、《秦中吟》等數十章，指言天下事，時人比之《風》、《騷》焉。
manualTranslations.literal: Repeatedly he submitted memorials speaking of gains and losses; thereby he composed several tens of chapters such as Ode Congratulating Rain and Chants of Qin, pointing out affairs under Heaven—men of the time compared them to the Airs and Elegies.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Repeatedly he submitted memorials speaking of gains and losses; thereby he composed several tens of chapters such as Ode Congratulating Rain and Chants of Qin, pointing out affairs under Heaven—men of the time compared them to the Airs and Elegies.

manualTranslations.zh: 予始與樂天同秘書，前後多以詩章相贈答。
manualTranslations.literal: I first served together with Juyi in the Secretariat; before and after we often exchanged poems as gifts and replies.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I first served together with Juyi in the Secretariat; before and after we often exchanged poems as gifts and replies.

manualTranslations.zh: 予譴掾江陵，樂天猶在翰林，寄予百韻律體及雜體，前後數十詩。
manualTranslations.literal: When I was banished to aide in Jiangling, Juyi was still in the Hanlin Academy and sent me regulated verse of a hundred rhymes and mixed forms—several tens of poems before and after.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When I was banished to aide in Jiangling, Juyi was still in the Hanlin Academy and sent me regulated verse of a hundred rhymes and mixed forms—several tens of poems before and after.

manualTranslations.zh: 是後各佐江、通，復相酬寄。
manualTranslations.literal: After this we each assisted Jiang and Tong and again exchanged poems in reply.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After this we each served in Jiangling and Tong Prefecture and again exchanged poems in reply.

manualTranslations.zh: 巴、蜀、江、楚間洎長安中少年，遞相仿效，競作新辭，自謂為元和詩。
manualTranslations.literal: Among Ba, Shu, Jiang, and Chu, down to the youths of Chang'an, they successively imitated one another, competing to compose new lyrics, calling themselves Yuanhe poetry.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Among Ba, Shu, Jiang, and Chu, down to the youths of Chang'an, they successively imitated one another, competing to compose new lyrics, calling themselves Yuanhe poetry.

manualTranslations.zh: 而樂天《秦中吟》、《賀雨》諷諭閑適等篇，時人罕能知者。
manualTranslations.literal: Yet Juyi's Chants of Qin, Ode Congratulating Rain, admonitory, leisurely, and other pieces were rarely known by men of the time.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yet Juyi's Chants of Qin, Ode Congratulating Rain, admonitory, leisurely, and other pieces were rarely known by men of the time.

manualTranslations.zh: 然而二十年間，禁省觀寺、郵候墻壁之上無不書；
manualTranslations.literal: Yet within twenty years, on the walls of the forbidden offices, temples, and postal stations, there was none not written;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yet within twenty years, on the walls of the forbidden offices, temples, and postal stations, there was none not written;

manualTranslations.zh: 王公妾婦、牛童馬走之口無不道。
manualTranslations.literal: in the mouths of kings, dukes, concubines, ox boys, and horse runners, there was none who did not speak of them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: in the mouths of kings, dukes, concubines, ox boys, and horse runners, there was none who did not speak of them.

manualTranslations.zh: 其繕寫模勒，炫賣於市井，或因之以交酒茗者，處處皆是。
manualTranslations.literal: Their copying and carving, flaunted and sold in the market streets, or used to exchange wine and tea—everywhere it was so.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Their copying and carving, flaunted and sold in the market streets, or used to exchange wine and tea—everywhere it was so.

manualTranslations.zh: 其甚有至盜竊名姓，茍求自售，雜亂間廁，無可奈何。
manualTranslations.literal: In the extreme there were even those who stole names and surnames, seeking by any means to sell themselves, jumbled among privies—with nothing to be done.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the extreme there were even those who stole names and surnames, seeking by any means to sell themselves, jumbled among privies—with nothing to be done.

manualTranslations.zh: 予嘗於平水市中，見村校諸童，競習歌詠，召而問之，皆對曰：「先生教我樂天、微之詩。」
manualTranslations.literal: I once in Pingshui market saw village school children competing to practice songs and chants; I summoned and asked them, and all replied: "The teacher teaches us the poems of Juyi and Zhen."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I once in Pingshui market saw village schoolchildren competing to practice songs and chants; I summoned and asked them, and all replied: "The teacher teaches us the poems of Juyi and Zhen."

manualTranslations.zh: 固亦不知予為微之也。
manualTranslations.literal: They indeed also did not know that I was Zhen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They did not even know that I was Zhen.

manualTranslations.zh: 又雞林賈人求市頗切，自云：「本國宰相，每以一金換一篇，甚偽者，宰相輒能辨別之。」
manualTranslations.literal: Again merchants of Goguryeo sought to buy with great urgency and said themselves: "Our country's chancellor exchanges one piece of gold for each piece; even very false ones, the chancellor can at once distinguish them."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Again merchants of Goguryeo sought to buy with great urgency and said: "Our country's chancellor exchanges one piece of gold for each piece; even very false ones, the chancellor can at once distinguish them."

manualTranslations.zh: 自篇章已來，未有如是流傳之廣者。
manualTranslations.literal: Since writings and chapters began, there has never been such wide circulation.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Since writings and chapters began, there has never been such wide circulation.

manualTranslations.zh: 長慶四年，樂天自杭州刺史以右庶子召還，予時刺會稽，因得盡征其文，手自排纘，成五十卷，凡二千二百五十一首。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year of Changqing, Juyi was recalled from Hangzhou prefect to right vice director of the crown prince's household; I was then prefect of Kuaiji and thereby was able to gather all his writings, personally arranging and compiling them into fifty scrolls, altogether two thousand two hundred fifty-one pieces.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Changqing, Juyi was recalled from Hangzhou prefect to right vice director of the crown prince's household; I was then prefect of Kuaiji and thereby was able to gather all his writings, personally arranging and compiling them into fifty scrolls, altogether two thousand two hundred fifty-one pieces.

manualTranslations.zh: 前輩多以前集、中集為名，予以為陛下明年當改元，長慶訖於是矣，因號《白氏長慶集》。
manualTranslations.literal: Former generations mostly named them former collection and middle collection; I believed Your Majesty next year would change the era name and Changqing would end at this point, and therefore titled it Collected Works of Bai of Changqing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Former generations mostly named them former collection and middle collection; I believed Your Majesty next year would change the era name and Changqing would end at this point, and therefore titled it Collected Works of Bai of Changqing.

manualTranslations.zh: 大凡人之文各有所長，樂天長可以為多矣。
manualTranslations.literal: Generally speaking, each man's writings has what it excels in; Juyi's excellence can be said to be many.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Generally speaking, each man's writings has what it excels in; Juyi's excellences can be said to be many.

manualTranslations.zh: 夫諷諭之詩長於激，閑適之時長於遣，感傷之詩長於切，五字律詩百言而上長於贍，五字、七字百言而下長於情，賦贊箴誡之類長於當，碑記敘事制誥長於實，啟奏表狀長於直，書檄辭冊剖判長於盡。
manualTranslations.literal: Admonitory poems excel in stirring; leisurely pieces excel in releasing; sentimental poems excel in cutting close; five-character regulated verse of more than a hundred words excels in fullness; five- and seven-character verse of less than a hundred words excels in feeling; fu, encomia, admonitions, and warnings excel in fitness; steles, records, narratives, and drafted edicts excel in substance; memorials, reports, and petitions excel in directness; letters, proclamations, documents, and judgments excel in completeness.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Admonitory poems excel in stirring; leisurely pieces excel in releasing; sentimental poems excel in cutting close; five-character regulated verse of more than a hundred words excels in fullness; five- and seven-character verse of less than a hundred words excels in feeling; fu, encomia, admonitions, and warnings excel in fitness; steles, records, narratives, and drafted edicts excel in substance; memorials, reports, and petitions excel in directness; letters, proclamations, documents, and judgments excel in completeness.

manualTranslations.zh: 總而言之，不亦多乎哉！
manualTranslations.literal: Speaking of them in sum, are they not also many!
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Speaking of them in sum, are they not also many!

sourceRange.text: 稹至同州，因表謝上，自敘曰：臣稹辜負聖明，辱累恩獎，便合自求死所，豈謂尚忝官榮？臣稹死罪。臣八歲喪父，家貧無業。母兄乞丐以供資養。衣不布體，食不充腸。幼學之年，不蒙師訓。因感鄰裏兒稚有父兄為開學校，涕咽發憤，願知《詩》、《書》。慈母哀臣，親為教授。年十有五，得明經出身，由是苦心為文，夙夜強學。年二十四，登吏部乙科，授校書郎。年二十八，蒙制舉首選，授左拾遺。始自為學，至於升朝，無朋友為臣吹噓，無親戚為臣援庇。莫非苦己，實不因人，獨立性成，遂無交結。任拾遺日，屢陳時政，蒙先皇帝召問於延英。旋為宰相所憎，出臣河南縣尉。及為監察御史，又不規避，專心糾繩，復為宰相怒臣下庇親黨，因以他事貶臣江陵判司。廢棄十年，分死溝瀆。元和十四年，憲宗皇帝開釋有罪，始授臣膳部員外郎。與臣同省署者，多是臣登朝時舉人；任卿相者，半是臣同諫院時拾遺、補闕。愚臣既不料陛下天聽過卑，知臣薄藝，硃書授臣制誥，延英召臣賜緋。宰相惡臣不出其門，由是百萬侵毀。陛下察臣無罪，寵獎逾深，召臣固授舍人，遣充承旨翰林學士，金章紫服，光飾陋軀，人生之榮，臣亦至矣。然臣益遭誹謗，日夜憂危。唯陛下聖鑒昭臨，彌加保任，竟排群議，擢授臺司。臣忝有肺肝，豈並尋常宰相？況當行營退散之後，牛元翼未出之間，每聞陛下軫念之言，愚臣恨不身先士卒。所問於方計策，遣王友明等救解深州，蓋欲上副聖情，豈是別懷他意？不料奸人疑臣殺害裴度，妄有告論，塵瀆聖聰，愧羞天地。臣本待辨明一了，便擬殺身謝責，豈料聖慈尚加，薄貶同州。雖違咫尺之間，不遠郊圻之境，伏料必是宸衷獨斷，乞臣此官。若遣他人商量，乍可與臣遠處方鎮，豈肯遣臣俯近闕廷？所恨今月三日，尚蒙召對延英。此時不解泣血，仰辭天顏，乃至今日竄逐。臣自離京國，目斷魂銷。每至五更朝謁之時，實制淚不已。臣若餘生未死，他時萬一歸還，不敢更望得見天顏，但得再聞京城鐘鼓之音，臣雖黃土覆面，無恨九泉。臣無任自恨自慚，攀戀聖慈之至。

localRange.text: 稹至同州，因表謝上，自敘曰：

context.beforeSource: 上怒，罰遵古，遣中人撫諭稹。
context.afterSource: 在郡二年，改授越州刺史、兼御史大夫、漸東觀察使。
context.beforeLocal: 上怒，罰遵古，遣中人撫諭稹。
context.afterLocal: 在郡二年，改授越州刺史、兼御史大夫、漸東觀察使。

manualTranslations.zh: 稹至同州，因表謝上，自敘曰：臣稹辜負聖明，辱累恩獎，便合自求死所，豈謂尚忝官榮？
manualTranslations.literal: When Zhen reached Tongzhou he submitted a memorial of thanks to the throne, with a self-account that read: This subject Zhen has failed the sage clarity, disgraced and burdened by favor and reward; he ought to seek his own place of death—how can he say he still undeservedly holds office and honor?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On reaching Tongzhou he submitted a memorial of thanks to the throne, with a self-account that read: This subject Zhen has failed Your sage clarity, disgraced and burdened by favor and reward; I ought to seek my own place of death—how can I say I still undeservedly hold office and honor?

manualTranslations.zh: 臣稹死罪。
manualTranslations.literal: This subject Zhen deserves death.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This subject Zhen deserves death.

manualTranslations.zh: 臣八歲喪父，家貧無業。
manualTranslations.literal: This subject lost his father at eight; the family was poor and without livelihood.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This subject lost his father at eight; the family was poor and without livelihood.

manualTranslations.zh: 母兄乞丐以供資養。
manualTranslations.literal: Mother and elder brother begged to supply sustenance.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Mother and elder brother begged to supply sustenance.

manualTranslations.zh: 衣不布體，食不充腸。
manualTranslations.literal: Clothes did not cover the body; food did not fill the belly.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Clothes did not cover the body; food did not fill the belly.

manualTranslations.zh: 幼學之年，不蒙師訓。
manualTranslations.literal: In the years of early study, I did not receive a teacher's instruction.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the years of early study, I did not receive a teacher's instruction.

manualTranslations.zh: 因感鄰裏兒稚有父兄為開學校，涕咽發憤，願知《詩》、《書》。
manualTranslations.literal: Because I was moved that neighborhood children had fathers and elder brothers who opened schools, I wept and choked with indignation and wished to know the Poetry and Documents.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because I was moved that neighborhood children had fathers and elder brothers who opened schools, I wept and choked with indignation and wished to know the Poetry and Documents.

manualTranslations.zh: 慈母哀臣，親為教授。
manualTranslations.literal: My kind mother pitied this subject and personally taught him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: My kind mother pitied me and personally taught me.

manualTranslations.zh: 年十有五，得明經出身，由是苦心為文，夙夜強學。
manualTranslations.literal: At fifteen I obtained entry by the classics examination; from this I labored at writing with bitter effort and studied strenuously morning and night.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At fifteen I obtained entry by the classics examination; from this I labored at writing with bitter effort and studied strenuously morning and night.

manualTranslations.zh: 年二十四，登吏部乙科，授校書郎。
manualTranslations.literal: At twenty-four I passed the Ministry of Personnel second class and was appointed collator.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At twenty-four I passed the Ministry of Personnel second class and was appointed collator.

manualTranslations.zh: 年二十八，蒙制舉首選，授左拾遺。
manualTranslations.literal: At twenty-eight I was honored with first selection in the special examination and was appointed left remonstrance official.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At twenty-eight I was honored with first selection in the special examination and was appointed left remonstrance official.

manualTranslations.zh: 始自為學，至於升朝，無朋友為臣吹噓，無親戚為臣援庇。
manualTranslations.literal: From first pursuing study to ascending court, there were no friends to puff up this subject, no kinsmen to shield and protect this subject.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From first pursuing study to ascending court, there were no friends to puff me up, no kinsmen to shield and protect me.

manualTranslations.zh: 莫非苦己，實不因人，獨立性成，遂無交結。
manualTranslations.literal: All was through bitter effort on myself; truly not through others. Independent character was formed, and thus there were no associations.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: All was through bitter effort on myself; truly not through others. Independent character was formed, and thus I had no associations.

manualTranslations.zh: 任拾遺日，屢陳時政，蒙先皇帝召問於延英。
manualTranslations.literal: During my days as remonstrance official I repeatedly set forth current government affairs and was honored by the late emperor with summons and inquiry in Yanying.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During my days as remonstrance official I repeatedly set forth current government affairs and was honored by the late emperor with summons and inquiry in Yanying.

manualTranslations.zh: 旋為宰相所憎，出臣河南縣尉。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon I was hated by the chancellor and this subject was sent out as marshal of Henan County.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon I was hated by the chancellor and was sent out as marshal of Henan County.

manualTranslations.zh: 及為監察御史，又不規避，專心糾繩，復為宰相怒臣下庇親黨，因以他事貶臣江陵判司。
manualTranslations.literal: When I became investigating censor, again I did not evade or avoid but devoted my heart to impeachment and discipline. Again the chancellor was angry that this subject's subordinates sheltered kin and partisans, and on another matter demoted this subject to aide in Jiangling.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When I became investigating censor, again I did not evade or avoid but devoted my heart to impeachment and discipline. Again the chancellor was angry that my subordinates sheltered kin and partisans, and on another matter demoted me to aide in Jiangling.

manualTranslations.zh: 廢棄十年，分死溝瀆。
manualTranslations.literal: Abandoned for ten years, I allotted myself to die in ditch and drain.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Abandoned for ten years, I allotted myself to die in ditch and drain.

manualTranslations.zh: 元和十四年，憲宗皇帝開釋有罪，始授臣膳部員外郎。
manualTranslations.literal: In Yuanhe 14, Emperor Xianzong opened release for the guilty and first appointed this subject vice director of the Board of Appointments.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Yuanhe 14, Emperor Xianzong opened release for the guilty and first appointed me vice director of the Board of Appointments.

manualTranslations.zh: 與臣同省署者，多是臣登朝時舉人；
manualTranslations.literal: Those in the same ministry office with this subject were mostly men this subject had recommended when ascending court;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Those in the same ministry office with me were mostly men I had recommended when ascending court;

manualTranslations.zh: 任卿相者，半是臣同諫院時拾遺、補闕。
manualTranslations.literal: those holding posts as ministers and chancellors were half remonstrance and supplementation officials from this subject's days in the remonstrance courtyard.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: those holding posts as ministers and chancellors were half remonstrance and supplementation officials from my days in the remonstrance courtyard.

manualTranslations.zh: 愚臣既不料陛下天聽過卑，知臣薄藝，硃書授臣制誥，延英召臣賜緋。
manualTranslations.literal: This foolish subject had not expected that Your Majesty's heavenly hearing was excessively low, knowing this subject's slight arts—vermilion writing appointed this subject to draft edicts, and Yanying summoned this subject to bestow crimson robes.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This foolish subject had not expected that Your Majesty's heavenly hearing was excessively humble, knowing my slight arts—vermilion writing appointed me to draft edicts, and Yanying summoned me to bestow crimson robes.

manualTranslations.zh: 宰相惡臣不出其門，由是百萬侵毀。
manualTranslations.literal: The chancellor hated that this subject did not come from his gate; thereby a hundred slanders invaded and destroyed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The chancellor hated that I did not come from his gate; thereby a hundred slanders invaded and destroyed.

manualTranslations.zh: 陛下察臣無罪，寵獎逾深，召臣固授舍人，遣充承旨翰林學士，金章紫服，光飾陋軀，人生之榮，臣亦至矣。
manualTranslations.literal: Your Majesty examined this subject and found no guilt; favor and reward exceeded the deep. This subject was summoned and firmly appointed palace aide, dispatched to serve as drafting Hanlin academician; golden seal and purple robes adorned my humble body—the glory of human life, this subject also reached its utmost.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Your Majesty examined me and found no guilt; favor and reward exceeded the deep. I was summoned and firmly appointed palace aide, dispatched to serve as drafting Hanlin academician; golden seal and purple robes adorned my humble body—the glory of human life, I also reached its utmost.

manualTranslations.zh: 然臣益遭誹謗，日夜憂危。
manualTranslations.literal: Yet this subject increasingly suffered slander and day and night worried over peril.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yet I increasingly suffered slander and day and night worried over peril.

manualTranslations.zh: 唯陛下聖鑒昭臨，彌加保任，竟排群議，擢授臺司。
manualTranslations.literal: Only Your Majesty's sage mirror brightly oversaw, increasingly added protection and trust, and in the end set aside the multitude of opinions and promoted me to the censorate.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Only Your Majesty's sage mirror brightly oversaw, increasingly added protection and trust, and in the end set aside the multitude of opinions and promoted me to the censorate.

manualTranslations.zh: 臣忝有肺肝，豈並尋常宰相？
manualTranslations.literal: This subject undeservedly possessed heart and liver—how could he be ranked with ordinary chancellors?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This subject undeservedly possessed heart and liver—how could I be ranked with ordinary chancellors?

manualTranslations.zh: 況當行營退散之後，牛元翼未出之間，每聞陛下軫念之言，愚臣恨不身先士卒。
manualTranslations.literal: Moreover, when the campaign forces had withdrawn and dispersed, and Niu Yuanji had not yet emerged, each time I heard Your Majesty's words of anxious concern, this foolish subject regretted that he was not first among the soldiers.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Moreover, when the campaign forces had withdrawn and dispersed, and Niu Yuanji had not yet emerged, each time I heard Your Majesty's words of anxious concern, this foolish subject regretted that I was not first among the soldiers.

manualTranslations.zh: 所問於方計策，遣王友明等救解深州，蓋欲上副聖情，豈是別懷他意？
manualTranslations.literal: What was asked about in plans and stratagems—dispatching Wang Youming and others to rescue and relieve Shen Prefecture—was surely to match above the sage sentiment; how could it be harboring another intent?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: What was asked about in plans and stratagems—dispatching Wang Youming and others to rescue and relieve Shen Prefecture—was surely to match Your sage sentiment; how could it be harboring another intent?

manualTranslations.zh: 不料奸人疑臣殺害裴度，妄有告論，塵瀆聖聰，愧羞天地。
manualTranslations.literal: I did not expect that wicked men suspected this subject of murdering Pei Du and falsely made accusations, dusting and defiling the sage hearing—shame before Heaven and Earth.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I did not expect that wicked men suspected me of murdering Pei Du and falsely made accusations, dusting and defiling Your sage hearing—shame before Heaven and Earth.

manualTranslations.zh: 臣本待辨明一了，便擬殺身謝責，豈料聖慈尚加，薄貶同州。
manualTranslations.literal: This subject originally waited to clarify the matter completely and then planned to kill his body to answer the blame—who expected that sage compassion still added favor, lightly demoting me to Tong Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This subject originally waited to clarify the matter completely and then planned to give my life to answer the blame—who expected that Your sage compassion still added favor, lightly demoting me to Tong Prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 雖違咫尺之間，不遠郊圻之境，伏料必是宸衷獨斷，乞臣此官。
manualTranslations.literal: Though separated by less than a foot's distance, not far from the suburban domain, I humbly reckon it must be the imperial heart's sole decision, granting this subject this office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Though separated by less than a foot's distance, not far from the suburban domain, I humbly reckon it must be Your imperial heart's sole decision, granting me this office.

manualTranslations.zh: 若遣他人商量，乍可與臣遠處方鎮，豈肯遣臣俯近闕廷？
manualTranslations.literal: If others had been sent to deliberate, they might for a time send this subject to a distant frontier command—but would they be willing to send this subject bowing near the court gate?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: If others had been sent to deliberate, they might for a time send me to a distant frontier command—but would they be willing to send me bowing near the court gate?

manualTranslations.zh: 所恨今月三日，尚蒙召對延英。
manualTranslations.literal: What I regret is that on the third day of this month I still received summons for audience in Yanying.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: What I regret is that on the third day of this month I still received summons for audience in Yanying.

manualTranslations.zh: 此時不解泣血，仰辭天顏，乃至今日竄逐。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time I did not understand to weep blood and look up to decline the heavenly countenance, and thus reached today's banishment and expulsion.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At that time I did not understand to weep blood and look up to decline Your countenance, and thus reached today's banishment and expulsion.

manualTranslations.zh: 臣自離京國，目斷魂銷。
manualTranslations.literal: Since this subject left the capital, eyes are severed and soul is broken.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Since I left the capital, my sight is severed and my soul is broken.

manualTranslations.zh: 每至五更朝謁之時，實制淚不已。
manualTranslations.literal: Each time the fifth watch arrives for court audience, I truly restrain tears without end.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Each time the fifth watch arrives for court audience, I truly restrain tears without end.

manualTranslations.zh: 臣若餘生未死，他時萬一歸還，不敢更望得見天顏，但得再聞京城鐘鼓之音，臣雖黃土覆面，無恨九泉。
manualTranslations.literal: If this subject's remaining life is not yet ended and someday by chance I return, I dare not hope again to see the heavenly countenance—only to hear once more the capital's bells and drums; though yellow earth covers my face, I would have no regret in the nine springs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: If my remaining life is not yet ended and someday by chance I return, I dare not hope again to see Your countenance—only to hear once more the capital's bells and drums; though yellow earth covers my face, I would have no regret in the grave.

manualTranslations.zh: 臣無任自恨自慚，攀戀聖慈之至。
manualTranslations.literal: This subject cannot bear self-reproach and self-shame, clinging in longing to the utmost sage compassion.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This subject cannot bear self-reproach and self-shame, clinging in longing to Your utmost sage compassion.

sourceRange.text: 」稹因獻其文，自敘曰：稹初不好文，徒以仕無他歧，強由科試。及有罪譴棄之後，自以為廢滯潦倒，不復為文字有聞於人矣。曾不知好事者抉擿芻蕪，塵瀆尊重。竊承相公特於廊廟間道稹詩句，昨又面奉教約，令獻舊文。戰汗悚踴，慚靦無地。稹自御史府謫官，於今十餘年矣。閑誕無事，遂專力於詩章。日益月滋，有詩句千餘首。其間感物寓意，可備矇瞽之風者有之。辭直氣粗，罪尤是懼，固不敢陳露於人。唯杯酒光景間，屢為小碎篇章，以自吟暢。然以為律體卑痹，格力不揚，茍無姿態，則陷流俗。常欲得思深語近，韻律調新，屬對無差，而風情宛然，而病未能也。江湖間多新進小生，不知天下文有宗主，妄相放效，而又從而失之，遂至於支離褊淺之辭，皆目為元和詩體。稹與同門生白居易友善。居易雅能詩，就中愛驅駕文字，窮極聲韻，或為千言，或五百言律詩，以相投寄。小生自審不能過之，往往戲排舊韻，別創新辭，名為次韻相酬，蓋欲以難相排。自爾江湖間為詩者，復相放效，力或不足，則至於顛倒語言，重復首尾，韻同意等，不異前篇，亦目為元和詩體。而司文者考變雅之由，往往歸咎於稹。嘗以為雕蟲小事，不足以自明。始聞相公記憶，累旬已來，實慮糞土之墻，庇之以大廈，使不復破壞，永為板築者之誤。輒寫古體歌詩一百首，百韻至兩韻律詩一百首，為五卷，奉啟跪陳。或希構廈之餘，一賜觀覽，知小生於章句中欒櫨榱桷之材，盡曾量度，則十餘年之邅回，不為無用矣。

localRange.text: 稹因獻其文，自敘曰：

context.beforeSource: 請出其所有，以豁予情。
context.afterSource: 楚深稱賞，以為今代之鮑、謝也。
context.beforeLocal: 請出其所有，以豁予情。
context.afterLocal: 楚深稱賞，以為今代之鮑、謝也。

manualTranslations.zh: 」稹因獻其文，自敘曰：稹初不好文，徒以仕無他歧，強由科試。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhen thereupon presented his writings, with a preface that read: Zhen at first did not love literature; he merely had no other path in office and was forced through the examination.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhen accordingly presented his collected writings, prefaced with an autobiographical note that read: At first I did not love literature; I merely had no other path in office and was forced through the civil service examination.

manualTranslations.zh: 及有罪譴棄之後，自以為廢滯潦倒，不復為文字有聞於人矣。
manualTranslations.literal: After being condemned and cast aside for guilt, I considered myself discarded, stagnant, and down and out, and no longer expected my writings to become known among men.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After being condemned and cast aside for guilt, I considered myself discarded, stagnant, and ruined, and no longer expected my writings to become known among men.

manualTranslations.zh: 曾不知好事者抉擿芻蕪，塵瀆尊重。
manualTranslations.literal: I never knew that lovers of the matter would pick out the fodder and weeds and defile what is honored with dust.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I never imagined that enthusiasts would pick out the fodder and weeds and defile what is honored.

manualTranslations.zh: 竊承相公特於廊廟間道稹詩句，昨又面奉教約，令獻舊文。
manualTranslations.literal: I have privately heard that the Chief Minister especially spoke of Zhen's poetic lines in the halls of state; yesterday I again received face to face his instruction and command to present old writings.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I have privately heard that the Chief Minister especially spoke of my poetic lines in the halls of state; yesterday I again received his face-to-face instruction to present my old writings.

manualTranslations.zh: 戰汗悚踴，慚靦無地。
manualTranslations.literal: Trembling with sweat, startled and leaping, ashamed beyond measure.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Trembling with sweat, startled and overwhelmed, I am ashamed beyond measure.

manualTranslations.zh: 稹自御史府謫官，於今十餘年矣。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhen, since demotion from the Censorate, has now been more than ten years.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Since my demotion from the Censorate, more than ten years have now passed.

manualTranslations.zh: 閑誕無事，遂專力於詩章。
manualTranslations.literal: Leisurely and at ease with nothing to do, I then devoted my strength to poetic compositions.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Leisurely and at ease with nothing to do, I then devoted myself to poetry.

manualTranslations.zh: 日益月滋，有詩句千餘首。
manualTranslations.literal: Day by day and month by month they increased; there are more than a thousand poetic lines.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Day by day and month by month they increased; I have more than a thousand poems.

manualTranslations.zh: 其間感物寓意，可備矇瞽之風者有之。
manualTranslations.literal: Among them are some that respond to things and convey meaning, fit to supply the style of instruction for the blind.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Among them are some that respond to things and convey meaning, fit to supply instruction for the unenlightened.

manualTranslations.zh: 辭直氣粗，罪尤是懼，固不敢陳露於人。
manualTranslations.literal: The wording is blunt and the tone rough; guilt is what I especially fear, so I truly do not dare to display them before others.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The wording is blunt and the tone rough; guilt is what I especially fear, so I truly do not dare display them before others.

manualTranslations.zh: 唯杯酒光景間，屢為小碎篇章，以自吟暢。
manualTranslations.literal: Only amid the light of wine and cups have I often made small fragmentary compositions to chant and enjoy for myself.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Only amid wine and cups have I often made small fragmentary pieces to chant for my own enjoyment.

manualTranslations.zh: 然以為律體卑痹，格力不揚，茍無姿態，則陷流俗。
manualTranslations.literal: Yet I consider regulated verse base and cramped, its force and style not uplifted; if without manner and bearing, then it falls into vulgar fashion.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yet I consider regulated verse base and cramped, its force and style not uplifted; without manner and bearing it falls into vulgar fashion.

manualTranslations.zh: 常欲得思深語近，韻律調新，屬對無差，而風情宛然，而病未能也。
manualTranslations.literal: I constantly wished to attain thought deep and language near, rhyme and measure tuned anew, parallel couplets without flaw, and feeling and style gracefully present—but the ailment I have not yet been able to overcome.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I constantly wished to attain deep thought and plain language, fresh rhyme and measure, flawless parallel couplets, and graceful feeling and style—but I have not yet overcome this failing.

manualTranslations.zh: 江湖間多新進小生，不知天下文有宗主，妄相放效，而又從而失之，遂至於支離褊淺之辭，皆目為元和詩體。
manualTranslations.literal: Along the rivers and lakes there are many newly advanced young men who do not know that literature under Heaven has a master; they recklessly imitate one another, and moreover lose their way in doing so, until fragmentary and narrow shallow phrasing all is called the Yuanhe poetic style.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Along the rivers and lakes there are many newly advanced young men who do not know that literature has a master; they recklessly imitate one another and lose their way, until fragmentary, narrow, shallow phrasing is all called the Yuanhe poetic style.

manualTranslations.zh: 稹與同門生白居易友善。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhen was on friendly terms with his fellow student Bai Juyi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I was on friendly terms with my fellow student Bai Juyi.

manualTranslations.zh: 居易雅能詩，就中愛驅駕文字，窮極聲韻，或為千言，或五百言律詩，以相投寄。
manualTranslations.literal: Juyi is elegantly skilled in poetry; among his works he especially loves driving and mastering words, exhausting sound and rhyme; sometimes thousand-character or five-hundred-character regulated poems he sends to exchange with me.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Juyi is elegantly skilled in poetry; among his works he especially loves mastering words and exhausting sound and rhyme; sometimes he sends me thousand-character or five-hundred-character regulated poems in exchange.

manualTranslations.zh: 小生自審不能過之，往往戲排舊韻，別創新辭，名為次韻相酬，蓋欲以難相排。
manualTranslations.literal: This humble student, examining myself, could not surpass him; I often playfully arranged old rhymes and separately created new wording, calling it matching rhymes in mutual response—intending to use difficulty to compete.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Examining myself, I could not surpass him; I often playfully arranged old rhymes and created new wording, calling it matching rhymes in mutual response—intending to compete through difficulty.

manualTranslations.zh: 自爾江湖間為詩者，復相放效，力或不足，則至於顛倒語言，重復首尾，韻同意等，不異前篇，亦目為元和詩體。
manualTranslations.literal: From then on, poets along the rivers and lakes again imitated one another; when strength was sometimes insufficient, it reached the point of inverted language, repeated beginnings and ends, rhymes and meaning the same, no different from the previous piece—this too was called the Yuanhe poetic style.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From then on, poets along the rivers and lakes again imitated one another; when their strength was insufficient, it reached inverted language, repeated beginnings and ends, identical rhymes and meaning no different from the previous piece—this too was called the Yuanhe poetic style.

manualTranslations.zh: 而司文者考變雅之由，往往歸咎於稹。
manualTranslations.literal: Yet those who oversee literature, examining the causes of the change in refined style, often lay blame on Zhen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yet those who oversee literature, examining the causes of the change in refined style, often lay blame on me.

manualTranslations.zh: 嘗以為雕蟲小事，不足以自明。
manualTranslations.literal: I once considered it a trifling matter of carving insects, insufficient to clarify myself.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I once considered it a trifling matter of literary ornament, insufficient to clarify myself.

manualTranslations.zh: 始聞相公記憶，累旬已來，實慮糞土之墻，庇之以大廈，使不復破壞，永為板築者之誤。
manualTranslations.literal: When I first heard that the Chief Minister remembered me, for many days now I have truly feared that a wall of dung and earth would be sheltered by a great hall so that it would no longer be broken—forever becoming the error of those who lay boards and build.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When I first heard that the Chief Minister remembered me, for many days I have truly feared that a wall of dung and earth would be sheltered by a great hall so it would no longer crumble—forever becoming the error of those who lay boards and build.

manualTranslations.zh: 輒寫古體歌詩一百首，百韻至兩韻律詩一百首，為五卷，奉啟跪陳。
manualTranslations.literal: I have hastily copied one hundred old-style songs and poems and one hundred regulated poems from hundred rhymes down to two rhymes, making five scrolls, which I respectfully present kneeling.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I have copied one hundred old-style songs and poems and one hundred regulated poems from hundred rhymes down to two rhymes, making five scrolls, which I respectfully present on my knees.

manualTranslations.zh: 或希構廈之餘，一賜觀覽，知小生於章句中欒櫨榱桷之材，盡曾量度，則十餘年之邅回，不為無用矣。
manualTranslations.literal: Perhaps hoping that after the great hall is built you might once bestow a reading, knowing that this humble student's timber for rafters and ridgepoles within lines and stanzas has all been measured—then more than ten years of wandering will not have been without use.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Perhaps, after the great hall is built, you might once grant a reading and know that this humble student's rafter and ridgepole timber within lines and stanzas has all been measured—then more than ten years of wandering will not have been in vain.

sourceRange.text: 居易既以尹正罷歸，每獨酌賦詠於舟中，因為《池上篇》曰：東都風土水木之勝在東南偏，東南之勝在履道里，裏之勝在西北隅，西闬北垣第一第，即白氏叟樂天退老之地。地方十七畝，屋室三之一，水五之一，竹九之一，而島樹橋道間之。初樂天既為主，喜且曰：「雖有池臺，無粟不能守也」，乃作池東粟廩。又曰：「雖有子弟，無書不能訓也。」乃作池北書庫。又曰：「雖有賓朋，無琴酒不能娛也」，乃作池西琴亭，加石樽焉。樂天罷杭州刺史，得天竺石一、華亭鶴二以歸。始作西平橋，開環池路。罷蘇州刺史時，得太湖石五、白蓮、折腰菱、青板舫以歸，又作中高橋，通三島逕。罷刑部侍郎時，有粟千斛，書一車，洎臧獲之習管磬弦歌者指百以歸。先是潁川陳孝仙與釀酒法，味甚佳；博陵崔晦叔與琴，韻甚清；蜀客姜發授《秋思》，聲甚淡；弘農楊貞一與青石三，方長平滑，可以坐臥。太和三年夏，樂天始得請為太子賓客，分秩於洛下，息躬於池上。凡三任所得，四人所與，洎吾不才身，今率為池中物。每至池風春，池月秋，水香蓮開之旦，露清鶴唳之夕，拂楊石，舉陳酒，援崔琴，彈《秋思》，頹然自適，不知其他。酒酣琴罷，又命樂童登中島亭，含奏《霓裳散序》，聲隨風飄，或凝或散，悠揚於竹煙波月之際者久之。曲未竟，而樂天陶然石上矣。睡起偶詠，非詩非賦，阿龜握筆，因題石間。視其粗成韻章，命為《池上篇》云：十畝之宅，五畝之園，有水一池，有竹千竿。勿謂土狹，勿謂地偏，足以容膝，足以息肩。有堂有亭，有橋有船，有書有酒，有歌有弦。有叟在中，白須颯然，識分知足，外無求焉。如鳥擇木，姑務巢安；如蛙作坎，不知海寬。靈鵲怪石，紫菱白蓮，皆吾所好，盡在我前。時引一杯，或吟一篇。妻孥熙熙，雞犬閑閑。優哉遊哉，吾將老乎其間。

localRange.text: 居易既以尹正罷歸，每獨酌賦詠於舟中，因為《池上篇》曰：

context.beforeSource: 家妓樊素、蠻子者，能歌善舞。
context.afterSource: 又效陶潛《五柳先生傳》，作《醉吟先生傳》以自況。

context.afterLocal: 又效陶潛《五柳先生傳》，作《醉吟先生傳》以自況。
