manualTranslations.literal: He also circulated a proclamation throughout the realm, saying: Zheng Tian, Military Commissioner of Fengxiang and Longyou, Acting Minister of the Left, Co-Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery, Supreme Commander of the Western Capital Circuit Expeditionary Forces, Supreme Pillar of State, Duke of Xingyang with a fief of two thousand households, issued a dispatch to all frontier commands, prefectures and counties, marquises and earls, prefects and magistrates, and officers and clerks, saying: Prosperity and adversity have their allotted measure; fortune and misfortune follow in succession, like the eclipse and waning of sun and moon, like the excess and concealment of yin and yang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He also circulated a proclamation throughout the realm, saying: Zheng Tian, Military Commissioner of Fengxiang and Longyou, Acting Minister of the Left, Co-Grand Councilor, Supreme Commander of the Western Capital Circuit Expeditionary Forces, Supreme Pillar of State, and Duke of Xingyang with a fief of two thousand households, issued a dispatch to all frontier commands, prefectures and counties, marquises and earls, prefects and magistrates, and military officers, saying: Prosperity and adversity have their allotted measure; fortune and misfortune follow in succession, like the eclipse and waning of sun and moon, like the excess and concealment of yin and yang.

manualTranslations.zh: 是以漢朝方盛，則莽、卓肆其奸兇；
manualTranslations.literal: Thus when the Han dynasty was flourishing, Wang Mang and Dong Zhuo unleashed their treachery and violence;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Thus when the Han dynasty was at its height, Wang Mang and Dong Zhuo unleashed their treachery and violence;

manualTranslations.zh: 夏道未衰，而羿、浞騁其殘酷。
manualTranslations.literal: when the way of Xia had not yet declined, Yi and Zhuo rode forth their cruelty.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: when the way of Xia had not yet declined, Yi and Zhuo rode forth their cruelty.

manualTranslations.zh: 不無僭越，尋亦誅夷。
manualTranslations.literal: There was never a lack of usurpation, yet soon they too were executed and exterminated.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Usurpation was never absent, yet soon they too were executed and destroyed.

manualTranslations.zh: 即知妖孽之生，古今難免。
manualTranslations.literal: From this one knows that the birth of evil spirits is hard to avoid in past and present.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From this one knows that the rise of evil spirits is hard to avoid in any age.

manualTranslations.zh: 代有忠貞之士，力為匡復之謀。
manualTranslations.literal: In every age there are loyal and steadfast men who strive with plans to restore and rectify.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In every age there are loyal and steadfast men who strive to restore and rectify the realm.

manualTranslations.zh: 我國家應五運以承乾，躡三王之垂統，綿區飲化，匝宇歸仁。
manualTranslations.literal: Our state, responding to the Five Movements to receive Heaven's mandate, treading in the transmitted line of the Three Kings, has spread transformation across the realm and drawn all within the four seas to benevolence.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Our state, responding to the Five Movements to receive Heaven's mandate and treading in the line of the Three Kings, has spread civilization across the realm and drawn all within the four seas to benevolence.

manualTranslations.zh: 十八帝之鴻猷，銘於神鼎；
manualTranslations.literal: The great designs of eighteen emperors are inscribed upon the sacred tripod;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The great designs of eighteen emperors are inscribed upon the sacred tripod;

manualTranslations.zh: 三百年之睿澤，播在人謠。
manualTranslations.literal: three hundred years of sagely grace are spread in the songs of the people.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: three hundred years of sagely grace are spread in the songs of the people.

manualTranslations.zh: 加以政尚寬弘，刑無枉濫，翼翼勤行於王道，孜孜務恤於生靈。
manualTranslations.literal: Moreover, government has prized leniency and magnanimity, punishments have been without wrongful excess, diligently practicing the kingly way, tirelessly seeking to comfort the living people.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Moreover, government has prized leniency and magnanimity, punishments have been without wrongful excess, diligently practicing the kingly way and tirelessly seeking to comfort the people.

manualTranslations.zh: 足可傳寶祚於無窮，禦瑤圖於不朽。
manualTranslations.literal: Truly it could transmit the imperial succession to endless ages and guard the jade chart unto immortality.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Truly it could transmit the imperial succession through endless ages and guard the jade chart unto immortality.

manualTranslations.zh: 近歲螟蝗作害，旱延災，因令無賴之徒，遽起亂常之暴。
manualTranslations.literal: In recent years locusts wrought harm and drought spread disaster, causing worthless fellows to rise suddenly in lawless violence.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In recent years locusts wrought harm and drought spread disaster, causing worthless fellows to rise suddenly in lawless violence.

manualTranslations.zh: 雖加討逐，猶肆猖狂。
manualTranslations.literal: Though pursuit and suppression were added, they still ran rampant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Though pursuit and suppression were ordered, they still ran rampant.

manualTranslations.zh: 草賊黃巢，奴仆下才，豺狼醜類。
manualTranslations.literal: The grass-bandit Huang Chao, a menial of base talent, an ugly breed of wolf and jackal.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The grass-bandit Huang Chao, a menial of base talent, an ugly breed of wolf and jackal.

manualTranslations.zh: 寒耕熱耨，不勵力於田疇；
manualTranslations.literal: In cold he did not plow, in heat he did not weed — he did not exert himself in the fields;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In cold he did not plow, in heat he did not weed — he did not exert himself in the fields;

manualTranslations.zh: 媮食靡衣，務偷生於剽奪。
manualTranslations.literal: he stole food and went without clothes, seeking only to live by plunder.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: he stole food and went without clothes, seeking only to live by plunder.

manualTranslations.zh: 結連兇黨，驅迫平人，始擾害於里閭，遂侵淩於郡邑。
manualTranslations.literal: He joined with vicious factions, drove and pressed ordinary people, first disturbing and harming in villages and lanes, then invading and oppressing prefectures and counties.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He joined with vicious factions, drove and pressed ordinary people, first disturbing villages and lanes, then invading and oppressing prefectures and counties.

manualTranslations.zh: 屬以籓臣不武，戎士貪財，徒加討逐之名，竟作遷延之役。
manualTranslations.literal: Because frontier ministers were not martial and soldiers were greedy for wealth, the name of pursuit and suppression was merely added, yet in the end it became a protracted campaign.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because frontier ministers were not martial and soldiers were greedy for wealth, pursuit and suppression were only in name, and in the end the campaign became protracted.

manualTranslations.zh: 致令滋蔓，累有邀求。
manualTranslations.literal: This caused the evil to spread and multiply, with repeated demands and exactions.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This caused the evil to spread and multiply, with repeated demands and exactions.

manualTranslations.zh: 聖上愛育情深，含弘道廣，指萬方而罪己，用百姓以為心。
manualTranslations.literal: The sage sovereign's love and nurture run deep, his forbearance and magnanimity are broad; he blamed himself before all regions and took the common people as his heart.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The sage sovereign's love and nurture run deep, his forbearance and magnanimity are broad; he blamed himself before all regions and took the common people as his heart.

manualTranslations.zh: 假以節旄，委之籓鎮，冀其悛革，免困疲羸。
manualTranslations.literal: He lent them banners of command and entrusted them to frontier commands, hoping they would reform, to spare the weary and weak.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He lent them banners of command and entrusted them to frontier commands, hoping they would reform and spare the weary and weak.

manualTranslations.zh: 而殊無犬馬之誠，但恣蟲蛇之毒。
manualTranslations.literal: Yet they showed not the least loyalty of hound or horse, but only indulged the poison of insects and serpents.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yet they showed not the least loyalty of hound or horse, but only indulged the poison of insects and serpents.

manualTranslations.zh: 剽掠我征鎮，覆沒我京都，淩辱我衣冠，屠殘我士庶。
manualTranslations.literal: They plundered our expeditionary commands, overthrew our capital, humiliated our officials and gentry, and slaughtered our scholars and commoners.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They plundered our expeditionary commands, overthrew our capital, humiliated our officials and gentry, and slaughtered our scholars and commoners.

manualTranslations.zh: 視人命有同於草芥，謂大寶易取如弈棋。
manualTranslations.literal: They regarded human lives as no different from grass and husks, and said the great treasure was as easy to seize as a game of chess.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They regarded human lives as no different from grass and husks, and said the great treasure was as easy to seize as a game of chess.

manualTranslations.zh: 而乃竊據宮闈，偽稱名號。
manualTranslations.literal: Then they usurped the palace quarters and falsely assumed titles.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Then they usurped the palace quarters and falsely assumed titles.

manualTranslations.zh: 爛羊頭而拜爵，續狗尾以命官。
manualTranslations.literal: They ennobled men for boiled sheep heads and appointed officials by stringing dog tails.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They ennobled men for boiled sheep heads and appointed officials by stringing dog tails.

manualTranslations.zh: 燕巢幕以誇安，魚在鼎而猶戲。
manualTranslations.literal: Like swallows nesting on a curtain they boasted of security; like fish still sporting in the cauldron.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Like swallows nesting on a curtain they boasted of security; like fish still sporting in the cauldron.

manualTranslations.zh: 殊不知五侯拗怒，期分項羽之屍；
manualTranslations.literal: They little knew that when the Five Marquises twisted in rage, they would expect to divide the corpse of Xiang Yu;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They little knew that when the Five Marquises twisted in rage, they would expect to divide the corpse of Xiang Yu;

manualTranslations.zh: 四冢既成，待葬蚩尤之骨。
manualTranslations.literal: when the Four Mounds were completed, they would await burying the bones of Chiyou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: when the Four Mounds were completed, they would await burying the bones of Chiyou.

manualTranslations.zh: 猶復廣侵田宅，濫瀆貨財，比溪壑以難盈，類烏鳶而縱攫。
manualTranslations.literal: Still they broadly seized fields and houses, wantonly defiled goods and wealth, like streams and ravines impossible to fill, like kites and crows let loose to snatch.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Still they broadly seized fields and houses, wantonly defiled goods and wealth, like streams and ravines impossible to fill, like kites and crows let loose to snatch.

manualTranslations.zh: 茫茫赤縣，僅同夷貊之鄉；
manualTranslations.literal: Across the vast Red County, it was scarcely different from the lands of barbarians;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Across the vast Red County, it was scarcely different from the lands of barbarians;

manualTranslations.zh: 惴惴黔黎，若在狴牢之內。
manualTranslations.literal: the trembling common people were as if within a prison.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: the trembling common people were as if within a prison.

manualTranslations.zh: 固已人神共怒，行路傷心。
manualTranslations.literal: Already men and spirits alike were enraged, and travelers on the road were heartsick.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Already men and spirits alike were enraged, and travelers on the road were heartsick.

manualTranslations.zh: 畋謬領籓垣，榮兼將相，每枕戈而待旦，常泣血以忘餐；
manualTranslations.literal: Tian wrongly holds frontier command, honored with both general and minister — each night he sleeps upon his spear awaiting dawn, often weeping blood and forgetting his meal;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tian wrongly holds frontier command, honored with both general and minister — each night he sleeps upon his spear awaiting dawn, often weeping blood and forgetting his meal;

manualTranslations.zh: 誓與義士忠臣，共翦狐鳴狗盜。
manualTranslations.literal: he vows with righteous men and loyal ministers jointly to cut down fox-calling, dog-stealing bandits.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: he vows with righteous men and loyal ministers jointly to cut down fox-calling, dog-stealing bandits.

manualTranslations.zh: 近承詔命，會合諸軍。
manualTranslations.literal: Recently he received imperial orders to assemble all armies.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Recently he received imperial orders to assemble all armies.

manualTranslations.zh: 皇帝親禦六師，即離三蜀；
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor personally leads the Six Armies, having just departed the Three Shu;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor personally leads the Six Armies, having just departed the Three Shu;

manualTranslations.zh: 霜戈萬隊，鐵馬千群；
manualTranslations.literal: frost-bright spears in ten thousand ranks, iron horses in a thousand hosts;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: frost-bright spears in ten thousand ranks, iron horses in a thousand hosts;

manualTranslations.zh: 雕虎嘯以風生，應龍驤而雲起。
manualTranslations.literal: carved tigers roar and the wind rises, responding dragons prance and clouds ascend.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: carved tigers roar and the wind rises, responding dragons prance and clouds ascend.

manualTranslations.zh: 淮南高相公，會關東諸道百萬雄師，計以夏初，會於關內。
manualTranslations.literal: The Excellency Gao of Huainan will assemble a million stalwart troops from the eastern circuits, planning to meet within the passes at the beginning of summer.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Excellency Gao of Huainan will assemble a million stalwart troops from the eastern circuits, planning to meet within the passes at the beginning of summer.

manualTranslations.zh: 畋與涇原節度使程宗楚、秦州節度使仇公遇等，已驅組練，大集關畿；
manualTranslations.literal: Tian, together with Cheng Zongchu, Military Commissioner of Jingyuan, Qiu Gongyu, Military Commissioner of Qinzhou, and others, have already driven their drilled troops and greatly gathered within the passes;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tian, together with Cheng Zongchu, Military Commissioner of Jingyuan, Qiu Gongyu, Military Commissioner of Qinzhou, and others, have already driven their drilled troops and greatly gathered within the passes;

manualTranslations.zh: 爭麾隴右之蛇矛，待掃關中之蟻聚。
manualTranslations.literal: eagerly brandishing the serpent spears of Longyou, awaiting to sweep the ant swarms of Guanzhong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: eagerly brandishing the serpent spears of Longyou, awaiting to sweep the ant swarms of Guanzhong.

manualTranslations.zh: 而吐蕃、党項以久被皇化，深憤國讎，願以沙漠之軍，共獻蕩平之捷。
manualTranslations.literal: Meanwhile the Tibetans and Tanguts, long subject to imperial civilization, deeply resent the national enemy and wish to offer the armies of the desert to present together the triumph of total pacification.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Meanwhile the Tibetans and Tanguts, long subject to imperial civilization, deeply resent the national enemy and wish to offer the armies of the desert to present together the triumph of total pacification.

manualTranslations.zh: 此際華戎合勢，籓鎮連衡，旌旗煥爛於雲霞，劍戟晶熒於霜雪。
manualTranslations.literal: At this moment Chinese and barbarian combine their strength, frontier commands link in alliance; banners blaze brilliant as cloud and mist, swords and halberds gleam like frost and snow.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At this moment Chinese and barbarian combine their strength, frontier commands link in alliance; banners blaze brilliant as cloud and mist, swords and halberds gleam like frost and snow.

manualTranslations.zh: 莫不持繩待試，賈勇爭先；
manualTranslations.literal: None fail to hold the cord awaiting the test, selling their courage to vie for the fore;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: None fail to hold the cord awaiting the test, selling their courage to vie for the fore;

manualTranslations.zh: 思垂竹帛之功，誓雪朝廷之恥。
manualTranslations.literal: thinking to leave achievements upon bamboo and silk, vowing to wash away the court's shame.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: thinking to leave achievements upon bamboo and silk, vowing to wash away the court's shame.

manualTranslations.zh: 矧茲殘孽，不足殄除。
manualTranslations.literal: How much more so this remnant evil — it is not enough to merit extermination.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: How much more so this remnant evil — it is scarcely worth the effort of extermination.

manualTranslations.zh: 況諸道世受國恩，身縻好爵，皆貯匡邦之略，鹹傾致主之誠。
manualTranslations.literal: Moreover, all circuits for generations have received the state's grace, their persons bound to fine ranks; all store strategies to restore the state and pour forth devotion to the sovereign.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Moreover, all circuits for generations have received the state's grace, their persons bound to fine ranks; all store strategies to restore the state and pour forth devotion to the sovereign.

manualTranslations.zh: 自函、洛構氛，鑾輿避狄，莫不指銅駝而皆裂，望玉壘以魂銷。
manualTranslations.literal: Since trouble arose at Hangu and Luoyang and the imperial carriage fled the barbarians, none have failed to point at the bronze camel and rend their hearts, or gaze toward Yumen and feel their souls dissolve.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Since trouble arose at Hangu and Luoyang and the imperial carriage fled the barbarians, none have failed to point at the bronze camel and rend their hearts, or gaze toward Yumen and feel their souls dissolve.

manualTranslations.zh: 聞此勤王，固宜投袂。
manualTranslations.literal: Hearing this call to aid the sovereign, it is fitting indeed to fling aside one's sleeves.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Hearing this call to aid the sovereign, it is fitting indeed to fling aside one's sleeves.

manualTranslations.zh: 更希憤激，速殄寇讎。
manualTranslations.literal: Further we hope for indignant zeal to speedily exterminate the bandit enemy.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Further we hope for indignant zeal to speedily exterminate the bandit enemy.

manualTranslations.zh: 永圖社稷之勛，以報君親之德，迎鑾反正，豈不休哉。
manualTranslations.literal: Ever seek merit for altars of state, to repay the virtue of sovereign and parent; welcome the carriage's return and restoration of order — would this not be glorious?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Ever seek merit for altars of state, to repay the virtue of sovereign and parent; welcome the carriage's return and restoration of order — would this not be glorious?

sourceRange.text: 至是，茂貞思畋獎待之恩，上表論之曰：臣伏見當道故檢校司空、同平章事鄭畋，瑞應星精，祥開月角；建洪爐於聖代，成庶績於明昌。鳳毛方浴於春池，龍節忽移於右輔。旋以群鴟嘯聚，萬蝟鋒攢，蒼黃而玉輅省方，次第而金門徹鑰。九州相望，初猶豫以從風；百辟無歸，半狐疑而委質。而畋沖冠怒發，投袂治兵；羅劍戟於樽前，練貔貅於閫外。坎牲誓眾，釁鼓出師；馳羽檄於四方，暢皇威於萬里。身維地軸，決橫流而盡入東溟；手正天關，掃妖星而重尊北極。及至囊沙減竈，伐鼓揚旌；四兇方侈於獸心，一陣盡塗於龍尾。大振建瓴之捷，只於反掌之間。不期天柱朝摧，將星夜隕；竹帛徒書於茂烈，松楸未煥於易名。臣始仕從戎，爰承指顧，稟三令五申之戒，預一匡九合之謀。今則謬以微功，獲居重鎮。尋武侯之遺愛，城壘宛然；念叔子之高蹤，涕零何極？伏冀特加贈謚，以慰泉扃。

localRange.text: 至是，茂貞思畋獎待之恩，上表論之曰：

manualTranslations.zh: 至是，茂貞思畋獎待之恩，上表論之曰：臣伏見當道故檢校司空、同平章事鄭畋，瑞應星精，祥開月角；
manualTranslations.literal: At this time, Maozhen, mindful of Tian's favor and treatment, submitted a memorial discussing him, saying: Your servant respectfully observes the former Acting Minister of Works and Co-Grand Councilor Zheng Tian of this circuit — an auspicious response of stellar essence, good omens opening at the moon's horn;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At this time, Maozhen, mindful of Tian's favor and treatment, submitted a memorial discussing him, saying: Your servant respectfully observes the former Acting Minister of Works and Co-Grand Councilor Zheng Tian of this circuit — an auspicious response of stellar essence, good omens opening at the moon's horn;

manualTranslations.zh: 建洪爐於聖代，成庶績於明昌。
manualTranslations.literal: He raised a great furnace in the sage age and accomplished many achievements in bright prosperity.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He raised a great furnace in the sage age and accomplished many achievements in bright prosperity.

manualTranslations.zh: 鳳毛方浴於春池，龍節忽移於右輔。
manualTranslations.literal: Phoenix down had just bathed in the spring pool when the dragon tally suddenly shifted to the right assistant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Phoenix down had just bathed in the spring pool when the dragon tally suddenly shifted to the right assistant.

manualTranslations.zh: 旋以群鴟嘯聚，萬蝟鋒攢，蒼黃而玉輅省方，次第而金門徹鑰。
manualTranslations.literal: Then owls gathered in screaming flocks and ten thousand hedgehogs massed their points; in haste the jade carriage toured the regions, and in succession the golden gate was unbarred.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Then owls gathered in screaming flocks and ten thousand hedgehogs massed their points; in haste the jade carriage toured the regions, and in succession the golden gate was unbarred.

manualTranslations.zh: 九州相望，初猶豫以從風；
manualTranslations.literal: The nine regions looked to one another, at first hesitating to follow the wind;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The nine regions looked to one another, at first hesitating to follow the wind;

manualTranslations.zh: 百辟無歸，半狐疑而委質。
manualTranslations.literal: the hundred ministers had nowhere to turn, half in doubt yet submitting their allegiance.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: the hundred ministers had nowhere to turn, half in doubt yet submitting their allegiance.

manualTranslations.zh: 而畋沖冠怒發，投袂治兵；
manualTranslations.literal: Yet Tian, cap-strings flying in rage, flung his sleeves and marshaled troops;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yet Tian, cap-strings flying in rage, flung his sleeves and marshaled troops;

manualTranslations.zh: 羅劍戟於樽前，練貔貅於閫外。
manualTranslations.literal: he arrayed swords and halberds before the wine cup and drilled fierce troops beyond the command post.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: he arrayed swords and halberds before the wine cup and drilled fierce troops beyond the command post.

manualTranslations.zh: 坎牲誓眾，釁鼓出師；
manualTranslations.literal: He cut sacrificial victims to swear the host and beat the blood-stained drum to march forth;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He cut sacrificial victims to swear the host and beat the blood-stained drum to march forth;

manualTranslations.zh: 馳羽檄於四方，暢皇威於萬里。
manualTranslations.literal: he galloped feathered dispatches to the four quarters and spread imperial majesty for ten thousand li.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: he galloped feathered dispatches to the four quarters and spread imperial majesty for ten thousand li.

manualTranslations.zh: 身維地軸，決橫流而盡入東溟；
manualTranslations.literal: His person upheld the earth's axis; he decided the crosscurrent and sent it all into the eastern sea;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His person upheld the earth's axis; he decided the crosscurrent and sent it all into the eastern sea;

manualTranslations.zh: 手正天關，掃妖星而重尊北極。
manualTranslations.literal: his hand rectified the heavenly gate, swept away the evil star and again honored the Northern Pole.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: his hand rectified the heavenly gate, swept away the evil star and again honored the Northern Pole.

manualTranslations.zh: 及至囊沙減竈，伐鼓揚旌；
manualTranslations.literal: When it came to filling sacks with sand and reducing cooking stoves, beating drums and raising banners;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When it came to filling sacks with sand and reducing cooking stoves, beating drums and raising banners;

manualTranslations.zh: 四兇方侈於獸心，一陣盡塗於龍尾。
manualTranslations.literal: the Four Evils were just swelling in beastly hearts, and one battle array was entirely smeared at Dragon Tail.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: the Four Evils were just swelling in beastly hearts, and one battle array was entirely smeared at Dragon Tail.

manualTranslations.zh: 大振建瓴之捷，只於反掌之間。
manualTranslations.literal: A great triumph like tipping the jar from on high was achieved in the turn of a hand.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: A great triumph like tipping the jar from on high was achieved in the turn of a hand.

manualTranslations.zh: 不期天柱朝摧，將星夜隕；
manualTranslations.literal: Unexpectedly the pillar of heaven was shattered at dawn, the general's star fell by night;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Unexpectedly the pillar of heaven was shattered at dawn, the general's star fell by night;

manualTranslations.zh: 竹帛徒書於茂烈，松楸未煥於易名。
manualTranslations.literal: bamboo and silk merely record his flourishing merit, yet pines and cypresses have not been brightened by a changed posthumous name.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: bamboo and silk merely record his flourishing merit, yet pines and cypresses have not been brightened by a changed posthumous name.

manualTranslations.zh: 臣始仕從戎，爰承指顧，稟三令五申之戒，預一匡九合之謀。
manualTranslations.literal: Your servant began his career in the army and received his guidance, bearing the admonitions given thrice and five times, taking part in the plan of one restoration and nine unifications.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Your servant began his career in the army and received his guidance, bearing the admonitions given thrice and five times, taking part in the plan of one restoration and nine unifications.

manualTranslations.zh: 今則謬以微功，獲居重鎮。
manualTranslations.literal: Now by mistake for slight merit I have obtained a great command.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Now by mistake for slight merit I have obtained a great command.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋武侯之遺愛，城壘宛然；
manualTranslations.literal: Seeking the lingering love of Marquis Wu, the walls and ramparts stand as before;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Seeking the lingering love of Marquis Wu, the walls and ramparts stand as before;

manualTranslations.zh: 念叔子之高蹤，涕零何極？
manualTranslations.literal: recalling the lofty traces of Unclezi, how boundless are the falling tears?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: recalling the lofty traces of Unclezi, how boundless are the falling tears?

manualTranslations.zh: 伏冀特加贈謚，以慰泉扃。
manualTranslations.literal: I humbly hope he may be specially granted posthumous honors to comfort his spirit beneath the gate.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I humbly hope he may be specially granted posthumous honors to comfort his spirit beneath the gate.

sourceRange.text: 蔚上疏諫曰：臣聞孔丘，聖者也，言則引周任之言；苻融，賢者也，諫必稱王猛之議。誠以事求師古，詞貴達情。陛下自纘帝圖，克崇佛事，止當修外，未甚得中。臣略采本朝名臣啟奏之言，以證奉佛初終之要。天後時，曾營大像，功費百萬，狄仁傑諫曰：「夫寶鉸殫於綴飾，瑰材竭於輪奐。功不使鬼，必在役人；物不天來，皆從地出；非苦百姓，物何以求？物生有時，用之無度；臣每思惟，實所悲痛。至如往在江表，像法盛興；梁武、簡文，施舍無限。及乎三淮沸浪，五嶺騰煙，列剎盈衢，無救危亡之禍；緇衣蔽路，豈益勤王之師？況近年以來，風塵屢擾；水旱失節，征役稍繁。必若多費官財，又苦人力，一隅有難，將何以救？」此切當之言一也。中宗時，公主外戚，奏度僧尼，姚崇諫曰：「佛不在外，求之於心。佛圖澄最賢，無益於後趙；羅什多藝，不救於姚秦。何充、苻融，皆遭敗滅；齊襄、梁武，未免災殃。但誌發慈悲，心行利益，若蒼生安樂，即是佛身。」此切當之言二也。睿宗為金仙、玉真二公主造二道宮，辛替否諫曰：「自夏以來，淫雨不解，谷荒於壟，麥爛於場。入秋以來，亢旱為災，苗而不實，霜損蟲暴，草菜枯黃；下人咨嗟，未加賑貸。陛下愛兩女而造兩觀，燒瓦運木，載土填沙。道路流言，皆云用錢百萬。陛下聖人也，遠無不知；陛下明君也，細無不見！既知且見，知倉有幾年之儲？庫有幾年之帛？知百姓之間可存活乎？三邊之士可轉輸乎？今發一卒扞以邊陲，追一兵以衛社稷，多無衣食，皆帶饑寒；賞賜之間，迥無所出。軍旅驟敗，莫不由斯。而陛下破百萬貫錢，造不急之觀，以賈六合之怨，以違萬人之心。」此切當之言三也。替否又諫造寺曰：「釋教以清凈為基，慈悲為主。常體道以濟物，不利己而害人。每去己以全真，不營身以害教。今三時之月，築山穿池，損命也；殫府虛藏，損人也；廣殿長廊，營身也。損命，則不慈悲，損人，則不濟物，營身，則不清凈。豈大聖至神之心乎？佛書曰：『一切有為法，如夢幻泡影，如露亦如電。』臣以為減雕琢之費以賑貧人，是有如來之德；息穿掘之苦以全昆蟲，是有如來之仁；罷營葺之直以給邊陲，是有湯武之功；回不急之祿以購清廉，是有唐虞之治。陛下緩其所急，急其所緩；親未來而疏見在，失真實而冀虛無。重俗人之所為，輕天子之功業，臣實痛之！」此切當之言四也。臣觀仁傑，天後時上公也；姚崇，開元時賢相也；替否，睿宗之直臣也。臣每覽斯言，未嘗不廢卷而太息，痛其言之不行也。伏以陛下深重緇流，妙崇佛事，其為樂善，實邁前蹤。但細詳時代之安危，渺鑒昔賢之敷奏，則思過半矣，道遠乎哉！臣過忝渥恩，言虧匡諫，但舉從繩之義，少裨負扆之明。營繕之間，稍宜停減。

manualTranslations.zh: 蔚上疏諫曰：臣聞孔丘，聖者也，言則引周任之言；
manualTranslations.literal: Wei submitted a memorial remonstrating, saying: Your servant has heard that Confucius, being a sage, in speaking would cite the words of Zhou Ren;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wei submitted a memorial of remonstrance, saying: Your servant has heard that Confucius, being a sage, in speaking would cite the words of Zhou Ren;

manualTranslations.zh: 苻融，賢者也，諫必稱王猛之議。
manualTranslations.literal: Fu Rong, being a worthy man, in remonstrance would always invoke the counsel of Wang Meng.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Fu Rong, being a worthy man, in remonstrance would always invoke the counsel of Wang Meng.

manualTranslations.zh: 誠以事求師古，詞貴達情。
manualTranslations.literal: Truly, in affairs one seeks teachers from antiquity; in words one values conveying the true feeling.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Truly, in affairs one seeks teachers from antiquity; in words one values conveying the true feeling.

manualTranslations.zh: 陛下自纘帝圖，克崇佛事，止當修外，未甚得中。
manualTranslations.literal: Your Majesty, since inheriting the imperial design, has been able to exalt Buddhist affairs, yet should cultivate only the outward aspect — not quite hitting the center.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Your Majesty, since inheriting the imperial design, has been able to exalt Buddhist affairs, yet should cultivate only the outward aspect — not quite hitting the center.

manualTranslations.zh: 臣略采本朝名臣啟奏之言，以證奉佛初終之要。
manualTranslations.literal: Your servant has briefly gathered the memorial words of eminent ministers of this dynasty to demonstrate the essentials of honoring Buddhism from beginning to end.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Your servant has briefly gathered the memorial words of eminent ministers of this dynasty to demonstrate the essentials of honoring Buddhism from beginning to end.

manualTranslations.zh: 天後時，曾營大像，功費百萬，狄仁傑諫曰：「夫寶鉸殫於綴飾，瑰材竭於輪奐。
manualTranslations.literal: In the time of the Empress, a great image was once built at a cost of a million in labor and expense. Di Renjie remonstrated, saying: "Precious fittings are exhausted in ornamentation, rare materials depleted in carved splendor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the time of the Empress, a great image was once built at a cost of a million in labor and expense. Di Renjie remonstrated, saying: "Precious fittings are exhausted in ornamentation, rare materials depleted in carved splendor.

manualTranslations.zh: 功不使鬼，必在役人；
manualTranslations.literal: Work is not done by ghosts — it must employ men;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Work is not done by ghosts — it must employ men;

manualTranslations.zh: 物不天來，皆從地出；
manualTranslations.literal: materials do not come from Heaven — all emerge from the earth;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: materials do not come from Heaven — all emerge from the earth;

manualTranslations.zh: 非苦百姓，物何以求？
manualTranslations.literal: if the common people are not made to suffer, how can materials be obtained?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: if the common people are not made to suffer, how can materials be obtained?

manualTranslations.zh: 物生有時，用之無度；
manualTranslations.literal: Things are produced in their seasons, yet used without measure;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Things are produced in their seasons, yet used without measure;

manualTranslations.zh: 臣每思惟，實所悲痛。
manualTranslations.literal: your servant reflects on this each time and is truly grieved.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: your servant reflects on this each time and is truly grieved.

manualTranslations.zh: 至如往在江表，像法盛興；
manualTranslations.literal: As for the past south of the Yangzi, when image-dharma flourished;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: As for the past south of the Yangzi, when image-dharma flourished;

manualTranslations.zh: 梁武、簡文，施舍無限。
manualTranslations.literal: Emperor Wu and Emperor Jianwen of Liang gave alms without limit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Emperor Wu and Emperor Jianwen of Liang gave alms without limit.

manualTranslations.zh: 及乎三淮沸浪，五嶺騰煙，列剎盈衢，無救危亡之禍；
manualTranslations.literal: When the Three Huai boiled in waves and the Five Ridges rose in smoke, temples lined the streets — yet they could not save the calamity of peril and ruin;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Three Huai boiled in waves and the Five Ridges rose in smoke, temples lined the streets — yet they could not save the calamity of peril and ruin;

manualTranslations.zh: 緇衣蔽路，豈益勤王之師？
manualTranslations.literal: black-robed monks blocked the roads — how could they aid the armies that rallied to the sovereign?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: black-robed monks blocked the roads — how could they aid the armies that rallied to the sovereign?

manualTranslations.zh: 況近年以來，風塵屢擾；
manualTranslations.literal: Moreover, in recent years dust and turmoil have repeatedly disturbed;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Moreover, in recent years dust and turmoil have repeatedly disturbed;

manualTranslations.zh: 水旱失節，征役稍繁。
manualTranslations.literal: floods and droughts have lost their seasons, and corvée and military service have grown somewhat heavy.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: floods and droughts have lost their seasons, and corvée and military service have grown somewhat heavy.

manualTranslations.zh: 必若多費官財，又苦人力，一隅有難，將何以救？
manualTranslations.literal: If much government wealth is spent and human labor is further burdened, when difficulty arises in one corner, how will it be rescued?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: If much government wealth is spent and human labor is further burdened, when difficulty arises in one corner, how will it be rescued?"

manualTranslations.zh: 」此切當之言一也。
manualTranslations.literal: This is the first apt and fitting statement.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This is the first apt and fitting statement.

manualTranslations.zh: 中宗時，公主外戚，奏度僧尼，姚崇諫曰：「佛不在外，求之於心。
manualTranslations.literal: In the time of Emperor Zhongzong, princesses and maternal relatives memorialized to ordain monks and nuns. Yao Chong remonstrated, saying: "Buddha is not outside — seek him in the heart.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the time of Emperor Zhongzong, princesses and maternal relatives memorialized to ordain monks and nuns. Yao Chong remonstrated, saying: "Buddha is not outside — seek him in the heart.

manualTranslations.zh: 佛圖澄最賢，無益於後趙；
manualTranslations.literal: Fotudeng was most worthy, yet of no benefit to Later Zhao;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Fotudeng was most worthy, yet of no benefit to Later Zhao;

manualTranslations.zh: 羅什多藝，不救於姚秦。
manualTranslations.literal: Kumarajiva was most accomplished, yet could not save Later Qin.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Kumarajiva was most accomplished, yet could not save Later Qin.

manualTranslations.zh: 何充、苻融，皆遭敗滅；
manualTranslations.literal: He Chong and Fu Rong both met defeat and destruction;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He Chong and Fu Rong both met defeat and destruction;

manualTranslations.zh: 齊襄、梁武，未免災殃。
manualTranslations.literal: Duke Xiang of Qi and Emperor Wu of Liang could not escape calamity.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Duke Xiang of Qi and Emperor Wu of Liang could not escape calamity.

manualTranslations.zh: 但誌發慈悲，心行利益，若蒼生安樂，即是佛身。
manualTranslations.literal: Only resolve to awaken compassion and in the heart practice benefit — if the common people are secure and happy, that itself is the Buddha-body."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Only resolve to awaken compassion and in the heart practice benefit — if the common people are secure and happy, that itself is the Buddha-body."

manualTranslations.zh: 」此切當之言二也。
manualTranslations.literal: This is the second apt and fitting statement.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This is the second apt and fitting statement.

manualTranslations.zh: 睿宗為金仙、玉真二公主造二道宮，辛替否諫曰：「自夏以來，淫雨不解，谷荒於壟，麥爛於場。
manualTranslations.literal: Emperor Ruizong built two Daoist palaces for the Princesses Jinxian and Yuzhen. Xin Tifou remonstrated, saying: "Since summer, unceasing rains have not ceased; grain lies waste in the furrows, wheat rots in the threshing floor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Emperor Ruizong built two Daoist palaces for the Princesses Jinxian and Yuzhen. Xin Tifou remonstrated, saying: "Since summer, unceasing rains have not ceased; grain lies waste in the furrows, wheat rots in the threshing floor.

manualTranslations.zh: 入秋以來，亢旱為災，苗而不實，霜損蟲暴，草菜枯黃；
manualTranslations.literal: Since autumn began, severe drought has become a disaster; shoots bear no grain, frost harms and insects ravage, grasses and vegetables wither yellow;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Since autumn began, severe drought has become a disaster; shoots bear no grain, frost harms and insects ravage, grasses and vegetables wither yellow;

manualTranslations.zh: 下人咨嗟，未加賑貸。
manualTranslations.literal: the common people sigh in distress, yet no relief or loans have been granted.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: the common people sigh in distress, yet no relief or loans have been granted.

manualTranslations.zh: 陛下愛兩女而造兩觀，燒瓦運木，載土填沙。
manualTranslations.literal: Your Majesty loves two daughters and builds two temples, burning tiles and hauling timber, loading earth and filling sand.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Your Majesty loves two daughters and builds two temples, burning tiles and hauling timber, loading earth and filling sand.

manualTranslations.zh: 道路流言，皆云用錢百萬。
manualTranslations.literal: Rumors on the roads all say a million in cash is being spent.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Rumors on the roads all say a million in cash is being spent.

manualTranslations.zh: 陛下聖人也，遠無不知；
manualTranslations.literal: Your Majesty is a sage — nothing distant is unknown;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Your Majesty is a sage — nothing distant is unknown;

manualTranslations.zh: 陛下明君也，細無不見！
manualTranslations.literal: Your Majesty is an enlightened sovereign — nothing minute escapes notice!
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Your Majesty is an enlightened sovereign — nothing minute escapes notice!

manualTranslations.zh: 既知且見，知倉有幾年之儲？
manualTranslations.literal: Since you know and see, do you know how many years' store the granaries hold?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Since you know and see, do you know how many years' store the granaries hold?

manualTranslations.zh: 庫有幾年之帛？
manualTranslations.literal: How many years' cloth do the treasuries hold?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: How many years' cloth do the treasuries hold?

manualTranslations.zh: 知百姓之間可存活乎？
manualTranslations.literal: Do you know whether the common people can survive?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Do you know whether the common people can survive?

manualTranslations.zh: 三邊之士可轉輸乎？
manualTranslations.literal: Can the troops on the three frontiers be supplied by transport?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Can the troops on the three frontiers be supplied by transport?

manualTranslations.zh: 今發一卒扞以邊陲，追一兵以衛社稷，多無衣食，皆帶饑寒；
manualTranslations.literal: Now to dispatch one soldier to defend the frontier, to press one trooper to guard the altars of state — most lack food and clothing, all bear hunger and cold;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Now to dispatch one soldier to defend the frontier, to press one trooper to guard the altars of state — most lack food and clothing, all bear hunger and cold;

manualTranslations.zh: 賞賜之間，迥無所出。
manualTranslations.literal: when it comes to rewards and gifts, there is utterly nowhere to draw from.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: when it comes to rewards and gifts, there is utterly nowhere to draw from.

manualTranslations.zh: 軍旅驟敗，莫不由斯。
manualTranslations.literal: Armies suddenly defeated — none of this is without this cause.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Armies suddenly defeated — none of this is without this cause.

manualTranslations.zh: 而陛下破百萬貫錢，造不急之觀，以賈六合之怨，以違萬人之心。
manualTranslations.literal: Yet Your Majesty breaks a million strings of cash to build temples not urgently needed, purchasing the resentment of all within the six directions and going against the hearts of ten thousand people.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yet Your Majesty breaks a million strings of cash to build temples not urgently needed, purchasing the resentment of all within the six directions and going against the hearts of ten thousand people.

manualTranslations.zh: 」此切當之言三也。
manualTranslations.literal: This is the third apt and fitting statement.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This is the third apt and fitting statement.

manualTranslations.zh: 替否又諫造寺曰：「釋教以清凈為基，慈悲為主。
manualTranslations.literal: Tifou again remonstrated against building temples, saying: "The Buddhist teaching takes purity as its foundation and compassion as its master.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tifou again remonstrated against building temples, saying: "The Buddhist teaching takes purity as its foundation and compassion as its master.

manualTranslations.zh: 常體道以濟物，不利己而害人。
manualTranslations.literal: It constantly embodies the Way to aid beings, not benefiting oneself while harming others.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: It constantly embodies the Way to aid beings, not benefiting oneself while harming others.

manualTranslations.zh: 每去己以全真，不營身以害教。
manualTranslations.literal: It always sets aside the self to preserve wholeness, not cultivating the person to harm the teaching.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: It always sets aside the self to preserve wholeness, not cultivating the person to harm the teaching.

manualTranslations.zh: 今三時之月，築山穿池，損命也；
manualTranslations.literal: Now in the months of the three seasons, building mountains and digging pools — this harms life;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Now in the months of the three seasons, building mountains and digging pools — this harms life;

manualTranslations.zh: 殫府虛藏，損人也；
manualTranslations.literal: exhausting treasuries and emptying stores — this harms people;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: exhausting treasuries and emptying stores — this harms people;

manualTranslations.zh: 廣殿長廊，營身也。
manualTranslations.literal: broad halls and long corridors — this cultivates the person.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: broad halls and long corridors — this cultivates the person.

manualTranslations.zh: 損命，則不慈悲，損人，則不濟物，營身，則不清凈。
manualTranslations.literal: To harm life is not compassion; to harm people is not aiding beings; to cultivate the person is not purity.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: To harm life is not compassion; to harm people is not aiding beings; to cultivate the person is not purity.

manualTranslations.zh: 豈大聖至神之心乎？
manualTranslations.literal: How could this be the mind of the great sage and supreme spirit?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: How could this be the mind of the great sage and supreme spirit?

manualTranslations.zh: 佛書曰：『一切有為法，如夢幻泡影，如露亦如電。
manualTranslations.literal: The Buddhist scripture says: 'All conditioned dharmas are like dreams, illusions, bubbles, shadows, like dew and also like lightning.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Buddhist scripture says: 'All conditioned dharmas are like dreams, illusions, bubbles, shadows, like dew and also like lightning.

manualTranslations.zh: 』臣以為減雕琢之費以賑貧人，是有如來之德；
manualTranslations.literal: ' Your servant holds that reducing carving and ornamentation to relieve the poor is to possess the virtue of the Tathagata;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: ' Your servant holds that reducing carving and ornamentation to relieve the poor is to possess the virtue of the Tathagata;

manualTranslations.zh: 息穿掘之苦以全昆蟲，是有如來之仁；
manualTranslations.literal: ceasing the suffering of digging and excavation to preserve insects is to possess the benevolence of the Tathagata;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: ceasing the suffering of digging and excavation to preserve insects is to possess the benevolence of the Tathagata;

manualTranslations.zh: 罷營葺之直以給邊陲，是有湯武之功；
manualTranslations.literal: halting construction costs to supply the frontier is to possess the achievement of Tang and Wu;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: halting construction costs to supply the frontier is to possess the achievement of Tang and Wu;

manualTranslations.zh: 回不急之祿以購清廉，是有唐虞之治。
manualTranslations.literal: redirecting salaries not urgently needed to reward integrity is to possess the governance of Tang and Yu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: redirecting salaries not urgently needed to reward integrity is to possess the governance of Tang and Yu.

manualTranslations.zh: 陛下緩其所急，急其所緩；
manualTranslations.literal: Your Majesty is slow where urgency lies and urgent where slowness lies;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Your Majesty is slow where urgency lies and urgent where slowness lies;

manualTranslations.zh: 親未來而疏見在，失真實而冀虛無。
manualTranslations.literal: cherishing what is not yet come while neglecting what is present, losing what is real while hoping for emptiness.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: cherishing what is not yet come while neglecting what is present, losing what is real while hoping for emptiness.

manualTranslations.zh: 重俗人之所為，輕天子之功業，臣實痛之！
manualTranslations.literal: You value what vulgar people do and slight the achievements of the Son of Heaven — your servant is truly pained!
manualTranslations.idiomatic: You value what vulgar people do and slight the achievements of the Son of Heaven — your servant is truly pained!

manualTranslations.zh: 」此切當之言四也。
manualTranslations.literal: This is the fourth apt and fitting statement.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This is the fourth apt and fitting statement.

manualTranslations.zh: 臣觀仁傑，天後時上公也；
manualTranslations.literal: Your servant observes that Renjie was a supreme minister in the time of the Empress;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Your servant observes that Renjie was a supreme minister in the time of the Empress;

manualTranslations.zh: 姚崇，開元時賢相也；
manualTranslations.literal: Yao Chong was a worthy chancellor in the Kaiyuan era;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yao Chong was a worthy chancellor in the Kaiyuan era;

manualTranslations.zh: 替否，睿宗之直臣也。
manualTranslations.literal: Tifou was a straightforward minister of Emperor Ruizong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tifou was a straightforward minister of Emperor Ruizong.

manualTranslations.zh: 臣每覽斯言，未嘗不廢卷而太息，痛其言之不行也。
manualTranslations.literal: Your servant, each time reading these words, has never failed to set down the scroll and sigh deeply, grieved that their words were not followed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Your servant, each time reading these words, has never failed to set down the scroll and sigh deeply, grieved that their words were not followed.

manualTranslations.zh: 伏以陛下深重緇流，妙崇佛事，其為樂善，實邁前蹤。
manualTranslations.literal: I humbly note that Your Majesty deeply esteems the black-robed clergy and exquisitely honors Buddhist affairs; in delighting in goodness, you truly surpass former traces.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I humbly note that Your Majesty deeply esteems the black-robed clergy and exquisitely honors Buddhist affairs; in delighting in goodness, you truly surpass former traces.

manualTranslations.zh: 但細詳時代之安危，渺鑒昔賢之敷奏，則思過半矣，道遠乎哉！
manualTranslations.literal: Yet if one carefully examines the safety and peril of the age and distantly perceives the memorials of past worthies, then reflection is more than half the way, and how far is the Way!
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yet if one carefully examines the safety and peril of the age and distantly perceives the memorials of past worthies, then reflection is more than half the way, and how far is the Way!

manualTranslations.zh: 臣過忝渥恩，言虧匡諫，但舉從繩之義，少裨負扆之明。
manualTranslations.literal: Your servant has unduly received thick favor; my words fall short of corrective remonstrance, yet I offer only the principle of following the plumb line, to add slightly to the clarity before the screen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Your servant has unduly received thick favor; my words fall short of corrective remonstrance, yet I offer only the principle of following the plumb line, to add slightly to the clarity before the screen.

manualTranslations.zh: 營繕之間，稍宜停減。
manualTranslations.literal: In construction and repair, it would be fitting to pause and reduce somewhat.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In construction and repair, it would be fitting to pause and reduce somewhat.

sourceRange.text: 初，上以太子稍長，不循法度，昵近小人，欲加廢黜。迫於公卿之請，乃止。太子終不悛改，至是暴薨。時傳云：太子德妃之出也，晚年寵衰。賢妃楊氏，恩渥方深。懼太子他日不利於己，故日加誣譖，太子終不能自辨明也。太子既薨，上意追悔。四年，因會寧殿宴。小兒緣橦，有一夫在下，憂其墮地，有若狂者。止問之，乃其父也。上因感泣，謂左右曰：「朕富有天下，不能全一子。」遂召樂官劉楚材、宮人張十十等責之，曰：「陷吾太子，皆爾曹也。今已有太子，更欲踵前耶？」立命殺之。

items.sourceTextOverride: 初，上以太子稍長，不循法度，昵近小人，欲加廢黜。迫於公卿之請，乃止。太子終不悛改，至是暴薨。時傳云：太子德妃之出也，晚年寵衰。賢妃楊氏，恩渥方深。懼太子他日不利於己，故日加誣譖，太子終不能自辨明也。太子既薨，上意追悔。四年，因會寧殿宴。小兒緣橦，有一夫在下，憂其墮地，有若狂者。上問之，乃其父也。上因感泣，謂左右曰：「朕富有天下，不能全一子。」遂召樂官劉楚材、宮人張十十等責之，曰：「陷吾太子，皆爾曹也。今已有太子，更欲踵前耶？」立命殺之。

manualTranslations.zh: 初，上以太子稍長，不循法度，昵近小人，欲加廢黜。
manualTranslations.literal: At first, because the crown prince was somewhat grown and did not follow laws and regulations, but was intimate with petty men, the emperor wanted to depose him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Earlier, once the crown prince had grown older, he ignored rules and discipline and kept close company with petty men, so the emperor wanted to depose him.

manualTranslations.zh: 迫於公卿之請，乃止。
manualTranslations.literal: Pressed by the requests of the dukes and ministers, he stopped.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Under pressure from the high ministers’ pleas, he stopped.

manualTranslations.zh: 太子終不悛改，至是暴薨。
manualTranslations.literal: The crown prince never reformed, and at this point suddenly died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The crown prince never reformed, and now he died suddenly.

manualTranslations.zh: 時傳云：太子德妃之出也，晚年寵衰。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time it was said: the crown prince was born of Consort De, whose favor declined in her later years.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: It was said at the time that the crown prince had been born to Consort De, whose favor declined in later years.

manualTranslations.zh: 賢妃楊氏，恩渥方深。
manualTranslations.literal: Consort Xian, Lady Yang, was then enjoying especially deep favor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Consort Xian, Lady Yang, was then enjoying deep favor.

manualTranslations.zh: 懼太子他日不利於己，故日加誣譖，太子終不能自辨明也。
manualTranslations.literal: Fearing that the crown prince would one day be disadvantageous to her, she daily added slanders and accusations, and the crown prince was ultimately unable to clarify matters for himself.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Fearing that the crown prince would one day harm her interests, she slandered him day after day, and he was never able to clear himself.

manualTranslations.zh: 太子既薨，上意追悔。
manualTranslations.literal: After the crown prince died, the emperor’s mind was remorseful.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After the crown prince died, the emperor regretted what had happened.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，因會寧殿宴。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year, during a banquet in Huining Hall.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, during a banquet in Huining Hall,

manualTranslations.zh: 小兒緣橦，有一夫在下，憂其墮地，有若狂者。
manualTranslations.literal: a child climbed a pole, and there was a man below who worried that he would fall to the ground, seeming almost mad.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: a child climbed a pole while a man below, frantic with worry, feared he would fall.

manualTranslations.zh: 上問之，乃其父也。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor asked about him, and he was the child’s father.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor asked who he was; he was the child’s father.

manualTranslations.zh: 上因感泣，謂左右曰：「朕富有天下，不能全一子。」
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor was moved to tears and said to those around him, “I possess all under Heaven in wealth, yet could not preserve one son.”
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Moved to tears, the emperor told his attendants, “I possess all under Heaven, yet I could not save one son.”

manualTranslations.zh: 遂召樂官劉楚材、宮人張十十等責之，曰：「陷吾太子，皆爾曹也。
manualTranslations.literal: He then summoned the music official Liu Chucai, the palace woman Zhang Shishi, and others, reproached them, and said, “Those who brought down my crown prince were all you people.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He then summoned the music official Liu Chucai, the palace woman Zhang Shishi, and the others, rebuking them: “It was all of you who ruined my crown prince.

manualTranslations.zh: 今已有太子，更欲踵前耶？」
manualTranslations.literal: Now there is already a crown prince; do you want again to follow the former path?”
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Now I already have another crown prince; do you mean to repeat the old affair?”

manualTranslations.zh: 立命殺之。
manualTranslations.literal: He immediately ordered them killed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He immediately ordered them put to death.

sourceRange.text: 仲武由是威加北狄，表請於薊北立《紀聖功銘》，敕李德裕為之文，其銘曰：太和之初，赤氣宵興；開成之末，彤雲暮凝。異鳥南來，胡滅之征。北夷飈掃，厥國土崩。逼迫遷徙，震我邊鄙；長蛇去穴，奔鯨失水。上都薊門，兵連千里；曾不畏天，猶為驕子。丐我邊谷，邀我王師，假我一城，建彼幡旗。歸計強漢，郅支嫚辭；狼顧朔野，伏莽見羸。雁門之北，羌戎雜處，濈々群羊，茫茫大鹵。縱其梟騎，驚我牧圉；暴若豺狼，疾如風雨。皇赫斯怒，羽檄征兵；謀而泉默，斷乃霆聲。沈機變化，動合神明，沙漠之外，虜無隱情。漁陽突騎，燕歌壯氣，赳赳元戎，眈眈虎視。金鼓誓眾，幹旄蔽地，爰命其弟，屬之大事。翩翩飛將，董我三軍；稟兄之制，代帥之勤。威略火烈，胡馬星分，戈回白日，劍薄浮云。天街之北，旄頭已落；絕轡之野，蚩尤未縛。俾我元侯，恢弘遠略；終取單於，系之徽索。陰山寢鋒，亭僥弢弓，萬里昆夷，九譯而通。蠻夷既同，天子之功；儒臣篆美，刊石垂鴻。

manualTranslations.zh: 仲武由是威加北狄，表請於薊北立《紀聖功銘》，敕李德裕為之文，其銘曰：太和之初，赤氣宵興；
manualTranslations.literal: Zhongwu thereby gained authority over the northern barbarians; he memorialized requesting that a "Record of Sacred Merit" stele be erected north of Ji, and an edict ordered Li Deyu to compose the text. The inscription reads: At the beginning of Taihe, crimson vapors rose through the night;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhongwu's prestige over the northern peoples was now supreme. He memorialized asking that a Record of Sacred Merit stele be erected north of Ji, and the court ordered Li Deyu to compose the inscription, which reads: In early Taihe crimson vapors rose at night;

manualTranslations.zh: 開成之末，彤雲暮凝。
manualTranslations.literal: At the end of Kaicheng, rosy clouds congealed at dusk.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: By the close of Kaicheng rosy clouds hung thick at dusk.

manualTranslations.zh: 異鳥南來，胡滅之征。
manualTranslations.literal: Strange birds came from the south — a sign that the barbarians would be destroyed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Strange birds flew from the south, portending the barbarians' destruction.

manualTranslations.zh: 北夷飈掃，厥國土崩。
manualTranslations.literal: Northern tribes were swept away like a storm; their state collapsed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Northern tribes were swept away in a whirlwind, and their realm collapsed.

manualTranslations.zh: 逼迫遷徙，震我邊鄙；
manualTranslations.literal: Driven and forced to migrate, they shook our frontier districts;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Driven into migration, they shook our frontier lands;

manualTranslations.zh: 長蛇去穴，奔鯨失水。
manualTranslations.literal: a long serpent left its den, a fleeing whale lost its water.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: like a serpent leaving its den, a whale cast ashore.

manualTranslations.zh: 上都薊門，兵連千里；
manualTranslations.literal: From the upper capital to Ji's gate, armies stretched for a thousand li;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From the upper capital to Ji's gate armies stretched a thousand li;

manualTranslations.zh: 曾不畏天，猶為驕子。
manualTranslations.literal: They did not fear Heaven, yet still acted as spoiled children.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They feared not Heaven, yet played the spoiled child.

manualTranslations.zh: 丐我邊谷，邀我王師，假我一城，建彼幡旗。
manualTranslations.literal: They begged our border grain, invited our royal army, borrowed a city from us, and raised their banners.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They begged for our border grain, invited our royal forces, borrowed a city, and raised their banners.

manualTranslations.zh: 歸計強漢，郅支嫚辭；
manualTranslations.literal: They plotted against mighty Han; Zhizhi's insolent words;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They plotted against strong Han with Zhizhi's insolent rhetoric;

manualTranslations.zh: 狼顧朔野，伏莽見羸。
manualTranslations.literal: a wolf glancing back on the northern wilds, hiding in the brush and showing weakness.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: like a wolf glancing back on the northern plain, crouching in the brush and feigning weakness.

manualTranslations.zh: 雁門之北，羌戎雜處，濈々群羊，茫茫大鹵。
manualTranslations.literal: North of Yanmen, Qiang and Rong dwelt mingled; sheep in restless flocks, vast barbarian wastes.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: North of Yanmen gate, Qiang and Rong mingled — restless flocks of sheep across vast barbarian wastes.

manualTranslations.zh: 縱其梟騎，驚我牧圉；
manualTranslations.literal: They unleashed their fierce cavalry and startled our herdsmen;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They unleashed fierce raiders, terrifying our herdsmen;

manualTranslations.zh: 暴若豺狼，疾如風雨。
manualTranslations.literal: violent as wolves, swift as wind and rain.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: savage as wolves, swift as wind and rain.

manualTranslations.zh: 皇赫斯怒，羽檄征兵；
manualTranslations.literal: The Emperor blazed with wrath; mobilization orders flew forth;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Son of Heaven blazed with wrath; urgent orders summoned the armies;

manualTranslations.zh: 謀而泉默，斷乃霆聲。
manualTranslations.literal: Plans were made in silence like a spring, execution like thunder.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Plans brewed in silence; decisions fell like thunder.

manualTranslations.zh: 沈機變化，動合神明，沙漠之外，虜無隱情。
manualTranslations.literal: Deep stratagems and transformations; every move accorded with the divine; beyond the desert the barbarians had no hidden designs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Deep schemes and transformations moved in accord with Heaven; beyond the desert the barbarians had no secret left.

manualTranslations.zh: 漁陽突騎，燕歌壯氣，赳赳元戎，眈眈虎視。
manualTranslations.literal: Fierce Yuyang cavalry, bold Yan songs and martial spirit; the valiant supreme commander, glaring like a tiger.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yuyang's fierce horsemen, the bold songs of Yan — the valiant commander glared like a tiger.

manualTranslations.zh: 金鼓誓眾，幹旄蔽地，爰命其弟，屬之大事。
manualTranslations.literal: Golden drums rallied the hosts, banners veiled the earth; he then entrusted his younger brother with the great enterprise.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Drums and banners rallied the hosts; he entrusted his younger brother with the great task.

manualTranslations.zh: 翩翩飛將，董我三軍；
manualTranslations.literal: A gallant flying general led our three armies;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: A gallant winged general commanded our three armies;

manualTranslations.zh: 稟兄之制，代帥之勤。
manualTranslations.literal: following his elder brother's command, serving as deputy commander with diligence.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: obeying his elder brother's orders, serving as deputy with tireless diligence.

manualTranslations.zh: 威略火烈，胡馬星分，戈回白日，劍薄浮云。
manualTranslations.literal: Strategy fierce as fire; barbarian horses scattered like stars; spears turned back the white sun, swords pierced the floating clouds.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Strategy blazed like fire; barbarian horses scattered like stars; spears blazed against the sun, swords pierced the clouds.

manualTranslations.zh: 天街之北，旄頭已落；
manualTranslations.literal: North of the Heavenly Street, the Bushel-star had fallen;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: North of the Heavenly Street the war-star had already fallen;

manualTranslations.zh: 絕轡之野，蚩尤未縛。
manualTranslations.literal: In the wilderness where reins are cut, Chiyou was not yet bound.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: on the plain where horses break free, Chiyou had yet to be bound.

manualTranslations.zh: 俾我元侯，恢弘遠略；
manualTranslations.literal: Our prince-commander expanded his far-reaching strategy;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Our champion lord broadened his distant strategy;

manualTranslations.zh: 終取單於，系之徽索。
manualTranslations.literal: ultimately capturing the chanyu and binding him with cord.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: and at last seized the chanyu and bound him with rope.

manualTranslations.zh: 陰山寢鋒，亭僥弢弓，萬里昆夷，九譯而通。
manualTranslations.literal: Swords slept on Yinshan; bows were unstrung at the frontier posts; ten thousand li of Kun barbarians were reached through nine translators.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Swords lay sheathed on Yinshan, bows unstrung at the frontier posts; barbarians ten thousand li distant were reached through nine translators.

manualTranslations.zh: 蠻夷既同，天子之功；
manualTranslations.literal: Barbarians were all brought together — the Son of Heaven's achievement;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the barbarians were united, it was the Son of Heaven's achievement;

manualTranslations.zh: 儒臣篆美，刊石垂鴻。
manualTranslations.literal: a Confucian minister inscribed its beauty, carving stone to leave a lasting monument.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: a Confucian minister praised the deed in elegant script, carving stone to leave a lasting monument.

sourceRange.text: 其末章曰：臣伏奉詔命，令臣自省，更勿依違者。臣仰天訴地，自淚交流；如劍戟攢心，若湯火在己。只如黃巢大寇，圍逼天長小城，四旬有余，竟至敗走。臣散征諸道兵甲，盡出家財賞給，而諸道多不發兵，財物即為己有。縱然遣使征得，敕旨不許過淮。其時黃巢殘兇，才及二萬，經過數千里，軍鎮盡若無人。只如潼關已東，止有一徑，其為險固，甚於井陘。豈有狂寇奔沖，略無阻礙，即百二之地，固是虛言。神策六軍，此時安在？陛下蒼黃西出，內官奔命東來，黎庶盡被殺傷，衣冠悉遭屠戮。今則園陵開毀，宗廟荊榛，遠近痛傷，遐邇嗟怨。雖然，奸臣未悟，陛下猶迷，不思宗廟之焚燒，不痛園陵之開毀。臣之痛也，實在於斯！此事見之多年，不獨知於今日。況自萑蒲盜起，朝廷征用至多，上至帥臣，下及裨將，以臣所料，悉可坐擒，用此為謀，安能辦事？陛下今用王鐸，盡主兵權，誠知狂寇必殲，梟巢即覆。臣讀《禮》至宣尼射於矍相之圃，蓋觀者如堵墻，使子路出延射曰：「潰軍之將，亡國之大夫，與為人後者，不入於射也。」嚴誡如斯，圖功也，豈宜容易？陛下安忍委敗軍之將，陷一儒臣？崔安潛到處貪殘，只如西川，可為驗矣，委之副貳，詎可平戎？況天下兵驕，在處僭越，豈二儒士，能戢強兵，萬一乖張，將何救助？願陛下下念黎庶，上為宗祧，無使百代有抱恨之臣，千古留刮席之恥！臣但慮寇生東土，劉氏復興，即軹道之災，豈獨往日！乞陛下稍留神慮，以安宗社。今賢才在野，憸人滿朝，致陛下為亡國之君，此等計將安出？伏乞戮賣官鬻爵之輩，征鯁直公正之臣，委之重難，置之左右，克復宮闕，莫尚於斯！若此時謗誹忠臣，沈埋烈士，匡復宗社，未見有期！臣受國恩深，不覺語切，無任憂懼之至。詔報駢曰：省表具悉。卿一門忠孝，三代勛庸，銘於景鐘，煥在青史。卿承祖父之訓，襲弓冶之基，起自禁軍，從微至著。始則囊錐露穎，稍有知音；尋則天驥呈才，急於試效。自秦州經略使，授交趾節旄，聯翩寵榮，汗漫富貴，未嘗斷絕，僅二十年。卿報國之功，亦可悉數。最顯赫者，安南拒蠻，至今海隅尚守。次則汶陽之日，政聲洽平。洎臨成都，脅歸驃信，三載之內，亦無侵淩。創築羅城，大新錦裏，其為雄壯，實少比儔。渚宮不暇於施為，便當移鎮；建鄴才聞於安靜，旋即渡江。自到廣陵，並鐘多壘，即亦招降草寇，救援臨淮。大約昭灼功勛，不大於此數者。朝廷累加渥澤，靡吝徽章，位極三公，兵環大鎮。銅鹽重務，綰握約及七年；都統雄籓，幅圓幾於萬里。朕瞻如太華，倚若長城，凡有奏論，無不依允，其為托賴，豈愧神明？自黃巢肆毒鹹京，卿並不離隋苑。豈金陵苑水，能遮鵝鸛之雄；風伯雨師，終阻帆檣之利？自聞歸止，寧免郁陶。卿既安住蕪城，鄭畋以春初入覲，遂命上相，親領師徒，因落卿都統之名，固亦不乖事例。仍加封實，貴表優恩。何乃疑忿太深，指陳過當，移時省讀，深用震嗟。聊舉諸條，粗申報復。卿表云：「自是陛下不用微臣，固非微臣有負陛下」者。朕拔卿汶上，超領劍南，荊、潤、維、揚，聯居四鎮。綰利則牢盆在手，主兵則都統當權。直至京北、京南、神策諸鎮，悉在指揮之下，可知董制之雄。而乃貴作司徒，榮為太尉，以為不用，何名為用乎？卿又云：「若欲俯念舊勛，佇觀後效，何不以王鐸權位，與臣主持，必能糾率諸侯，誅鋤群盜」者。朕緣久付卿兵柄，不能翦滅元兇。自天長漏網過淮，不出一兵襲逐，奄殘京國，首尾三年；廣陵之師，未離封部，忠臣積望，勇士興譏。所以擢用元臣，誅夷巨寇，心期貔武，便掃欃槍。卿初委張璘，請放卻諸道兵士，辛勤召置，容易放還，璘果敗亡，巢益顛越。卿前年初夏，逞發神機，與京中朝貴書，題云：「得靈仙教導，芒種之後，賊必蕩平。」尋聞圍逼天長，必謂死在卿手，豈知魚跳鼎釜，狐脫網羅，遽過長淮，竟為大憝。都統既不能禦遏，諸將更何以枝梧？果致連犯關河，繼傾都邑。從來倚仗之意，一旦控告無門，凝睇東南，惟增淒惻。及朕蒙塵入蜀，宗廟汙於賊庭，天下人心，無不雪涕。既知歷數猶在，謳謠未移，則懷忠拗怒之臣，貯救難除奸之誌，便須果決，安可因循？況恩厚者其報深，位重者其心急。此際天下義舉，皆望淮海率先。豈知近輔儒臣，先為首唱；而窮邊勇將，誓誌平戎，關東寂寥，不見幹羽。洎乎初秋覽表，方雲仲夏發兵，便詔軍前，並移汶上。喜聞兵勢，渴見旌幢。尋稱宣潤阻艱，難從天討。謝玄破苻堅於淝水，裴度平元濟於淮西，未必儒臣不如武將！卿又云：「若不斥逐邪佞，親近忠良，臣既不能保家，陛下豈能安國？忽當今日，棄若寒灰」者。未委誰是忠良，誰為邪佞？終日寵榮富貴，何嘗不保其家；無人扞禦冠戎，所以不安其國。豈有位兼將相，使帶銅鹽，自謂寒灰，真同浪語。卿又云：「不通園陵之開毀，不念宗廟之焚燒，臣實痛之，實在茲也。」且龜玉毀於櫝中，誰之過也？鯨鯢漏於網外，抑有其由！卿手握強兵，身居大鎮，不能遮圍擒戮，致令脫漏猖狂，雖則上系天時，抑亦旁由人事。朕自到西蜀，不離一室之中，屏棄笙歌，杜絕遊獵，蔬食適口，布服被身，焚香以望園陵，雪涕以思宗廟，省躬罪己，不敢遑安。「奸臣未悟」之言，誰人肯認？「陛下猶迷」之語，朕不敢當！卿又云：「自來所用將帥，上至帥臣，下及裨將，以臣所料，悉可坐擒，用此為謀，安能集事」者。且十室之邑，猶有忠信，天下至大，豈無英雄？況守固城池，悉嚴兵甲，縱非盡美，安得平欺？卿尚不能縛黃巢於天長，安能坐擒諸將？只如拓拔思恭、諸葛爽輩，安能坐擒耶？勿務大言，不堪垂訓。卿又云：「王鐸是敗軍之將，兼征引矍相射義」者。昔曹沫三敗，終復魯讎；孟明再奔，竟雪秦恥。近代汾陽尚父，咸寧太師，亦曾不利鼓鼙，尋則功成鐘鼎。安知王鐸不立大勛？卿又云：「無使百代有抱恨之臣，千古留刮席之恥。但慮寇生東土，劉氏復興，即軹道之災，豈獨往日」者。我國家景祚方遠，天命未窮，海內人心，尚樂唐德。朕不荒酒色，不虧刑名，不結怨於生靈，不貪財於宇縣。自知運歷，必保延洪。況巡省已來，禎祥薦降；西蜀半年之內，聲名又以備全。塞北、日南，悉來朝貢；黠戛、善闡，並至梯航。但慮天寶、建中，未如今日；清宮復國，必有近期。卿雲「劉氏復興」，不知誰為其首？遽言「刮席之恥」，比朕於劉盆子耶？仍憂「軹道之災」，方朕於秦子嬰也？雖稱直行，何太罔誣！三復斯言，尤深駭異。卿又云：「賢才在野，憸人滿朝，致陛下為亡國之君，此子等計將安出？伏乞戮賣官鬻爵之輩，征鯁直公正之臣」者。且唐、虞之世，未必盡是忠良；今巖野之間，安得不遺賢彥？朕每令銓擇，亦遣訪求。其於選將料兵，安人救物，但屬收復之業，講求理化之基，自有長才，同匡大計。賣官鬻爵之士，中外必不有之，勿聽狂辭，以資遊說。且朕遠違宮闕，寄寓巴邛，所失恩者甚多，尚不興怨，卿落一都統，何足介懷？況天步未傾，皇綱尚整，三靈不昧，百度猶存。但守君臣之軌儀，正上下之名分，宜遵教約，未可隳淩。朕雖沖人，安得輕侮！但以知卿歲久，許卿分深，貴存終始之恩，忽貯猜嫌之慮。所宜深省，無更過言！

sourceRange.text: 中宗即位，以車安備禮徵之，降書曰：朕聞大隱忘情，不去朝市，至人無跡，何所凝滯。王高標峻尚，雅操孤貞；有咸一之用，弘體二之德；學究深遠，理實精微。草芥貂蟬，錙銖纓紱；廕松山而辭竹苑，去硃邸而臥清溪；逍遙林壑，傲睨箕潁，有年歲矣。朕虔膺聖歷，重闡皇基；保乂邦家，寧輯區宇；求賢采彥，俯谷窺山。王之所居，接近嵩嶽，長望高烈，思滿風煙。駐驆喬巖，追尋大隗；鳴鑾峒岫，詢訪廣成；機務殷繁，有懷莫遂。今遣國子司業杜慎盈以禮命徵辟，掃夔、龍之弟，虛稷、契之筵，神化丹青，朕之志也。豈以黃屋之貴，傾彼白雲之心？通變之宜，希從降志；延貯閶闔，若在汾陽。

sourceRange.text: 中宗即位，侍中敬暉等以唐室中興，武氏諸王宜削其王爵，乃率群官上表曰：臣聞神器者，天下之至公，必歸乎有德；皇極者，域中之大寶，必順乎天命。歷考前古，祥觀帝業，皆不並興，莫有二主。故三皇氏沒而五帝氏興，夏、商氏衰而周、漢氏作。何則？帝王之歷數，心應乎五行，水盛則火衰，木衰則金盛。天地之運也，合乎四時，春往則夏來，暑退則寒集。則知五行之數也，帝王不可違，違之則宗社不安，生人不理。四時之序，天地不能變，變之則霜露不均，水旱交錯。自有隋失御，海內崩離，天歷之重，歸於唐室。萬方樂業，荷撥亂之功；三聖重光，布生成之德。可謂有功於四海，有德於蒸人。自弘道遏密，生靈降禍，百辟哀號，如喪考妣。則天皇后臨御帝圖，明目達聰，躬親庶績。則有讒邪兇孽，誣惑睿德，構害宗枝，誅夷殆盡。英籓賢戚，百不一存，餘類在者，投竄荒裔。冤酷人神，感傷天地，忠臣義士，實所痛心。自天授之際，時稱改革，武家子侄，咸樹封建，十餘年間，實亦榮極。於時唐室籓屏，豈得並封，故知事有陞降，時使然也。今則天皇帝厭倦萬機，神器大寶，重歸陛下。百姓謳歌，欣復唐業，上至卿士，下及蒼生，黃髮之倫，童兒之輩，莫不歡欣舞忭，如見父母。豈不以唐家恩德，感幽祇之心；陛下仁明，順天下之望？今皇業重構，聖祚中興，神祇之道，有助於先德矣！黎人之誠，無負於陛下矣！臣又聞之，業不兩盛，事不兩大，故天無二日，土無二王，前聖之格言，先哲之明誡。自皇明反正，天命惟新，武家諸王，封建依舊，生者既加茅土，死者仍追賦邑，萬姓失望，卿士寒心，何則？開辟以來，罕有斯理，帝王之道，實無此法。陛下縱欲開恩，以行私惠，豈可違五行之歷數乎？乖四時之寒暑乎？又海內眾情，朝廷竊議，為武氏諸王身計，亦適將有損。何則？處之未得其所，居之實恐不安，陛下雖欲寵之，翻乃陷之，不遵古典故也。且唐歷有歸，周命已去；爵重則難保，祿薄則易全。又則天皇帝親政之時，武氏諸王，亦分外職。今居京輦，不降舊封，天下之心，竊將不可。陛下縱欲敦崇外戚，曲流恩貸，奈宗廟社稷之計何？奈卿士黎庶之議何？伏願陛下為社稷之遠圖，割私情之小愛，內崇經邦之要，外順遐邇之心，豈不固宗社之基，允人靈之願？則陛下巍巍之業，貫三光而洞九泉。親親之義，上有倫而下有序。臣特承榮寵，思竭丹赤，既為唐臣，實為唐計，伏乞聖慈，俯垂矜納。

sourceRange.text: 上答曰：朕嘗因暇景，博覽前修，帝籍皇圖，略稽其跡。至若二靈肇判，三才聿興，驪連粟陸之辰，尊盧大庭之日，時猶樸略，未著圖書。洎乎出震應期，畫八卦而成象；炎皇御歷，播百穀以興農。車服創於軒轅之朝，歷象建於唐堯之代，封建之事，闕爾無聞。自周漢已來，方崇蕃屏。至於三微更王，五運叠興，以古揆今，事跡有爽。比者別宗撫歷，異姓興邦，伏以則天大聖皇帝，內輔外臨，將五十載，在朕躬則為慈母，於士庶即是明君。往者垂拱之中，嗣皇臨政，當此之際，魯衛並存。及乎全節興妖，瑯邪構逆，災連七國，釁結三監，既行大義之懷，遂有泣誅之事。周唐革命，蓋為從權，子侄封王，國之常典。卿等表云「天授之際，武家封建，唐家籓屏，豈得並封」者，至如千里一房，不預逆謀，還依姓李，無改舊惠，豈非善惡區分，申明逆順矣？今以聖上乖豫，高枕怡神，委政朕躬，纂承丕緒。昨者二月之首，攸暨等屢請削封，朕獨斷襟懷，不依來請。昔漢祖以布衣取天下，猶封異姓為王，況朕以累聖開基，豈可削封外族？群公等以「天無二日，土無二王」，抗表紫庭，用申丹懇者。然以賞罰之典，經國大綱，攸暨、三思，皆悉預告兇豎，雖不親冒白刃，而亦早獻丹誠，今若卻除舊封，便慮有功難勸。

sourceRange.text: 賊巢之亂，諸葛爽受其偽命河陽節度使。時僖宗在蜀，寇盜蜂起，簡據有六州，甲兵強盛，竊懷僭亂之志，且欲啟其封疆，乃舉兵攻河陽，爽棄城而走。簡遂留兵保守，因北掠邢、洺而歸，遂移軍攻鄆。鄆帥曹全晸出戰，爲簡所敗，死之。鄆將崔君裕收合殘眾，保鄆州。簡進攻其城，半年不下，河陽復爲諸葛爽所襲。簡因欲先討君裕，次及河陽，乃舉兵至鄆，君裕請降。尋移軍復攻河陽，行及新鄕，爲爽軍逆擊，敗之。簡單騎奔回，憂憤。疽發背而卒，時中和元年十一月也。

context.beforeSource: 其後累加至侍中，封昌黎郡王。
context.afterSource: 樂彥禎，魏州人也。

context.afterLocal: 樂彥禎，魏州人也。

manualTranslations.literal: At the time Emperor Xizong was in Shu; bandits and robbers swarmed forth. Jian held six prefectures, his armor and troops were strong, and he secretly harbored ambitions of usurpation and wished to expand his territory; he therefore raised troops to attack Heyang, and Shuang abandoned the city and fled.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor was then in Shu while rebels swarmed the land. Jian held six prefectures and a powerful army; nursing secret ambitions of rebellion and eager to enlarge his domain, he marched on Heyang, and Shuang abandoned the city and fled.

manualTranslations.zh: 簡遂留兵保守，因北掠邢、洺而歸，遂移軍攻鄆。
manualTranslations.literal: Jian then left troops to hold and defend the place, raided north through Xing and Ming and returned, then shifted his army to attack Yan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jian left troops to hold Heyang, raided north through Xing and Ming, then turned his army against Yan.

manualTranslations.zh: 鄆帥曹全晸出戰，爲簡所敗，死之。
manualTranslations.literal: Cao Quanzhen, military governor of Yan, went out to battle and was defeated by Jian and killed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Cao Quanzhen, governor of Yan, marched out to meet him, was defeated, and was killed.

manualTranslations.zh: 鄆將崔君裕收合殘眾，保鄆州。
manualTranslations.literal: The Yan general Cui Junyu gathered the scattered remnants and held Yan prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Yan officer Cui Junyu rallied the survivors and held Yanzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 簡進攻其城，半年不下，河陽復爲諸葛爽所襲。
manualTranslations.literal: Jian pressed the attack on the city for half a year without taking it; Heyang was again seized by Zhuge Shuang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jian besieged the city for half a year without success, while Heyang was seized again by Zhuge Shuang.

manualTranslations.zh: 簡因欲先討君裕，次及河陽，乃舉兵至鄆，君裕請降。
manualTranslations.literal: Jian therefore wished first to subdue Junyu and afterward deal with Heyang; he raised troops and came to Yan, and Junyu requested surrender.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jian resolved to deal with Junyu first and Heyang afterward; he marched on Yan, and Junyu offered to surrender.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋移軍復攻河陽，行及新鄕，爲爽軍逆擊，敗之。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he shifted his army to attack Heyang again; when he reached Xinxing he was struck in counterattack by Shuang's army and defeated.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He soon marched on Heyang again, but near Xinxing Shuang's troops met him head-on and routed him.

manualTranslations.zh: 簡單騎奔回，憂憤。
manualTranslations.literal: Jian fled back alone on horseback, stricken with grief and anger.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jian fled back alone on horseback, sick with grief and rage.

manualTranslations.zh: 疽發背而卒，時中和元年十一月也。
manualTranslations.literal: A carbuncle broke out on his back and he died — this was in the eleventh month of the first year of Zhonghe.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: A carbuncle broke out between his shoulders and he died, in the eleventh month of the first year of Zhonghe.

sourceRange.text: 中宗神龍元年三月八日，詔曰：國之大綱，惟刑與政。刑之不中，其政乃虧。劉光業、王德壽、王處貞、屈貞筠、鮑思恭、劉景陽等，庸流賤職，奸吏險夫，以粗暴為能官，以兇殘為奉法。往從按察，害虐在心，倏忽加刑，呼吸就戮，曝骨流血，其數甚多，冤濫之聲，盈於海內。朕唯布新澤，恩被人祇，撫事長懷，尤深惻隱。光業等五人積惡成釁，並謝生涯，雖其人已殂，而其跡可貶，所有官爵，並宜追奪。其枉被殺人，各令州縣以禮埋葬，還其官廕。劉景陽身今見在，情不可矜，特以會恩，免其嚴罰，宜從貶降，以雪冤情，可棣州樂單縣員外尉。自今內外法官，咸宜敬慎。其文深刺骨，跡徇凝脂，高下任情，輕重隨意，如酷吏丘神勣、來子珣、萬國俊、周興、來俊臣、魚承曄、王景昭、索元禮、傅遊藝、王弘義、張知默、裴籍、焦仁亶、侯思止、郭霸、李仁敬、皇甫文備、陳嘉言等，其身已死，自垂拱已來，枉濫殺人，有官者並令削奪。唐奉一依前配流，李秦授、曹仁哲，並與嶺南惡處。開元十三年三月十二日，御史大夫程行諶奏：周朝酷吏來子珣、萬國俊、王弘義、侯思止、郭霸、焦仁亶、張知默、李敬仁、唐奉一、來俊臣、周興、丘神勣、索元禮、曹仁哲、王景昭、裴籍、李秦授、劉光業、王德壽、屈貞筠、鮑思恭、劉景陽、王處貞二十三人，殘害宗枝，毒陷良善，情狀尤重，子孫不許與官。陳嘉言、魚承曄、皇甫文備、傅遊藝四人，情狀稍輕，子孫不許近任。周興者，雍州長安人也。

姚紹之姚紹之，湖州武康人也。解褐典儀，累拜監察御史。中宗朝，武三思恃庶人勢，駙馬都尉王同皎謀誅之。事泄，令紹之按問而誅同皎。紹之初按問同皎，張仲之、祖延慶謀衣袖中發調弩射三思，伺其便，未果。宋之遜以其外妹妻延慶，曰：「今日將行何事，而以妻為？之遜固抑與延慶，且洽其心矣。之遜子曇密發之，乃敕右臺大夫李承嘉與紹之按於新開門內。初，紹之將直盡其事。詔宰相李嶠等對問。諸相懼三思威權，但僶俛佯不問。仲之、延慶言曰：「宰相中有附會三思者。嶠與承嘉耳言，復說誘紹之，其事乃變。遂密置人力十餘，命引仲之對問。至，即為紹之所擒，塞口反接，送獄中。紹之還，謂仲之曰：「張三，事不諧矣！仲之固言三思反狀，紹之命棒之而臂折，大呼天者六七。謂紹之曰：「反賊，臂且折矣，命已輸汝，當訴爾於天帝！因裂衫以束之，乃自誣反而遇誅。紹之自此神氣自若，朝廷側目。累遷左臺侍御史。奉使江左，經汴州，辱錄事參軍魏傳弓。尋拜監察御史。紹之後坐贓汙，詔傳弓按之，獲贓五千餘貫以聞，當坐死。韋庶人妹保持之，遂黜放為嶺南瓊山尉。傳弓初按紹之，紹之在揚州，色動，謂長吏盧萬石曰：「頃辱傳弓，今為所按，紹之死矣！逃入西京，為萬年尉擒之，擊折其足，因授南陵令員外置，累轉括州長史同正員，不預知州事，死。周利貞周利貞，神龍初為侍御史。附托權要，為桓彥範、敬暉等五王嫉之，出為嘉州司馬。時中書舍人崔湜與桓、敬善。武三思用事禁中，彥範憂之，托心腹於湜。湜反露其計於三思，為三思所中，盡流嶺南。湜勸盡殺之。以絕其歸望。三思問：「誰可使者？利貞即湜之表兄，因舉為此行。利貞至，皆鴆殺之，因擢為左臺御史中丞，為廣州都督。時湜為中書令，與僕射劉幽求不葉，陷幽求徙於嶺表，諷利貞殺之，為桂州都督王晙護之，逗留獲免。無何，玄宗正位，利貞與薛季昶、宋之問同賜死於桂州驛。王旭王旭，太原祁人也。曾祖珪，貞觀初為侍中，尚永寧公主。旭解褐鴻州參軍，轉兗州兵曹。正月，張柬之、桓彥範等誅張易之、昌宗兄弟，尊立孝和皇帝。其兄昌儀先貶乾封尉，旭斬之，賫其首，赴於東都。遷并州錄事參軍。唐隆元年，玄宗誅韋庶人等。并州長史周仁軌，韋氏之黨，有詔誅之。旭不覆敕，又斬其首，馳赴西京，累遷左臺侍御史。時光祿少卿盧崇道以崔湜妻父，貶於嶺外。逃歸，匿於東都，為仇家所發，詔旭究其獄。旭欲擅其威權，因捕崇道親黨數十人，皆極其楚毒，然後結成其罪。崇道及三子並杖死於都亭驛，門生親友皆決杖流貶。時得罪多是知名之士，四海冤之。旭又與御史大夫李傑不葉，遞相糾訐，傑竟左遷衢州刺史。旭既得誌，擅行威福，由是朝廷畏而鄙之。五年，遷左司郎中，常帶侍御史。旭為吏嚴苛，左右無敢支梧，每銜命推劾，一見無不輸款者。時宋王憲府掾紀希虬兄任劍南縣令，被告有贓私，旭使至蜀鞫之。其妻美，旭威逼之，因奏決殺縣令，納贓數千萬。至六年，希虬遣奴詐為祗承人，受顧在臺，事旭累月。旭賞之，召入宅中，委以腹心。其奴密記旭受饋遺囑托事，乃成數千貫，歸謁希虬。希虬銜泣見憲，敘以家冤。憲憫之，執其狀以奏，詔付臺司劾之。贓私累巨萬，貶龍平尉，憤恚而死，甚為時人之所慶快。吉溫吉溫，天官侍郎頊弟琚之孽子也。譎詭能諂事人，遊於中貴門，愛若親戚。性禁害，果於推劾。天寶初，為新豐丞。時太子文學薛嶷承恩幸，引溫入對。玄宗目之而謂嶷曰：「是一不良漢，朕不要也。時蕭炅為河南尹，河南府有事，京臺差溫推詰，事連炅，堅執不舍，賴炅與右相李林甫善，抑而免之。及溫選，炅已為京兆尹，一唱萬年尉，即就其官，人為危之。時驃騎高力士常止宿宮禁，或時出外第，炅必謁焉。溫先馳與力士言謔甚洽，握手呼行第，炅覷之嘆伏。及他日，溫謁炅於府庭，遽布心腹曰：「他日不敢隳國家法，今日已後，洗心事公。炅復與盡歡。會林甫與左相李適之、駙馬張垍不葉，適之兼兵部尚書，垍兄均為兵部侍郎，林甫遣人訐出兵部銓曹主簿事令史六十餘人偽濫事，圖覆其官長，詔出付京兆府與憲司對問。數日，竟不究其由。炅使溫劾之。溫於院中分囚於兩處，溫於後廳佯取兩重囚訊之，或杖或壓，痛苦之聲，所不忍聞。即云：「若存性命，乞紙盡答。令史輩素諳溫，各自誣伏罪，及溫引問，無敢違者。晷刻間事輯，驗囚無栲訊決罰處。常云：「若遇知己，南山白額獸不足縛也。會李林甫將起刑獄，除不附己者，乃引之於門，與羅希奭同鍛煉詔獄。五載，因中官納其外甥武敬一女為盛王琦妃，擢京兆府士曹。時林甫專謀不利於東儲，以左驍衛兵曹柳湜杜良娣妹婿，令溫推之。溫追著作郎王曾、前右司禦率府倉曹王修己、左武衛司戈盧寧、左威衛騎曹徐徵同就臺鞫，數日而獄成。勣等杖死，積屍於大理寺。六載，林甫又以戶部侍郎、兼御史中丞楊慎矜違忤其旨，御史中丞王鉷與慎矜親而嫉之，同構其事，云：「蓄圖讖，以己是隋煬帝子孫，規於興復」，林甫又奏付溫鞫焉，慎矜下獄繫之。使溫於東京收捕其兄少府少監慎餘、弟洛陽令慎名，於汝州捕其門客史敬忠。敬忠頗有學，嘗與朝貴遊。蹉跎不進。與溫父琚情契甚密，溫孩孺時，敬忠嘗抱撫之。溫令河南丞姚開就擒之，鎖其頸，布袂蒙面以見溫。溫驅之於前，不交一言。欲及京，使典誘之云：「楊慎矜今款招己成，須子一辨。若解人意，必活；忤之，必死。敬忠回首曰：「七郎，乞一紙。溫佯不與，見詞懇，乃於桑下令答，三紙辯皆符溫旨。喜曰：「丈人莫相怪！遂徐下拜。及至溫湯，始鞫慎矜，以敬忠詞為證。及再搜其家，不得圖讖。林甫恐事泄，危之，乃使御史盧鉉入搜。鉉乃袖讖書而入，於隱僻中詬而出曰：「逆賊牢藏秘記，今得之矣！指於慎矜小妻韓珠團婢，見舉家惶懼，且行捶擊，誰敢忤焉！獄乃成，慎矜兄弟賜死。溫自是威振，衣冠不敢偶言。溫早以嚴毒聞，頻知詔獄，忍行枉濫，推事未訊問，已作奏狀，計贓數。及被引問，便懾懼，即隨意而書，無敢惜其生者。因不加栲擊，獄成矣。林甫深以溫為能，擢戶部郎中，常帶御史。林甫雖倚以爪牙，溫又見安祿山受主恩，驃騎高力士居中用事，皆附會其間，結為兄弟。常謂祿山曰：「李右相雖觀察人事，親於三兄，必不以兄為宰相。溫雖被驅使，必不超擢。若三兄奏溫為相，即奏兄堪大任，擠出林甫，是兩人必為相矣。祿山悅之。時祿山承恩無敵，驟言溫能，玄宗亦忘曩歲之語。十載，祿山加河東節度，因奏溫為河東節度副使，並知節度營田及管內采訪監察留後事。其載，又加兼雁門太守，仍知安邊郡鑄錢事，賜紫金魚袋。及丁所生憂，祿山又奏起復為本官。尋復奏為魏郡太守、兼侍御史。楊國忠入相，素與溫交通，追入為御史中丞，仍充京畿、關內采訪處置使。溫於范陽辭，祿山令累路館驛作白䌷帳以候之，又令男慶緒出界送，攏馬出驛數十步。及至西京，朝廷動靜，輒報祿山，信宿而達。十三載正月，祿山入朝，拜左僕射，充閑廄使。因奏加溫武部侍郎、兼御史中丞，充閑廄、苑內、營田、五坊等副使。時楊國忠與祿山嫌隙已成，溫轉厚於祿山，國忠又忌之。其冬，河東太守韋陟入奏於華清宮，陟自謂失職，托於溫結歡於祿山，廣載河東土物饋於溫，又及權貴。國忠諷評事吳豸之使鄉人告之，召付中書門下，對法官鞫之，陟伏其狀，貶桂嶺尉，溫澧陽長史。溫判官員錫新興尉。明年，溫又坐贓七千匹及奪人口馬奸穢事發，貶端州高要尉。溫至嶺外，遷延不進，依於張博濟，止於始安郡。八月，遣大理司直蔣沇鞫之。溫死於獄中，博濟及始安太守羅希奭死於州門。初，溫之貶斥，玄宗在華清宮，謂朝臣曰：「吉溫是酷吏子侄，朕被人誑惑，用之至此。屢勸朕起刑獄以作威福，朕不受其言。今去矣，卿等皆可安枕也！初，開元九年，有王鈞為洛陽尉。十八年，有嚴安之為河南丞。皆性毒虐，笞罰人畏其不死，皆杖訖不放起，須其腫憤，徐乃重杖之，懊血流地，苦楚欲死，鈞與安之始眉目喜暢，故人吏懾懼。溫則售身權貴，噬螫衣冠，來頗異耳。溫九月死始興。十一月，祿山起兵作亂，人謂與溫報仇耳。祿山入洛陽城，即偽位。玄宗幸蜀後，祿山求得溫一子，才六七歲，授河南府參軍，給與財帛。初，溫之按楊慎矜，侍御史盧鉉同其事。鉉初為御史，作韋堅判官。及堅為李林甫所嫉，鉉以堅款曲發於林甫，冀售其身。及按慎矜，鉉先與張瑄同臺，情旨素厚，貴取媚於權臣，誣瑄與楊慎矜共解圖讖。持之，為驢駒板橛以成其獄。又為王鉷閑廄判官，鉷緣邢縡事朝堂被推，鉉證云：「大夫將白帖索廄馬五百匹以助逆，我不與之。鉷死在晷刻，鉉忍誣之，眾咸怒恨焉。及被貶為廬江長史，在郡忽見瑄為祟，乃云：「端公何得來乞命？不自由。鉉須臾而卒。羅希奭羅希奭，本杭州人也，近家洛陽，鴻臚少卿張博濟堂外甥。為吏持法深刻。天寶初，右相李林甫引與吉溫持獄，又與希奭姻婭，自御史臺主簿再遷殿中侍御史。自韋堅、皇甫惟明、李適之、柳勣、裴敦復、李邕、鄔元昌、楊慎矜、趙奉璋下獄事，皆與溫鍛煉，故時稱「羅鉗吉網」，惡其深刻也。八載，除刑部員外，轉郎中。十一載，李林甫卒，出為中部、始安二太守，仍充當管經略使。十四載，以張博濟、吉溫，韋陟、韋誡奢、李從一、員錫等流貶，皆於始安，希奭或令假攝。右相楊國忠奏遣司直蔣沇往按之，復令張光奇替為始安太守。仍降敕曰：前始安郡太守、充當管經略使羅希奭，幸此資序，叨居牧守。地列要荒，人多竄殛，尤加委任，冀絕奸訛。翻乃嘯結逋逃，群聚不逞，應是流貶，公然安置。或差攝郡縣，割剝黎氓；或輟借館宇，侵擾人吏。不唯輕侮典憲，實亦隳壞紀綱。擢發數愆，豈多其罪，可貶海東郡海康尉、員外置。張博濟往托回邪，跡惟憑恃，嘗自抵犯，又坐親姻，前後貶官，歲月頗久，逗留不赴，情狀難容。及命按舉，仍更潛匿，亡命逭刑，莫斯為甚。並當切害，合峻常刑，宜於所在各決重杖六十。使夫為政之士，克守章程；負罪之人，期於悛革。凡厥在位，宜各悉心。時員錫、李從一、韋誡奢、吉承恩並決杖，遣司直宇文審往監之。毛若虛毛若虛，絳州太平人也。眉毛覆於眼，其性殘忍。初為蜀川縣尉，使司以推勾見任。天寶末，為武功丞，年已六十餘矣。肅宗收兩京，除監察御史。審國用不足，上策徵剝財貨。有潤於公者，日有進奉，漸見任用稱旨。每推一人，未鞫，即先收其家資，以定贓數。不滿望，即攤徵鄉里近親。峻其威權，人皆懼死，輸納不差晷刻，鳳翔府七坊押官先行剽劫，州縣不能制，因有劫殺事。縣尉謝夷甫因眾怒，遂搒殺之。其妻訴於李輔國，輔國奏請御史孫瑩鞫之。瑩不能正其事。又令中丞崔伯陽三司使雜訊之，又不證成其罪。因令若虛推之，遂歸罪於夷甫。伯陽與之言，若虛頗不遜。伯陽數讓之，若虛馳謁告急。肅宗曰：「卿且出。對曰：「臣出即死矣。肅宗潛留若虛簾內，召伯陽至，伯陽頗短若虛。上怒，叱出之。因流貶伯陽同推官十餘人，皆於嶺外遠惡處。宰相李峴以左右於瑩等，亦被貶斥。於是若虛威震朝列，公卿懾懼矣！尋擢為御史中丞，貶賓化尉而死。敬羽敬羽，寶鼎人也。父昭道，開元初為監察御史。羽貌寢而性便僻，善候人意旨。天寶九載，為康成縣尉。安思順為朔方節度使，引在幕下。及肅宗於靈武即大位，羽尋擢為監察御史。以苛刻徵剝求進。及收兩京後，轉見委任。作大枷，有鹴尾榆，著即悶絕。又臥囚於地，以門關輾其腹，號為「肉餺飥」。掘地為坑，實以棘刺，以敗席覆上，領囚臨坑訊之，必墜其中，萬刺攢之。又捕逐錢貨，不減毛若虛。上元中，擢為御史中丞。太子少傅、宗正卿、鄭國公李遵，為宗子通事舍人李若冰告其贓私，詔羽按之。羽延遵，各危坐於小床。羽小瘦，遵豐碩，頃間問即倒，請垂足。羽曰：「尚書下獄是囚，羽禮延坐，何得慢耶！遵絕倒者數四。請問，羽徐應之，授紙筆，書贓數千貫，奏之。肅宗以勛舊舍之，但停宗正卿。及嗣薛王珍潛謀不軌，詔羽鞫之。羽召支黨羅於廷，索鹴尾榆枷之，布栲訊之具以繞之，信宿成獄。珍坐死，右衛將軍竇如玢、試都水使者崔昌等九人並斬，太子洗馬趙非熊、陳王府長史陳閎、楚州司馬張昴、左武衛兵曹參軍焦自榮，前鳳翔府郿縣主簿李、廣文館進士張夐等六人決殺，駙馬都尉薛履謙賜自盡，左散騎常侍張鎬貶辰州司戶。胡人康謙善賈，資產億萬計。楊國忠為相，授安南都護。至德中，為試鴻臚卿，專知山南東路。驛人嫉之，告其陰通史朝義。謙髭鬚長三尺過帶，按之兩宿，鬢髮皆禿，膝踝亦栲碎，視之者以為鬼物，非人類也。乞舍其生，以後送狀奏殺之，沒其資產。羽與毛若虛在臺五六年間，臺中囚繫不絕。又有裴升、畢曜同為御史，皆酷毒。人之陷刑，當時有毛、敬、裴、畢之稱。裴、畢尋又流黔中。羽，貶為道州刺史。尋有詔殺之，羽聞之，衣兇服南奔溪洞，為吏所擒。臨刑，袖中執州縣官吏犯贓私狀數紙，曰：「有人通此狀，恨不得推究其事。主州政者，無宜寢也。贊曰：王德將衰，政在奸臣。鷹犬搏擊，縱之者人。遭其毒螫，可為悲辛。作法為害，延濫不仁。
