manualTranslations.zh: 其子獻，配流崖州。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Xian was sent into exile in Yazhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Xian was exiled to Yazhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 長安三年，召還。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year of Chang'an he was recalled.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year of Chang'an he was recalled.

manualTranslations.zh: 累授右驍衛大將軍，襲父興昔亡可汗，充安撫招慰十姓大使。
manualTranslations.literal: He rose through appointments to Grand General of the Right Xiaowei Guards, succeeded his father as Khan Irbis She, and served as Commissioner for Pacification and Solicitation of the Ten Surnames.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He rose through appointments to Grand General of the Right Xiaowei Guards, succeeded his father as Khan Irbis She, and served as Commissioner for Pacification and Solicitation of the Ten Surnames.

manualTranslations.zh: 獻本蕃漸為默啜及烏質勒所侵。
manualTranslations.literal: Xian's homeland was gradually encroached upon by Ashina Mochuo and Wuzhile.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xian's homeland was gradually encroached upon by Mochuo and Wuzhile.

manualTranslations.zh: 遂不敢還國。
manualTranslations.literal: He therefore dared not return to his realm.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He therefore dared not return to his realm.

manualTranslations.zh: 開元中，累遷右金吾大將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: During the Kaiyuan reign he was repeatedly promoted, eventually to Grand General of the Right Jinwu Guards.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During the Kaiyuan reign he rose through repeated promotions to Grand General of the Right Jinwu Guards.

manualTranslations.zh: 卒於長安。
manualTranslations.literal: He died in Chang'an.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died in Chang'an.

manualTranslations.zh: 阿史那步真者，在本蕃授左屯衛大將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: Ashina Bozhen had been appointed Grand General of the Left Tunwei Guards in his own realm.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Ashina Bozhen had been appointed Grand General of the Left Tunwei Guards in his own realm.

manualTranslations.zh: 與彌射討平賀魯，加授驃騎大將軍、行右衛大將軍、濛池都護、繼往絕可汗，押五弩失畢部落。
manualTranslations.literal: Together with Mishshe he helped subdue Helu and was additionally appointed General of Agile Cavalry, Acting Grand General of the Right Guards, Protector of Mengchi, and Khan Jiwangjue, given charge of the five Nishibi tribes.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Together with Mishshe he helped subdue Helu and was further appointed General of Agile Cavalry, Acting Grand General of the Right Guards, Protector of Mengchi, and Khan Jiwangjue, with charge of the five Nishibi tribes.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋卒。
manualTranslations.literal: He soon died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He soon died.

manualTranslations.zh: 其子斛瑟羅，本蕃為步利設，垂拱初，授右玉鈐衛將軍兼濛池都護、襲繼往絕可汗，押五弩失畢部落。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Husero, who in his own realm had been Bolu She, in the early Chuigong period was appointed General of the Right Jade Command Guards and Protector of Mengchi, succeeded as Khan Jiwangjue, and was given charge of the five Nishibi tribes.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Husero, who in his own realm had been Bolu She, in the early Chuigong period was appointed General of the Right Jade Command Guards and Protector of Mengchi, succeeded as Khan Jiwangjue, and was given charge of the five Nishibi tribes.

manualTranslations.zh: 天授元年，拜左衛大將軍，改封竭忠事主可汗，仍賜濛池都護。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Tianshou he was appointed Grand General of the Left Guards, re-enfeoffed as Khan Jiezhong Shizhu, and again granted the Protector of Mengchi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tianshou he was appointed Grand General of the Left Guards, re-enfeoffed as Khan Jiezhong Shizhu, and again granted the Protector of Mengchi.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋卒。
manualTranslations.literal: He soon died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He soon died.

manualTranslations.zh: 子懷道，神龍年累授右屯衛大將軍、光祿卿，轉太仆卿兼濛池都護、十姓可汗。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Huaidao, in the Shenlong period, rose through appointments to Grand General of the Right Tunwei Guards and Director of the Imperial Household Service, then was transferred to Director of the Imperial Stud, concurrently Protector of Mengchi and Khan of the Ten Surnames.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Huaidao, in the Shenlong period, rose to Grand General of the Right Tunwei Guards and Director of the Imperial Household Service, then became Director of the Imperial Stud, concurrently Protector of Mengchi and Khan of the Ten Surnames.

manualTranslations.zh: 自垂拱已後，十姓部落頻被突厥默啜侵掠，死散殆盡。
manualTranslations.literal: From Chuigong onward the Ten Surname tribes were repeatedly raided by the Turk Mochuo; the dead and scattered were nearly wiped out.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From Chuigong onward the Ten Surname tribes were repeatedly raided by the Turk Mochuo until the dead and scattered were nearly wiped out.

manualTranslations.zh: 及隨斛瑟羅才六七萬人，徙居內地，西突厥阿史那氏於是遂絕。
manualTranslations.literal: Only about sixty or seventy thousand followed Husero, migrating to settle within the interior. The Ashina clan of the Western Turks thus came to an end.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Only about sixty or seventy thousand followed Husero in migration to the interior. The Ashina line of the Western Turks thus came to an end.

sourceRange.text: 頡利之衰也，兄弟扌勾隙而部族離心。

localRange.text: 頡利之衰也，兄弟抅隙而部族離心。

context.beforeSource: 遇煬帝之亂，亡命蓄怒者既附之，其興也宜哉！
context.afterSource: 當太宗之理，謀臣猛將討逐之，其亡也宜哉！
context.beforeLocal: 遇煬帝之亂，亡命蓄怒者既附之，其興也宜哉！
context.afterLocal: 當太宗之理，謀臣猛將討逐之，其亡也宜哉！

sourceRange.text: 永徽二年，賀魯破北庭，詔將軍梁建方、契苾何力領兵二萬，取回紇五萬騎，大破賀魯，收復北庭。顯慶元年，賀魯又犯邊。詔程知節、蘇定方、任雅相、蕭嗣業領兵並回紇大破賀魯於陰山，再破於金牙山，盡收所據之地，西遂至耶羅川。賀魯西奔石國，婆閏隨蘇定方逐賀魯至石國西北蘇咄城，城主伊涅達幹執賀魯送洛陽。以其地置濛池、昆陵府，以阿史那彌射、阿史那步真為二府都督，統十姓左廂五弩失畢、右廂五咄陸。以賀魯種落分置州縣，西盡波斯。加婆閏右衛大將軍、兼瀚海都督。

context.beforeSource: 回紇不肯西屬突厥。
context.afterSource: 永徽六年，回鶻遣兵隨蕭嗣業討高麗。
context.beforeLocal: 回紇不肯西屬突厥。
context.afterLocal: 永徽六年，回鶻遣兵隨蕭嗣業討高麗。

manualTranslations.zh: 永徽二年，賀魯破北庭，詔將軍梁建方、契苾何力領兵二萬，取回紇五萬騎，大破賀魯，收復北庭。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Yonghui, Helu captured Beiting; an edict ordered Generals Liang Jianfang and Qibi Heli to lead twenty thousand troops, taking fifty thousand Huihe horsemen, to inflict a great defeat on Helu and recover Beiting.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Yonghui 2, Helu seized Beiting; Generals Liang Jianfang and Qibi Heli were sent with twenty thousand Tang troops and fifty thousand Huihe cavalry to crush Helu and retake Beiting.

manualTranslations.zh: 顯慶元年，賀魯又犯邊。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Xianqing, Helu again raided the border.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Xianqing 1, Helu raided the frontier again.

manualTranslations.zh: 詔程知節、蘇定方、任雅相、蕭嗣業領兵並回紇大破賀魯於陰山，再破於金牙山，盡收所據之地，西遂至耶羅川。
manualTranslations.literal: An edict ordered Cheng Zhijie, Su Dingfang, Ren Yaxiang, and Xiao Siye to lead troops together with the Huihe to inflict a great defeat on Helu at Yinshan, defeat him again at Jinyashan, recover all the territory he held, and advance west as far as the Yalu River.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Cheng Zhijie, Su Dingfang, Ren Yaxiang, and Xiao Siye were ordered out with Huihe allies to rout Helu at Yinshan and again at Golden Tooth Mountain, reclaiming his lands and pushing west to the Yalu River.

manualTranslations.zh: 賀魯西奔石國，婆閏隨蘇定方逐賀魯至石國西北蘇咄城，城主伊涅達幹執賀魯送洛陽。
manualTranslations.literal: Helu fled west to Shiguo; Po Yen followed Su Dingfang in pursuit of Helu to Sudu City northwest of Shiguo; the city lord Yiniedagan seized Helu and sent him to Luoyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Helu fled west into the kingdom of Shiguo; Po Yen followed Su Dingfang to Sudu City northwest of Shiguo, where the lord Yiniedagan captured Helu and sent him to Luoyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 以其地置濛池、昆陵府，以阿史那彌射、阿史那步真為二府都督，統十姓左廂五弩失畢、右廂五咄陸。
manualTranslations.literal: On his former lands the Mengchi and Kunling protectorates were established; Ashina Mishe and Ashina Buzhen were made commanders of the two protectorates, ruling the ten surnames — the five Nushibi of the left wing and the five Tulu of the right wing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His territory was organized as the Mengchi and Kunling protectorates under Ashina Mishe and Ashina Buzhen, who governed the ten tribes—the five Nushibi of the left wing and the five Tulu of the right.

manualTranslations.zh: 以賀魯種落分置州縣，西盡波斯。
manualTranslations.literal: Helu's clans and tribes were distributed into prefectures and counties, west as far as Persia.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Helu's people were settled in prefectures and counties stretching west to Persia.

manualTranslations.zh: 加婆閏右衛大將軍、兼瀚海都督。
manualTranslations.literal: Po Yen was further made General of the Right Guard and concurrently Commander of Hanhai.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Po Yen was further promoted to General of the Right Guard and retained command of Hanhai.

sourceRange.text: 德宗初即位，使中官梁文秀告哀於回紇，且修舊好，可汗移地健不為禮。而九姓胡素屬於回紇者，又陳中國便利以誘其心，可汗乃舉國南下，將乘我喪。其宰相頓莫賀達幹諫曰：「唐，大國也，且無負於我。前年入太原，獲羊馬數萬計，可謂大捷矣。以道途艱阻，比及國，傷耗殆盡。今若舉而不捷，將安歸乎？」可汗不聽。頓莫賀乘人之心，因擊殺之，並殺其親信及九姓胡所誘來者凡二千人。

context.beforeSource: 先是，辛雲京守太原，回紇懼雲京，不敢窺並、代，知鮑防無武略，乃敢淩逼，賴光晟邀戰勝之，北人乃安。
context.afterSource: 頓莫賀自立號為合骨咄祿毗伽可汗，使其酋長建達幹隨文秀來朝。
context.beforeLocal: 先是，辛雲京守太原，回紇懼雲京，不敢窺並、代，知鮑防無武略，乃敢淩逼，賴光晟邀戰勝之，北人乃安。
context.afterLocal: 頓莫賀自立號為合骨咄祿毗伽可汗，使其酋長建達幹隨文秀來朝。

manualTranslations.zh: 德宗初即位，使中官梁文秀告哀於回紇，且修舊好，可汗移地健不為禮。
manualTranslations.literal: When Dezong first took the throne, he sent palace official Liang Wenxiu to announce mourning to the Huihe and also restore the old friendship; Qaghan Yidi Jian showed no courtesy.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Dezong first ascended the throne he sent the palace official Liang Wenxiu to announce the mourning and renew the old alliance, but Qaghan Yidi Jian received him without courtesy.

manualTranslations.zh: 而九姓胡素屬於回紇者，又陳中國便利以誘其心，可汗乃舉國南下，將乘我喪。
manualTranslations.literal: Moreover, Sogdians who had long belonged to the Huihe also set forth China's advantages to entice his heart; the qaghan thereupon led the whole nation southward, intending to take advantage of our mourning.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sogdians long subject to the Huihe also painted China's riches before him, and the qaghan marched the whole nation south to exploit the dynasty's mourning.

manualTranslations.zh: 其宰相頓莫賀達幹諫曰：「唐，大國也，且無負於我。
manualTranslations.literal: His chancellor Dun Mohedagan remonstrated, saying: "Tang is a great state, and moreover has not wronged us.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His chancellor Dun Mohedagan remonstrated: "Tang is a great power and has done us no wrong.

manualTranslations.zh: 前年入太原，獲羊馬數萬計，可謂大捷矣。
manualTranslations.literal: The year before last we entered Taiyuan and obtained tens of thousands of sheep and horses — this can be called a great victory.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Two years ago we entered Taiyuan and took tens of thousands of sheep and horses—a great victory already.

manualTranslations.zh: 以道途艱阻，比及國，傷耗殆盡。
manualTranslations.literal: Because the road was hard and perilous, by the time we reached our country the losses were nearly complete.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The road home was hard, and by the time we reached our lands the spoils were nearly gone.

manualTranslations.zh: 今若舉而不捷，將安歸乎？」
manualTranslations.literal: If we now mobilize and do not succeed, where shall we return?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: If we march now and fail, where shall we go back to?

manualTranslations.zh: 可汗不聽。
manualTranslations.literal: The qaghan would not listen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The qaghan would not heed him.

manualTranslations.zh: 頓莫賀乘人之心，因擊殺之，並殺其親信及九姓胡所誘來者凡二千人。
manualTranslations.literal: Dun Mohe seized upon men's hearts, and thereupon struck and killed him, also killing his close confidants and those the Sogdians had enticed to come, altogether two thousand men.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Dun Mohe seized the moment, killed the qaghan, and slaughtered his confidants and the two thousand Sogdians who had urged the invasion.

sourceRange.text: 咸議姑息。

localRange.text: 鹹議姑息。

context.beforeSource: 恃功伊何？
context.afterSource: 民不聊生，國殫其力。
context.beforeLocal: 恃功伊何？
context.afterLocal: 民不聊生，國殫其力。

sourceRange.text: 回紇，其先匈奴之裔也。在後魏時，號鐵勒部落。其象微小，其俗驍強，依托高車，臣屬突厥，近謂之特勒。無君長，居無恆所，隨水草流移。人性兇忍，善騎射，貪婪尤甚，以寇抄為生。自突厥有國，東西征討，皆資其用，以制北荒。隋開皇末，晉王廣北征突厥，大破步迦可汗，特勒於是分散。大業元年，突厥處羅可汗擊特勒諸部，厚斂其物。又猜忌薛延陀，恐為變，遂集其渠帥數百人盡誅之，特勒由是叛。特勒始有仆骨、同羅、回紇、拔野古、覆羅步，號俟斤，後稱回紇焉。在薛延陀北境，居娑陵水側，去長安六千九百里。隨逐水草，勝兵五萬，人口十萬人。

context.afterSource: 初，有特健俟斤死，有子曰菩薩，部落以為賢而立之。
context.afterLocal: 初，有特健俟斤死，有子曰菩薩，部落以為賢而立之。

manualTranslations.zh: 回紇，其先匈奴之裔也。
manualTranslations.literal: The Huihe — their forebears were descendants of the Xiongnu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Huihe were originally of Xiongnu descent.

manualTranslations.zh: 在後魏時，號鐵勒部落。
manualTranslations.literal: In the time of the Later Wei, they were called the Tiele tribal confederation.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During the Northern Wei they were known as the Tiele tribes.

manualTranslations.zh: 其象微小，其俗驍強，依托高車，臣屬突厥，近謂之特勒。
manualTranslations.literal: Their standing was slight, their customs fierce and strong; they relied on the Gaochar and were subjects of the Turks, and in recent times were called Tiele.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They were a minor power with a fierce martial culture, leaning on the Gaochar and owing allegiance to the Turks; more recently they were known as the Tiele.

manualTranslations.zh: 無君長，居無恆所，隨水草流移。
manualTranslations.literal: They had no paramount chief, no fixed abode, and moved wherever grass and water took them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They had no single ruler and no permanent settlements, wandering with the pasturage.

manualTranslations.zh: 人性兇忍，善騎射，貪婪尤甚，以寇抄為生。
manualTranslations.literal: Their nature was cruel and fierce; they were skilled at mounted archery, exceedingly greedy, and made their living by raiding.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They were brutal by nature, expert horsemen and archers, and extraordinarily rapacious, living by plunder.

manualTranslations.zh: 自突厥有國，東西征討，皆資其用，以制北荒。
manualTranslations.literal: From the time the Turks had a state, in their campaigns east and west they always drew on the Tiele for use in controlling the northern wilds.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Once the Turkic khaganate arose, it relied on them in every eastern and western campaign to hold the northern frontier.

manualTranslations.zh: 隋開皇末，晉王廣北征突厥，大破步迦可汗，特勒於是分散。
manualTranslations.literal: At the end of the Kaihuang era of Sui, Prince of Jin Yang Guang campaigned north against the Turks and greatly defeated Qaghan Buka; the Tiele thereupon scattered.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the late Kaihuang period, Prince Yang Guang of Jin led a northern expedition against the Turks and routed Qaghan Buka, after which the Tiele split apart.

manualTranslations.zh: 大業元年，突厥處羅可汗擊特勒諸部，厚斂其物。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Daye, the Turkic Qaghan Chuluo attacked the Tiele tribes and heavily levied their goods.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Daye 1 (605), the Turkic qaghan Chuluo attacked the Tiele tribes and exacted heavy tribute from them.

manualTranslations.zh: 又猜忌薛延陀，恐為變，遂集其渠帥數百人盡誅之，特勒由是叛。
manualTranslations.literal: He also grew suspicious of the Xueyantuo, fearing they would rebel, and so assembled several hundred of their chieftains and executed them all; the Tiele therefore revolted.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Suspecting the Xueyantuo of plotting rebellion, he summoned several hundred of their chiefs and put them all to death, and the Tiele rose in revolt.

manualTranslations.zh: 特勒始有仆骨、同羅、回紇、拔野古、覆羅步，號俟斤，後稱回紇焉。
manualTranslations.literal: Among the Tiele there were at first the Pugu, Tongluo, Huihe, Bayegu, and Fuluo tribes, called irkin; later they came to be called Huihe.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Tiele confederation initially comprised the Pugu, Tongluo, Huihe, Bayegu, and Fuluo tribes under the title irkin; in time they took the name Huihe.

manualTranslations.zh: 在薛延陀北境，居娑陵水側，去長安六千九百里。
manualTranslations.literal: They lay on the northern border of the Xueyantuo, dwelling beside the Selenga River, six thousand nine hundred li from Chang'an.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They lived north of the Xueyantuo along the Selenga River, some six thousand nine hundred li from Chang'an.

manualTranslations.zh: 隨逐水草，勝兵五萬，人口十萬人。
manualTranslations.literal: They followed grass and water; their fighting men numbered fifty thousand, their population one hundred thousand.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They moved with the pastures; they could field fifty thousand warriors and numbered one hundred thousand people in all.

sourceRange.text: 咸亨元年四月，詔以右威衛大將軍薛仁貴為邏婆道行軍大總管，左衛員外大將軍阿史那道真、右衛將軍郭待封為副，率眾十余萬以討之。軍至大非川，為吐蕃大將論欽陵所敗，仁貴等並坐除名。吐谷渾全國盡沒，唯慕容諾曷缽及其親信數千帳來內屬，仍徙於靈州。自是吐蕃連歲寇邊，當、悉等州諸羌盡降之。

context.beforeSource: 吐谷渾大敗，河源王慕容諾曷缽及弘化公主脫身走投涼州，遣使告急。
context.afterSource: 上元三年，進寇鄯、廓等州，殺掠人吏，高宗命尚書左僕射劉仁軌往洮河軍鎮守以禦之。

sourceRange.text: 久視元年，吐蕃又遣其將趨莽布支寇涼州，圍逼昌松縣。隴右諸軍州大使唐休璟與莽布支戰於洪源谷，斬其副將二人，獲首二千五百級。長安二年，贊普率眾萬余人寇悉州，都督陳大慈與賊凡四戰，皆破之，斬首千余級。於是吐蕃遣使論彌薩等入朝請求和，則天宴之於麟德殿，奏百戲於殿庭。論彌薩曰：「臣生於邊荒，由來不識中國音樂，乞放臣親觀。」則天許之。於是論彌薩等相視笑忭拜謝曰：「臣自歸投聖朝，前後禮數優渥，又得親觀奇樂，一生所未見。自顧微瑣，何以仰答天恩，區區褊心，唯願大家萬歲。」明年，又遣使獻馬千匹、金二千兩以求婚，則天許之。

sourceRange.text: 吐蕃，在長安之西八千里，本漢西羌之地也。其種落莫知所出也，或云南涼禿發利鹿孤之後也。利鹿孤有子曰樊尼，及利鹿孤卒，樊尼尚幼，弟傉檀嗣位，以樊尼為安西將軍。後魏神瑞元年，傉檀為西秦乞佛熾盤所滅，樊尼招集余眾，以投沮渠蒙遜，蒙遜以為臨松太守。及蒙遜滅，樊尼乃率眾西奔，濟黃河，逾積石，於羌中建國，開地千里。樊尼威惠夙著，為群羌所懷，皆撫以恩信，歸之如市。遂改姓為窣勃野，以禿發為國號，語訛謂之吐蕃，其後子孫繁昌，又侵伐不息，土宇漸廣。歷周及隋，猶隔諸羌，未通於中國。

sourceRange.text: 二十一年二月，順宗命佐金吾衛將軍、兼御史中丞田景度持節告哀於吐蕃，以庫部員外郎、兼御史中丞熊執易為副使。七月，吐蕃使論悉諾等來朝。永貞元年十月，贊普使論乞縷勃藏來貢，助德宗山陵金銀、衣服、牛馬等。十一月，以衛尉少卿、兼御史中丞侯幼平充入蕃告冊立等使。元和元年正月，福建道送到吐蕃生口十七人，詔給遞乘放還蕃。六月，遣使論勃藏來朝。五年五月，遣使論思耶熱來朝，並歸鄭叔矩、路泌之柩及叔矩男文延等一十三人。叔矩、泌，平涼之盟陷焉，凡二十餘年，竟不屈節，因沒於蕃中，至是請和，故歸之。六月，命宰相杜佑等與吐蕃使議事中書令廳，且言歸我秦、原、安樂州地。七月，遣鴻臚少卿、攝御史中丞李銘為入蕃使，丹王府長史、兼侍御史吳暈副之。六年至十年，遣使朝貢不絕。十二年四月，吐蕃以贊普卒來告，以右衛將軍烏重兼御史中丞，充吊祭使，殿中侍御史段鈞副之。

context.beforeSource: 十二月，遣使論襲執、郭誌崇來朝。
context.afterSource: 十三年十月，吐蕃圍我宥州、鳳翔，上言遣使修好。

manualTranslations.zh: 二十一年二月，順宗命佐金吾衛將軍、兼御史中丞田景度持節告哀於吐蕃，以庫部員外郎、兼御史中丞熊執易為副使。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second month of the twenty-first year, Shunzong ordered Tian Jingdu, Assistant General of the Left Golden Guard Army and concurrent Vice Censor-in-Chief, to bear credentials and announce mourning to Tibet, with Xiong Zhiyi, Vice Director of the Treasury Bureau and concurrent Vice Censor-in-Chief, as deputy envoy.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second month of the twenty-first year, Shunzong ordered Tian Jingdu, Assistant General of the Left Golden Guard Army and concurrent Vice Censor-in-Chief, to bear credentials and announce mourning to Tibet, with Xiong Zhiyi, Vice Director of the Treasury Bureau and concurrent Vice Censor-in-Chief, as deputy envoy.

manualTranslations.zh: 七月，吐蕃使論悉諾等來朝。
manualTranslations.literal: In the seventh month, the Tibetan envoys Lun Xinuo and others came to court.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Tibetan envoys led by Lun Xinuo came to court.

manualTranslations.zh: 永貞元年十月，贊普使論乞縷勃藏來貢，助德宗山陵金銀、衣服、牛馬等。
manualTranslations.literal: In the tenth month of the first year of Yongzhen, the tsenpo's envoy Lun Qilü Bocang came bearing tribute, presenting gold and silver, clothing, cattle, and horses to assist Dezong's mausoleum.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of Yongzhen 1 (805), the tsenpo's envoy Lun Qilü Bocang came bearing tribute of gold and silver, clothing, cattle, and horses to assist Dezong's mausoleum.

manualTranslations.zh: 十一月，以衛尉少卿、兼御史中丞侯幼平充入蕃告冊立等使。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eleventh month, Hou Youping, Vice Director of the Court of the Imperial Stud and concurrent Vice Censor-in-Chief, was appointed envoy to enter Tibet to announce the enthronement and related matters.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Hou Youping, Vice Director of the Court of the Imperial Stud and concurrent Vice Censor-in-Chief, was appointed envoy to Tibet to announce the enthronement and related matters.

manualTranslations.zh: 元和元年正月，福建道送到吐蕃生口十七人，詔給遞乘放還蕃。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Yuanhe, the Fujian circuit delivered seventeen Tibetan captives; an edict ordered relay transport provided and their release back to Tibet.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first month of Yuanhe 1 (806), the Fujian circuit delivered seventeen Tibetan captives; an edict ordered relay transport and their release back to Tibet.

manualTranslations.zh: 六月，遣使論勃藏來朝。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth month, envoys led by Lun Bocang were dispatched to come to court.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Tibet sent envoys led by Lun Bocang to the capital.

manualTranslations.zh: 五年五月，遣使論思耶熱來朝，並歸鄭叔矩、路泌之柩及叔矩男文延等一十三人。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth month of the fifth year, envoys led by Lun Siyere came to court, and the coffins of Zheng Shuju and Lu Bi were returned, together with Shuju's son Wenyuan and twelve others.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the fifth year, envoys led by Lun Siyere came to court, returning the coffins of Zheng Shuju and Lu Bi along with Shuju's son Wenyuan and twelve others.

manualTranslations.zh: 叔矩、泌，平涼之盟陷焉，凡二十餘年，竟不屈節，因沒於蕃中，至是請和，故歸之。
manualTranslations.literal: Shuju and Bi had been trapped at the Pingliang alliance; for more than twenty years they never yielded their integrity and therefore perished in Tibet; now, because peace was sought, they were returned.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shuju and Bi had been captured at the Pingliang alliance; for more than twenty years they never yielded, and died in Tibet. Now, with peace sought, their remains were returned.

manualTranslations.zh: 六月，命宰相杜佑等與吐蕃使議事中書令廳，且言歸我秦、原、安樂州地。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth month, Chief Minister Du You and others were ordered to discuss affairs with the Tibetan envoys in the Chief Minister's Hall of the Secretariat, and also to speak of returning to us the territories of Qin, Yuan, and Anle prefectures.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Chief Minister Du You and others were ordered to meet Tibetan envoys in the Chief Minister's Hall of the Secretariat and to demand the return of Qin, Yuan, and Anle prefectures.

manualTranslations.zh: 七月，遣鴻臚少卿、攝御史中丞李銘為入蕃使，丹王府長史、兼侍御史吳暈副之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the seventh month, Li Ming, Vice Chamberlain for Dependencies and acting Vice Censor-in-Chief, was sent as envoy to enter Tibet, with Wu Yun, Chief Clerk of the Prince of Dan's household and concurrent Attending Censor, as deputy.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Li Ming, Vice Chamberlain for Dependencies and acting Vice Censor-in-Chief, was sent to Tibet, with Wu Yun, Chief Clerk of the Prince of Dan's household and concurrent Attending Censor, as deputy.

manualTranslations.zh: 六年至十年，遣使朝貢不絕。
manualTranslations.literal: From the sixth through the tenth year, envoys were sent in tribute without interruption.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From the sixth through the tenth year, tribute missions continued without interruption.

manualTranslations.zh: 十二年四月，吐蕃以贊普卒來告，以右衛將軍烏重兼御史中丞，充吊祭使，殿中侍御史段鈞副之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth month of the twelfth year, Tibet announced the death of the tsenpo; Wu Chong, General of the Right Guard Army and concurrent Vice Censor-in-Chief, was appointed mourning envoy, with Duan Jun, Palace Attending Censor, as deputy.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the twelfth year, Tibet announced the tsenpo's death; Wu Chong, General of the Right Guard Army and concurrent Vice Censor-in-Chief, was appointed mourning envoy, with Palace Attending Censor Duan Jun as deputy.

sourceRange.text: 十二月，吐蕃千餘人圍烏、白池。長慶元年六月，犯青塞堡，以我與回紇和親故也。鹽州刺史李文悅發兵進擊之。九月，吐蕃遣使請盟，上許之。宰相欲重其事，請告太廟，太常禮院奏曰：「謹按肅宗、代宗故事，與吐蕃會盟，並不告廟。唯德宗建中末，與吐蕃會盟於延平門，欲重其誠信，特令告廟。至貞元三年，會於平涼，亦無告廟之文。伏以事出一時，又非經制，求之典禮，亦無其文。今謹參詳，恐不合告。」從之。乃命大理卿、兼御史大夫劉元鼎充西蕃盟會使，以兵部郎中、兼御史中丞劉師老為副，尚舍奉禦、兼監察御史李武、京兆府奉先縣丞兼監察御史李公度為判官。十月十日，與吐蕃使盟，宰臣及右僕射、六曹尚書、中執法、太常、司農卿、京兆尹、金吾大將軍皆預焉。其詞曰：維唐承天，撫有八纮，聲教所臻，靡不來廷。

localRange.text: 十二月，吐蕃千余人圍烏、白池。維唐承天，撫有八纮，聲教所臻，靡不來廷。

The Court of Imperial Sacrifices memorialized: "Reviewing the precedents of Suzong and Daizong, alliances with Tibet were not announced at the temple.

manualTranslations.zh: 唯德宗建中末，與吐蕃會盟於延平門，欲重其誠信，特令告廟。
manualTranslations.literal: Only at the end of Jianzhong under Dezong, when alliance was concluded with Tibet at Yanping Gate, wishing to emphasize sincerity and trust, was announcement at the temple specially ordered.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Only at the end of Jianzhong under Dezong, when an alliance with Tibet was concluded at Yanping Gate to emphasize sincerity, was the temple specially notified.

manualTranslations.zh: 至貞元三年，會於平涼，亦無告廟之文。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: We submit that this was a one-time matter, not a standing institution, and canonical ritual provides no precedent for it.

sourceRange.text: 二十一年，伊嗣候遣使獻一獸，名活褥蛇，形類鼠而色青，身長八九寸，能入穴取鼠。伊嗣候懦弱，為大首領所逐，遂奔吐火羅，未至，亦為大食兵所殺。其子名卑路斯，又投吐火羅葉護，獲免。卑路斯龍朔元年奏言頻被大食侵擾，請兵救援。詔遣隴州南由縣令王名遠充使西域，分置州縣，因列其地疾陵城為波斯都督府，授卑路斯為都督。是後數遣使貢獻。咸亨中，卑路斯自來入朝，高宗甚加恩賜，拜右武衛將軍。儀鳳三年，令吏部侍郎裴行儉將兵冊送卑路斯為波斯王，行儉以其路遠，至安西碎葉而還，卑路斯獨返，不得入其國，漸為大食所侵，客於吐火羅國二十餘年，有部落數千人，後漸離散。

sourceRange.text: 長慶二年十二月，遣使金柱弼朝貢。寶曆元年，其王子金昕來朝。太和元年四月，皆遣使朝貢。五年，金彥升卒，以嗣子金景徽爲開府儀同三司、檢校太尉、使侍節大都督雞林州諸軍事，兼持節充甯海軍使、新羅王；景徽母樸氏爲太妃，妻朴氏爲妃。命太子左諭德、兼御史中丞源寂持節弔祭冊立。開成元年，王子金義琮來謝恩，兼宿衛。二年四月，放還籓，賜物遣之。五年四月，鴻臚寺奏：新羅國告哀，質子及年滿合歸國學生等共一百五人，並放還。會昌元年七月，敕：「歸國新羅官、前入新羅宣慰副使、前充兗州都督府司馬、賜緋魚袋金雲卿，可淄州長史。」者，古也。去京師一萬四千里，在東南大海中，依山島而居。東西五月行，南北三月行。世與中國通。

sourceRange.text: 貞觀元年，太宗賜其王璽書曰：「王世爲君長，撫有東蕃。海隅遐曠，風濤艱阻，忠款之至，職貢相尋，尚想徽猷，甚以嘉慰！朕自祗承寵命，君臨區宇，思弘王道，愛育黎元。舟車所通，風雨所及，期之遂性，咸使乂安。新羅王金真平，朕之籓臣，王之鄰國。每聞遣師，征討不息，阻兵安忍，殊乖所望。朕已對王侄信福及高麗、新羅使人，具敕通和，咸許輯睦。王必須忘彼前怨，識朕本懷，共篤鄰情，即停兵革。」璋因遣使奉表陳謝，雖外稱順命，內實相仇如故。十一年，遣使來朝，獻鐵甲雕斧。太宗優勞之，賜彩帛三千段並錦袍等。

sourceRange.text: 乾封元年，高藏遣其子入朝，陪位於太山之下。其年，蓋蘇文死，其子男生代爲莫離支，與其弟男建、男產不睦，各樹朋黨，以相攻擊。男生爲二弟所逐，走據國內城死守，其子獻誠詣闕求哀。詔令左驍衛大將軍契苾何力率兵應接之。男生脫身來奔，詔授特進、遼東大都督兼平壤道安撫大使，封玄菟郡公。十一月，命司空、英國公李勣爲遼東道行軍大總管，率裨將郭待封等以征高麗。

sourceRange.text: 高藏以永淳初卒，贈衛尉卿，詔送至京師，於頡利墓左賜以葬地，兼爲樹碑。垂拱二年，又封高藏孫寶元爲朝鮮郡王。聖曆元年，進授左鷹揚衛大將軍，封爲忠誠國王，委其統攝安東舊戶，事竟不行。二年，又授高藏男德武爲安東都督，以領本蕃。自是高麗舊戶在安東者漸寡少。分投突厥及靺鞨等，高氏君長遂絕矣！

sourceRange.text: 元和元年十一月，放宿衛王子金獻忠歸本國，仍加試秘書監。三年，遣使金力奇來朝。其年七月，力奇上言：「貞元十六年，奉詔冊臣故主金俊邕爲新羅王，母申氏爲太妃，妻叔氏爲王妃。冊使韋丹至中路，知俊邕薨，其冊卻回，在中書省。今臣還國，伏請授臣以歸。」敕：「金俊邕等冊，宜令鴻臚寺於中書省受領，至寺宣授與金力奇，令奉歸國。仍賜其叔彥升門戟，令本國准例給。」四年，遣使金陸珍等來朝貢。五年，王子金憲章來朝貢。

sourceRange.text: 總章元年九月，勣又移營于平壤城南，男建頻遣兵出戰，皆大敗。男建下捉兵總管僧信誠密遣人詣軍中，許開城門爲內應。經五日，信誠果開門，勣從兵入，登城鼓噪，燒城門樓，四面火起。男建窘急自刺，不死。十一月，拔平壤城，虜高藏、男建等。十二月，至京師，獻俘于含元宮。詔以高藏政不由己，授司平太常伯；男產先降，授司宰少卿；男建配流黔州；男生以鄉導有功，授右衛大將軍，封汴國公，特進如故。

sourceRange.text: 延和元年，左羽林將軍、檢校幽州大都督孫儉，率兵十二萬以襲其部落，師次冷硎，前軍左驍衛將軍李楷洛等與大輔會戰，我師敗績。儉懼，不敢進救，遣使矯報大輔云：「我奉敕來此招諭蕃將，李楷洛等不受節度而輒用兵，請斬以謝。」大輔曰：「若奉敕招諭，有何國信物？」儉率軍中繒帛萬余段並袍帶以與之。大輔曰：「將軍可南還，無相驚擾。」儉軍漸失部伍，大輔乃率衆逼之，由是大敗，兵士死傷者數萬。儉及副將周以悌爲大輔所擒，送於突厥默啜，並遇害。

sourceRange.text: 嵩璘父欽茂，開元中，襲父位爲郡王、左金吾大將軍。天寶中，累加特進、太子詹事、賓客。寶應元年，進封國王。大曆中，累加拜司空、太尉。及嵩璘襲位，但授其郡王、將軍而已。嵩璘遣使敘理，故再加冊命。十一月，以王侄大能信爲左驍衛中郎將、虞候、婁蕃長，都督茹富仇爲右武衛將軍，放還。

context.beforeSource: 十四年，加銀青光祿大夫、檢校司空，進封渤海國王。
context.afterSource: 二十一年，遣使來朝。

sourceRange.text: 寶應元年十月，遣元帥雍王領河東朔方諸節度、回紇兵馬赴陝。僕固懷恩與回紇左殺為先鋒，魚朝恩、郭英乂為後殿，自澠池入；李抱玉自河陽入；副元帥李光弼自陳留入；雍王留陝州。二十九日，與朝義戰於邙山之下。逆賊敗績，走渡河，斬首萬六千，生擒四千六百，降三萬二千人，器械不可勝數。朝義走投汴州，汴州偽將張獻誠拒之，乃渡河北投幽州。二年正月，賊偽范陽節度李懷仙于莫州生擒之，送款來降，梟首至闕下。又以偽官以城降者恆州刺史、成德軍節度張忠志為禮部尚書，余如故。趙州刺史盧淑、定州程元勝、徐州劉如伶、相州節度薛嵩、幽州李懷仙、鄭州田承嗣並加封爵，領舊職。

context.beforeSource: 諸節度使皆祿山舊將，與思明等夷，朝義徵召不至。
context.afterSource: 思明乾元二年僭號，至朝義寶應元年滅，凡四年。

sourceRange.text: 天寶元年，拜左領軍倉曹參軍同正員。六載，安祿山奏為平盧掌書記，出入祿山臥內。祿山肥多睡，尚執筆在旁或通宵焉，由是浸親厚之。遂與祿山解圖讖，勸其反。

context.beforeSource: 無何，令妻父呂令皓特表薦之。

sourceRange.text: 明日，聲言以關王權主社稷，士庶競往觀之。八日，源休、姚令言、李忠臣、張光晟等八人導泚自白華入宣政殿，僭即偽位，自稱大秦皇帝，號應天元年，愚智莫不憤心。侍衛皆卒伍，行列不過十餘人。下偽詔曰：「幽囚之中。神器自至，豈朕薄德所能經營。」彭偃之詞也。偽署姚令言為侍中，李忠臣為司空、兼侍中，源休為中書侍郎、平章事、判度支，蔣鎮為吏部侍郎，樊系為禮部侍郎、禮儀使，許季常為京兆尹，洪經綸為太常少卿，彭偃為中書舍人，裴揆、崔幼貞為給事中，崔莫為御史中丞，張光晟、仇敬忠、敬釭、張寶、何望之、段誠諫、張庭芝、杜如江為節度使，仍以其兄子遂為太子，遙封弟滔為冀王。太尉、尚書令，尋又號皇太弟。

sourceRange.text: 秦宗權者，許州人，為郡牙將。廣明元年880年十月，巢賊渡淮而北。十一月，忠武軍亂，逐其帥薛能。是月，朝廷授別校周岌為許帥。初軍城未變，宗權因調發至蔡州，聞府軍亂，乃閱集蔡州之兵，欲赴難。俄聞府主殂，周岌未至，巢賊充斥，日寇郡城，宗權乃督勵士眾，登城拒守。洎岌至，即令典郡事。天子幸蜀，姑務翦寇，上蔡有勁兵萬人，宗權即與監軍楊復光同議勤王，出師破賊，以蔡牧授之，仍置節度之號。
